

/* SOURCE_FILE: /storage/emulated/0/Map Check/reports/V15_SOURCE_EXTRACTED/Assembly-CSharp/Achievements.cs

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Beam;
using Beam.AccountServices;
using Beam.Crafting;
using Beam.Events;
using Beam.Obfuscated.Users;
using Beam.Serialization.Json;
using Beam.UI;
using Beam.Utilities;
using Beam.Utilities.Reflection;
using Funlabs;
using UnityEngine;

public class Achievements : MonoBehaviour, INeedPlayerComponent, ISaveable
{
	private const int FISH_ARE_FRIENDS_GOAL = 10;

	private const int VEGETARIAN_GOAL = 10;

	private const int ISLAND_HERMIT_GOAL = 10;

	private const int DAY_10_GOAL = 10;

	private const int DAY_20_GOAL = 20;

	private const int DAY_50_GOAL = 50;

	private const int DAY_100_GOAL = 100;

	private const int FISHING_SEASON_OPEN_GOAL = 1;

	private const int SEA_HARVEST_GOAL = 10;

	private const int ISLAND_HOPPER_GOAL = 1;

	private const int ANOTHER_DAY_SHORE_GOAL = 5;

	private const int COLUMBUS_GOAL = 10;

	private const int WORKING_WITH_HANDS_GOAL = 20;

	private const int LEAN_MEAN_CRAFTING_GOAL = 40;

	private const int CALL_ME_AHAB_GOAL = 3;

	private const int INDUSTRIAL_FASHION_GOAL = 10;

	private const int THIS_SPARKS_JOY_GOAL = 100;

	private IPlayer _player;

	private bool _usedLoom;

	private bool _usedCompass;

	private int _daysWithoutHop;

	private int _daysWithoutFish;

	private int _daysWithoutMeat;

	private int _toolsCrafted;

	private int _corrugatedFurnitureCrafted;

	private int _sheltersScavenged;

	private int _pilesCrafted;

	private bool[] _achieved;

	IPlayer INeedPlayerComponent.Player => _player;

	private bool GetAchieved(EAchievement ach)
	{
		if (ach > EAchievement.HORRIFIC_PACIFIC && (int)ach < _achieved.Length)
		{
			return _achieved[(int)ach];
		}
		return false;
	}

	private void SetAchieved(EAchievement ach, bool value)
	{
		if (ach > EAchievement.HORRIFIC_PACIFIC && (int)ach < _achieved.Length)
		{
			_achieved[(int)ach] = value;
		}
	}

	private void Awake()
	{
		int num = Enum.GetNames(typeof(EAchievement)).Length;
		_achieved = new bool[num];
	}

	public void SetPlayer(IPlayer player)
	{
		if ((Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer() && !player.IsOwner) || (!Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer() && player.Id != 0))
		{
			enabled = false;
			return;
		}
		_player = player;
		if (Game.State == GameState.NEW_GAME || Game.State == GameState.LOAD_GAME)
		{
			_player.Crafter.Crafted += Crafter_Crafted;
			_player.Statistics.Ate += Statistics_Ate;
			_player.Statistics.PlayerEffectApplied += Statistics_PlayerEffectApplied;
			Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.DayTick += GameTime_DayTick;
			Tutorial.Instance.Completed += Tutorial_Completed;
			Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.ZoneEvents.CampFirePlaced += ZoneEvents_CampFirePlaced;
			Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.ZoneEvents.CropPlanted += ZoneEvents_CropPlanted;
			EventManager.AddListener<AddStatsEvent>(EventManager_AddStatsEvent);
			EventManager.AddListener<ScavengedShelterEvent>(EventManager_ScavengedShelterEvent);
			EventManager.AddListener<AchievementUnlockEvent>(EventManager_AchievementUnlock);
			EventManager.AddListener<CompletedEndGameEvent>(EventManager_CompletedEndGameEvent);
		}
	}

	private void OnDestroy()
	{
		if ((bool)Singleton<GameTime>.Instance)
		{
			Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.DayTick -= GameTime_DayTick;
		}
		if ((bool)Tutorial.Instance)
		{
			Tutorial.Instance.Completed -= Tutorial_Completed;
		}
		if ((bool)Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance)
		{
			Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.ZoneEvents.CampFirePlaced -= ZoneEvents_CampFirePlaced;
			Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.ZoneEvents.CropPlanted -= ZoneEvents_CropPlanted;
		}
		EventManager.RemoveListener<AddStatsEvent>(EventManager_AddStatsEvent);
		EventManager.RemoveListener<ScavengedShelterEvent>(EventManager_ScavengedShelterEvent);
		EventManager.RemoveListener<AchievementUnlockEvent>(EventManager_AchievementUnlock);
		EventManager.RemoveListener<CompletedEndGameEvent>(EventManager_CompletedEndGameEvent);
	}

	private void EventManager_AchievementUnlock(AchievementUnlockEvent e)
	{
		DoAchievement(e.Achievement);
	}

	private void EventManager_CompletedEndGameEvent(CompletedEndGameEvent e)
	{
		AwardEndGameAchievement();
	}

	private void Tutorial_Completed()
	{
		if (!Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
		{
			DoAchievement(EAchievement.HORRIFIC_PACIFIC);
		}
	}

	private void GameTime_DayTick()
	{
		if (Game.State != GameState.INTRO)
		{
			if (!AchievementTools.IsCheating(transform.position))
			{
				_daysWithoutFish++;
				_daysWithoutMeat++;
				_daysWithoutHop++;
			}
			if (_daysWithoutFish >= 10)
			{
				DoAchievement(EAchievement.FISH_ARE_FRIENDS);
			}
			if (_daysWithoutMeat >= 10)
			{
				DoAchievement(EAchievement.VEGETARIAN);
			}
			if (_daysWithoutHop >= 10)
			{
				DoAchievement(EAchievement.HERMIT);
			}
			if (Singleton<GameCalendar>.Instance.DaysElapsed >= 10)
			{
				DoAchievement(EAchievement.DAY_10);
			}
			if (Singleton<GameCalendar>.Instance.DaysElapsed >= 20)
			{
				DoAchievement(EAchievement.DAY_20);
			}
			if (Singleton<GameCalendar>.Instance.DaysElapsed >= 50)
			{
				DoAchievement(EAchievement.DAY_50);
			}
			if (Singleton<GameCalendar>.Instance.DaysElapsed >= 100)
			{
				DoAchievement(EAchievement.DAY_100);
			}
		}
	}

	public void ZoneEvents_CampFirePlaced(Zone zone)
	{
		int num = Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.Zones.Sum((Zone z) => (z.Attributes.CampFires > 0) ? 1 : 0);
		if (num >= 5)
		{
			DoAchievement(EAchievement.ANOTHER_DAY_ANOTHER_SHORE);
		}
		if (num >= 10)
		{
			DoAchievement(EAchievement.COLUMBUS);
		}
	}

	public void ZoneEvents_CropPlanted(Zone zone, PlantType plantType)
	{
		if (zone.Attributes.Crops.All_NonAlloc((KeyValuePair<PlantType, int> c) => c.Value > 0) && !AchievementTools.IsCheating(_player.transform.position))
		{
			DoAchievement(EAchievement.HORTICULTURALIST);
		}
	}

	private void EventManager_AddStatsEvent(AddStatsEvent e)
	{
		if (e.PlayerId != _player.Id)
		{
			return;
		}
		GAccountService.Get().LocalUser.UserStats.SessionStats += e.StatsToAdd;
		if (e.StatsToAdd.FishFished > 0)
		{
			int fishFished = GAccountService.Get().LocalUser.UserStats.SessionStats.FishFished;
			if (fishFished >= 1)
			{
				DoAchievement(EAchievement.FISHING_SEASON_IS_OPEN);
			}
			if (fishFished >= 10)
			{
				DoAchievement(EAchievement.THE_SEAS_HARVEST);
			}
		}
		if (e.StatsToAdd.IslandsHopped > 0)
		{
			if (GAccountService.Get().LocalUser.UserStats.SessionStats.IslandsHopped >= 1)
			{
				DoAchievement(EAchievement.ISLAND_HOPPER);
			}
			_daysWithoutHop = 0;
		}
	}

	private void EventManager_ScavengedShelterEvent(ScavengedShelterEvent e)
	{
		if (!AchievementTools.IsCheating(transform.position))
		{
			_sheltersScavenged++;
		}
		if (_sheltersScavenged >= Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.ShelterCount)
		{
			DoAchievement(EAchievement.ARCHAEOLOGIST);
		}
	}

	private void Crafter_Crafted(CraftingCombination combination)
	{
		if (combination.Name == "ITEM PILE")
		{
			OnItemPileCrafted();
		}
		else if (combination.CraftingType.AttributeType == AttributeType.Corrugated && (combination.CraftingType.InteractiveType == InteractiveType.SHELF || combination.CraftingType.InteractiveType == InteractiveType.TABLE || combination.CraftingType.InteractiveType == InteractiveType.CHAIR))
		{
			OnCorrugatedFurnitureCrafted();
		}
		else
		{
			if (combination.IsExtension)
			{
				CraftingType craftingType = combination.Materials.FirstOrDefault_NonAlloc();
				if ((object)craftingType != null && craftingType.InteractiveType == InteractiveType.STATION_LOOM)
				{
					DoAchievement(EAchievement.NEW_THREADS);
					goto IL_00d5;
				}
			}
			if (combination.CraftingType.InteractiveType == InteractiveType.TROPHY)
			{
				OnTrophyCrafted();
			}
			else if (combination.CraftingType.InteractiveType.ToString().Contains("TOOL"))
			{
				OnToolCrafted();
			}
		}
		goto IL_00d5;
		IL_00d5:
		CheckCraftedThemAll();
	}

	private void OnItemPileCrafted()
	{
		if (!AchievementTools.IsCheating(transform.position))
		{
			_pilesCrafted++;
		}
		if (_pilesCrafted >= 100)
		{
			DoAchievement(EAchievement.THIS_SPARKS_JOY);
		}
	}

	private void OnCorrugatedFurnitureCrafted()
	{
		if (!AchievementTools.IsCheating(transform.position))
		{
			_corrugatedFurnitureCrafted++;
		}
		if (_corrugatedFurnitureCrafted >= 10)
		{
			DoAchievement(EAchievement.INDUSTRIAL_FASHION);
		}
	}

	private void OnTrophyCrafted()
	{
		if (CheckMissionTrophiesCrafted() >= 3)
		{
			DoAchievement(EAchievement.CALL_ME_AHAB);
		}
	}

	private int CheckMissionTrophiesCrafted()
	{
		int num = 0;
		foreach (CraftingCombination combination in _player.Crafter.CraftingCombinations.Combinations)
		{
			if ((combination.Name == "SHARK TROPHY" || combination.Name == "EEL TROPHY" || combination.Name == "SQUID TROPHY") && combination.Unlocked && combination.CraftedCount > 0)
			{
				num++;
			}
		}
		return num;
	}

	private void OnToolCrafted()
	{
		if (!AchievementTools.IsCheating(transform.position))
		{
			_toolsCrafted++;
		}
		if (_toolsCrafted >= 20)
		{
			DoAchievement(EAchievement.WORKING_WITH_MY_HANDS);
		}
		if (_toolsCrafted >= 40)
		{
			DoAchievement(EAchievement.LEAN_MEAN_CRAFTING_MACHINE);
		}
	}

	public void Statistics_Ate(InteractiveType type, MeatProvenance provenance)
	{
		if (type == InteractiveType.FOOD_MEAT)
		{
			_daysWithoutMeat = 0;
			if (provenance == MeatProvenance.Fish)
			{
				_daysWithoutFish = 0;
			}
		}
	}

	private void Statistics_PlayerEffectApplied(PlayerEffect effect)
	{
		GAccountService.Get().LocalUser.UserStats.SessionStats.StatusEffects++;
	}

	private void CheckCraftedThemAll()
	{
		if (!GetAchieved(EAchievement.GOTTA_CRAFT_EM_ALL) && _player.Crafter.CraftingCombinations.Combinations.Where((CraftingCombination c) => !c.IsDynamic).All_NonAlloc((CraftingCombination c) => c.CraftedCount > 0))
		{
			DoAchievement(EAchievement.GOTTA_CRAFT_EM_ALL);
		}
	}

	public void AwardEndGameAchievement()
	{
		if (!_usedCompass)
		{
			EventManager.RaiseEvent(new AchievementUnlockEvent(EAchievement.MAGNETS));
		}
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new AchievementUnlockEvent(EAchievement.OUT_OF_THE_FRYING_PAN));
		AccountUserStats userStats = GAccountService.Get().LocalUser.UserStats;
		GLeaderboardHandler.Get().SubmitScore("QUICKEST_ESCAPE", userStats.SessionStats.DaysSurvived);
	}

	public void UsedCompass()
	{
		_usedCompass = true;
	}

	private void DoAchievement(EAchievement ach)
	{
		if ((!Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer() || _player.IsOwner) && !GetAchieved(ach))
		{
			SetAchieved(ach, value: true);
			UnlockAchievement(ach);
		}
	}

	private void UnlockAchievement(EAchievement ach)
	{
		GAchievementsHandler.Get().UnlockAchievement(ach);
	}

	private void NotifyMissedAchievement(EAchievement ach)
	{
		string text = ach.GetAttribute<DescriptionAttribute>().Text;
		LocalizedNotification localizedNotification = new LocalizedNotification(new Notification());
		localizedNotification.Priority = NotificationPriority.Immediate;
		localizedNotification.Duration = 8f;
		localizedNotification.TitleText.SetTerm("ACHIEVEMENT_NTF_MISSED_ACHIEVEMENT_TITLE");
		localizedNotification.MessageText.SetTerm("ACHIEVEMENT_NTF_MISSED_ACHIEVEMENT_DESC");
		localizedNotification.MessageText.SetArgs(text);
		localizedNotification.Raise();
	}

	private void CheckAchievementsGoals()
	{
		if (CheckMissionTrophiesCrafted() >= 3)
		{
			DoAchievement(EAchievement.CALL_ME_AHAB);
		}
	}

	public JObject Save()
	{
		JObject jObject = new JObject();
		JObject jObject2 = new JObject();
		for (int i = 0; i < _achieved.Length; i++)
		{
			bool instance = _achieved[i];
			jObject2.Add(instance);
		}
		jObject.AddField("achieved", jObject2);
		jObject.AddField("usedLoom", JSerializer.Serialize(_usedLoom));
		jObject.AddField("usedCompass", JSerializer.Serialize(_usedCompass));
		jObject.AddField("daysWithoutHop", JSerializer.Serialize(_daysWithoutHop));
		jObject.AddField("daysWithoutFish", JSerializer.Serialize(_daysWithoutFish));
		jObject.AddField("daysWithoutMeat", JSerializer.Serialize(_daysWithoutMeat));
		jObject.AddField("toolsCrafted", JSerializer.Serialize(_toolsCrafted));
		jObject.AddField("corrugatedFurnitureCrafted", JSerializer.Serialize(_corrugatedFurnitureCrafted));
		jObject.AddField("sheltersScavenged", JSerializer.Serialize(_sheltersScavenged));
		jObject.AddField("pilesCrafted", JSerializer.Serialize(_pilesCrafted));
		return jObject;
	}

	public void Load(JObject data)
	{
		if (!enabled)
		{
			return;
		}
		if (data == null || data.IsNull())
		{
			Debug.LogWarning($"Achievements:: Data was null or empty for P{_player.Id}");
			return;
		}
		JObject field = data.GetField("achieved");
		if (field != null)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < _achieved.Length && i < field.Children.Count; i++)
			{
				if (field.Children[i].GetValue<bool>())
				{
					_achieved[i] = true;
					EAchievement ach = (EAchievement)i;
					UnlockAchievement(ach);
				}
			}
		}
		bool value = data.GetField("usedLoom").GetValue<bool>();
		_usedLoom = value;
		bool value2 = data.GetField("usedCompass").GetValue<bool>();
		_usedCompass = value2;
		int value3 = data.GetField("daysWithoutHop").GetValue<int>();
		_daysWithoutHop = value3;
		int value4 = data.GetField("daysWithoutFish").GetValue<int>();
		_daysWithoutFish = value4;
		int value5 = data.GetField("daysWithoutMeat").GetValue<int>();
		_daysWithoutMeat = value5;
		int value6 = data.GetField("toolsCrafted").GetValue<int>();
		_toolsCrafted = value6;
		int value7 = data.GetField("corrugatedFurnitureCrafted").GetValue<int>();
		_corrugatedFurnitureCrafted = value7;
		int value8 = data.GetField("sheltersScavenged").GetValue<int>();
		_sheltersScavenged = value8;
		JObject field2 = data.GetField("pilesCrafted");
		if (field2 != null)
		{
			_pilesCrafted = field2.GetValue<int>();
		}
		CheckAchievementsGoals();
	}
}

using System;
using Beam;
using Beam.Utilities;
using SharpNeatLib.Maths;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Rendering;

public class Atmosphere : Singleton<Atmosphere>
{
	[Serializable]
	public class Illuminary
	{
		[SerializeField]
		private GameObject _gameObject;

		private Transform _transform;

		public Light Light;

		public Renderer Renderer;

		[Range(0f, 8f)]
		[SerializeField]
		private float _intensity;

		private float _currentIntensity;

		[SerializeField]
		private Gradient _gradient;

		public GameObject GameObject => _gameObject;

		public Transform Transform
		{
			get
			{
				if (!_transform)
				{
					_transform = _gameObject.transform;
				}
				return _transform;
			}
		}

		public float Intensity => _intensity;

		public float CurrentIntensity
		{
			get
			{
				return _currentIntensity;
			}
			set
			{
				_currentIntensity = value;
			}
		}

		public Gradient Gradient => _gradient;

		public void Enable()
		{
			Light.enabled = true;
			if (Renderer != null)
			{
				Renderer.enabled = true;
			}
		}

		public void Disable()
		{
			Light.enabled = false;
			if (Renderer != null)
			{
				Renderer.enabled = false;
			}
		}
	}

	[SerializeField]
	private Illuminary _sunIlluminary;

	[SerializeField]
	private Illuminary _moonIlluminary;

	[SerializeField]
	private MeshRenderer _skyDome;

	private bool _dayTime;

	private float _latitude;

	private float _longitude;

	private float _date = 180f;

	private float _theta;

	private float _sunOrbitRadius;

	private float _altitude;

	[SerializeField]
	private Gradient _skyColorPolariser;

	[SerializeField]
	private Gradient _ambientSkyColorGradient;

	[SerializeField]
	private Gradient _ambientGroundColorGradient;

	[SerializeField]
	private Gradient _ambientUnderwaterGroundColorGradient;

	[SerializeField]
	[HideInInspector]
	private Texture2D _transmittance;

	[SerializeField]
	[HideInInspector]
	private Texture2D _inscatter;

	private Texture3D _inscatterEncoded;

	[SerializeField]
	[HideInInspector]
	private Texture2D _irradiance;

	[SerializeField]
	private RenderTexture _atmosphereLookupTexture;

	private Material _atmosphereLookupMaterial;

	private Color _ambientLightColor;

	private Color _ambientGroundColor;

	[Range(0f, 1f)]
	[SerializeField]
	private float _mieG = 0.85f;

	private float _lastUpdatedTime = -1f;

	[Range(0f, 0.1f)]
	[SerializeField]
	public float MilitaryTimeDiffToUpdate = 0.005f;

	public Illuminary SunIlluminary => _sunIlluminary;

	public Illuminary MoonIlluminary => _moonIlluminary;

	public Illuminary CurrentIlluminary
	{
		get
		{
			if (!_dayTime)
			{
				return _moonIlluminary;
			}
			return _sunIlluminary;
		}
	}

	public bool DayTime => _dayTime;

	public float Altitude => _altitude;

	public Gradient AmbientGroundColorGradient => _ambientGroundColorGradient;

	public Gradient AmbientUnderwaterGroundColorGradient => _ambientUnderwaterGroundColorGradient;

	public Texture2D Transmittance => _transmittance;

	public Texture2D Inscatter => _inscatter;

	public Texture2D Irradiance => _irradiance;

	public event EmptyEventHandler SunsetEvent;

	private bool CheckUpdate()
	{
		if (Options.GraphicsSettings.ShadowQuality > Quality_Shadows.MEDIUM)
		{
			return true;
		}
		float militaryTime = Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.MilitaryTime;
		if ((double)_lastUpdatedTime < 0.0)
		{
			_lastUpdatedTime = militaryTime;
			return true;
		}
		if (Mathf.PingPong(militaryTime - _lastUpdatedTime, 24f) >= MilitaryTimeDiffToUpdate)
		{
			_lastUpdatedTime = militaryTime;
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	protected virtual void OnSunsetEvent()
	{
		SunsetEvent?.Invoke();
	}

	private void Awake()
	{
		_sunOrbitRadius = _skyDome.transform.localScale.x * 0.99f;
		_inscatterEncoded = ConvertLookUpTable(_inscatter);
		_atmosphereLookupTexture = CreateBRDFTexture();
		_atmosphereLookupMaterial = CreateBRDFMaterial();
		SetStaticShaderUniforms();
		SetMaterialUniforms(_skyDome.sharedMaterial);
		RenderSettings.ambientMode = AmbientMode.Trilight;
		RenderSettings.ambientIntensity = 1f;
	}

	public RenderTexture CreateBRDFTexture()
	{
		RenderTexture renderTexture = (_atmosphereLookupTexture = new RenderTexture(512, 512, 0, RenderTextureFormat.ARGBHalf));
		renderTexture.filterMode = FilterMode.Bilinear;
		renderTexture.useMipMap = true;
		renderTexture.autoGenerateMips = true;
		return renderTexture;
	}

	public Material CreateBRDFMaterial()
	{
		Shader shader = Shader.Find("Beam Team/Atmosphere/Atmosphere BRDF");
		if (shader != null)
		{
			Material material = new Material(shader);
			SetMaterialUniforms(material);
			return material;
		}
		Debug.LogError("Atmosphere::Start: Atmosphere BRDF Shader could not be found.");
		return null;
	}

	private void Start()
	{
		Camera.onPreCull = (Camera.CameraCallback)Delegate.Combine(Camera.onPreCull, new Camera.CameraCallback(Camera_OnPreCull));
	}

	protected override void OnDestroy()
	{
		BeamTeam.Destroy(_atmosphereLookupMaterial);
		BeamTeam.Destroy(_atmosphereLookupTexture);
		BeamTeam.Destroy(_inscatterEncoded);
		Camera.onPreCull = (Camera.CameraCallback)Delegate.Remove(Camera.onPreCull, new Camera.CameraCallback(Camera_OnPreCull));
		base.OnDestroy();
	}

	private void Camera_OnPreCull(Camera camera)
	{
		if (!(camera == null) && (camera.CompareTag("MainCamera") || camera.CompareTag("PlayerCamera")))
		{
			ClampSkyPosition(camera.transform.position);
			CalculateIlluminaryColors(camera);
			CalculateAmbientColor(camera);
		}
	}

	public static Texture3D ConvertLookUpTable(Texture2D texture)
	{
		if ((bool)texture)
		{
			if (texture.height != Mathf.FloorToInt(Mathf.Sqrt(texture.width)))
			{
				Debug.LogWarning("Atmosphere::ConvertLookUpTable: The given 2D texture " + texture.name + " cannot be used as a 3D LUT.");
				return null;
			}
			int num = 16;
			int height = texture.height;
			int num2 = 16;
			Color[] pixels = texture.GetPixels();
			Color[] array = new Color[pixels.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < height; j++)
				{
					for (int k = 0; k < num2; k++)
					{
						array[i + j * num + k * num * height] = pixels[i + j * num * num2 + k * num];
					}
				}
			}
			Texture3D texture3D = new Texture3D(num, height, num2, TextureFormat.ARGB32, mipChain: false);
			texture3D.wrapMode = TextureWrapMode.Clamp;
			texture3D.filterMode = FilterMode.Bilinear;
			texture3D.SetPixels(array);
			texture3D.Apply();
			return texture3D;
		}
		Debug.LogError("Atmosphere::ConvertLookUpTable(): Couldn't load 3D LUT texture. Texture3D will be disabled.");
		return null;
	}

	private void CalculateIlluminaryPositions()
	{
		float f = MathF.PI / 180f * _latitude;
		float num = Mathf.Sin(f);
		float num2 = Mathf.Cos(f);
		float num3 = MathF.PI / 180f * _longitude;
		float f2 = 0.4093f * Mathf.Sin(MathF.PI / 184f * (_date - 81f));
		float num4 = Mathf.Sin(f2);
		float num5 = Mathf.Cos(f2);
		float num6 = (int)(_longitude / 15f);
		float num7 = MathF.PI / 12f * num6;
		float num8 = Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.MilitaryTime + 0.17f * Mathf.Sin(0.03369f * (_date - 80f)) - 0.129f * Mathf.Sin(MathF.PI * 2f / 355f * (_date - 8f)) + 12f / MathF.PI * (num7 - num3);
		float f3 = MathF.PI / 12f * num8;
		float num9 = Mathf.Sin(f3);
		float num10 = Mathf.Cos(f3);
		float num11 = Mathf.Asin(num * num4 - num2 * num5 * num10);
		float y = (0f - num5) * num9;
		float x = num2 * num4 - num * num5 * num10;
		float num12 = Mathf.Atan2(y, x);
		_theta = MathF.PI / 2f - num11;
		float phi = num12;
		_sunIlluminary.Transform.position = transform.position + transform.rotation * SphericalToCartesian(_sunOrbitRadius, _theta, phi);
		_sunIlluminary.Transform.LookAt(transform.position);
		_moonIlluminary.Transform.position = transform.position + transform.rotation * SphericalToCartesian(_sunOrbitRadius, _theta + MathF.PI, phi);
		_moonIlluminary.Transform.LookAt(transform.position);
		_altitude = MathF.PI / 2f - _theta;
		float num13 = Mathf.Abs(_altitude);
		float num14 = MathF.PI / 180f;
		float num15 = MathF.PI / 15f;
		if (_altitude > 0f)
		{
			_sunIlluminary.Enable();
			_moonIlluminary.Disable();
			float num16 = Mathf.Lerp(0f, _sunIlluminary.Intensity, num13 / num14);
			_sunIlluminary.CurrentIntensity = ((num13 < num14) ? num16 : _sunIlluminary.Intensity);
			_sunIlluminary.Light.intensity = _sunIlluminary.CurrentIntensity;
			if (!_dayTime)
			{
				_dayTime = true;
				OnSunsetEvent();
			}
		}
		else
		{
			_moonIlluminary.Enable();
			_sunIlluminary.Disable();
			float num17 = Mathf.Lerp(0f, _moonIlluminary.Intensity, num13 / num15);
			_moonIlluminary.CurrentIntensity = ((num13 < num15) ? num17 : _moonIlluminary.Intensity);
			_moonIlluminary.Light.intensity = _moonIlluminary.CurrentIntensity;
			if (_dayTime)
			{
				_dayTime = false;
				OnSunsetEvent();
			}
		}
	}

	private void CalculateIlluminaryColors(Camera camera)
	{
		bool flag = Cameras.IsUnderwater(camera.transform);
		float normalizedTime = Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.NormalizedTime;
		Color color = _sunIlluminary.Gradient.Evaluate(normalizedTime);
		Color color2 = _moonIlluminary.Gradient.Evaluate(normalizedTime);
		WeatherEvent weatherEvent = Singleton<AtmosphereStorm>.Instance?.CurrentWeatherEvent;
		if (weatherEvent != null && weatherEvent.HasStarted)
		{
			color = weatherEvent.GetSunColor(color);
			color2 = weatherEvent.GetMoonColor(color2);
		}
		_sunIlluminary.Light.color = color;
		_moonIlluminary.Light.color = color2;
		if (flag)
		{
			float num = Singleton<CetoSettings>.Instance.BelowVisibility * 1.5f;
			float num2 = Mathf.Clamp01((camera.transform.position.y + num) / num);
			CurrentIlluminary.Light.color = Color.Lerp(CurrentIlluminary.Light.color * new Color(0.5f, 0.9f, 1f), CurrentIlluminary.Light.color, num2);
			CurrentIlluminary.Light.intensity = CurrentIlluminary.CurrentIntensity * num2;
		}
	}

	private void CalculateAmbientColor(Camera camera)
	{
		bool flag = Cameras.IsUnderwater(camera.transform);
		float normalizedTime = Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.NormalizedTime;
		_ambientLightColor = _ambientSkyColorGradient.Evaluate(normalizedTime) * _skyColorPolariser.Evaluate(normalizedTime);
		_ambientGroundColor = (flag ? _ambientUnderwaterGroundColorGradient.Evaluate(normalizedTime) : _ambientGroundColorGradient.Evaluate(normalizedTime));
		WeatherEvent weatherEvent = Singleton<AtmosphereStorm>.Instance?.CurrentWeatherEvent;
		if (weatherEvent != null && weatherEvent.HasStarted)
		{
			_ambientLightColor = weatherEvent.GetAmbientSkyColor(_ambientLightColor);
			_ambientGroundColor = weatherEvent.GetAmbientGroundColor(_ambientGroundColor);
		}
		if (flag)
		{
			float num = Singleton<CetoSettings>.Instance.BelowVisibility * 1.5f;
			float num2 = Mathf.Clamp01((camera.transform.position.y + num) / num);
			_ambientLightColor *= num2;
			_ambientGroundColor *= num2;
		}
		RenderSettings.sun = CurrentIlluminary.Light;
		RenderSettings.ambientLight = _ambientLightColor;
		RenderSettings.ambientEquatorColor = Color.Lerp(_ambientGroundColor, _ambientLightColor, 0.6f);
		RenderSettings.ambientGroundColor = _ambientGroundColor;
	}

	private Vector3 SphericalToCartesian(float radius, float theta, float phi)
	{
		float num = Mathf.Sin(theta);
		float num2 = Mathf.Cos(theta);
		float num3 = Mathf.Sin(phi);
		float num4 = Mathf.Cos(phi);
		Vector3 zero = Vector3.zero;
		zero.x = radius * num * num4;
		zero.y = radius * num2;
		zero.z = radius * num * num3;
		return zero;
	}
}

		if (Game.Mode.IsMaster())

		{
			Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.NewDayTick -= GameTime_NewDayTick;
			Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.HourChanged -= GameTime_HourChanged;
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < _weatherEvents.Count; i++)
		{
			_weatherEvents[i].Started -= WeatherEvent_Started;
			_weatherEvents[i].Stopped -= WeatherEvent_Stopped;
		}
		EventManager.RemoveListener<EndGameSequenceEvent>(EventManager_EndGameSequenceEvent);
		WeatherStarted = null;
		WeatherStopped = null;
		base.OnDestroy();
	}

	{
		_random.RestoreState(seed, iter);
	}

	private void EventManager_EndGameSequenceEvent(EndGameSequenceEvent ev)
	{
		ClearWeatherEvent();
		_canDoWeather = false;
	}

	private void GameTime_NewDayTick()
	{
		if (!Game.Mode.IsClient())
		{
			ReplicatedCheckWeather();
		}
	}

	private void GameTime_HourChanged(float hours)
	{
		if (!(_currentWeatherEvent != null))
		{
			return;
		}
		if (_currentWeatherEvent.HasStarted)
		{
			if (GameTime.GetMinutesSince(_currentWeatherEvent.StartedTime) > _currentWeatherEvent.TotalEventMinutes)
			{
				_currentWeatherEvent.ResetEvent();
			}
		}
		else if (Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.MilitaryTime > _currentWeatherEvent.StartTime + _currentWeatherEvent.TotalEventHours)
		{
			ClearWeatherEvent();
		}
		else if (Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.MilitaryTime > _currentWeatherEvent.StartTime)
		{
			float hours2 = Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.MilitaryTime - _currentWeatherEvent.StartTime;
			_currentWeatherEvent.StartedTime = GameTime.Now.RemoveHours(hours2);
			_currentWeatherEvent.ResumeEvent();
			CancelInvoke("PollTimeForWeatherEvent");
		}
	}

	private void CheckWeather()
	{
		if (_lastDayChecked == Singleton<GameCalendar>.Instance.Day)
		{
			return;
		}
		if (_lastRainyDay != Singleton<GameCalendar>.Instance.Day)
		{
			if (_currentWeatherEvent != null)
			{
				_lastRainyDay = Singleton<GameCalendar>.Instance.Day;
			}
			else if ((float)_random.NextDouble() * 100f <= (float)_percentage)
			{
				_lastRainyDay = Singleton<GameCalendar>.Instance.Day;
				CreateWeatherEvent();
			}
		}
		_lastDayChecked = Singleton<GameCalendar>.Instance.Day;
	}

	private void CreateWeatherEvent()
	{
		List<WeatherEvent> list = new List<WeatherEvent>();
		for (int i = 0; i < _weatherEvents.Count; i++)
		{
			WeatherEvent weatherEvent = _weatherEvents[i];
			for (int j = 0; j < weatherEvent.Percentage / 10; j++)
			{
				list.Add(weatherEvent);
			}
		}
		int index = _random.Next(0, list.Count);
		WeatherEvent weatherEvent2 = list[index];
		float startTime = 10f + 6f * (float)_random.NextDouble();
		weatherEvent2.StartTime = startTime;
		NewWeatherEvent(weatherEvent2);
	}

	private void PollTimeForWeatherEvent()
	{
		if (_canDoWeather && Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.MilitaryTime >= _currentWeatherEvent.StartTime)
		{
			CancelInvoke("PollTimeForWeatherEvent");
			StartWeatherEvent();
		}
	}

	public void StartWeatherEvent()
	{
		if (_currentWeatherEvent != null)
		{
			_currentWeatherEvent.StartEvent();
			if (Mathf.Approximately(_currentWeatherEvent.Humidity, 100f))
			{
				_rain++;
			}
		}
	}

	private void WeatherEvent_Started(WeatherEvent weather)
	{
		OnWeatherStarted(weather);
	}

	private void WeatherEvent_Stopped()
	{
		OnWeatherStopped();
	}

	public void NewWeatherEvent(WeatherEvent weather)
	{
		SetWeatherEvent(weather);
		InvokeRepeating("PollTimeForWeatherEvent", 0f, 2f);
	}

	public void SetWeatherEvent(WeatherEvent weather)
	{
		_currentWeatherEvent = weather;
	}

	public void ClearWeatherEvent()
	{
		_currentWeatherEvent = null;
		CancelInvoke("PollTimeForWeatherEvent");
	}

	private void ReplicatedCheckWeather()
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
		{
			ReplicateCheckWeatherMsg replicateCheckWeatherMsg = new ReplicateCheckWeatherMsg();
			replicateCheckWeatherMsg.Seed = _random.GetSeed();
			replicateCheckWeatherMsg.Iter = _random.GetIter();
			replicateCheckWeatherMsg.Post();
		}
		CheckWeather();
	}

	public JObject Save()
	{
		JObject jObject = new JObject();
		jObject.AddField("Rain", _rain);
		JObject data = SavingUtilities.Save(_random);

	}

	public void Load(JObject data)
	{
		_rain = data.GetField("Rain").GetValue<int>();
		JObject field = data.GetField("State");
		if ((bool)field)
		{
			SavingUtilities.Load(_random, field);
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < _weatherEvents.Count; i++)
		{
			WeatherEvent weatherEvent = _weatherEvents[i];
			JObject field2 = data.GetField(weatherEvent.name);
			if (field2 != null)
			{
				weatherEvent.Load(field2);
				break;
			}
		}
	}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Beam;
using UnityEngine;

public class BEAMSeaFortGenerator : MonoBehaviour, IGenerationObject
{
	[SerializeField]
	private Transform startingPoint;

	public Module[] Modules;

	public Module[] StartModule;

	private static System.Random _randomSeed;

	[SerializeField]
	private int minIteration = 1;

	[SerializeField]
	private int maxIteration = 4;

	private void Start()
	{
		_randomSeed = Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.GenerateLocalSeed(transform.position);
		int num = _randomSeed.Next(minIteration, maxIteration);
		Module module = UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(StartModule[_randomSeed.Next(StartModule.Length)], startingPoint.position, transform.rotation);
		module.transform.parent = transform.parent;
		module.SetUpSupport(seaLadderAccess: true);
		List<ModuleConnector> list = new List<ModuleConnector>(module.GetExits());
		for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
		{
			List<ModuleConnector> list2 = new List<ModuleConnector>();
			foreach (ModuleConnector item in list)
			{
				string random = GetRandom(item.Tags);
				Module module2 = UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(GetRandomWithTag(Modules, random));
				module2.transform.parent = transform.parent;
				bool upSupport = _randomSeed.NextDouble() < 0.20000000298023224;
				module2.SetUpSupport(upSupport);
				ModuleConnector[] exits = module2.GetExits();
				ModuleConnector exitToMatch = exits.FirstOrDefault((ModuleConnector x) => x.IsDefault) ?? GetRandom(exits);
				MatchExits(item, exitToMatch);
				list2.AddRange(exits.Where((ModuleConnector e) => e != exitToMatch));
			}
			list = list2;
		}
	}

	private void MatchExits(ModuleConnector oldExit, ModuleConnector newExit)
	{
		Transform parent = newExit.transform.parent.parent;
		parent.RotateAround(angle: Azimuth(-oldExit.transform.forward) - Azimuth(newExit.transform.forward), point: newExit.transform.position, axis: Vector3.up);
		Vector3 vector = oldExit.transform.position - newExit.transform.position;
		parent.transform.position += vector;
	}

	private static TItem GetRandom<TItem>(TItem[] array)
	{
		return array[_randomSeed.Next(0, array.Length)];
	}

	private static Module GetRandomWithTag(IEnumerable<Module> modules, string tagToMatch)
	{
		return GetRandom(modules.Where((Module m) => m.Tags.Contains(tagToMatch)).ToArray());
	}

	private static float Azimuth(Vector3 vector)
	{
		return Vector3.Angle(Vector3.forward, vector) * Mathf.Sign(vector.x);
	}
}

	{
		OnDamaged(damage, damager);
		IPickupable pickupable = damager as IPickupable;
		if (!pickupable.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			LastPlayerIdToDamageThis = pickupable.PreviousOwnerId;
		}
		HealthPoints -= damage;
		if (HealthPoints <= 0f)
		{
			if (_materialRefunder != null)
			{
				_materialRefunder.RefundMaterials(LastPlayerIdToDamageThis);
			}
			Destroy();
		}
	}

	public void Damage(DamageUnityEventArgs args)
	{
		Damage(args.Damage, args.Damager);
	}

	public virtual void Destroy()
	{
		BeamTeam.Destroy(gameObject);
	}

	public override JObject Save()
	{
		JObject jObject = base.Save();
		JObject data = JSerializer.Serialize(transform);
		jObject.AddField("Transform", data);
		if (!_displayName.Equals(_originalDisplayName, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
		{
			jObject.AddField("dName", JSerializer.Serialize(_displayName));
		}
		if (!Mathf.Approximately(_healthPoints, OriginalHealthPoints))
		{
			jObject.AddField("healthPoints", JSerializer.Serialize(_healthPoints));
		}
		return jObject;
	}

	public override void Load(JObject data)
	{
		base.Load(data);
		JSerializer.DeserializeInto(data.GetField("Transform"), transform);
		CompleteTransformSerialization();
		JObject field = data.GetField("dName");
		if (field != null)
		{
			string value = field.GetValue<string>();
			DisplayName = value;
		}
		JObject field2 = data.GetField("healthPoints");
		if (field2 != null)
		{
			_healthPoints = field2.GetValue<float>();
		}
	}
}

using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Beam;

public class BiomeFlockProvider : FlockProvider
{
	private Dictionary<Zone.BiomeType, List<FlockData>> _biomeFlocks;

	private Dictionary<string, List<FlockData>> _cachedFlocks = new Dictionary<string, List<FlockData>>();

	private string _previousZoneName;

	private void Start()
	{
		if ((bool)Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance)
		{
			Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.ZoneEntered += StrandedWorld_ZoneEntered;
		}
	}

	private void OnDestroy()
	{
		if ((bool)Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance)
		{
			Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.ZoneEntered -= StrandedWorld_ZoneEntered;
		}
	}

	private void StrandedWorld_ZoneEntered(Zone zone)
	{
		if (_cachedFlocks.ContainsKey(_previousZoneName))
		{
			return;
		}
		foreach (FlockData item in _cachedFlocks[_previousZoneName])
		{
			_ = item;
		}
	}

	public override IList<FlockData> GetFlocks()
	{
		Zone zone = StrandedWorld.GetZone(transform.position);
		if (_cachedFlocks.ContainsKey(zone.ZoneName))
		{
			return _cachedFlocks[zone.ZoneName];
		}
		return _biomeFlocks[zone.Biome];
	}

	public IDictionary<FlockSpecies, FlockData> GetFlockData()
	{
		Dictionary<FlockSpecies, FlockData> dictionary = new Dictionary<FlockSpecies, FlockData>();
		foreach (KeyValuePair<Zone.BiomeType, List<FlockData>> biomeFlock in _biomeFlocks)
		{
			foreach (FlockData item in biomeFlock.Value)
			{
				dictionary.Add(item.Species, item);
			}
		}
		return dictionary;
	}
}



/* SOURCE_FILE: /storage/emulated/0/Map Check/reports/V15_SOURCE_EXTRACTED/Assembly-CSharp/Beam/BuoyancyManager.cs
SOURCE_BYTES: 2188
SOURCE_SHA256: 6ad63b4ffb40735ace4443ab7773d6a59182d6651332f5d8097bd88318b2cfe3
MATCHES: StrandedWorld

using System.Collections.Generic;
using Beam.Utilities;
using Ceto;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Beam;

public class BuoyancyManager : Singleton<BuoyancyManager>
{
	private const int POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 1;

	private const float OUT_OF_RANGE_DISTANCE = 120f;

	private readonly HashSet<IQueryWaves> _queries = new HashSet<IQueryWaves>();

	private int _stepCount;

	private bool _queriesDoneThisFrame;

	public void Add(IQueryWaves query)
	{
		_queries.Add(query);
	}

	public void Remove(IQueryWaves query)
	{
		_queries.Remove(query);
	}

	private void Start()
	{
		InvokeRepeating("Poll_InvokeRepeating", 1f, 1f);
	}

	protected override void OnDestroy()
	{
		_queries.Clear();
		base.OnDestroy();
	}

	private void FixedUpdate()
	{
		if (!_queriesDoneThisFrame)
		{
			_stepCount++;
			DoQueries();
			_stepCount = 0;
		}
	}

	private void LateUpdate()
	{
		_queriesDoneThisFrame = false;
	}

	private void DoQueries()
	{
		foreach (IQueryWaves query in _queries)
		{
			if (!query.Active)
			{
				continue;
			}
			foreach (WaveQuery waveQuery in query.WaveQueries)
			{
				Ceto.Ocean.Instance.QueryWaves(waveQuery);
			}
		}
		_queriesDoneThisFrame = true;
	}

	private void Poll_InvokeRepeating()
	{
		foreach (IQueryWaves query in _queries)
		{
			if (!query.Active)
			{
				continue;
			}
			WaveQuery waveQuery = query.WaveQueries.FirstOrDefault_NonAlloc();
			if (waveQuery != null)
			{
				Vector3 queryPosition = new Vector3(waveQuery.posX, 0f, waveQuery.posZ);
				if (CheckInRangeOfPlayer(queryPosition))
				{
					query.InRange();
				}
				else if (CheckInRangeOfActiveZone(queryPosition))
				{
					query.InRange();
				}
				else
				{
					query.OutOfRange();
				}
			}
		}
	}

	private bool CheckInRangeOfPlayer(Vector3 queryPosition)
	{
		foreach (IPlayer allPlayer in PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers)
		{
			if ((allPlayer.transform.position - queryPosition).sqrMagnitude < BeamMath.Sqr(120f))
			{
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	private bool CheckInRangeOfActiveZone(Vector3 queryPosition)
	{
		Zone zone = StrandedWorld.GetZone(queryPosition);
		if (zone != null && (zone.Loading || zone.Loaded))
		{
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}
}

	public static bool IsVisible(Bounds bounds)

		{
			IGameCamera gameCamera = _AllCameras[i];
			BeamGeometryUtility.CalculateFrustumPlanes(_planes, gameCamera.Camera.projectionMatrix * gameCamera.Camera.worldToCameraMatrix);
			if (GeometryUtility.TestPlanesAABB(_planes, bounds))

	private void Camera_OnPreCull(Camera camera)
	{
		if (!(camera == null) && (camera.CompareTag("MainCamera") || camera.CompareTag("PlayerCamera")))
		{
			_Current = camera;
			OnPreCull?.Invoke(_Current);
			CalculateFrustumCorners(_Current);
		}
	}

	private void CalculateFrustumCorners(Camera camera)
	{
		float nearClipPlane = camera.nearClipPlane;
		float farClipPlane = camera.farClipPlane;
		float fieldOfView = camera.fieldOfView;
		float aspect = camera.aspect;
		Matrix4x4 identity = Matrix4x4.identity;
		float num = fieldOfView * 0.5f;
		Vector3 vector = camera.transform.right * nearClipPlane * Mathf.Tan(num * (MathF.PI / 180f)) * aspect;
		Vector3 vector2 = camera.transform.up * nearClipPlane * Mathf.Tan(num * (MathF.PI / 180f));
		Vector3 vector3 = camera.transform.forward * nearClipPlane - vector + vector2;
		float num2 = vector3.magnitude * farClipPlane / nearClipPlane;
		vector3.Normalize();
		vector3 *= num2;
		Vector3 vector4 = camera.transform.forward * nearClipPlane + vector + vector2;
		vector4.Normalize();
		vector4 *= num2;
		Vector3 vector5 = camera.transform.forward * nearClipPlane + vector - vector2;
		vector5.Normalize();
		vector5 *= num2;
		Vector3 vector6 = camera.transform.forward * nearClipPlane - vector - vector2;
		vector6.Normalize();
		vector6 *= num2;
		identity.SetRow(0, vector3);
		identity.SetRow(1, vector4);
		identity.SetRow(2, vector5);
		identity.SetRow(3, vector6);
		Shader.SetGlobalMatrix("_ShaderFrustumCorners", identity);
	}

	{
		Zone zone = StrandedWorld.GetZone(Main.transform.position);
		Vector3 down = Vector3.down;
		Vector3 vector = zone.transform.position + Vector3.up * 128f;
		string text = ((Game.Mode == GameMode.SinglePlayer) ? "dynamic" : "dynamic_COOP");
		CaptureScreen(vector, down, Screen.width, Screen.height, text);
		JObject jObject = new JObject();
		jObject.AddField("Pos", JSerializer.Serialize(vector));
		jObject.AddField("Dir", JSerializer.Serialize(down));
		rootData.AddField("ScreenCap", jObject);
	}

	private void CaptureScreen(Vector3 position, Vector3 direction, int width, int height, string name)
	{
		Debug.Log("Cameras::CaptureScreen:: Capturing Screen...");
		Camera camera = CreateCamera(_postCamera);
		camera.depth = GetPostCamera().depth + 2f;
		Camera camera2 = CreateCamera(PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers[0].PlayerCamera.Camera);
		camera2.depth = camera.depth - 1f;
		if (!CameraData.ContainsKey(camera2))
		{
			CameraData.Add(camera2, new AlwaysCameraData(camera2));
		}
		Quaternion rotation = Quaternion.LookRotation(direction, Vector3.up);
		RenderTexture temporary = RenderTexture.GetTemporary(width, height, 24, RenderTextureFormat.ARGB32);
		RenderInto(camera2, temporary, position, rotation);
		RenderInto(camera, temporary, position, rotation);
		RenderTexture active = RenderTexture.active;
		RenderTexture.active = temporary;
		Texture2D texture2D = new Texture2D(temporary.width, temporary.height, TextureFormat.RGB24, mipChain: false);
		texture2D.ReadPixels(new Rect(0f, 0f, texture2D.width, texture2D.height), 0, 0);
		texture2D.Apply(updateMipmaps: false);
		RenderTexture.active = active;
		temporary.Release();
		DestroyCamera(camera2);
		DestroyCamera(camera);
		Debug.Log("Cameras::CaptureScreen:: Writing screenshot to file...");
		string path = PathTools.Combine(SaveManager.GetSaveFolderPath(), name + ".bytes");
		try
		{
			using (FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(path, FileMode.Create, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.ReadWrite))
			{
				byte[] array = texture2D.EncodeToPNG();
				fileStream.Write(array, 0, array.Length);
			}
			Debug.Log("Cameras::CaptureScreen:: Complete.");
		}
		catch (Exception)
		{
			Debug.LogError("Cameras::CaptureScreen:: Error writing screenshot to file: ");
			LocalizedNotification localizedNotification = new LocalizedNotification(new Notification());
			localizedNotification.Priority = NotificationPriority.Immediate;
			localizedNotification.Duration = 8f;
			localizedNotification.PlayerId = 0;
			localizedNotification.MessageText.SetTerm("Error writing screenshot to file. Please contact Beam Team on the Steam Forum.");
			localizedNotification.Raise();
		}
	}

	private void RenderInto(Camera camera, RenderTexture target, Vector3 position, Quaternion rotation)
	{
		camera.transform.position = position;
		camera.transform.rotation = rotation;
		camera.targetTexture = target;
		camera.Render();
	}

using System.Collections;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Beam;

public class Decal : MonoBehaviour
{
	private ITerrainProvider _terrain;

	[SerializeField]
	private float _size = 1f;

	[SerializeField]
	private float _offset = 0.03f;

	private IEnumerator Start()
	{
		Decal decal = this;
		ITerrainProvider instance = Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance;
		decal._terrain = instance ?? NullObject<NullTerrainProvider>.Instance;
		while (LevelLoader.IsLoading())
		{
			yield return null;
		}
		GenerateDecalMesh();
	}

	private void GenerateDecalMesh()
	{
		Mesh mesh = new Mesh();
		float size = _size;
		int num = 8;
		int num2 = num + 1;
		int num3 = num + 1;
		int num4 = num2 * num3;
		Vector3[] array = new Vector3[num4];
		Vector2[] array2 = new Vector2[num4];
		Vector2 b = new Vector2(1f / ((float)num3 - 1f), 1f / ((float)num2 - 1f));
		Vector3 a = new Vector3(size / ((float)num3 - 1f), 1f, size / ((float)num2 - 1f));
		for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
		{
			for (int j = 0; j < num3; j++)
			{
				Vector3 b2 = new Vector3(j, 0f, i);
				Vector3 position = Vector3.Scale(a, b2) - new Vector3(size / 2f, 0f, size / 2f);
				Vector3 worldPosition = transform.TransformPoint(position);
				float height = _terrain.GetHeight(worldPosition);
				array[j * num3 + i] = transform.InverseTransformPoint(new Vector3(worldPosition.x, height + _offset, worldPosition.z));
				array2[j * num3 + i] = Vector2.Scale(new Vector2(j, i), b);
			}
		}
		mesh.vertices = array;
		mesh.uv = array2;
		int num5 = num + 1;
		int[] array3 = new int[num * num * 6];
		int k = 0;
		int num6 = 0;
		for (; k < num; k++)
		{
			for (int l = 0; l < num; l++)
			{
				array3[num6++] = k * num5 + l;
				array3[num6++] = k * num5 + (l + 1);
				array3[num6++] = (k + 1) * num5 + (l + 1);
				array3[num6++] = k * num5 + l;
				array3[num6++] = (k + 1) * num5 + l + 1;
				array3[num6++] = (k + 1) * num5 + l;
			}
		}
		mesh.triangles = array3;
		mesh.RecalculateNormals();
		mesh.RecalculateTangents();
		GetComponent<MeshFilter>().mesh = mesh;
	}
}

			_player.Movement.falling = false;
			_player.Movement.grounded = false;
			_player.Movement.InWater = false;
			_player.Movement.ActivePlatform = null;
			_player.Movement.activeLadder = null;
			_player.Movement.activeLedge = null;
			_inFlyMode = true;
		}
		else if (_inFlyMode)
		{
			_player.Movement.activeLadder = null;
			_player.Movement.ActivePlatform = null;
			_player.Movement.GodMode = false;
			_inFlyMode = false;
		}
	}

	public bool Teleport(int zoneId)
	{
		if (zoneId < 0 || zoneId > 48)
		{
			return false;
		}
		Zone zone = Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.Zones[zoneId];
		Teleport(zone.transform.position);
		return true;
	}

	public bool Teleport(Vector3 position)
	{
		if (!_inFlyMode)
		{
			ReplicatedToggleGodMode();
		}
		_player.transform.position = position + Vector3.up * 22.5f;
		return true;
	}

	public void ReplicatedToggleGodMode()
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
		{
			ReplicateToggleGod replicateToggleGod = new ReplicateToggleGod();
			replicateToggleGod.Player = _player;
			replicateToggleGod.Post();
		}
		ToggleGodMode();
	}
}



/* SOURCE_FILE: /storage/emulated/0/Map Check/reports/V15_SOURCE_EXTRACTED/Assembly-CSharp/Beam/FlockController.cs
SOURCE_BYTES: 11133
SOURCE_SHA256: ff69f38490da62dd7c06b9c3b4687e3d24b8543e9aa68b42fd4a7bd738a13634
MATCHES: StrandedWorld
*/
using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Beam.Events;
using Beam.Utilities;
using Funlabs;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Beam;

public class FlockController : MonoBehaviour
{
	private class ReplicatedRepositionOriginMsg : MultiplayerMessage
	{
		[Replicate]
		public Vector3 Position;

		public override void OnPeer()
		{
			UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectOfType<FlockController>().RepositionOrigin(Position);
		}
	}

	private static FlockController _Instance;

	private LandingSpotController _landingSpotController;

	[SerializeField]
	private Transform _activeContainer;

	[SerializeField]
	private Transform _deactivatedContainer;

	[SerializeField]
	private LayerMask _avoidanceMask;

	private Vector3 _origin;

	[Header("Flock Bounds")]
	[SerializeField]
	private Vector3 _center;

	[SerializeField]
	private Vector2 _size;

	[SerializeField]
	private Vector2 _spawnBuffer;

	[Header("Waypoints")]
	[SerializeField]
	private float _waypointDistance = 10f;

	[Tooltip("Bias for new waypoint direction between flock's forward direction and random direction.")]
	[Range(0f, 1f)]
	[SerializeField]
	private float _waypointForwardBias = 0.3f;

	[Tooltip("Bias for new waypoint height between flock's height and random height.")]
	[Range(0f, 1f)]
	[SerializeField]
	private float _waypointHeightBias = 0.5f;

	[Header("Flocks")]
	[SerializeField]
	private FlockProvider _flockProvider;

	public FlockAudio _flockAudioPrefab;

	private IList<FlockData> _flockData;

	private Dictionary<FlockSpecies, FlockData> _availableFlocks = new Dictionary<FlockSpecies, FlockData>();

	private string _currentZoneName;

	private string _nmlZoneName = "";

	private string _endGameZoneName = "";

	public static FlockController Instance => _Instance;

	public Transform ActiveContainer => _activeContainer;

	public Transform DeactivatedContainer => _deactivatedContainer;

	public LayerMask AvoidanceMask => _avoidanceMask;

	public IDictionary<FlockSpecies, FlockData> AvailableFlocks => _availableFlocks;

	public Vector3 ControllerPosition => _origin + _center;

	public float MaxLandingSpotDistance => 30f;

	private void Awake()
	{
		if (_Instance != null)
		{
			BeamTeam.Destroy(gameObject);
		}
		else
		{
			_Instance = this;
		}
	}

	private IEnumerator Start()
	{
		_landingSpotController = Singleton<LandingSpotController>.Instance;
		if (!Game.Mode.IsMaster())
		{
			yield break;
		}
		while (LevelLoader.IsLoadingScene())
		{
			yield return null;
		}
		_flockData = _flockProvider.GetFlocks();
		CreateFlocks();
		EventManager.AddListener<EndGameSequenceEvent>(EventManager_EndGameSequenceEvent);
		if ((bool)Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance)
		{
			_nmlZoneName = Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.NmlZone.name;
			Zone zone = Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.FindEndGameZone();
			if ((bool)zone)
			{
				_endGameZoneName = zone.name;
			}
		}
		InvokeRepeating("PollZone", 1f, 1f);
		InvokeRepeating("PollFlockEvents", 1f, 1f);
	}

	private void OnDestroy()
	{
		if (!(_Instance != this))
		{
			_Instance = null;
			if (Game.Mode.IsMaster())
			{
				EventManager.RemoveListener<EndGameSequenceEvent>(EventManager_EndGameSequenceEvent);
			}
		}
	}

	private void EventManager_EndGameSequenceEvent(EndGameSequenceEvent e)
	{
		StopAllFlockAudio();
	}

	private void PollZone()
	{
		IPlayer player = PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers.FirstOrDefault_NonAlloc();
		if (player.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			return;
		}
		Zone zone = StrandedWorld.GetZone(player.transform.position);
		if ((bool)zone && !(zone.name == _currentZoneName))
		{
			_currentZoneName = zone.name;
			DeactivateFlocks();
			if (!(_currentZoneName == _nmlZoneName) && !(_currentZoneName == _endGameZoneName))
			{
				ReplicatedRepositionOrigin(zone.transform.position);
				RefreshAvailableFlocks();
			}
		}
	}

	private void RepositionOrigin(Vector3 position)
	{
		Vector3 origin = position;
		origin.y = 0f;
		_origin = origin;
	}

	private void CreateFlocks()
	{
		foreach (FlockData flockDatum in _flockData)
		{
			_availableFlocks.Add(flockDatum.Species, flockDatum);
			FlockAudio audio = CreateFlockAudio(flockDatum);
			_availableFlocks[flockDatum.Species].Audio = audio;
			for (int i = 0; i < flockDatum.Population; i++)
			{
				CreateFlockChild(flockDatum);
			}
		}
	}

	public void StopAllFlockAudio()
	{
		foreach (FlockData flockDatum in _flockData)
		{
			_availableFlocks[flockDatum.Species].Audio.Stop();
		}
	}

	private FlockChild CreateFlockChild(FlockData flockData)
	{
		FlockChild component = MultiplayerMng.Instantiate<SaveablePrefab>(flockData.Prefab.GetComponent<SaveablePrefab>().PrefabId, MiniGuid.New()).GetComponent<FlockChild>();
		component.transform.SetParent(_deactivatedContainer, worldPositionStays: false);
		component.Initialize(this, _landingSpotController);
		flockData.Children.Add(component);
		return component;
	}

	private FlockAudio CreateFlockAudio(FlockData flockData)
	{
		FlockAudio flockAudio = UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(_flockAudioPrefab);
		flockAudio.transform.SetParent(_deactivatedContainer, worldPositionStays: false);
		flockAudio.AmbientClip = flockData.FlockAudioClip;
		return flockAudio;
	}

	private void InitializeFlockChild(FlockChild flockChild, Vector3 startingPosition)
	{
		flockChild.transform.position = startingPosition + UnityEngine.Random.onUnitSphere * flockChild.LocalWaypointSpreadRadius;
		flockChild.Reset();
		flockChild.SetLocalWaypoint();
		flockChild.ReplicatedChangeState(FlockChildState.Flying, Vector3.zero);
	}

	private void PollFlockEvents()
	{
		if (_currentZoneName == _nmlZoneName || _currentZoneName == _endGameZoneName)
		{
			return;
		}
		foreach (KeyValuePair<FlockSpecies, FlockData> availableFlock in _availableFlocks)
		{
			FlockData value = availableFlock.Value;
			if ((!value.Active || value.Migrating) && CheckTime(value.StartTime, value.EndTime))
			{
				if (UnityEngine.Random.value * 100f <= (float)value.Percentage)
				{
					StartFlockEvent(value);
				}
			}
			else if (value.Active && !CheckTime(value.StartTime, value.EndTime))
			{
				StopFlockEvent(value);
			}
			if (value.Migrating && value.Children.All_NonAlloc((FlockChild x) => (FlockChildState)x.CurrentState == FlockChildState.Migrated))
			{
				DeactivateFlock(value);
			}
		}
	}

	private void StartFlockEvent(FlockData flockData)
	{
		Vector3 startingPosition = GetStartingPosition();
		flockData.Migrating = false;
		flockData.Waypoint = GetRandomPositionInBounds();
		SetNewWaypointForSpecies(flockData.Species, UnityEngine.Random.onUnitSphere);
		flockData.Audio.transform.position = startingPosition;
		ActivateFlock(flockData);
		foreach (FlockChild child in flockData.Children)
		{
			InitializeFlockChild(child, startingPosition);
		}
	}

	private void StopFlockEvent(FlockData flockData)
	{
		if (flockData.Migrating)
		{
			return;
		}
		Vector3 startingPosition = GetStartingPosition();
		flockData.Migrating = true;
		flockData.Waypoint = startingPosition;
		flockData.Audio.TargetPosition = startingPosition;
		foreach (FlockChild child in flockData.Children)
		{
			child.SpeciesWaypoint = flockData.Waypoint;
			child.SetLocalWaypoint();
			child.Migrate();
		}
	}

	private void ActivateFlock(FlockData flockData)
	{
		foreach (FlockChild child in flockData.Children)
		{
			child.transform.SetParent(_activeContainer);
		}
		flockData.Audio.transform.SetParent(_activeContainer);
		flockData.Active = true;
	}

	private void DeactivateFlock(FlockData flockData)
	{
		if (!flockData.Active)
		{
			return;
		}
		foreach (FlockChild child in flockData.Children)
		{
			DeactivateFlockChild(child);
		}
		flockData.Audio.transform.SetParent(_deactivatedContainer);
		flockData.Active = false;
	}

	private void DeactivateFlocks()
	{
		foreach (KeyValuePair<FlockSpecies, FlockData> availableFlock in _availableFlocks)
		{
			FlockData value = availableFlock.Value;
			DeactivateFlock(value);
		}
	}

	public void DeactivateFlockChild(FlockChild flockChild)
	{
		flockChild.transform.SetParent(_deactivatedContainer);
	}

	private void RefreshAvailableFlocks()
	{
		_flockData = _flockProvider.GetFlocks();
	}

	public void SetNewWaypointForSpecies(FlockSpecies species, Vector3 forward)
	{
		Vector3 newWaypoint = GetNewWaypoint(_availableFlocks[species].Waypoint, forward);
		foreach (FlockChild child in _availableFlocks[species].Children)
		{
			child.SpeciesWaypoint = newWaypoint;
		}
		_availableFlocks[species].Waypoint = newWaypoint;
		_availableFlocks[species].Audio.TargetPosition = newWaypoint;
	}

	private Vector3 GetNewWaypoint(Vector3 previousWaypoint, Vector3 forward)
	{
		Vector3 vector = Vector3.Lerp(forward, UnityEngine.Random.onUnitSphere, _waypointForwardBias) * _waypointDistance;
		if (Vector3Tools.DistanceOnAxis(ControllerPosition, previousWaypoint + vector, Vector3Tools.xz) > _size.x)
		{
			vector.x *= -1f;
			vector.z *= -1f;
		}
		Vector3 result = previousWaypoint + vector;
		result.y = Mathf.Lerp(previousWaypoint.y, result.y, _waypointHeightBias);
		result.y = Mathf.Clamp(result.y, ControllerPosition.y, ControllerPosition.y + _size.y);
		return result;
	}

	private Vector3 GetStartingPosition()
	{
		Vector3 vector = ControllerPosition - PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers[0].transform.position;
		vector.y = 0f;
		vector.Normalize();
		return ControllerPosition + vector * (_size.x + _spawnBuffer.x);
	}

	public void RemoveChildFromFlock(FlockChild flockChild)
	{
		if (_availableFlocks.TryGetValue(flockChild.Species, out var value))
		{
			value.Children.Remove(flockChild);
			FlockChild flockChild2 = CreateFlockChild(value);
			if (value.Active)
			{
				flockChild2.transform.SetParent(_activeContainer);
			}
			flockChild2.SpeciesWaypoint = value.Waypoint;
			InitializeFlockChild(flockChild2, GetStartingPosition());
			if (value.Migrating)
			{
				flockChild2.Migrate();
			}
		}
	}

	private Vector3 GetRandomPositionInBounds()
	{
		Vector3 result = ControllerPosition + UnityEngine.Random.insideUnitSphere * _size.x;
		result.y = ControllerPosition.y + UnityEngine.Random.Range(0f, _size.y);
		return result;
	}

	private Vector3 GetRandomPositionOnBounds()
	{
		Vector3 result = ControllerPosition + UnityEngine.Random.onUnitSphere * _size.x;
		result.y = ControllerPosition.y + UnityEngine.Random.Range(0f, _size.y);
		return result;
	}

	private void ReplicatedRepositionOrigin(Vector3 position)
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsServer())
		{
			ReplicatedRepositionOriginMsg replicatedRepositionOriginMsg = new ReplicatedRepositionOriginMsg();
			replicatedRepositionOriginMsg.Position = position;
			replicatedRepositionOriginMsg.Post();
		}
		RepositionOrigin(position);
	}

	private bool CheckTime(float startTime, float endTime)
	{
		return IsTimeBetween(GameTime.Now.TimeOfDay, TimeSpan.FromHours(startTime), TimeSpan.FromHours(endTime));
	}

	private bool IsTimeBetween(TimeSpan time, TimeSpan startTime, TimeSpan endTime)
	{
		if (endTime == startTime)
		{
			return true;
		}
		if (endTime < startTime)
		{
			if (!(time <= endTime))
			{
				return time >= startTime;
			}
			return true;
		}
		if (time >= startTime)
		{
			return time <= endTime;
		}
		return false;
	}
}

using UnityEngine;

namespace Beam;

public class InteractiveObject_PALM : InteractiveObject
{
	private class ReplicateConnectTreeSegments : MultiplayerMessage
	{
		[Replicate]
		public MiniGuid[] SegmentsReferenceIds;

		public ReplicateConnectTreeSegments()
		{
		}

		public ReplicateConnectTreeSegments(List<InteractiveObject_PALM_LOG> segments)
		{
			SegmentsReferenceIds = new MiniGuid[segments.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < segments.Count; i++)
			{
				SegmentsReferenceIds[i] = segments[i].ReferenceId;
			}
		}

		public override void OnPeer()
		{
			Timing.RunCoroutine(ConnectSegments());
		}

		private IEnumerator<float> ConnectSegments()
		{
			List<InteractiveObject_PALM_LOG> segments = new List<InteractiveObject_PALM_LOG>();
			float startTime = Time.unscaledTime;
			bool found = false;
			while (!found && !(Time.unscaledTime > startTime + Peer.DEFAULT_TIMEOUT))
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < SegmentsReferenceIds.Length; i++)
				{
					MiniGuid referenceId = SegmentsReferenceIds[i];
					if (!referenceId.IsDefault())
					{
						InteractiveObject_PALM_LOG interactiveObject_PALM_LOG = MultiplayerMng.FindObject<InteractiveObject_PALM_LOG>(referenceId);
						if (!interactiveObject_PALM_LOG.IsNullOrDestroyed())
						{
							segments.Add(interactiveObject_PALM_LOG);
							SegmentsReferenceIds[i] = default;
						}
					}
				}
				found = SegmentsReferenceIds.Length == segments.Count;
				if (!found)
				{
					yield return 0f;
				}
			}
			if (found)
			{
				ConnectTreeSegments(segments);
			}
			else
			{
				PlayerRegistry.LocalPeer.ReplicatedDisconnect(DisconnectDetail.Timeout_PalmSegments);
			}
		}
	}

	private List<InteractiveObject_PALM_LOG> GenerateTreeSegments()
	{
		List<InteractiveObject_PALM_LOG> list = new List<InteractiveObject_PALM_LOG>();
		float num = 1.638f;
		Vector3 localPosition = new Vector3(_treeTrunk.localPosition.x, num, _treeTrunk.localPosition.z);
		InteractiveObject_PALM_LOG interactiveObject_PALM_LOG = MultiplayerMng.Instantiate<InteractiveObject_PALM_LOG>(Singleton<TreeManager>.Instance.TreeSegments[0].PrefabId, MiniGuid.New());
		interactiveObject_PALM_LOG.transform.rotation = transform.rotation;
		interactiveObject_PALM_LOG.transform.parent = transform;
		interactiveObject_PALM_LOG.transform.localPosition = localPosition;
		interactiveObject_PALM_LOG.transform.parent = null;
		interactiveObject_PALM_LOG.TransformParent = Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.NmlZone.SaveContainer;
		interactiveObject_PALM_LOG.Parent();
		list.Add(interactiveObject_PALM_LOG);
		if (_treeNumber != 1)
		{
			localPosition = new Vector3(_treeTrunk.localPosition.x, num + 2.03f, _treeTrunk.localPosition.z);
			int num2 = 1;
			if (_treeNumber == 2)
			{
				num2 = 2;
			}
			for (int i = 1; i < _treeNumber; i++)
			{
				interactiveObject_PALM_LOG = MultiplayerMng.Instantiate<InteractiveObject_PALM_LOG>(Singleton<TreeManager>.Instance.TreeSegments[num2].PrefabId, MiniGuid.New());
				interactiveObject_PALM_LOG.transform.rotation = transform.rotation;
				interactiveObject_PALM_LOG.transform.parent = transform;
				interactiveObject_PALM_LOG.transform.localPosition = localPosition;
				interactiveObject_PALM_LOG.transform.parent = null;
				interactiveObject_PALM_LOG.TransformParent = Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.NmlZone.SaveContainer;
				interactiveObject_PALM_LOG.Parent();
				list.Add(interactiveObject_PALM_LOG);
				localPosition += new Vector3(0f, 2.03f, 0f);
				num2 = 2;
				if (_treeNumber == 4 && i == 3)
				{
					num2 = 1;
				}
			}
		}
		InteractiveObject_PALM_LOG interactiveObject_PALM_LOG2 = MultiplayerMng.Instantiate<InteractiveObject_PALM_LOG>(Singleton<TreeManager>.Instance.TreeTopSegement.PrefabId, MiniGuid.New());
		interactiveObject_PALM_LOG2.transform.rotation = transform.rotation;
		interactiveObject_PALM_LOG2.transform.parent = transform;

		interactiveObject_PALM_LOG2.transform.parent = null;

		interactiveObject_PALM_LOG2.Parent();
		list.Add(interactiveObject_PALM_LOG2);
		return list;

	private void GenerateFruit()
	{
		if (_fruits.Count != 0)
		{
			return;
		}
		Vector3 localPosition = new Vector3(0f, 1f + 2.03f * (float)_treeNumber, 0f);
		GameObject gameObject = Object.Instantiate(_fruitSpawnerPrefab);
		gameObject.transform.parent = transform;
		gameObject.transform.localPosition = localPosition;
		int num = Mathf.Min(Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.GenerateLocalSeed(transform.position).Range(1, gameObject.transform.childCount), 63);
		for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
		{
			MiniGuid referenceId = MiniGuid.NewFrom(ReferenceId, i + 1);
			Transform fruitPosition = gameObject.transform.GetChild(i);
			if (Game.Mode.IsMaster())
			{
				AddFruit(MultiplayerMng.Instantiate<InteractiveObject_FOOD>(_fruit.PrefabId, fruitPosition.position, fruitPosition.rotation, referenceId), fruitPosition);
				continue;
			}
			MultiplayerZoneSync.Instance.LinkData(MultiplayerZoneSync.Usage.Palm, referenceId, (MultiplayerZoneSync.Command command) =>
			{
				AddFruit((InteractiveObject_FOOD)command.Instance, fruitPosition);
			});
		}
		BeamTeam.Destroy(gameObject);
	}

	private void AddFruit(InteractiveObject_FOOD fruit, Transform fruitPosition)
	{
		fruit.transform.parent = null;
		fruit.TransformParent = Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.NmlZone.SaveContainer;
		fruit.Parent();
		AttachFruit(fruit, fruitPosition);
	}

	public override void Damage(float damage, IBase damager)
	{
		IPickupable pickupable = damager as IPickupable;
		if (!pickupable.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			IPlayer playerFromId = PlayerUtilities.GetPlayerFromId(pickupable.OwnerId);
			if (!playerFromId.IsNullOrDestroyed() && !playerFromId.Movement.ClimbingLadder)
			{
				BaseUtilities.DoPlayerDamageMultipliers_Harvesting(ref damage, pickupable);
				_fallDir = playerFromId.transform.forward;
				base.Damage(damage, damager);
				Vector3 vector = new Vector3(0f, 0.15f / (OriginalHealthPoints / damage), 0f);
				_treeTrunk.localPosition += vector;
			}
		}
	}

	public override void Destroy()
	{
		BaseUtilities.DoPlayerDamageExperience_Harvesting(OriginalHealthPoints, LastPlayerIdToDamageThis);
		Lop();
	}

	private void Lop()
	{
		GetComponent<BoxCollider>().enabled = false;
		DetachFruit();
		if (Game.Mode.IsMaster())
		{
			List<InteractiveObject_PALM_LOG> list = GenerateTreeSegments();
			ReplicatedConnectTreeSegments(list);
			float num = Mathf.Max(10f, 20f / (float)list.Count);
			list[list.Count - 1].rigidbody.AddForce(_fallDir * num, ForceMode.Impulse);
		}
		Ladders componentInChildren = GetComponentInChildren<Ladders>();
		if (componentInChildren != null)
		{
			foreach (IPlayer allPlayer in PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers)
			{
				if (allPlayer.Movement.activeLadder == componentInChildren)
				{
					allPlayer.Movement.ExitLadder();
				}
			}
		}
		_stump.transform.parent = transform.parent;
		transform.CheckForProjectilesInChildren();
		ActionEventData.Populate(this, null);
		Lopped?.Invoke(this, ActionEventData);
		BeamTeam.Destroy(gameObject);
	}

	private static void ConnectTreeSegments(List<InteractiveObject_PALM_LOG> segments)
	{
		int num = 0;
		for (int i = 0; i < segments.Count - 1; i++)
		{
			InteractiveObject_PALM_LOG interactiveObject_PALM_LOG = segments[i];
			InteractiveObject_PALM_LOG interactiveObject_PALM_LOG2 = segments[i + 1];
			if (i > 0)
			{
				InteractiveObject_PALM_LOG connectedBelowLog = segments[i - 1];
				interactiveObject_PALM_LOG.ConnectedBelowLog = connectedBelowLog;
			}
			interactiveObject_PALM_LOG.ConnectedAboveLog = interactiveObject_PALM_LOG2;
			FixedJoint fixedJoint = segments[i].gameObject.AddComponent<FixedJoint>();
			fixedJoint.connectedBody = interactiveObject_PALM_LOG2.rigidbody;
			fixedJoint.breakForce = float.PositiveInfinity;
			fixedJoint.breakTorque = float.PositiveInfinity;
			interactiveObject_PALM_LOG.FixedJoint = fixedJoint;
			num++;
		}
		if (num > 0)
		{
			InteractiveObject_PALM_LOG connectedBelowLog2 = segments[num - 1];
			segments[num].ConnectedBelowLog = connectedBelowLog2;
		}
		foreach (InteractiveObject_PALM_LOG segment in segments)
		{
			segment.CheckSeperated();
		}
	}

	public void AttachFruit(InteractiveObject_FOOD fruit, Transform position)
	{
		if (position.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			fruit.Attach(null);
		}
		else
		{
			fruit.Attach(new StaticAttachingAnchor(position));
		}
		fruit.DetachedEvent += Fruit_Detached;
		_fruits.Add(fruit);
	}

	private void DetachFruit()
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < _fruits.Count; i++)
		{
			InteractiveObject_FOOD interactiveObject_FOOD = _fruits[i];
			interactiveObject_FOOD.DetachedEvent -= Fruit_Detached;
			interactiveObject_FOOD.DetachFromImpact();
			interactiveObject_FOOD.rigidbody.AddForce(_fallDir * 4f, ForceMode.VelocityChange);
		}
		_fruits.Clear();
	}

	private void Fruit_Detached(IAttachable sender)
	{
		InteractiveObject_FOOD interactiveObject_FOOD = sender as InteractiveObject_FOOD;
		interactiveObject_FOOD.DetachedEvent -= Fruit_Detached;
		_fruits.Remove(interactiveObject_FOOD);
	}

	private void ReplicatedConnectTreeSegments(List<InteractiveObject_PALM_LOG> segments)
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
		{
			new ReplicateConnectTreeSegments(segments).Post();
		}
		ConnectTreeSegments(segments);
	}

	public override JObject Save()
	{
		JObject jObject = base.Save();
		if (_fruits.Count > 0)
		{
			JObject jObject2 = new JObject();
			for (int i = 0; i < _fruits.Count; i++)
			{
				jObject2.Add(_fruits[i].ReferenceId.ToString());
			}
			jObject.AddField("Fruits", jObject2);
		}
		return jObject;
	}

	public override void Load(JObject data)
	{
		base.Load(data);
		JObject fruitsData = data.GetField("Fruits");
		if (fruitsData == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		LevelLoader.CurrentLoader.DeferredLoading.Add(() =>
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < fruitsData.Children.Count; i++)
			{
				InteractiveObject_FOOD interactiveObject_FOOD = MultiplayerMng.FindObject<InteractiveObject_FOOD>(fruitsData.Children[i].GetValue<string>().ToMiniGuid());
				if (interactiveObject_FOOD != null)
				{
					AttachFruit(interactiveObject_FOOD, interactiveObject_FOOD.transform);
				}
			}
		});
	}
}

			IsKinematic = false;
			IsDraggable = true;
			CanPickUp = true;

		{
			this.LoadSkinnable(field2);
		}
	}

	public override MiniGuid ReferenceId

	private void Awake()
	{
		_raft.VehicleMovement.Operated += RaftVehicleMovement_Operated;
	}

	private void OnDestroy()
	{
		Timing.KillCoroutines(_deployedSequence);
		_raft.VehicleMovement.Operated -= RaftVehicleMovement_Operated;
		Singleton<BuoyancyManager>.Instance?.Remove(this);
	}

	private void RaftVehicleMovement_Operated(bool operated)
	{
		if (operated && Deployed)
		{
			Retrieve();
		}
	}

	public bool Interact(IPlayer player)
	{
		if (!Deployed)
		{
			if (!CanDeploy())
			{
				LocalizedNotification.Post(player, NotificationPriority.Low, 4f, "SEA_ANCHOR_NTF_TOO_SHALLOW_DESC");
				return false;
			}
			Deploy();
			return true;
		}
		if (Deployed)
		{
			Retrieve();
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	private void Deploy()
	{
		Singleton<BuoyancyManager>.Instance?.Add(this);
		_deployedAnchorTransform.gameObject.SetActive(value: true);
		_deployedAnchorTransform.position = transform.parent.position + Vector3.down * 1.1f + -Wind.Direction * 10f;
		_deployedAnchorTransform.rotation = Quaternion.LookRotation(Wind.Direction, Vector3.up);
		_deployedAnchorRope.gameObject.SetActive(value: true);
		_packedAnchorTransform.gameObject.SetActive(value: false);
		_raft.Buoyancy.EnableWind(enable: false);
		_raft.Buoyancy.SetDampening(0.7f);
		_deployedSequence = Timing.RunCoroutine(Deployed_Sequence());
		Deployed = true;
		OnDeploy?.Invoke();
	}

	public void Retrieve()
	{
		Singleton<BuoyancyManager>.Instance?.Remove(this);
		_deployedAnchorTransform.gameObject.SetActive(value: false);
		_deployedAnchorTransform.localPosition = Vector3.zero;
		_deployedAnchorRope.gameObject.SetActive(value: false);
		_packedAnchorTransform.gameObject.SetActive(value: true);
		_raft.Buoyancy.EnableWind(enable: true);
		_raft.Buoyancy.ResetDampening();
		Timing.KillCoroutines(_deployedSequence);
		Deployed = false;
		OnRetrieve?.Invoke();
	}

	public bool InteractWithObject(IPlayer player, IBase obj)
	{
		return Interact(player);
	}

	private bool CanDeploy()
	{
		if (Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance == null)
		{
			return true;
		}
		Vector3 vector = transform.parent.position + -Wind.Direction * 10f;
		if (Physics.CheckSphere(vector, _deployedAnchorCollider.radius, _deployedAnchorCollisionMask, QueryTriggerInteraction.Ignore))
		{
			return false;
		}
		if (Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.GetHeight(vector) > -5f)
		{
			return false;
		}
		return true;
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> Deployed_Sequence()
	{
		while (true)
		{
			_anchorWaveQuery.posX = _deployedAnchorTransform.position.x;
			_anchorWaveQuery.posZ = _deployedAnchorTransform.position.z;
			Vector3 position = _deployedAnchorTransform.position;
			position.y = _anchorWaveQuery.result.height - 1.1f;
			_deployedAnchorTransform.position = position;
			yield return 0f;
		}
	}

	public void Parent()
	{
	}

	public void Damage(float damage, IBase damager1)
	{
	}

	public void Destroy()
	{
	}

	public new JObject Save()
	{
		JObject jObject = new JObject();
		jObject.AddField("Deployed", Deployed);
		return jObject;
	}

	public new void Load(JObject data)
	{
		if (data.GetField("Deployed").GetValue<bool>())
		{
			Deploy();
		}
	}
}

	public static void LoadPlayer(Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject persistentData)
	{
		if (persistentData.GetField("CraftingCombinations") != null)
		{
			LoadPre_64_04_Player(persistentData);
		}
		else
		{
			PlayerRegistry.Load(persistentData.GetField("PlayerRegistry"));
		}
	}

	private static void LoadPre_64_04_Player(Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject persistentData)
	{
		Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject data = persistentData["CraftingCombinations"]["Combinations"];
		Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject jObject = new Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject();
		jObject.AddField("Combinations", data);
		Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject field = persistentData.GetField("PlayerRegistry");
		foreach (Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject child in field.Children)
		{
			child.AddField("Crafter", jObject);
		}
		UnityEngine.Debug.Log("LegacyUtilities:: Loading pre-0.64.04 player data...");
		PlayerRegistry.Load(field);
	}

	public static bool LoadStrandedWorldPlayerPosition_PreCoop(Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject data, out Vector3 position)
	{
		position = Vector3.zero;
		Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject field = data.GetField("PlayerPosition");
		if (field != null)
		{
			position = JSerializer.Deserialize<Vector3>(field);
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	public static bool LoadStrandedWorldPlayerZoneId_PreCoop(JToken data, out string zoneId)
	{
		zoneId = string.Empty;
		JToken jToken = data["PlayerZoneId"];
		if (jToken != null)
		{
			zoneId = jToken.ToObject<string>();
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}
