	private static bool IsLegacySaveFile()
	{
		if (SaveManager.CompareSaveFileVersion(GameMode.SinglePlayer, new Version(0, 71, 0)) == VersionStatus.Newer || SaveManager.CompareSaveFileVersion(GameMode.Coop_2, new Version(0, 71, 0)) == VersionStatus.Newer || SaveManager.CompareSaveFileVersion(GameMode.Coop_Server, new Version(0, 75, 0)) == VersionStatus.Newer)
		{
			return false;
		}
		return true;
	}

	private static bool IsLegacyWorld()
	{
		if (!Directory.Exists(FilePath.WORLD_FOLDER))
		{
			return false;
		}
		IEnumerable<string> enumerable = from x in Directory.GetDirectories(FilePath.WORLD_FOLDER)
			select Path.GetFileName(x) into x
			where !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x)
			select x;
		if (enumerable == null || enumerable.Count() == 0)
		{
			return false;
		}
		return enumerable.Contains("0_0");
	}

	private static void UseLegacyBackups()
	{
		string saveFilePath = SaveManager.GetSaveFilePath(GameMode.SinglePlayer);
		if (File.Exists(saveFilePath + "_LEGACY"))
		{
			File.Move(saveFilePath, saveFilePath + "_LEGACY2");
			File.Move(saveFilePath + "_LEGACY", saveFilePath);
			UnityEngine.Debug.Log("Using legacy save backup for 1P upgrade...");
		}
		saveFilePath = SaveManager.GetSaveFilePath(GameMode.Coop_2);
		if (File.Exists(saveFilePath + "_LEGACY"))
		{
			File.Move(saveFilePath, saveFilePath + "_LEGACY2");
			File.Move(saveFilePath + "_LEGACY", saveFilePath);
			UnityEngine.Debug.Log("Using legacy save backup for 2P upgrade...");
		}
		saveFilePath = SaveManager.GetSaveFilePath(GameMode.Coop_Server);
		if (File.Exists(saveFilePath + "_LEGACY"))
		{
			File.Move(saveFilePath, saveFilePath + "_LEGACY2");
			File.Move(saveFilePath + "_LEGACY", saveFilePath);
			UnityEngine.Debug.Log("Using legacy save backup for MP upgrade...");
		}
	}

	public static void UpgradeLegacyGame()
	{
		if (IsLegacySaveFile() && IsLegacyWorld())
		{
			Stopwatch stopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
			UpgradeLegacyWorld();
			UpgradeLegacySaveFiles();
			GC.Collect();
			UnityEngine.Debug.Log($"Upgraded world in: {stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds}ms");
		}
	}

	private static void UpgradeLegacyWorld()
	{
		UnityEngine.Debug.Log("LegacyUtilities::UpgradeLegacyWorld()");
		World.UpgradeLegacyWorld(out var _);
	}

	private static void UpgradeLegacySaveFiles()
	{
		UseLegacyBackups();
		UnityEngine.Debug.Log("LegacyUtilities::UpgradeLegacySaveFiles()");
		if (SaveManager.CheckSaveFileVersion(GameMode.SinglePlayer) || SaveManager.CheckSaveFileVersion(GameMode.Coop_2) || SaveManager.CheckSaveFileVersion(GameMode.Coop_Server))
		{
			SaveManager.BackupSaveFiles("_LEGACY");
			UpgradeSaveFile(GameMode.SinglePlayer);
			UpgradeSaveFile(GameMode.Coop_2);
			UpgradeSaveFile(GameMode.Coop_Server);
		}
	}

	private static void UpgradeSaveFile(GameMode mode)
	{
		UnityEngine.Debug.Log($"LegacyUtilities::UpgradeSaveFile:: Upgrading {mode} save file...");
		if (!SaveManager.CheckSaveFileVersion(mode))
		{
			return;
		}
		Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject jObject = SaveManager.LoadSaveFile(mode);
		if (jObject == null || jObject.IsNull())
		{
			UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("Root data null. Could not upgrade..");
			return;
		}
		Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject persistentData = SaveManager.GetPersistentData(jObject);
		if (persistentData == null || persistentData.IsNull())
		{
			UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("Persistent data null. Could not upgrade..");
			return;
		}
		Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject field = persistentData.GetField("StrandedWorld");
		if (field == null || field.IsNull())
		{
			UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("StrandedWorld data null. Could not upgrade..");
			return;
		}
		Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject field2 = field.GetField("Zones");
		if (field2 == null || field2.IsNull())
		{
			UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("Zone data null. Could not upgrade..");
			return;
		}
		Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject jObject2 = new Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject();
		int i = 0;
		int num = 0;
		for (; i < 7; i++)
		{
			int num2 = 0;
			while (num2 < 7)
			{
				Map map = World.MapList[num];
				Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject jObject3 = new Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject();
				jObject3.AddField("Name", map.EditorData.Name);
				jObject3.AddField("Id", map.EditorData.Id);
				jObject3.AddField("Version", map.EditorData.VersionNumber);
				jObject2.Add(jObject3);
				num2++;
				num++;
			}
		}
		int num3 = 1;
		int num4 = 1;
		int j = 0;
		int num5 = 0;
		for (; j < 5; j++)
		{
			int num6 = 0;
			while (num6 < 5)
			{
				Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject value = field2.Children[num5];
				int num7 = j + num3;
				int num8 = num6 + num4;
				jObject2.Children[num8 * 7 + num7] = value;
				num6++;
				num5++;
			}
		}
		FixRigidbodyWorldPositions_Pre_72_00(jObject2);
		field["Zones"] = jObject2;
		Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject field3 = field.GetField("PlayersData");
		Vector2[] array = new Vector2[2];
		Vector3[] array2 = new Vector3[field3.Children.Count];
		for (int k = 0; k < field3.Children.Count; k++)
		{
			Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject jObject4 = field3.Children[k];
			string zoneId = jObject4.GetField("ZoneId").GetValue<string>();
			int num9 = World.MapList.FindIndex((Map map2) => map2.EditorData.Id == zoneId);
			if (num9 != -1)
			{
				array[k] = World.GenerationZonePositons[num9];
				Vector3 vector = ConvertLegacyWorldPositionToLocal(JSerializer.Deserialize<Vector3>(jObject4.GetField("Position")), World.GenerationZonePositons[num9]);
				array2[k] = vector;
				Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject value2 = JSerializer.Serialize(array2[k]);
				jObject4["Position"] = value2;
			}
		}
		Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject field4 = persistentData.GetField("PlayerRegistry");
		for (int num10 = 0; num10 < field4.Children.Count; num10++)
		{
			Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject jObject5 = field4.Children[num10];
			Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject value3 = JSerializer.Serialize(array2[num10]);
			jObject5["Movement"]["Transform"]["localPosition"] = value3;
		}
		FixPiscusFollowerWorldPositions(persistentData, array);
		Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject jObject6 = new Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject();
		jObject6.AddField("Version", JSerializer.Serialize(BuildInformation.BuildVersion.ToPaddedString()));
		jObject6.AddField("Persistent", persistentData);
		Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject field5 = jObject.GetField("CustomSettings");
		if (field5 != null)
		{
			jObject6.AddField("CustomSettings", field5);
		}
		Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject field6 = jObject.GetField("ScreenCapture");
		if (field6 != null)
		{
			jObject6.AddField("ScreenCapture", field6);
		}
		SaveManager.SaveToFile(SaveManager.GetSaveFilePath(mode), jObject6);
	}

	private static void FixPiscusFollowerWorldPositions(Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject persistentData, Vector2[] newPositions)
	{
		Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject field = persistentData.GetField("PiscusFollower");
		if (field != null)
		{
			Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject jObject = new Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject();
			for (int i = 0; i < field.Children.Count; i++)
			{
				_ = field.Children[i];
				Vector3 zero = Vector3.zero;
				zero.x = newPositions[i].x;
				zero.z = newPositions[i].y;
				jObject.AddField("CenterGridPos_" + i, JSerializer.Serialize(zero));
			}
			persistentData["PiscusFollower"] = jObject;
		}
	}

	private static void FixRigidbodyWorldPositions_Pre_72_00(Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject zonesData)
	{
		foreach (Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject child in zonesData.Children)
		{
			string id = child.GetField("Id").GetValue<string>();
			int num = World.MapList.FindIndex((Map map) => map.EditorData.Id == id);
			if (num != -1)
			{
				Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject field = child.GetField("Objects");
				if (field != null && !field.IsNull())
				{
					RecursiveFixRigidbodyWorldPositions(field, World.GenerationZonePositons[num]);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	private static void RecursiveFixRigidbodyWorldPositions(Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject rootData, Vector3 newOrigin)
	{
		foreach (Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject child in rootData.Children)
		{
			if (child.IsNull())
			{
				continue;
			}
			Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject field = child.GetField("Rigidbody");
			if (field != null)
			{
				FixRigidbodyWorldPosition(field, newOrigin);
			}
			Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject field2 = child.GetField("Ragdolls");
			if (field2 != null && !field2.IsNull())
			{
				foreach (Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject child2 in field2.Children)
				{
					FixRigidbodyWorldPosition(child2, newOrigin);
				}
			}
			RecursiveFixRigidbodyWorldPositions(child, newOrigin);
		}
	}

	private static void FixRigidbodyWorldPosition(Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject rigidbodyData, Vector3 newOrigin)
	{
		if (rigidbodyData == null || rigidbodyData.IsNull())
		{
			UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("FixRigidbodyWorldPosition:: Rigidbody data is null or empty.");
			return;
		}
		Vector3 vector = ConvertLegacyWorldPositionToLocal(rigidbodyData.GetField("position"), newOrigin);
		rigidbodyData["position"] = JSerializer.Serialize(vector);
	}

	public static Vector3 ConvertLegacyWorldPositionToLocal(Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject worldPositionData, Vector2 localOrigin)
	{
		return ConvertLegacyWorldPositionToLocal(JSerializer.Deserialize<Vector3>(worldPositionData), localOrigin);
	}

	public static Vector3 ConvertLegacyWorldPositionToLocal(Vector3 worldPosition, Vector2 localOrigin)
	{
		Vector3 vector = worldPosition;
		vector.x -= 315f;
		vector.z -= 315f;
		float num = BeamMath.Frac(vector.x / 630f);
		float num2 = BeamMath.Frac(vector.z / 630f);
		float num3 = num * 630f;
		float num4 = num2 * 630f;
		float num5 = (float)Math.Sign(vector.x) * 315f;
		float num6 = (float)Math.Sign(vector.z) * 315f;
		num3 -= num5;
		num4 -= num6;
		Vector3 zero = Vector3.zero;
		zero.x = localOrigin.x + num3;
		zero.z = localOrigin.y + num4;
		zero.y = vector.y;
		return zero;
	}

	public static bool ResetInput_Pre_65_05()
	{
		Version fileVersion = Options.GetFileVersion();
		if (fileVersion == null)
		{
			return false;
		}
		VersionStatus versionStatus = (VersionStatus)fileVersion.CompareTo(new Version(0, 65, 5));
		if (versionStatus == VersionStatus.Equal || versionStatus == VersionStatus.Newer)
		{
			return false;
		}
		Options.Load();
		Rewired.Player player = ReInput.players.GetPlayer(0);
		player.controllers.maps.LoadDefaultMaps(ControllerType.Mouse);
		player.controllers.maps.LoadDefaultMaps(ControllerType.Keyboard);
		player.controllers.maps.LoadDefaultMaps(ControllerType.Joystick);
		Options.InputSettings = new InputSettings();
		Options.Save();
		UnityEngine.Debug.Log("LegacyUtilities:: Reset input for pre-0.65.05 settings.");
		return true;
	}

	public static bool HasSaveFilePre_74_00(GameMode mode, out string filePath)
	{
		filePath = string.Empty;
		string userId = GAccountService.Get().LocalUser.UserInfo.UserId;
		if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(userId))
		{
			return false;
		}
		string text = PathTools.Combine(FilePath.LEGACY_SAVE_FOLDER, userId);
		if (!Directory.Exists(text))
		{
			return false;
		}
		string text2 = PathTools.Combine(text, userId + FilePath.GetSaveFileExtension(mode));
		if (!File.Exists(text2))
		{
			return false;
		}
		filePath = text2;
		return true;
	}

	public static void MigrateSaveDataPre_74_00()
	{
		string filePath = string.Empty;
		string filePath2 = string.Empty;
		if ((0u | (HasSaveFilePre_74_00(GameMode.SinglePlayer, out filePath) ? 1u : 0u) | (HasSaveFilePre_74_00(GameMode.Coop_2, out filePath2) ? 1u : 0u)) != 0)
		{
			string text = PathTools.Combine(FilePath.SAVE_FOLDER, FilePath.GetSlotFolderName(0));
			if (!Directory.Exists(text))
			{
				Directory.CreateDirectory(text);
			}
			string destFileName = PathTools.Combine(text, "data" + FilePath.GetSaveFileExtension(GameMode.SinglePlayer));
			string destFileName2 = PathTools.Combine(text, "data" + FilePath.GetSaveFileExtension(GameMode.Coop_2));
			if (File.Exists(filePath))
			{
				File.Copy(filePath, destFileName, overwrite: true);
			}
			if (File.Exists(filePath2))
			{
				File.Copy(filePath2, destFileName2, overwrite: true);
			}
			BeamTeam.CopyDirectory(PathTools.Combine(FilePath.LEGACY_SAVE_FOLDER, "Editor/World"), PathTools.Combine(text, "World"));
			BeamTeam.CopyDirectory(PathTools.Combine(FilePath.LEGACY_SAVE_FOLDER, "Editor/Heightmaps"), PathTools.Combine(text, "Heightmaps"));
			BeamTeam.CopyDirectory(PathTools.Combine(FilePath.LEGACY_SAVE_FOLDER, "Editor/Maps"), FilePath.LOCAL_MAPS_FOLDER);
			string text2 = PathTools.Combine(FilePath.LEGACY_SAVE_FOLDER, "Options.json");
			if (File.Exists(text2))
			{
				File.Copy(text2, FilePath.OPTIONS_FILE, overwrite: true);
			}
			string text3 = PathTools.Combine(FilePath.LEGACY_SAVE_FOLDER, "Editor/Screenshots/dynamic.bytes");
			if (File.Exists(text3))
			{
				File.Copy(text3, PathTools.Combine(text, "dynamic.bytes"), overwrite: true);
			}
			string text4 = PathTools.Combine(FilePath.LEGACY_SAVE_FOLDER, "Editor/Screenshots/dynamic_COOP.bytes");
			if (File.Exists(text4))
			{
				File.Copy(text4, PathTools.Combine(text, "dynamic_COOP.bytes"), overwrite: true);
			}
		}
	}
}

using UnityEngine;

namespace Beam;

public static class MapTools
{
	public static Texture2D CreateHeightmapTexture(float[,] heightData)
	{
		Texture2D texture2D = new Texture2D(257, 257, TextureFormat.ARGB32, mipChain: false, linear: false);
		for (int i = 0; i < 257; i++)
		{
			for (int j = 0; j < 257; j++)
			{
				float num = heightData[i, j];
				float a = 1f;
				if (num * 150f - (float)Mathf.Abs(-100) < 0f)
				{
					num = 0f;
					a = 0f;
				}
				Color color = new Color(num, num, num, a);
				texture2D.SetPixel(j, i, color);
			}
		}
		texture2D.Apply();
		return texture2D;
	}

	public static float[,] GetHeightsFromTexture(Texture2D heightmap)
	{
		float[,] array = new float[257, 257];
		Color[] pixels = heightmap.GetPixels();
		for (int i = 0; i < 257; i++)
		{
			for (int j = 0; j < 257; j++)
			{
				Color color = pixels[j * 257 + i];
				array[j, i] = color.grayscale;
			}
		}
		return array;
	}

	public static string FormatNameForSave(string mapName)
	{
		return mapName.Replace(" ", "_");
	}
}

	public List<IPlayer> ActivePlayers = new List<IPlayer>();

	private const float START_DISTANCE = 40f;

	private const float FAIL_DISTANCE = 80f;

	private const float PROXIMITY_DISTANCE = 15f;

	[SerializeField]
	private MissionAssetLoader _missionAssetLoader;

	[SerializeField]
	private MissionData _missionData;

	[SerializeField]
	private bool _missionActivated;

	[SerializeField]
	private bool _missionLeave;

	private bool _missionCompleted;

	private bool _inProximity;

	public IMissionData MissionData => _missionData;

	public IMissionGoal MissionGoal { get; set; }

	public event Action<IMissionDetailsProvider, bool> MissionStarted;

	public event Action<IMissionDetailsProvider> MissionCompleted;

	public event Action MissionFailed;

	public event Action MissionEnded;

	public event Action<bool> EnteredMissionProximity;

	public event Action LeftMissionProximity;

	protected virtual void OnMissionStarted(IMissionDetailsProvider missionDetailsProvider, bool alreadyStarted)
	{
		MissionStarted?.Invoke(missionDetailsProvider, alreadyStarted);
		MultiplayerMng.UpdateSessionToken_IsBusy(isBusy: true);
	}

	protected virtual void OnMissionCompleted(IMissionDetailsProvider missionDetailsProvider)
	{
		MissionCompleted?.Invoke(missionDetailsProvider);
		MultiplayerMng.UpdateSessionToken_IsBusy(isBusy: false);
	}

	protected virtual void OnMissionFailed()
	{
		MissionFailed?.Invoke();
		MultiplayerMng.UpdateSessionToken_IsBusy(isBusy: false);
	}

	protected virtual void OnMissionEnded()
	{
		MissionEnded?.Invoke();
		MultiplayerMng.UpdateSessionToken_IsBusy(isBusy: false);
	}

	protected virtual void OnEnteredMissionProximity(bool showHUD)
	{
		EnteredMissionProximity?.Invoke(showHUD);
	}

	protected virtual void OnLeftMissionProximity()
	{
		LeftMissionProximity?.Invoke();
	}

	private void Start()
	{
		StartCoroutine(Initialize_Sequence());
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> Initialize_Sequence()
	{
		_missionAssetLoader.LoadedGoal += MissionAssetLoader_LoadedGoal;
		_missionAssetLoader.LoadFailed += MissionAssetLoader_LoadFailed;
		_missionAssetLoader.Load();
		while (LevelLoader.IsLoading())
		{
			yield return 0f;
		}
		InvokeRepeating("PollActivation_InvokeRepeating", 0f, 1f);
	}

	private void OnDestroy()
	{
		MissionStarted = null;
		MissionCompleted = null;
		MissionFailed = null;
		MissionEnded = null;
		EnteredMissionProximity = null;
		LeftMissionProximity = null;
	}

	private void PollActivation_InvokeRepeating()
	{
		if (_missionCompleted)
		{
			CancelInvoke("PollActivation_InvokeRepeating");
		}
		else
		{
			if (MissionGoal == null || LevelLoader.IsServerJoinInProgress)
			{
				return;
			}
			IPlayer player = PlayerUtilities.FindClosestPlayer(transform.position, out var distance);
			float playerDistanceFromMission = PlayerUtilities.GetPlayerDistanceFromMission(transform.position, PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer);
			if (distance < 40f && (!_missionActivated || (!ActivePlayers.Contains(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer) && playerDistanceFromMission < 40f)))
			{
				if (!ActivePlayers.Contains(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer) && playerDistanceFromMission < 40f)
				{
					ReplicatedComputeMissionStarted(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer, _missionActivated);
				}
				else if (!_missionActivated)
				{
					ReplicatedComputeMissionStarted(player, _missionActivated);
				}
			}
			else if ((distance > 80f || (ActivePlayers.Contains(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer) && playerDistanceFromMission > 80f && !_missionLeave)) && _missionActivated)
			{
				if (ActivePlayers.Count == 2 && ActivePlayers.Contains(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer) && playerDistanceFromMission > 80f)
				{
					ReplicatedComputeMissionFailed(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer, onePlayerLeavesMission: true);
				}
				else
				{
					ReplicatedComputeMissionFailed(player, onePlayerLeavesMission: false);
				}
				return;
			}
			float playerDistanceFromMission2 = PlayerUtilities.GetPlayerDistanceFromMission(MissionGoal.Location, PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer);
			if (playerDistanceFromMission2 < 15f && !_inProximity)
			{
				ReplicatedComputeEnteredMission(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer);
			}
			else if (playerDistanceFromMission2 > 15f && _inProximity)
			{
				ReplicatedComputeLeftMission(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer);
			}
		}
	}

	private void ComputeMissionStarted(IPlayer player, bool alreadyStarted)
	{
		Debug.Log($"<color=#FF0000>Player {player.Id} starts Mission</color>");
		Zone zone = StrandedWorld.GetZone(player.transform.position);
		Zone zone2 = StrandedWorld.GetZone(transform.position);
		Zone zone3 = StrandedWorld.GetZone(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.transform.position);
		if (!ActivePlayers.Contains(player))
		{
			ActivePlayers.Add(player);
		}
		if (alreadyStarted)
		{
			_missionLeave = false;
		}
		if (zone == zone2 && (PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.CurrentMissionGoal == null || zone3 == zone2))
		{
			PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.CurrentMissionGoal = MissionGoal;
			OnMissionStarted(this, alreadyStarted);
		}
		_missionActivated = true;
	}

	private void ComputeMissionFailed(IPlayer player, bool onePlayerLeavesMission)
	{
		Debug.Log($"<color=#FF0000>Player {player.Id} failed Mission</color>");
		Zone zone = StrandedWorld.GetZone(player.transform.position);
		Zone zone2 = StrandedWorld.GetZone(transform.position);
		Zone zone3 = StrandedWorld.GetZone(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.transform.position);
		if (!onePlayerLeavesMission)
		{
			ActivePlayers.Clear();
		}
		if (zone == zone2 && PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.CurrentMissionGoal == MissionGoal && zone3 == zone2)
		{
			PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.CurrentMissionGoal = null;
			if (!onePlayerLeavesMission)
			{
				MissionGoal.Reset();
				_missionActivated = false;
			}
			OnMissionFailed();
			OnMissionEnded();
		}
	}

	private void ComputeEnteredMission(IPlayer player)
	{
		Zone zone = StrandedWorld.GetZone(player.transform.position);
		Zone zone2 = StrandedWorld.GetZone(transform.position);
		Zone zone3 = StrandedWorld.GetZone(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.transform.position);
		if (zone == zone2 && (PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.CurrentMissionGoal == MissionGoal || zone3 == zone2))
		{
			OnEnteredMissionProximity(zone3 == zone2);
			_inProximity = true;
		}
	}

	private void ComputeLeftMission(IPlayer player)
	{
		Zone zone = StrandedWorld.GetZone(player.transform.position);
		Zone zone2 = StrandedWorld.GetZone(transform.position);
		Zone zone3 = StrandedWorld.GetZone(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.transform.position);
		if (zone == zone2 && (PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.CurrentMissionGoal == MissionGoal || zone3 == zone2))
		{
			OnLeftMissionProximity();
			_inProximity = false;
		}
	}

	private void ComputeOnePlayerLeftMission(IPlayer player)
	{
		ActivePlayers.Remove(player);
		if (player == PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer)
		{
			_missionLeave = true;
		}
	}

	private void MissionAssetLoader_LoadedGoal(IMissionGoal goal)
	{
		MissionGoal = goal;
		if (Game.Mode.IsMaster())
		{
			MissionGoal.Completed += MissionGoal_Completed;
		}
	}

	private void MissionAssetLoader_LoadFailed()
	{
		LocalizedNotification localizedNotification = new LocalizedNotification(new Notification());
		localizedNotification.Priority = NotificationPriority.Immediate;
		localizedNotification.Duration = 4f;
		localizedNotification.MessageText.SetTerm("MISSIONS_MISSION_ASSET_LOADER_FAILED");
		localizedNotification.Raise();
	}

	private void MissionGoal_Completed()
	{
		ReplicatedMissionGoal_CompletedCore(PlayerUtilities.FindClosestPlayer(transform.position));
	}

	private void MissionGoal_CompletedCore(IPlayer player)
	{
		_missionCompleted = true;
		_missionActivated = false;
		MissionData.RewardProvider.DoRewards(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer);
		OnMissionCompleted(this);
		Zone zone = StrandedWorld.GetZone(player.transform.position);
		Zone zone2 = StrandedWorld.GetZone(transform.position);
		Zone zone3 = StrandedWorld.GetZone(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.transform.position);
		if (zone == zone2 && (PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.CurrentMissionGoal == null || PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.CurrentMissionGoal == MissionGoal || zone3 == zone2))
		{
			PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.CurrentMissionGoal = null;
			OnMissionEnded();
		}
	}

	private void ReplicatedMissionGoal_CompletedCore(IPlayer player)
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsServer())
		{
			ReplicateMissionGoal_Completed replicateMissionGoal_Completed = new ReplicateMissionGoal_Completed();
			replicateMissionGoal_Completed.MissionSaveablePrefab = this;
			replicateMissionGoal_Completed.Player = player;
			replicateMissionGoal_Completed.Post();
		}
		MissionGoal_CompletedCore(player);
	}

	private void ReplicatedComputeMissionStarted(IPlayer player, bool alreadyStarted)
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsServer() | alreadyStarted)
		{
			ReplicateMissionStarted replicateMissionStarted = new ReplicateMissionStarted();
			replicateMissionStarted.MissionSaveablePrefab = this;
			replicateMissionStarted.Player = player;
			replicateMissionStarted.AlreadyStarted = alreadyStarted;
			replicateMissionStarted.Post();
		}
		ComputeMissionStarted(player, alreadyStarted);
	}

	private void ReplicatedComputeMissionFailed(IPlayer player, bool onePlayerLeavesMission)
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsServer() && !onePlayerLeavesMission)
		{
			ReplicateMissionFailed replicateMissionFailed = new ReplicateMissionFailed();
			replicateMissionFailed.MissionSaveablePrefab = this;
			replicateMissionFailed.Player = player;
			replicateMissionFailed.OnePlayerLeavesMission = onePlayerLeavesMission;
			replicateMissionFailed.Post();
		}
		else if (onePlayerLeavesMission)
		{
			ReplicatedOnePlayerLeftMission(player);
		}
		ComputeMissionFailed(player, onePlayerLeavesMission);
	}

	private void ReplicatedComputeEnteredMission(IPlayer player)
	{
		ComputeEnteredMission(player);
	}

	private void ReplicatedComputeLeftMission(IPlayer player)
	{
		ComputeLeftMission(player);
	}

	private void ReplicatedOnePlayerLeftMission(IPlayer player)
	{
		ReplicateOnePlayerLeftMission replicateOnePlayerLeftMission = new ReplicateOnePlayerLeftMission();
		replicateOnePlayerLeftMission.MissionSaveablePrefab = this;
		replicateOnePlayerLeftMission.Player = player;
		replicateOnePlayerLeftMission.Post();
		ComputeOnePlayerLeftMission(player);
	}

	public override JObject Save()
	{
		JObject jObject = base.Save();
		JObject data = JSerializer.Serialize(transform);
		jObject.AddField("Transform", data);
		return jObject;
	}

	public override void Load(JObject data)
	{
		base.Load(data);
		JSerializer.DeserializeInto(data.GetField("Transform"), transform);
		CompleteTransformSerialization();
	}
}

namespace Beam;

public class PrefabSizeFitsBetweenTerrainAndOcean : PlacementValidator
{
	public override bool ValidatePlacement(Placement placement, IPlacementSettings settings)
	{
		float num = 0f;
		return ((Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance != null) ? Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.GetHeight(placement.Position) : (-100f)) + settings.Size.y < num;
	}
}



/* SOURCE_FILE: /storage/emulated/0/Map Check/reports/V15_SOURCE_EXTRACTED/Assembly-CSharp/Beam/ProjectileMovement.cs
SOURCE_BYTES: 11607
SOURCE_SHA256: 392c0a84e3094fe722705ca0f427d4f61b0812c88382a805a58ee3d0960546ec
MATCHES: StrandedWorld

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Beam.Crafting;
using Beam.Utilities;
using Funlabs;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Beam;

public class ProjectileMovement : MonoBehaviour
{
	private class ReplicateHandleCollision : MultiplayerMessage
	{
		[Replicate]
		public SaveablePrefab Projectile;

		[Replicate]
		public Vector3 ProjectilePosition;

		[Replicate]
		public Quaternion ProjectileRotation;

		[Replicate]
		public Rigidbody Rigidbody;

		[Replicate]
		public Collider Collider;

		[Replicate]
		public Vector3 Point;

		public override void OnPeer()
		{
			Projectile.GetComponent<ProjectileMovement>()._replicatedCollissions.Enqueue(this);
		}

		public void Execute(ProjectileMovement movement)
		{
			movement.HandleCollision(Rigidbody, Collider, Point);
			Projectile.transform.localPosition = ProjectilePosition;
			Projectile.transform.localRotation = ProjectileRotation;
		}
	}

	private class ReplicateLocalFaunaStick : MultiplayerMessage
	{
		[Replicate]
		public ProjectileObject Projectile;

		[Replicate]
		public Vector3 ProjectilePosition;

		[Replicate]
		public Vector3 ProjectileForward;

		[Replicate]
		public Vector3 Point;

		[Replicate]
		public byte Material;

		public override void OnPeer()
		{
			ProjectileMovement component = Projectile.GetComponent<ProjectileMovement>();
			component.SetupMultiplayerLaunch(fire: false);
			ProjectileEventDataVal projectileEventDataVal = new ProjectileEventDataVal(Point, (PhysicMaterial)Material);
			Projectile.transform.position = ProjectilePosition;
			Projectile.transform.forward = ProjectileForward;
			Projectile.LocalFaunaPierce();
			component._isStuck = true;
			component.Rigidbody.isKinematic = true;
			component.Rigidbody.velocity = Vector3.zero;
			component._trailRenderer.transform.SetParent(ParticleManager.TRAIL_CONTAINER, worldPositionStays: true);
			component._collider.enabled = true;
			component.Stuck?.Invoke(component, projectileEventDataVal);
		}
	}

	public static bool DEBUG_COLLISION;

	[SerializeField]
	private ProjectileCollisionDetectionBase _collisionDetection;

	[SerializeField]
	private LayerMask _collisionLayermask;

	[SerializeField]
	private LayerMask _autoAimLayermask;

	[SerializeField]
	private GameObject _impactParticle;

	[SerializeField]
	private GameObject _gib;

	[SerializeField]
	private float _projectileHead;

	[SerializeField]
	private float _projectileAutoAimRadius;

	[SerializeField]
	private int _projectileAutoAimSamples = 8;

	[SerializeField]
	private float _projectileDamage;

	[SerializeField]
	private TrailRenderer _trailRenderer;

	[PREFAB_PROCESSOR_GetComponent]
	[SerializeField]
	private Rigidbody _rigidbody;

	[PREFAB_PROCESSOR_GetComponent]
	[SerializeField]
	private Collider _collider;

	protected IPlayer _thrower;

	private IProjectile _projectile;

	private bool _isStuck;

	private RaycastHit _hit;

	private static string _raycastLabel;

	private Queue<ReplicateHandleCollision> _replicatedCollissions = new Queue<ReplicateHandleCollision>();

	public Rigidbody Rigidbody
	{
		get
		{
			if (_rigidbody == null)
			{
				_rigidbody = GetComponent<Rigidbody>();
			}
			return _rigidbody;
		}
	}

	public IBase AttachedBase { get; set; }

	public IPlayer Thrower => _thrower;

	public event Action<ProjectileMovement, IProjectileEventData> Stuck;

	public event Action<ProjectileMovement, IProjectileEventData> Broken;

	private void Awake()
	{
		_trailRenderer.transform.SetParent(ParticleManager.TRAIL_CONTAINER, worldPositionStays: false);
		_trailRenderer.transform.localPosition = Vector3.zero;
	}

	public void Initialize(IProjectile projectile)
	{
		_projectile = projectile;
	}

	private void OnDestroy()
	{
		Stuck = null;
		Broken = null;
		if (_trailRenderer != null)
		{
			BeamTeam.Destroy(_trailRenderer.gameObject);
		}
	}

	public void Fire(IPlayer player)
	{
		_collider.enabled = false;
		_thrower = player;
		_trailRenderer.transform.SetParent(transform, worldPositionStays: false);
		_trailRenderer.transform.localPosition = Vector3.zero;
		_trailRenderer.Clear();
		SetupMultiplayerLaunch(fire: true);
	}

	private void SetupMultiplayerLaunch(bool fire)
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
		{
			Rigidbody.isKinematic = !fire;
			Rigidbody.useGravity = fire;
			((SaveablePrefab)_projectile).ParentId = (fire ? TransformId.Unknown : gameObject.transform.parent.GetTransfromId());
		}
	}

	public void Reset()
	{
		_collider.enabled = true;
		_thrower = null;
		_isStuck = false;
		AttachedBase = null;
	}

	private void FixedUpdate()
	{
		if (_isStuck || Rigidbody == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		if (Rigidbody.velocity.magnitude > 0.001f)
		{
			Rigidbody.MoveRotation(Quaternion.LookRotation(Rigidbody.velocity));
		}
		if (_thrower.IsOwner)
		{
			CheckCollision((Vector3 position, RaycastHit hit) =>
			{
				Vector3 point = hit.point;
				Collider collider = hit.collider;
				Rigidbody rigidbody = hit.rigidbody;
				PhysicMaterialPenetration penetration = GetPenetration(collider);
				if (penetration == PhysicMaterialPenetration.STICK)
				{
					Rigidbody.position = position;
				}
				if (Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
				{
					if (PhysicMaterialPenetration.STICK == penetration && GetAttachedBase(collider, rigidbody) is Interactive_FISHES)
					{
						if (Game.Mode.IsClient())
						{
							GetPositionAndForward(point, out var position2, out var forward);
							ReplicateLocalFaunaStick replicateLocalFaunaStick = new ReplicateLocalFaunaStick();
							replicateLocalFaunaStick.Projectile = (ProjectileObject)_projectile;
							replicateLocalFaunaStick.Point = point;
							replicateLocalFaunaStick.Material = (byte)PhysicMaterialUtility.GetPhysicMaterialType(collider);
							replicateLocalFaunaStick.ProjectilePosition = position2;
							replicateLocalFaunaStick.ProjectileForward = forward;
							replicateLocalFaunaStick.Post();
						}
						HandleCollision(rigidbody, collider, point);
					}
					else
					{
						collider = (collider.IsReplicable() ? collider : null);
						rigidbody = (rigidbody.IsReplicable() ? rigidbody : null);
						ReplicatedHandleCollision(rigidbody, collider, point);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					HandleCollision(rigidbody, collider, point);
				}
			});
		}
		if (_replicatedCollissions.Count != 0)
		{
			_replicatedCollissions.Dequeue().Execute(this);
		}
	}

	private void CheckCollision(Action<Vector3, RaycastHit> onCollision)
	{
		if (_collisionDetection.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			return;
		}
		Vector3 vector = ((Rigidbody.velocity.magnitude < 0.001f) ? transform.forward : Rigidbody.velocity.normalized);
		Quaternion quaternion = Quaternion.LookRotation(vector);
		float num = _projectileHead + Time.fixedDeltaTime * 120f;
		if (_collisionDetection.CheckCollisions(new Ray(Rigidbody.position, vector), out _hit, num, _collisionLayermask.value))
		{
			onCollision(Rigidbody.position, _hit);
			return;
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < _projectileAutoAimSamples; i++)
		{
			Vector3 zero = Vector3.zero;
			zero.x = UnityEngine.Random.Range(0f - _projectileAutoAimRadius, _projectileAutoAimRadius);
			zero.y = UnityEngine.Random.Range(0f - _projectileAutoAimRadius, _projectileAutoAimRadius);
			Vector3 vector2 = Rigidbody.position + quaternion * zero;
			if (Physics.Raycast(new Ray(vector2, vector), out _hit, num, _autoAimLayermask.value))
			{
				onCollision(vector2, _hit);
				break;
			}
		}
	}

	private void ReplicatedHandleCollision(Rigidbody rigidbody, Collider collider, Vector3 point)
	{
		if (HandleCollision(rigidbody, collider, point) && Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
		{
			ReplicateHandleCollision replicateHandleCollision = new ReplicateHandleCollision();
			replicateHandleCollision.Projectile = GetComponent<SaveablePrefab>();
			replicateHandleCollision.ProjectilePosition = transform.localPosition;
			replicateHandleCollision.ProjectileRotation = transform.localRotation;
			replicateHandleCollision.Rigidbody = rigidbody;
			replicateHandleCollision.Collider = collider;
			replicateHandleCollision.Point = point;
			replicateHandleCollision.Post();
		}
	}

	private bool HandleCollision(Rigidbody rigidbody, Collider collider, Vector3 hitPoint)
	{
		PhysicMaterial physicMaterialType = PhysicMaterialUtility.GetPhysicMaterialType(collider);
		ProjectileEventDataVal projectileEventDataVal = new ProjectileEventDataVal(hitPoint, physicMaterialType);
		PhysicMaterialPenetration penetration = GetPenetration(collider);
		if (DEBUG_COLLISION)
		{
			StrandedWorld.AddDebugAxis(hitPoint, transform.rotation, $"R {rigidbody?.name}\nC {collider?.name}\nP {penetration}");
		}
		switch (penetration)
		{
		case PhysicMaterialPenetration.STICK:
		{
			SetupMultiplayerLaunch(fire: false);
			_isStuck = true;
			Vector3 force2 = Rigidbody.mass * Rigidbody.velocity;
			Rigidbody.velocity = Vector3.zero;
			GetPositionAndForward(hitPoint, out var position, out var forward);
			transform.position = position;
			transform.forward = forward;
			AttachedBase = GetAttachedBase(collider, rigidbody);
			ProjectileHit args = new ProjectileHit(collider.transform, AttachedBase);
			_projectile.Pierce(args);
			if (!AttachedBase.IsNullOrDestroyed())
			{
				IAttachable attachable = AttachedBase as IAttachable;
				if (attachable.IsNullOrDestroyed() || !attachable.IsAttached)
				{
					rigidbody?.AddForce(force2, ForceMode.Impulse);
				}
				Shootable component2 = AttachedBase.transform.GetComponent<Shootable>();
				if ((bool)component2)
				{
					component2.Shot?.Invoke(new DamageUnityEventArgs(_projectileDamage, _projectile as IBase));
				}
			}
			_trailRenderer.transform.SetParent(ParticleManager.TRAIL_CONTAINER, worldPositionStays: true);
			_collider.enabled = true;
			Stuck?.Invoke(this, projectileEventDataVal);
			return true;
		}
		case PhysicMaterialPenetration.BREAK:
			SetupMultiplayerLaunch(fire: false);
			Broken?.Invoke(this, projectileEventDataVal);
			UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(_gib, transform.position, transform.rotation);
			MultiplayerMng.Destroy(gameObject.GetComponent<SaveablePrefab>());
			return true;
		case PhysicMaterialPenetration.BREAK_DAMAGE:
		{
			SetupMultiplayerLaunch(fire: false);
			Broken?.Invoke(this, projectileEventDataVal);
			Vector3 force = Rigidbody.mass * Rigidbody.velocity;
			rigidbody.AddForce(force, ForceMode.Impulse);
			Shootable component = rigidbody.GetComponent<Shootable>();
			if ((bool)component)
			{
				component.Shot?.Invoke(new DamageUnityEventArgs(_projectileDamage, _projectile as IBase));
			}
			if (_gib != null)
			{
				UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(_gib, transform.position, transform.rotation);
			}
			MultiplayerMng.Destroy(gameObject.GetComponent<SaveablePrefab>());
			return true;
		}
		default:
			return false;
		}
	}

	private void GetPositionAndForward(Vector3 hitPoint, out Vector3 position, out Vector3 forward)
	{
		Vector3 normalized = (hitPoint - Rigidbody.position).normalized;
		position = hitPoint - normalized * _projectileHead;
		forward = normalized;
	}

	private IBase GetAttachedBase(Collider collider, Rigidbody rigidbody)
	{
		IBase obj = collider.GetInterface<IBase>();
		if (obj.IsNullOrDestroyed() && rigidbody != null)
		{
			obj = rigidbody.GetInterface<IBase>();
			if (obj.IsNullOrDestroyed())
			{
				RagdollChild component = rigidbody.GetComponent<RagdollChild>();
				if (component != null)
				{
					obj = component.InteractiveObject;
				}
			}
		}
		return obj;
	}

	private PhysicMaterialPenetration GetPenetration(Collider collider)
	{
		if (collider == null)
		{
			return PhysicMaterialPenetration.BREAK;
		}
		return PhysicMaterialUtility.GetPenetration(collider.sharedMaterial?.name);
	}
}

	public virtual bool OwnerPlacing(Transform ghost, BeamRay ray, float yRotation)
	{
		Placement placement = new Placement();
		placement.Position = ghost.position;
		placement.Rotation = ghost.rotation;
		for (int i = 0; i < _placementModifiers.Length; i++)
		{
			placement = _placementModifiers[i].Modify(placement, ray);
		}
		bool result = false;
		_prevSnappedConnector = _snappedConnector;
		_snappedConnector = null;
		_snapped = false;
		IList<Connector> componentSphereCastAll = BeamPhysics.GetComponentSphereCastAll<Connector>(ray.BaseRay, 0.3f, ray.Length, _connectorLayerMask.value);
		if (componentSphereCastAll.Count > 0)
		{
			for (int j = 0; j < componentSphereCastAll.Count; j++)
			{
				Connector connector = componentSphereCastAll[j];
				_snapped = _myConnector.ConnectTo(connector, placement);
				if (!_snapped)
				{
					continue;
				}
				placement = CheckPlacement(placement);
				_snappedConnector = connector;
				if (_snappedConnector != _prevSnappedConnector)
				{
					Ghost component = ghost.GetComponent<Ghost>();
					IList<Constructing> constructions;
					if (!_snappedConnector.Constructing.Structure.DisableGhostCollisionOnSnap)
					{
						IList<Constructing> list = _snappedConnector.Constructing.Structure.Constructions.Where((Constructing c) => c is Construction_RAFT).ToList();
						constructions = list;
					}
					else
					{
						constructions = _snappedConnector.Constructing.Structure.Constructions;
					}
					component.SetCollisionForConstructions(constructions, ignore: true);
				}
				result = true;
				break;
			}
		}
		else
		{
			result = _myConnector.ConnectTo(null, placement);
		}
		if ((bool)_prevSnappedConnector && _prevSnappedConnector != _snappedConnector && (bool)_prevSnappedConnector.Constructing && (bool)_prevSnappedConnector.Constructing.Structure)
		{
			ghost.GetComponent<Ghost>().SetCollisionForConstructions(_prevSnappedConnector.Constructing.Structure.Constructions, ignore: false);
		}
		_prevSnappedConnector = null;
		if (_snapped)
		{
			Quaternion rotation = placement.Rotation;
			if (_rotationMode != ERotationMode.None)
			{
				float y = Mathf.Round(yRotation / (float)_rotationAngle) * (float)_rotationAngle;
				rotation *= Quaternion.Euler(new Vector3(0f, y, 0f));
			}
			ghost.position = placement.Position;
			ghost.rotation = rotation;
		}
		else
		{
			ghost.position = placement.Position;
			ghost.rotation = placement.Rotation;
			if (_rotationMode != ERotationMode.None)
			{
				ghost.rotation *= Quaternion.Euler(new Vector3(0f, yRotation, 0f));
			}
		}
		return result;
	}

			}
		}
		for (int j = 0; j < _myConnectors.Length; j++)
		{
			Connector connector2 = _myConnectors[j];
			if (_nestedPlacingCollider)
			{
				connector2.Refresh(gameObject);

			{
				connector2.Refresh();
			}
		}
	}

	public virtual void CheckStructure()
	{
		if (_snappedConnector != null)
		{
			Structure = _snappedConnector.Constructing.Structure;
		}
		else if (Structure.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			uint prefabId = StructurePrefab.GetComponent<SaveablePrefab>().PrefabId;
			Structure = MultiplayerMng.Instantiate<Construction_STRUCTURE>(prefabId, MiniGuid.NewFrom(ReferenceId), Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance?.NmlZone.SaveContainer);
			Structure.transform.position = transform.position;
			Structure.transform.rotation = transform.rotation;
			Structure.transform.localScale = Vector3.one;
			Structure.gameObject.layer = gameObject.layer;
			if (Game.Mode.IsServer() && Prefabs.IsMultiplayerEntity(prefabId))
			{
				ReplicateCreateConstruction replicateCreateConstruction = new ReplicateCreateConstruction();
				replicateCreateConstruction.Structure = Structure;
				replicateCreateConstruction.StructureLayer = gameObject.layer;
				replicateCreateConstruction.PrefabId = PrefabId;
				replicateCreateConstruction.ReferenceId = ReferenceId;
				replicateCreateConstruction.Position = transform.position;
				replicateCreateConstruction.Rotation = transform.rotation;
				replicateCreateConstruction.Post();
			}
		}
		transform.parent = null;
		TransformParent = Structure.transform;
		Parent();
		transform.localScale = Vector3.one;
		Structure.AddConstruction(this);
	}

	protected virtual Placement CheckPlacement(Placement placement)
	{
		if ((_previousPlacement.Position - placement.Position).magnitude > 0.2f)
		{
			_previousPlacement.Position = placement.Position;
			_previousPlacement.Rotation = placement.Rotation;
		}
		return _previousPlacement;
	}

	public bool HasMaxHealth()
	{
		return HealthPoints == MaximumHealthPoints;
	}

	public virtual void CheckHealth()
	{
		HealthPoints = Mathf.Min(HealthPoints, MaximumHealthPoints);
		if (_constructingLevels == null || _constructingLevels.Length == 0)
		{
			return;
		}
		int a = Mathf.FloorToInt((HealthPoints - 25f) / MaximumHealthPoints / 0.33f);
		a = Mathf.Max(0, Mathf.Min(a, _constructingLevels.Length - 1));
		bool flag = false;
		for (int i = 0; i < _constructingLevels.Length; i++)
		{
			ConstructingLevel obj = _constructingLevels[i];
			bool flag2 = i == a;
			obj.LevelGameObject.SetActive(flag2);
			if (!flag2)
			{
				continue;
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < _constructingLevelColliders.Length; j++)
			{
				if (_previousLevel == _constructingLevels.Length - 2 && a == _constructingLevels.Length - 1 && handlePlayerColission)
				{
					Collider[] array = Physics.OverlapBox(_constructingLevelColliders[j].bounds.center, _constructingLevelColliders[j].bounds.extents * 0.7f);
					foreach (Collider collider in array)
					{
						if (collider.gameObject.layer == Layers.PLAYER && collider.GetType() == typeof(CharacterController))
						{
							if (FindSuitableTranslatePoint(collider, out var translatePoint) && !flag)
							{
								collider.transform.Translate(translatePoint, Space.World);
								flag = true;
							}
							else
							{
								collider.transform.Translate(Vector3.up);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				_previousLevel = a;
				_constructingLevelColliders[j].isTrigger = a != _constructingLevels.Length - 1;
			}
		}
	}

	public override void Damage(float damage, IBase damager)
	{
		base.Damage(damage, damager);
		CheckHealth();
	}

	public virtual void Dismantle()
	{
		transform.CheckForProjectilesInChildren();
		gameObject.SetActive(value: false);
		MultiplayerMng.Destroy(this);
	}

	public override void Destroy()
	{
		IList<Connector> connectorsAtPlacement = GetConnectorsAtPlacement();
		Dismantle();
		UpdateConnectorsAtPlacement(connectorsAtPlacement);
		if ((bool)Structure)
		{
			Structure.RemoveConstruction(this);
		}
	}

	public int GetConnectorId(Connector connector)
	{
		if (connector == _myConnector)
		{
			return 0;
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < _myConnectors.Length; i++)
		{
			if (_myConnectors[i] == connector)
			{
				return i + 1;
			}
		}
		return -1;
	}

	public Connector GetConnectorById(int id)
	{
		if (id < 0)
		{
			return null;
		}
		if (id == 0)
		{
			return _myConnector;
		}
		return _myConnectors[id - 1];
	}

	public override JObject Save()
	{
		JObject jObject = base.Save();
		if (Structure != null)
		{
			JObject jObject2 = new JObject();
			jObject2.AddField("Transform", JSerializer.Serialize(Structure.transform));
			jObject.AddField("Parent", jObject2);
		}
		JObject jObject3 = new JObject();
		for (int i = 0; i < _myConnectors.Length; i++)
		{
			try
			{
				JObject data = _myConnectors[i].Save();
				jObject3.Add(data);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				Debug.LogError("Constructing::Load:: Error saving a connector [" + _myConnectors[i].name + "]\n" + ex);
			}
		}
		jObject.AddField("Connectors", jObject3);
		return jObject;
	}

	public override void Load(JObject data)
	{
		base.Load(data);
		CheckHealth();
		JObject field = data.GetField("Transform");
		Pos = JSerializer.Deserialize<Vector3>(field.GetField("localPosition"));
		Rot = JSerializer.Deserialize<Quaternion>(field.GetField("localRotation"));
		JObject field2 = data.GetField("Connectors");
		for (int i = 0; i < _myConnectors.Length; i++)
		{
			if (i >= field2.Children.Count)
			{
				Debug.LogError("Missing data for connector '" + _myConnectors[i].name + "'");
				continue;
			}
			try
			{
				JObject jObject = field2.Children[i];
				if (jObject != null)
				{
					_myConnectors[i].Load(jObject);
				}
				else
				{
					Debug.LogError("No saved data for connector [" + _myConnectors[i].name + "]");
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				Debug.LogError("Error loading a connector [" + _myConnectors[i].name + "]\n" + ex);
			}
		}
	}

	private bool FindSuitableTranslatePoint(Collider hit, out Vector3 translatePoint)
	{
		CharacterController component = hit.GetComponent<CharacterController>();
		Vector3 vector = hit.transform.position + (component.bounds.size.y - component.radius) * 1.5f * Vector3.up;
		Vector3 vector2 = hit.transform.position + (component.bounds.size.y + component.radius) * 0.5f * Vector3.up;
		LayerMask physicsLayerMask = GetPhysicsLayerMask(Layers.PLAYER);
		physicsLayerMask = (int)physicsLayerMask ^ LayerMask.GetMask(LayerMask.LayerToName(Layers.PLAYER));
		Collider[] array = Physics.OverlapCapsule(vector, vector2, component.radius, physicsLayerMask);
		if (array.Length == 0)
		{
			translatePoint = Vector3.up;
			return true;
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
		{
			for (int j = -1; j < 2; j++)
			{
				for (int k = -1; k < 2; k++)
				{
					Vector3 vector3 = new Vector3(j, 0f, k);
					if (!Physics.CheckCapsule(vector + vector3, vector2 + vector3, component.radius, physicsLayerMask))
					{
						translatePoint = Vector3.up + vector3;
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		translatePoint = Vector3.zero;
		return false;
	}

	private LayerMask GetPhysicsLayerMask(int currentLayer)
	{
		int num = 0;
		for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++)
		{
			if (!Physics.GetIgnoreLayerCollision(currentLayer, i))
			{
				num |= 1 << i;
			}
		}
		return num;
	}
}

using Beam.Events;

using Beam.UI;
using Beam.Utilities;

using Funlabs;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Events;

namespace Beam.Crafting;

public class Constructing_ANCHOR : Constructing, IInteractable, IBase, IHasCraftingType
{
	[SerializeField]
	private Transform _packedAnchorTransform;

	[SerializeField]
	private GameObject _deployedAnchorGameObject;

	[SerializeField]
	private Transform _deployedAnchorTransform;

	[SerializeField]
	private VerletLine _deployedAnchorRope;

	private Construction_STRUCTURE_RAFT _raftStructure;

	private bool _serverJoinInProgressAttemptDeploy;

	private bool _deployed;

	[HideInInspector]
	public UnityEvent OnDeploy;

	[HideInInspector]
	public UnityEvent OnRetrieve;

	public bool CanInteract { get; set; } = true;

	protected Construction_STRUCTURE_RAFT RaftStructure
	{
		get
		{
			if (_raftStructure == null)
			{
				_raftStructure = Structure as Construction_STRUCTURE_RAFT;
			}
			return _raftStructure;
		}
	}

	public string GetInteractionDescription(int playerId, IBase obj)
	{
		if (!_deployed)
		{
			return "ITEM_INTERACTION_DESCRIPTION_DROP";
		}
		return "ITEM_INTERACTION_DESCRIPTION_RETRIEVE";
	}

	protected override void Start()
	{
		base.Start();
		EventManager.AddListener<ServerJoinInProgressStarted>(OnServerJoinInProgressStarted);
		EventManager.AddListener<ServerJoinInProgressEnded>(OnServerJoinInProgressEnded);
	}

	private void OnDestroy()
	{
		EventManager.RemoveListener<ServerJoinInProgressStarted>(OnServerJoinInProgressStarted);
		EventManager.RemoveListener<ServerJoinInProgressEnded>(OnServerJoinInProgressEnded);
		if (_deployed)
		{
			Retrieve();
		}
		if (_deployedAnchorTransform != null)
		{
			BeamTeam.Destroy(_deployedAnchorTransform.gameObject);
		}
	}

	private void OnServerJoinInProgressStarted(ServerJoinInProgressStarted @event)
	{
		_serverJoinInProgressAttemptDeploy = false;
		if (!_deployed && !PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.IsNullOrDestroyed() && PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.IsInitialized && !PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.Movement.IsNullOrDestroyed() && !Structure.IsNullOrDestroyed() && !(Structure.transform != PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.Movement.ActivePlatform))
		{
			_serverJoinInProgressAttemptDeploy = true;
			Interact(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer);
		}
	}

	private void OnServerJoinInProgressEnded(ServerJoinInProgressEnded @event)
	{
		if (_deployed && _serverJoinInProgressAttemptDeploy)
		{
			LocalizedNotification.Post(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer, NotificationPriority.Low, 4f, "ANCHOR_NTF_SERVER_JIP_DEPLOYED");
			_serverJoinInProgressAttemptDeploy = false;
		}
	}

	public override void Damage(float damage, IBase damager)
	{
		base.Damage(damage, damager);
	}

	public bool Interact(IPlayer player)
	{
		if (!_deployed)
		{
			if (!CanDeploy())
			{
				LocalizedNotification.Post(player, NotificationPriority.Low, 4f, "ANCHOR_NTF_CANT_DROP_HERE_DESC");
				return false;
			}
			Deploy(GetAnchorPlacement(transform.position));
			return true;
		}
		if (_deployed)
		{
			Retrieve();
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	public bool InteractWithObject(IPlayer player, IBase obj)
	{
		return Interact(player);
	}

	private void Deploy(Placement placement)
	{
		_deployedAnchorGameObject.SetActive(value: true);
		_deployedAnchorTransform.position = placement.Position + new Vector3(0f, 0.9f, 0f);
		_deployedAnchorTransform.rotation = placement.Rotation;
		_deployedAnchorTransform.parent = transform.parent.parent;
		_deployedAnchorRope.gameObject.SetActive(value: true);
		_packedAnchorTransform.gameObject.SetActive(value: false);
		RaftStructure.StructureBuoyancy.EnableWind(enable: false);
		RaftStructure.StructureBuoyancy.SetDampening(0.7f);
		_deployed = true;
		_raftStructure.AnchorsDeployed++;
		OnDeploy?.Invoke();
	}

	public void Retrieve()
	{
		_deployedAnchorGameObject.SetActive(value: false);
		_deployedAnchorTransform.parent = _deployedAnchorGameObject.transform;
		_deployedAnchorTransform.localPosition = Vector3.zero;
		_deployedAnchorRope.gameObject.SetActive(value: false);
		_packedAnchorTransform.gameObject.SetActive(value: true);
		_deployed = false;
		_raftStructure.AnchorsDeployed--;
		if (_raftStructure.AnchorsDeployed <= 0)
		{
			RaftStructure.StructureBuoyancy.Rigidbody.constraints = RigidbodyConstraints.None;
			RaftStructure.StructureBuoyancy.EnableWind(enable: true);
			RaftStructure.StructureBuoyancy.ResetDampening();
		}
		OnRetrieve?.Invoke();
	}

	private bool CanDeploy()
	{
		if (Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance == null)
		{
			return true;
		}
		float height = Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.GetHeight(transform.position);
		if (height < Ceto.Ocean.Instance.level && height >= -100f)
		{
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	private Placement GetAnchorPlacement(Vector3 position)
	{
		if (Physics.Raycast(position, Vector3.down, out var hitInfo, 100f, (1 << Layers.TERRAIN) | (1 << Layers.TERRAIN_OBJECTS)))
		{
			return new Placement
			{
				Position = hitInfo.point,
				Rotation = Quaternion.LookRotation(Vector3.forward, hitInfo.normal)
			};
		}
		return new Placement
		{
			Position = position - Vector3.up * 15f,
			Rotation = Quaternion.LookRotation(Vector3.forward, Vector3.up)
		};
	}

	public override void OnTransformSerialisationIdChanged()
	{
		base.OnTransformSerialisationIdChanged();
		if (!Game.Mode.IsMaster() && _deployed)
		{
			Deploy(GetAnchorPlacement(transform.position));
		}
	}

	public override JObject Save()
	{
		JObject jObject = base.Save();
		jObject.AddField("Deployed", _deployed);
		return jObject;
	}

	public override void Load(JObject data)
	{
		base.Load(data);
		if (data.GetField("Deployed").GetValue<bool>())
		{
			LevelLoader.CurrentLoader.DeferredLoading.Add(() =>
			{
				Deploy(GetAnchorPlacement(transform.position));
			});
		}
	}
}

public class ConstructionObject_BED : ConstructionObject

		public string Message;

	public override bool Interact(IPlayer player)
	{
		if (_isSleeping || !player.IsOwner)
		{
			return false;
		}
		player.Movement.StopAutoWalk();
		Result result = CheckCanUseBed(player);
		if (!result.Succeeded)
		{
			string message = result.Message;
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(message))
			{
				LocalizedNotification.Post(player, NotificationPriority.Immediate, 4f, message);
			}
			return false;
		}
		if (Time.timeScale != 0f)
		{
			ShowDialogue(player);
		}
		return true;
	}

	private Result CheckCanUseBed(IPlayer player)
	{
		Result result = new Result
		{
			Succeeded = false
		};
		if (LevelLoader.IsCreatingOrLoading)
		{
			result.Message = "BED_NTF_CANT_USE_LOADING";
			return result;
		}
		if (AnyPlayerIsBusy())
		{
			result.Message = "BED_NTF_CANT_USE_BUSY";
			return result;
		}
		result.Message = string.Empty;
		result.Succeeded = true;
		return result;
	}

	private Result CheckCanSave(IPlayer player)
	{
		Result result = CheckCanUseBed(player);
		if (!result.Succeeded)
		{
			return result;
		}
		result.Succeeded = false;
		if (AnyPlayerKnockedOut())
		{
			result.Message = "BED_NTF_CANT_SAVE_KNOCKED_OUT";
			return result;
		}
		if (!AllPlayersOverLand())
		{
			result.Message = ((Game.Mode == GameMode.SinglePlayer) ? "BED_NTF_CANT_SAVE_DESC" : "BED_NTF_CANT_SAVE_COOP_DESC");
			return result;
		}
		result.Message = string.Empty;
		result.Succeeded = true;
		return result;
	}

	private Result CheckCanSleep(IPlayer player)
	{
		Result result = CheckCanUseBed(player);
		if (!result.Succeeded)
		{
			return result;
		}
		result.Succeeded = false;
		if ((bool)_buoyancy && (_buoyancy.Floating || _buoyancy.IsInWater))
		{
			result.Message = "BED_NTF_CANT_SLEEP_UNDERWATER_DESC";
			return result;
		}
		if (GameTime.GetHoursSince(_LastTimeSlept) < 4f)
		{
			result.Message = "BED_NTF_CANT_SLEEP_DESC";
			return result;
		}
		if (Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.MilitaryTime > 4f && Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.MilitaryTime < 18f)
		{
			result.Message = "BED_NTF_CANT_SLEEP_NIGHT";
			return result;
		}
		if (!AllPlayersInProximity(player))
		{
			result.Message = "BED_NTF_CANT_SLEEP_APART_DESC";
			return result;
		}
		result.Message = string.Empty;
		result.Succeeded = true;
		return result;
	}

	private void DoSave(IPlayer player)
	{
		HideDialogue(player);
		Result result = CheckCanSave(player);
		if (!result.Succeeded)
		{
			MultiplayerMng.UpdateSessionToken_IsBusy(isBusy: false);
			string message = result.Message;
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(message))
			{
				LocalizedNotification.Post(player, NotificationPriority.Immediate, 4f, message);
			}
		}
		else
		{
			SaveOnMaster(player);
		}
	}

	private void DoSleep(IPlayer player)

		HideDialogue(player);
		Result result = CheckCanSleep(player);
		if (!result.Succeeded)
		{
			MultiplayerMng.UpdateSessionToken_IsBusy(isBusy: false);
			string message = result.Message;
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(message))
			{
				LocalizedNotification.Post(player, NotificationPriority.Immediate, 4f, message);
			}
		}
		else
		{

		}
	}

	private void DoCancel(IPlayer player)

	private void ShowDialogue(IPlayer player)

		Time.timeScale = 0f;
		player.Input.GetOtherPlayers().DisableMaps();
		player.Input.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: false, 0);

		player.Input.SetCursorEnabled(enabled: true);
		player.IsBusy = true;
		MultiplayerMng.UpdateSessionToken_IsBusy(isBusy: true);
		saveDialogueBox = DialogueBox.Show(player.Input, "BED_DB_SLEEP_TITLE", "BED_DB_SLEEP_SAVE_DESC", "BED_DB_BUTTON_SLEEP", "BED_DB_BUTTON_SAVE", "BED_DB_BUTTON_CANCEL");
		saveDialogueBox.Accept += () =>

			DoSleep(player);
		};
		saveDialogueBox.Decline += () =>
		{
			DoSave(player);
		};
		saveDialogueBox.Cancel += () =>
		{
			DoCancel(player);
		};
	}

	private void HideDialogue(IPlayer player)
	{
		Time.timeScale = 1f;
		player.Input.GetOtherPlayers().RestoreMapsEnabled();
		player.Input.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: false, 16);
		player.Input.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: true, 0);
		player.Input.SetCursorEnabled(enabled: false);
		player.IsBusy = false;
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> Sleep_Sequence(float randomValue, float militaryTime)
	{
		RewiredUtilities.Players.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: false, 0);
		_isSleeping = true;
		foreach (IPlayer allPlayer in PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers)
		{
			++allPlayer.Movement.IsBusy;
		}
		Singleton<Fader>.Instance.FadeOut(3f);
		float timer = 0f;
		while (timer < 3f)
		{
			timer += Time.deltaTime;
			AudioListener.volume -= 1f / 3f * Time.deltaTime;
			yield return 0f;
		}
		AudioListener.volume = 0f;
		if (Game.Mode.IsClient())
		{
			Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.MilitaryTime_NoEvents = militaryTime;
		}
		if (Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.MilitaryTime > 18f)
		{
			CheckShelter();
			Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.MilitaryTime = 24f;
			yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(0.5f);
		}
		float num = 4f + randomValue * 3f;
		if (Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.MilitaryTime < num)
		{
			float num2 = num - Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.MilitaryTime;
			CheckShelter();
			Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.MilitaryTime += num2;
		}
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(1.5f);
		_LastTimeSlept = GameTime.Now;
		Singleton<Fader>.Instance.FadeIn(3f);
		timer = 0f;
		while (timer < 3f)
		{
			timer += Time.deltaTime;
			AudioListener.volume += 1f / 3f * Time.deltaTime;
			yield return 0f;
		}
		AudioListener.volume = 1f;
		_isSleeping = false;
		foreach (IPlayer allPlayer2 in PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers)
		{
			--allPlayer2.Movement.IsBusy;
		}
		RewiredUtilities.Players.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: true, 0);
		MultiplayerMng.UpdateSessionToken_IsBusy(isBusy: false);
	}

	private void CheckShelter()
	{
		foreach (IPlayer allPlayer in PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers)
		{
			Sunburn playerEffect = allPlayer.Statistics.GetPlayerEffect<Sunburn>();
			if (playerEffect != null && CraftingType.InteractiveType == InteractiveType.CRAFTING_BED_SHELTER)
			{
				playerEffect.Protected = true;
			}
		}
	}

	private bool AllPlayersOverLand()
	{
		Zone zone = Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.FindEndGameZone();
		foreach (IPlayer allPlayer in PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers)
		{
			Zone zone2 = StrandedWorld.GetZone(allPlayer.Movement.transform.position);
			if (zone2 == null || (zone2.Biome == Zone.BiomeType.MISSION && zone2 != zone))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!Physics.Raycast(allPlayer.Movement.transform.position, Vector3.down, out var hitInfo, 256f, 1 << Layers.TERRAIN))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (hitInfo.point.y < -5f)
			{
				return false;
			}
		}
		return true;
	}

	private bool AllPlayersInProximity(IPlayer player)
	{
		if (Game.Mode == GameMode.SinglePlayer)
		{
			return true;
		}
		foreach (IPlayer allPlayer in PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers)
		{
			if ((player.transform.position - allPlayer.transform.position).magnitude > 3f)
			{
				return false;
			}
		}
		return true;
	}

	private bool IsFightingBoss()
	{
		Zone zone = Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.FindEndGameZone();
		foreach (IPlayer allPlayer in PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers)
		{
			if (!allPlayer.IsNullOrDestroyed())
			{
				Zone zone2 = StrandedWorld.GetZone(allPlayer.transform.position);
				if (zone2.Biome == Zone.BiomeType.MISSION && zone != zone2)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	private bool AnyPlayerKnockedOut()
	{
		foreach (Player allPlayer in PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers)
		{
			if (!allPlayer.IsNullOrDestroyed() && allPlayer.Statistics.IsKnockedOut)
			{
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	private bool AnyPlayerIsBusy()
	{
		foreach (IPlayer allPlayer in PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers)
		{
			if (allPlayer.Crafter.IsPlacing)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (allPlayer.Lighter.IsLightingFire)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (allPlayer.Skinner.IsSkinning)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (allPlayer.Movement.CheckVehicle())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (allPlayer.Movement.groundedAnimal)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (allPlayer.IsBusy)
			{
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	public override JObject Save()
	{
		JObject jObject = base.Save();
		jObject.AddField("LastTimeSlept", JSerializer.Serialize(_LastTimeSlept));
		jObject.AddField("canDrag", JSerializer.Serialize(CanDrag));
		jObject.AddField("canPickup", JSerializer.Serialize(CanPickUp));
		return jObject;
	}

	public override void Load(JObject data)
	{
		base.Load(data);
		_LastTimeSlept = JSerializer.Deserialize<DateTime>(data.GetField("LastTimeSlept"));
		JObject field = data.GetField("canDrag");
		if (field != null)
		{
			CanDrag = field.GetValue<bool>();
		}
		JObject field2 = data.GetField("canPickup");
		if (field2 != null)
		{
			CanPickUp = field2.GetValue<bool>();
		}
	}

	private static void SaveOnMaster(IPlayer invokingPlayer)
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsClient())
		{
			ReplicateSaveGameOnMasterMsg replicateSaveGameOnMasterMsg = new ReplicateSaveGameOnMasterMsg();
			replicateSaveGameOnMasterMsg.InvokingPlayer = invokingPlayer;
			replicateSaveGameOnMasterMsg.Post();
		}
		else
		{
			SaveManager.SaveGame(invokingPlayer);
		}
	}

	private void ReplicatedSleep_Sequence(float randomValue)
	{
		Timing.RunCoroutine(Sleep_Sequence(randomValue, Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.MilitaryTime), Segment.RealtimeUpdate);
		if (Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
		{
			ReplicateSleep_Sequence replicateSleep_Sequence = new ReplicateSleep_Sequence();
			replicateSleep_Sequence.Bed = this;
			replicateSleep_Sequence.RandomValue = randomValue;
			replicateSleep_Sequence.MilitaryTime = Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.MilitaryTime;
			replicateSleep_Sequence.Post();
		}
	}
}

public class Holder : SerializedMonoBehaviour, IHolder, INeedPlayerComponent, IHotkeySource, IGameInputHandler, IGameActionProvider, ISaveable

	private class PostReplicatePickup : I_MultiplayerMessage
	{
		[Replicate]
		public IPlayer Player;

		[I_Replicate]
		public IPickupable Pickupable;

		[Replicate]
		public bool Animate;

		public override void OnPeer()
		{
			Player.Holder.ReplicatedPickup(Pickupable, Animate);
		}
	}

	private class ReplicatePickup : I_MultiplayerMessage

		public bool Animate;

		public override void OnPeer()

		}
	}

	private class ReplicateSelect : MultiplayerMessage
	{
		[Replicate]
		public IPlayer Player;

		[Replicate]
		public IPickupable Pickupable;

		public override void OnPeer()
		{
			Player.Holder.Select(Pickupable);
		}
	}

	private class ReplicateRelease : I_MultiplayerMessage
	{
		[Replicate]
		public IPlayer Player;

		[I_Replicate]
		public IPickupable Pickupable;

		public override void OnPeer()
		{
			Player.Holder.Release(Pickupable);
		}
	}

	public class ReplicateHolderCommand : MultiplayerMessage
	{
		public enum Command
		{
			SelectHands,
			DropCurrent
		}

		[Replicate]
		public IPlayer Player;

		public Command Cmd;

		public override void OnPeer()
		{
			switch (Cmd)
			{
			case Command.SelectHands:
				Player.Holder.SelectHands();
				break;
			case Command.DropCurrent:
				Player.Holder.DropCurrent();
				break;
			}
		}

		public override void Read(UdpPacket packet)
		{
			base.Read(packet);
			Cmd = (Command)packet.ReadByte();
		}

		public override void Write(UdpPacket packet)
		{
			base.Write(packet);
			packet.WriteByte((byte)Cmd);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return base.ToString() + $"({Cmd})";
		}
	}

	private class ReplicateSwitchCurrent : MultiplayerMessage
	{
		[Replicate]
		public IPlayer Player;

		[Replicate]
		public ISaveablePrefab RaycasterCurrentObject;

		public ReplicateSwitchCurrent()
		{
		}

		public ReplicateSwitchCurrent(IPlayer player)
		{
			Player = player;
			RaycasterCurrentObject = player.User.Controller.Raycaster.CurrentObject as ISaveablePrefab;
		}

		public override void OnPeer()
		{
			Player.User.Controller.Raycaster.SetCurrentObject(RaycasterCurrentObject as IBase);
			Player.Holder.SwitchCurrent();
		}
	}

	[SerializeField]
	private Transform _holdingContainer;

	[SerializeField]
	private ISlotStorageProvider<IPickupable> _storageProvider;

	private ISlotStorage<IPickupable> _storage;

	private bool _loaded;

	private IPickupable _currentObject;

	private IPickupable _currentlyPicking;

	[SerializeField]
	private EventItemProxies _proxies;

	private IPlayer _player;

	private IDynamicParentProvider _dynamicParenter;

	private IGameInputController _controller;

	private bool _poll = true;

	private List<IGameAction> _gameActions = new List<IGameAction>();

	private GameAction _gameAction = new GameAction();

	private int _objectResourceCount;

	private bool _objectiveComplete;

	[SerializeField]
	private UnityEvent _onGatheredResources;

	public ISlotStorage<IPickupable> Storage => _storage;

	public bool Loaded => _loaded;

	public IPickupable CurrentObject => _currentObject;

	public EventItemProxies Proxies => _proxies;

	IPlayer INeedPlayerComponent.Player => _player;

	public UnityEvent OnGatheredResources => _onGatheredResources;

	public event Action<IPickupable> SelectedItemChanged;

	public event Action<IPickupable> PickedUp;

	public event Action<IPickupable> Dropped;

	protected virtual void OnSelectedItemChanged(IPickupable pickupable)
	{
		SelectedItemChanged?.Invoke(pickupable);
	}

	protected virtual void OnPickedUp(IPickupable pickupable)
	{
		PickedUp?.Invoke(pickupable);
	}

	protected virtual void OnDropped(IPickupable pickupable)
	{
		Dropped?.Invoke(pickupable);
	}

	private void Awake()
	{
		_storage = _storageProvider.GetSlotStorage();
		_storage.SelectionChanged += Storage_SelectionChanged;
		_storage.Pushed += Storage_Pushed;
	}

	private void Start()
	{
		_dynamicParenter = UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectOfType<StrandedWorld>();
	}

	public void Initialize(IGameInputController controller)
	{
		_controller = controller;
		_controller.Interacter.InteractingFellThrough += Interacter_InteractingFellThrough;
		_controller.Raycaster.SetFilter(new HoldingRaycastFilter(_holdingContainer));
	}

	public void SetPlayer(IPlayer player)
	{
		_player = player;
		_player.GameInput.Subscribe(this);
		_player.Movement.BeginClimbing += PlayerMovement_BeginClimbing;
		_player.Movement.EndClimbing += PlayerMovement_EndClimbing;
		_gameAction.PlayerActionRequiredDescription = "PLAYER_ACTION_PRESS";
		_gameAction.ElementRequiredId = 9;
		_gameAction.ResultingActionDescription = "PLAYER_ACTION_PICK_UP";
		_gameAction.Action = Pickup_GameAction;
		_gameActions.Add(_gameAction);
	}

	public void SetEnabled(bool enabled)
	{
		_poll = enabled;
	}

	private void OnDestroy()
	{
		PickedUp = null;
		Dropped = null;
		SelectedItemChanged = null;
		if (_player.IsValid())
		{
			if (_player.GameInput != null)
			{
				_player.GameInput.Unsubscribe(this);
			}
			if (_player.Movement != null)
			{
				_player.Movement.BeginClimbing -= PlayerMovement_BeginClimbing;
				_player.Movement.EndClimbing -= PlayerMovement_EndClimbing;
			}
		}
		if (_storage.IsValid())
		{
			_storage.SelectionChanged -= Storage_SelectionChanged;
			_storage.Pushed -= Storage_Pushed;
		}
		if (_controller.IsValid())
		{
			_controller.Interacter.InteractingFellThrough -= Interacter_InteractingFellThrough;
		}
	}

	private void PlayerMovement_BeginClimbing()
	{
		HideCurrent();
	}

	private void PlayerMovement_EndClimbing()
	{
		ShowCurrent();
	}

	public void CheckInput()
	{
		if (_poll && _player.IsOwner)
		{
			if (_player.Input.GetButtonDown(29))
			{
				ReplicatedSwitchCurrent();
			}
			else if (_player.Input.GetButtonDown(10))
			{
				ReplicatedDropCurrent();
			}
			else if (_player.Input.GetButtonDown(17))
			{
				ReplicatedSelectHands();
			}
		}
	}

	IEnumerable<IGameAction> IGameActionProvider.GetGameActions()
	{
		IPickupable pickupable = _controller.Raycaster.CurrentObject as IPickupable;
		if (IsValidPickupable(pickupable))
		{
			return _gameActions;
		}
		return null;
	}

	private void Interacter_InteractingFellThrough()
	{
		if (_poll)
		{
			IPickupable pickupable = _controller.Raycaster.CurrentObject as IPickupable;
			if (IsValidPickupable(pickupable))
			{
				PostReplicatedPickup(pickupable);
			}
		}
	}

	private void Pickup_GameAction(IBase obj)
	{
		IPickupable pickupable = obj as IPickupable;
		if (IsValidPickupable(pickupable))
		{
			Pickup(pickupable);
		}
	}

	public bool IsPickingUp(IPickupable pickupable)
	{
		if (_currentlyPicking != pickupable)
		{
			return CurrentObject == pickupable;
		}
		return true;
	}

	public bool CanPickup(IPickupable pickupable, bool notification = true)
	{
		bool flag = true;
		IDisintegratable disintegratable = pickupable as IDisintegratable;
		foreach (IPlayer allPlayer in PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers)
		{
			if (allPlayer.Dragger.IsDragging && allPlayer.Dragger.Draggable == pickupable)
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			if (allPlayer.Holder._currentlyPicking == pickupable)
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			if (allPlayer.Holder.CurrentObject == pickupable)
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			if (allPlayer.Crafter.CurrentCraftable != pickupable && allPlayer.Crafter.CraftingWithMaterial(pickupable))
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			if (allPlayer.Skinner.CurrentSkinnable == pickupable)
			{
				flag = false;
			}
		}
		if (disintegratable != null && disintegratable.Disintegrating)
		{
			flag = false;
		}
		if (pickupable.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			flag = false;
		}
		else if (pickupable.IsPickedUp && pickupable.OwnerId != _player.Id)
		{
			flag = false;
		}
		if (flag)
		{
			flag = _currentObject.IsNullOrDestroyed() || _storage.CanPush(pickupable, notification);
		}
		else
		{
			_storage.CanPush(pickupable, notification);
		}
		return flag;
	}

	public bool Pickup(IPickupable pickupable, bool animate = true)
	{
		if (CanPickup(pickupable))
		{
			StartCoroutine(Pickup_Sequence(pickupable, animate));
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	private IEnumerator Pickup_Sequence(IPickupable pickupable, bool animate)
	{
		_controller.CurrentHandler = this;
		_currentlyPicking = pickupable;
		if (animate)
		{
			_player.Character.Animater.PlayPickupAnimation();
			yield return new WaitForSeconds(0.3f);
		}
		if (!pickupable.IsNullOrDestroyed() && pickupable.gameObject.activeInHierarchy)
		{
			PickupCallback(pickupable);
			yield return Reload(pickupable);
		}
		_controller.CurrentHandler = null;
		_currentlyPicking = null;
	}

	private void PickupCallback(IPickupable pickupable)
	{
		if (_currentObject.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			Select(pickupable);
		}
		else
		{
			_storage.Push(pickupable);
		}
		OnPickedUp(pickupable);
		CheckTutorialObjective();
	}

	public void DropCurrent()
	{
		DropAndPop(ref _currentObject);
	}

	private void DropAndPop(ref IPickupable pickupable)
	{
		if (!pickupable.IsNullOrDestroyed() && !_player.Statistics.IsKnockedOut)
		{
			IPickupable obj = pickupable;
			Drop(ref pickupable);
			_storage.PopNext(obj);
			_controller.Raycaster.Reset();
		}
	}

	private void Drop(ref IPickupable pickupable)
	{
		if (!pickupable.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			if (!pickupable.gameObject.activeInHierarchy)
			{
				pickupable.gameObject.SetActive(value: true);
			}
			pickupable.Release();
			pickupable.transform.parent = null;
			pickupable.TransformParent = _dynamicParenter?.GetParent();
			pickupable.Parent();
			pickupable.Hold(holding: false);
			pickupable.SetOwner(null);
			_player.Character.Hold(null);
			OnDropped(pickupable);
			pickupable = null;
		}
	}

	private void SwitchCurrent()
	{
		if (!_currentObject.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			IPickupable pickupable = _controller.Raycaster.CurrentObject as IPickupable;
			if (IsValidPickupable(pickupable))
			{
				Drop(ref _currentObject);
				Pickup(pickupable, animate: false);
			}
		}
	}

	private bool IsValidPickupable(IPickupable pickupable)
	{
		if (!pickupable.IsNullOrDestroyed() && pickupable.CanPickUp)
		{
			return _currentObject != pickupable;
		}
		return false;
	}

	public void HideCurrent()
	{
		HidePickupable(_currentObject);
	}

	public void ShowCurrent()
	{
		ShowPickupable(_currentObject);
	}

	private void HidePickupable(IPickupable pickupable)
	{
		if (!pickupable.IsNullOrDestroyed() && pickupable.gameObject.activeSelf)
		{
			pickupable.gameObject.SetActive(value: false);
		}
	}

	private void ShowPickupable(IPickupable pickupable)
	{
		if (!pickupable.IsNullOrDestroyed() && !pickupable.gameObject.activeSelf)
		{
			pickupable.gameObject.SetActive(value: true);
			pickupable.SetLOD(0);
		}
	}

	public bool CheckCurrent()
	{
		if (_currentObject == null)
		{
			return _proxies.CheckProxiesActive();
		}
		return true;
	}

	public void ReleaseAndDestroyCurrent()
	{
		if (!_currentObject.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			ReleaseAndDestroy(_currentObject);
		}
	}

	private void Release(IPickupable pickupable)
	{
		if (!pickupable.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			if (_currentObject == pickupable)
			{
				DropCurrent();
			}
			else
			{
				_storage.Pop(pickupable);
			}
		}
	}

	public void ReleaseAndDestroy(IPickupable pickupable)
	{
		if (!pickupable.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			Release(pickupable);
			pickupable.transform.CheckForProjectilesInChildren();
			MultiplayerMng.Destroy((SaveablePrefab)pickupable);
		}
	}

	public bool Select(IPickupable pickupable)
	{
		if (pickupable == null)
		{
			return false;
		}
		if (pickupable == _currentObject)
		{
			return true;
		}
		_storage.Pop(pickupable);
		if (!_currentObject.IsNullOrDestroyed() && !_storage.Push(_currentObject))
		{
			_storage.Push(pickupable);
			_storage.CanPush(_currentObject);
			return false;
		}
		if (_player.Movement.ClimbingLadder)
		{
			ShowCurrent();
			HidePickupable(pickupable);
		}
		else
		{
			ShowPickupable(pickupable);
		}
		_currentObject = pickupable;
		_currentObject.SetOwner(_player);
		_currentObject.Store();
		_currentObject.transform.CheckForProjectilesInChildren();
		_currentObject.transform.parent = null;
		_currentObject.TransformParent = _holdingContainer;
		_currentObject.Parent();
		_currentObject.transform.localRotation = Quaternion.identity;
		_currentObject.transform.localPosition = Vector3.zero;
		_currentObject.transform.localScale = Vector3.one;
		_currentObject.Hold(holding: true);
		_player.Character.Hold(_currentObject);
		OnSelectedItemChanged(_currentObject);
		Reload(null, manual: true);
		_controller.Raycaster.Reset();
		return true;
	}

	private void SelectHands()
	{
		if (!_currentObject.IsNullOrDestroyed() && _storage.Push(_currentObject))
		{
			EmptyHands();
		}
	}

	private void EmptyHands()
	{
		_player.Character.Hold(null);
		_controller.Raycaster.Reset();
		_currentObject = null;
		OnSelectedItemChanged(null);
	}

	private void CheckTutorialObjective()
	{
		if (!_objectiveComplete)
		{
			_objectResourceCount++;
			if (_objectResourceCount > 4)
			{
				OnGatheredResources?.Invoke();
				_objectiveComplete = true;
			}
		}
	}

	public void Storage_SelectionChanged(IPickupable pickupable)
	{
		if (pickupable.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			SelectHands();
		}
		else
		{
			Select(pickupable);
		}
	}

	private void Storage_Pushed(IPickupable pickupable, bool success)
	{
	}

	private Coroutine Reload(IPickupable pickupable, bool manual = false)
	{
		IReloadable reloadable = _currentObject as IReloadable;
		if (!reloadable.IsNullOrDestroyed() && !reloadable.Reloaded && (manual || reloadable.CanReloadWith(pickupable)))
		{
			return StartCoroutine(Reload_Sequence(reloadable, pickupable));
		}
		return null;
	}

	private IEnumerator Reload_Sequence(IReloadable reloadable, IPickupable pickupable)
	{
		_controller.CurrentHandler = this;
		reloadable.Reload(pickupable);
		if (_player.Character.Animater.CurrentAnimationType != AnimationType.SPEAR_SECONDARY)
		{
			yield return _player.Character.Animater.Play(reloadable.ReloadAnimation);
		}
		_controller.CurrentHandler = null;
	}

	public bool ReplicatedPickup(IPickupable pickupable, bool animate = true)
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
		{
			ReplicatePickup replicatePickup = new ReplicatePickup();
			replicatePickup.Player = _player;
			replicatePickup.Pickupable = pickupable;
			replicatePickup.Animate = animate;
			replicatePickup.Post();
		}
		return Pickup(pickupable, animate);
	}

	private void PostReplicatedPickup(IPickupable pickupable, bool animate = true)
	{
		if (_player.Id == 1 && Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
		{
			PostReplicatePickup postReplicatePickup = new PostReplicatePickup();
			postReplicatePickup.Player = _player;
			postReplicatePickup.Pickupable = pickupable;
			postReplicatePickup.Animate = animate;
			postReplicatePickup.Post();
		}
		else
		{
			ReplicatedPickup(pickupable, animate);
		}
	}

	public bool ReplicatedSelect(IPickupable pickupable)
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
		{
			ReplicateSelect replicateSelect = new ReplicateSelect();
			replicateSelect.Player = _player;
			replicateSelect.Pickupable = pickupable;
			replicateSelect.Post();
		}
		return Select(pickupable);
	}

	private void ReplicatedSelectHands()
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
		{
			ReplicateHolderCommand replicateHolderCommand = new ReplicateHolderCommand();
			replicateHolderCommand.Player = _player;
			replicateHolderCommand.Cmd = ReplicateHolderCommand.Command.SelectHands;
			replicateHolderCommand.Post();
		}
		SelectHands();
	}

	private void ReplicatedSwitchCurrent()
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
		{
			new ReplicateSwitchCurrent(_player).Post();
		}
		SwitchCurrent();
	}

	public void ReplicatedRelease(IPickupable pickupable)
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
		{
			ReplicateRelease replicateRelease = new ReplicateRelease();
			replicateRelease.Player = _player;
			replicateRelease.Pickupable = pickupable;
			replicateRelease.Post();
		}
		Release(pickupable);
	}

	public void ReplicatedDropCurrent()
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
		{
			ReplicateHolderCommand replicateHolderCommand = new ReplicateHolderCommand();
			replicateHolderCommand.Player = _player;
			replicateHolderCommand.Cmd = ReplicateHolderCommand.Command.DropCurrent;
			replicateHolderCommand.Post();
		}
		DropCurrent();
	}

	public JObject Save()
	{
		JObject jObject = new JObject();
		if (!_currentObject.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			JObject jObject2 = SavingUtilities.SavePrefabToJObject(_currentObject);
			if (jObject2 != null)
			{
				jObject.AddField("CurrentObject", jObject2);
			}
			else
			{
				Debug.LogError("Holder::Save:: Error saving current object.\n\nName: " + _currentObject.gameObject.name + "\nReference Id: " + _currentObject.ReferenceId.ToString());
			}
		}
		else
		{
			jObject.AddField("CurrentObject", "Empty");
		}
		return jObject;
	}

	public void Load(JObject data)
	{
		JObject field = data.GetField("CurrentObject");
		if (field.IsValid() && !field.IsNull() && field.Type != JObject.EToken.STRING)
		{
			SavingUtilities.LoadPrefabFromJData(MultiplayerZoneSync.Usage.Holder, field, (SaveablePrefab instance) =>
			{
				instance?.transform?.SetParent(null);
			}, (SaveablePrefab instance) =>
			{
				Select((IPickupable)instance.GetComponent<BaseObject>());
				_loaded = true;
			});
		}
		else
		{
			_loaded = true;
		}
	}
}
