using Beam.Language;
using Beam.Serialization.Json;
using Beam.UI;
using Funlabs;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Beam.Crafting;

public class Inventory : MonoBehaviour, ISlotStorageProvider<IPickupable>, INeedPlayerComponent, ISaveable
{
	[SerializeField]
	private SlotStorage _slotStorage;

	private IPlayer _player;

	private IDynamicParentProvider _dynamicParenter;

	private bool _firstPush = true;

	public bool Loaded => _slotStorage.LoadState.IsLoaded();

	IPlayer INeedPlayerComponent.Player => _player;

	public ISlotStorage<IPickupable> GetSlotStorage()
	{
		return _slotStorage;
	}

	private void Awake()
	{
		_slotStorage.Name = "INVENTORY_MENU_BACKPACK_TITLE";
		_slotStorage.Initialize();
		_slotStorage.Pushed += SlotStorage_Pushed;
		_slotStorage.Popped += SlotStorage_Popped;
	}

	private void Start()
	{
		_dynamicParenter = Object.FindObjectOfType<StrandedWorld>();
		StorageRegistry.Link(_slotStorage);
	}

	private void OnDestroy()
	{
		_slotStorage.Pushed -= SlotStorage_Pushed;
		_slotStorage.Popped -= SlotStorage_Popped;
		StorageRegistry.Unlink(_slotStorage);
	}

	public void SetPlayer(IPlayer player)
	{
		_slotStorage.ReferenceId = MiniGuid.PLAYER_STORAGE(player);
		_player = player;
	}

	private void SlotStorage_Pushed(IPickupable pickupable, bool success)
	{
		if (!success)
		{
			LocalizedNotification.Post(_player, NotificationPriority.Low, 4f, "INVENTORY_MENU_NTF_NOT_ENOUGH_ROOM_DESC");
			return;
		}
		pickupable.SetOwner(_player);
		pickupable.Hold(holding: false);
		if (_firstPush)
		{
			PlatformLocalizedText platformLocalizedText = new PlatformLocalizedText();
			platformLocalizedText.SetTerm("INVENTORY_MENU_NTF_ITEM_STORED_DESC");
			platformLocalizedText.SetArgs(pickupable.DisplayName);
			platformLocalizedText.SetActions(12);
			LocalizedNotification.Post(_player, NotificationPriority.Immediate, 8f, platformLocalizedText);
			_firstPush = false;
		}
	}

	private void SlotStorage_Popped(IPickupable pickupable)
	{
		pickupable.transform.parent = null;
		pickupable.TransformParent = _dynamicParenter?.GetParent();
		pickupable.Parent();
		pickupable.Hold(holding: false);
		pickupable.SetOwner(null);
	}

	public JObject Save()
	{
		return _slotStorage.Save();
	}

	public void Load(JObject data)
	{
		_slotStorage.Load(data);
	}
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Beam.Events;
using Beam.Serialization;
using Beam.Serialization.Json;
using Beam.UI;
using Ceto;
using Funlabs;
using MEC;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Events;

namespace Beam.Intro;

public class AircraftVFX : ReplicableMonoBehaviour, ISaveable
{
	public class ReplicateEnterCockpit : MultiplayerMessage
	{
		[Replicate]
		public AircraftVFX aircraftVFX;

		public override void OnPeer()
		{
			aircraftVFX.EnterCockpit();
		}
	}

	private MiniGuid _referenceId;

	public override MiniGuid ReferenceId
	{
		get
		{
			if (_referenceId.IsDefault())
			{
				_referenceId = MiniGuid.INTERACTIVE_AIRCRAFT_VFX;
			}
			return _referenceId;
		}
		set
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

	private void Start()
	{
		_player1 = (Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer() ? PlayerRegistry.ServerPeer.Player : PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers[0]);
		if (Game.Mode.GetPlayersCount() > 1 && PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers.Count > 1 && PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers[1] != null)
		{
			_player2 = PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers[1];
		}
		EventManager.AddListener<PlayerDisconnectedEvent>(RemotePlayerDisconnected_Event);
		AudioTools.FixMixerGroups(_idleEngineAudio);
		AudioTools.FixMixerGroups(_throttledEngineAudio);
		IPlayerSpeech playerSpeech = _player1.PlayerSpeech;
		_player1Speech = playerSpeech ?? NullObject<NullPlayerSpeech>.Instance;
		_crashAircraftTrans.gameObject.SetActive(value: false);
		_crashPrivateJetTrans.gameObject.SetActive(value: false);
		_crashAnimation.gameObject.SetActive(value: false);
		_cockpitInteraction.gameObject.SetActive(value: false);
		_cockpitLights.gameObject.SetActive(value: false);
	}

	private void OnDestroy()
	{
		Timing.KillCoroutines(_enterHangarSequence);
		Timing.KillCoroutines(_enterCockpitSequence);
		Timing.KillCoroutines(_completedObjectiveSequence);
		Timing.KillCoroutines(_completedObjectivesSequence);
		Timing.KillCoroutines(_interactionSequence);
		Timing.KillCoroutines(_flyingSequence);
		Timing.KillCoroutines(_crashSequence);
		Timing.KillCoroutines(_rotatePropeller);
		Timing.KillCoroutines(_clampCamera);
		EventManager.RemoveListener<PlayerDisconnectedEvent>(RemotePlayerDisconnected_Event);
	}

	public void RemotePlayerDisconnected_Event(PlayerDisconnectedEvent e)
	{
		if (e.PlayerId == 1)
		{
			_player2 = null;
		}
	}

	public void Initialize(AircraftManager aircraftManager)
	{
		_aircraftManager = aircraftManager;
	}

	private void PlayAircraftAnimation(string animationName)
	{
		_aircraftAnimator.SetTrigger(animationName);
	}

	private void PlayCharacterAnimation(IPlayer player, string animationName)
	{
		player.Character.PlayEventAnimation(animationName);
	}

	private void SetCharacterPosition(IPlayer player, Transform trans)
	{
		player.Movement.transform.position = trans.position;
		player.Movement.transform.rotation = trans.rotation;
		player.Character.SetPosition(trans.position);
		player.Character.SetRotation(trans.rotation);
	}

	private void SetPlayer2()
	{
		if (_player2 != null)
		{
			FreezePlayer(_player2);
			SetCharacterPosition(_player2, _backseatOperatingPosition);
			_player2.Character.transform.parent = _backseatOperatingPosition;
			_player2.Character.transform.localPosition = Vector3.zero;
			_player2.Character.PlayingEventAnimation = true;
			PlayCharacterAnimation(_player2, "EndGame_Cockpit_Idle");
		}
	}

	private void FreezePlayer(IPlayer player)
	{
		if (player.IsOwner)
		{
			++player.Movement.IsBusy;
			player.Movement.IsInCutscene = true;
			player.Movement.CharacterController.enabled = false;
		}
	}

	private void ResetCharacter(IPlayer player)
	{
		if (player.IsOwner)
		{
			--player.Movement.IsBusy;
			player.Movement.IsInCutscene = false;
			player.Movement.CharacterController.enabled = true;
		}
	}

	private void CameraShakeEffect(float magnitude, float duration)
	{
		_player1.PlayerCamera.CameraMovement.ShakeCamera(duration, magnitude);
		if (_player2 != null)
		{
			_player2.PlayerCamera.CameraMovement.ShakeCamera(duration, magnitude);
		}
	}

	private void CameraSpeedEffect(float fov, float duration)
	{
		LeanTween.value(gameObject, UpdateCameraSpeedEffect, _player1.PlayerCamera.Camera.fieldOfView, fov, duration);
	}

	private void UpdateCameraSpeedEffect(float fov)
	{
		_player1.PlayerCamera.Camera.fieldOfView = fov;
		if (_player2 != null)
		{
			_player2.PlayerCamera.Camera.fieldOfView = fov;
		}
	}

	private IPlayer GetClosestPlayer(Vector3 position)
	{
		IPlayer result = PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers[0];
		if (Game.Mode.GetPlayersCount() == 1)
		{
			return result;
		}
		float num = float.PositiveInfinity;
		for (int i = 0; i < PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers.Count; i++)
		{
			IPlayer player = PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers[i];
			float magnitude = (position - player.transform.position).magnitude;
			if (magnitude < num)
			{
				num = magnitude;
				result = player;
			}
		}
		return result;
	}

	public void EnterHangar()
	{
		if (_enteredHangar)
		{
			PlayTrack(TrackType.Ambience_Carrier);
			return;
		}
		_enteredHangar = true;
		_enterHangarSequence = Timing.RunCoroutine(EnterHangar_Sequence());
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> EnterHangar_Sequence()
	{
		SpawnGyroRewardPieces();
		IPlayer closestPlayer = GetClosestPlayer(_enterHangarPosition.position);
		closestPlayer.Character.PlayingEventAnimation = true;
		SetCharacterPosition(closestPlayer, _enterHangarPosition);
		PlayCharacterAnimation(closestPlayer, "EndGame_EnterHangar");
		FreezePlayer(closestPlayer);
		closestPlayer.PlayerCamera.CameraMovement.SetRotation(closestPlayer.Character.CharacterFirstPerson.CameraRigPosition);
		closestPlayer.PlayerCamera.CameraMovement.SetCameraTarget(closestPlayer.Character.CharacterFirstPerson.CameraRigPosition);
		closestPlayer.PlayerCamera.MouseLook.enabled = false;
		AudioManager.GetAudioPlayer().Play2D(_enterHangarClip, AudioMixerChannels.FX);
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(8f);
		closestPlayer.PlayerCamera.CameraMovement.ResetCameraTarget();
		closestPlayer.PlayerCamera.CameraMovement.SetPosition(closestPlayer.Character.CharacterFirstPerson.CameraRigPosition);
		closestPlayer.PlayerCamera.MouseLook.enabled = closestPlayer.IsOwner;
		SetCharacterPosition(closestPlayer, _endHangarPosition);
		closestPlayer.Character.PlayingEventAnimation = false;
		ResetCharacter(closestPlayer);
		PlayTrack(TrackType.Ambience_Carrier);
		Timing.KillCoroutines(_enterHangarSequence);
	}

	private void SpawnGyroRewardPieces()
	{
		if (!Game.Mode.IsClient())
		{
			uint num = Prefabs.ConvertLegacyPrefabId(_gyroPartID);
			if (num == 0)
			{
				Debug.LogError("AircraftVFX :: SpawnGyroRewardPieces : Missing Gyrocopter Reward Piece!");
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
			{
				MultiplayerMng.Instantiate<SaveablePrefab>(num, _gyroRewardPiecePositions[i].position, _gyroRewardPiecePositions[i].rotation, MiniGuid.New());
			}
		}
	}

	public void EndGameObjectives_ObjectivesCompleted(AircraftObjectivesCompletedArgs args)
	{
		_completedObjectivesSequence = Timing.RunCoroutine(ObjectivesCompleted_Sequence(args));
		_completed = true;
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> ObjectivesCompleted_Sequence(AircraftObjectivesCompletedArgs args)
	{
		ActivateParts();
		CloseFuelHatches();
		if (args.IsFirstTime)
		{
			yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(0.5f);
			AudioManager.GetAudioPlayer().Play2D(_objectivesCompletedClip, AudioMixerChannels.Music);
			yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(_objectivesCompletedClip.length * 0.7f);
			if (_player1Speech != null)
			{
				_player1Speech.Play("STATUS_END_OBJECTIVES_COMPLETED", _player1.Gender, underwater: false);
			}
			yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(4f);
		}
		_aircraftStation.SetActive(value: true);
		Timing.KillCoroutines(_completedObjectivesSequence);
		ObjectivesComplete?.Invoke();
	}

	public void EndGameObjectives_ObjectiveCompleted()
	{
		if (!_completedObjectiveSequence.IsRunning)
		{
			_completedObjectiveSequence = Timing.RunCoroutine(ObjectiveCompleted_Sequence());
		}
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> ObjectiveCompleted_Sequence()
	{
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(0.5f);
		AudioManager.GetAudioPlayer().Play2D(_objectiveCompletedClip, AudioMixerChannels.FX);
	}

	private void EnterCockpit()
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
		{
			MultiplayerMng.UpdateSessionToken_IsBusy(isBusy: true);
		}
		if (_player1.IsOwner)
		{
			_player1.PlayerCamera.SetCameraMode(CameraViewMode.FIRST_PERSON);
		}
		if (_player2 != null && _player2.IsOwner)
		{
			_player2.PlayerCamera.SetCameraMode(CameraViewMode.FIRST_PERSON);
		}
		_enterCockpitSequence = Timing.RunCoroutine(EnterCockpit_Sequence());
	}

	public void ReplicatedEnterCockpit()
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
		{
			ReplicateEnterCockpit replicateEnterCockpit = new ReplicateEnterCockpit();
			replicateEnterCockpit.aircraftVFX = this;
			replicateEnterCockpit.Post();
		}
		EnterCockpit();
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> EnterCockpit_Sequence()
	{
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new EndGameSequenceEvent());
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new FreezeNotificationsEvent(freeze: true));
		foreach (IPlayer allPlayer in PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers)
		{
			if (allPlayer.IsOwner)
			{
				allPlayer.Input.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: false, 0);
				allPlayer.Input.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: true, 10);
			}
			allPlayer.Character.HideCurrentItem();
			FreezePlayer(allPlayer);
			allPlayer.PlayerCamera.CameraMovement.SetRotation(allPlayer.Character.CharacterFirstPerson.CameraRigPosition);
			allPlayer.PlayerCamera.CameraMovement.SetCameraTarget(allPlayer.Character.CharacterFirstPerson.CameraRigPosition);
			allPlayer.PlayerCamera.MouseLook.enabled = false;
		}
		PlayTrack(TrackType.Ambience_Cockpit);
		_aircraftStation.SetActive(value: false);
		float num = Mathf.Abs(Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.MilitaryTime - 16f);
		if (Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.MilitaryTime > 16f)
		{
			num = 24f - num;
		}
		float num2 = num * 60f * 60f;
		float rate = num2 / 3f / (float)GameTime.TIME_SCALE;
		while (Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.MilitaryTime > 16f)
		{
			Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.Tick += Time.deltaTime * rate;
			yield return 0f;
		}
		while (Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.MilitaryTime < 16f)
		{
			Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.Tick += Time.deltaTime * rate;
			yield return 0f;
		}
		while (_ambientLight.intensity > 0f)
		{
			_ambientLight.intensity -= Time.deltaTime;
			if (_ambientLight.intensity <= 0f)
			{
				_ambientLight.enabled = false;
			}
			yield return 0f;
		}
		Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.MilitaryTime_NoEvents = 16f;
		Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.Paused = true;
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(0.5f);
		_player1.PlayerCamera.CameraMovement.ResetCameraTarget();
		_player1.PlayerCamera.MouseLook.enabled = _player1.IsOwner;
		if (_player2 != null)
		{
			_player2.PlayerCamera.CameraMovement.ResetCameraTarget();
			_player2.PlayerCamera.MouseLook.enabled = _player2.IsOwner;
		}
		_tightCameraClamp = true;
		ClampCameras();
		_player1.Character.PlayingEventAnimation = true;
		SetCharacterPosition(_player1, _cockpitOperatingPosition);
		PlayCharacterAnimation(_player1, "EndGame_EnterCockpit");
		PlayAircraftAnimation("Cockpit_Enter");
		if (_player2 != null)
		{
			_player2.Character.PlayingEventAnimation = true;
			SetCharacterPosition(_player2, _backseatOperatingPosition);
			PlayCharacterAnimation(_player2, "EndGame_EnterCockpit_2");
		}
		AudioManager.GetAudioPlayer().Play2D(_enterCockpitClip, AudioMixerChannels.FX);
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(1f);
		_aircraftManager.Objectives.CompleteFinalObjective();
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(8f);
		SetCharacterPosition(_player1, _cockpitOperatingPosition);
		_player1.Character.transform.parent = _cockpitOperatingPosition;
		_player1.Character.transform.localPosition = Vector3.zero;
		if (_player2 != null)
		{
			SetCharacterPosition(_player2, _backseatOperatingPosition);
			_player2.Character.transform.parent = _backseatOperatingPosition;
			_player2.Character.transform.localPosition = Vector3.zero;
		}
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(1f);
		_tightCameraClamp = false;
		_player1.Statistics.Invincible = true;
		Sunburn playerEffect = _player1.Statistics.GetPlayerEffect<Sunburn>();
		if (playerEffect != null)
		{
			playerEffect.ResetExposure();
		}
		if (_player2 != null)
		{
			_player2.Statistics.Invincible = true;
			Sunburn playerEffect2 = _player2.Statistics.GetPlayerEffect<Sunburn>();
			if (playerEffect2 != null)
			{
				playerEffect2.ResetExposure();
			}
		}
		InteractionCheck(InteractionSequence.CheckSystems);
	}

	public void InteractionCheck(InteractionSequence sequence)
	{
		Timing.KillCoroutines(_interactionSequence);
		switch (sequence)
		{
		case InteractionSequence.CheckSystems:
			_interactionSequence = Timing.RunCoroutine(InteractionCheck_Sequence());
			break;
		case InteractionSequence.StartEngine:
			_interactionSequence = Timing.RunCoroutine(InteractionStartEngine_Sequence());
			break;
		case InteractionSequence.CloseCockpit:
			_interactionSequence = Timing.RunCoroutine(InteractionCloseCockpit_Sequence());
			break;
		case InteractionSequence.EngageRail:
			_interactionSequence = Timing.RunCoroutine(InteractionRail_Sequence());
			break;
		case InteractionSequence.EngageEngine:
			_interactionSequence = Timing.RunCoroutine(InteractionEngageEngine_Sequence());
			break;
		case InteractionSequence.TakeOff:
			_interactionSequence = Timing.RunCoroutine(InteractionLaunch_Sequence());
			break;
		}
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> InteractionCheck_Sequence()
	{
		PlayCharacterAnimation(_player1, "Cockpit_Check");
		PlayAircraftAnimation("Cockpit_Check");
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(0.8f);
		AudioManager.GetAudioPlayer().Play2D(_cockpitCheckClip, AudioMixerChannels.FX);
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(10f);
		_cockpitInteraction.SetActive(value: true);
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> InteractionStartEngine_Sequence()
	{
		PlayCharacterAnimation(_player1, "Cockpit_StartEngine");
		PlayAircraftAnimation("Cockpit_StartEngine");
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(1f);
		AudioManager.GetAudioPlayer().Play2D(_cockpitStartEngineClip, AudioMixerChannels.FX);
		_cockpitLights.SetActive(value: true);
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(3.2f);
		_maxPropellerSpeed = 0.3f;
		RotatePropellers();
		CameraShakeEffect(0.001f, -1f);
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(11.1f);
		_idleEngineAudio.Play();
		_cockpitInteraction.SetActive(value: true);
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> InteractionCloseCockpit_Sequence()
	{
		PlayCharacterAnimation(_player1, "Cockpit_Close");
		PlayAircraftAnimation("Cockpit_Close");
		AudioManager.GetAudioPlayer().Play2D(_cockpitCloseClip, AudioMixerChannels.FX);
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(3.5f);
		_idleEngineAudioFilter.enabled = true;
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(6.1f);
		CloseEngineHatch();
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(2.5f);
		_cockpitInteraction.SetActive(value: true);
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> InteractionRail_Sequence()
	{
		PlayCharacterAnimation(_player1, "Cockpit_Rail");
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(0.5f);
		PlayAircraftAnimation("Cockpit_Rail");
		AudioManager.GetAudioPlayer().Play2D(_cockpitRailClip, AudioMixerChannels.FX);
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(4.5f);
		Quaternion startingRotation = _aircraftRail.localRotation;
		Quaternion endRotation = Quaternion.identity;
		float timer = 0f;
		while (timer < 9f)
		{
			float t = timer / 9f;
			_aircraftRail.localRotation = Quaternion.Lerp(startingRotation, endRotation, t);
			timer += Time.deltaTime;
			yield return 0f;
		}
		_aircraftRail.localRotation = endRotation;
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(1f);
		_cockpitInteraction.SetActive(value: true);
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> InteractionEngageEngine_Sequence()
	{
		PlayCharacterAnimation(_player1, "Cockpit_EngageEngine");
		PlayAircraftAnimation("Cockpit_Throttle");
		RaiseRail();
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(0.5f);
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(3f);
		CameraShakeEffect(0.005f, 60f);
		_maxPropellerSpeed = 1f;
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(2f);
		_idleEngineAudio.Stop();
		AudioManager.GetAudioPlayer().Play2D(_cockpitThrottleClip, AudioMixerChannels.FX);
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(2f);
		_throttledEngineAudio.Play();
		Quaternion startingRotation = _aircraft.localRotation;
		Quaternion endRotation = Quaternion.identity;
		float timer = 0f;
		while (timer < 3f)
		{
			float t = timer / 3f;
			_aircraft.localRotation = Quaternion.Lerp(startingRotation, endRotation, t);
			timer += Time.deltaTime;
			yield return 0f;
		}
		_aircraft.localRotation = endRotation;
		_cockpitInteraction.SetActive(value: true);
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> InteractionLaunch_Sequence()
	{
		foreach (IPlayer allPlayer in PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers)
		{
			if (allPlayer.IsOwner)
			{
				allPlayer.Input.DisableMaps();
				allPlayer.Input.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: true, 9);
			}
		}
		PlayCharacterAnimation(_player1, "Cockpit_Launch");
		PlayAircraftAnimation("Cockpit_Launch");
		PlayTrackInstantly(TrackType.Cockpit_TakeOff);
		AudioManager.GetAudioPlayer().Play2D(_cockpitLaunchClip, AudioMixerChannels.FX);
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(1.5f);
		_aircraft.transform.parent = _aircraftTakeOffAnimation.transform;
		float num = 1f;
		float animationTime = _aircraftTakeOffAnimation["Aircraft_TakeOff"].length * (1f / num);
		_aircraftTakeOffAnimation["Aircraft_TakeOff"].speed = num;
		_aircraftTakeOffAnimation.Play();
		CameraSpeedEffect(90f, 1f);
		CameraShakeEffect(0.01f, 60f);
		float timer = 0f;
		bool launched = false;
		while (timer < animationTime)
		{
			if (timer > 7f && !launched)
			{
				launched = true;
				FlyAircraft();
			}
			timer += Time.deltaTime;
			yield return 0f;
		}
		Timing.KillCoroutines(_interactionSequence);
	}

	public void FlyAircraft()
	{
		_flyingSequence = Timing.RunCoroutine(FlyAircraft_Sequence());
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> FlyAircraft_Sequence()
	{
		CameraSpeedEffect(60f, 3f);
		float flightTime = 25f;
		float roll = 0f;
		CameraSpeedEffect(60f, 3f);
		CameraShakeEffect(0.01f, flightTime + 3f);
		float timer = 0f;
		while (timer < flightTime)
		{
			if (_player1.IsOwner)
			{
				float axis = _player1.Input.GetAxis(0);
				roll += axis;
				roll = Mathf.Clamp(roll, -10f, 10f);
			}
			_aircraft.localRotation = Quaternion.Lerp(_aircraft.localRotation, Quaternion.Euler(new Vector3(0f, 0f, 0f - roll)), Time.deltaTime);
			timer += Time.deltaTime;
			yield return 0f;
		}
		CrashAircraft();
		Timing.KillCoroutines(_flyingSequence);
	}

	public void CrashAircraft()
	{
		foreach (IPlayer allPlayer in PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers)
		{
			if (allPlayer.IsOwner)
			{
				allPlayer.Movement.IsInEndGameScene = true;
			}
		}
		_crashSequence = Timing.RunCoroutine(CrashAircraft_Sequence());
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> CrashAircraft_Sequence()
	{
		Singleton<Fader>.Instance?.SetFadeColor(Color.black);
		Singleton<Fader>.Instance?.FadeOut(3f);
		while (_throttledEngineAudio.volume > 0f)
		{
			_throttledEngineAudio.volume -= 0.1f * Time.deltaTime;
			yield return 0f;
		}
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(5f);
		TMPTextScreenViewAdapter textView = UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectOfType<TMPTextScreenViewAdapter>();
		textView?.SetHeaderText("AIRCRAFT_TEXT_SCREEN_LABEL_THREE_HOURS_LATER");
		textView?.SetSubheaderText("");
		textView?.SetTooltipText("");
		textView.Show();
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(4f);
		yield return _introAssetLoader.Load_Async();
		_introAssetLoader.Jet.SetupEndingScene();
		textView.Hide();
		SetupCrashScene();
		Singleton<Fader>.Instance?.FadeIn(0.1f);
		_throttledEngineAudio.volume = 1f;
		CameraShakeEffect(0.001f, 60f);
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(1f);
		if (Game.Mode.IsMaster() && _player1.IsOwner)
		{
			EventManager.RaiseEvent(new CompletedEndGameEvent());
		}
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(15f);
		_tightCameraClamp = true;
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(3f);
		_crashPrivateJetTrans.gameObject.SetActive(value: true);
		float num = 1f;
		float animationTime = _crashAnimation["Aircraft_Crash"].length * (1f / num);
		_crashAnimation["Aircraft_Crash"].speed = num;
		_crashAnimation.Play();
		PlayAircraftAnimation("Cockpit_Crash");
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(2f);
		PlayCharacterAnimation(_player1, "Cockpit_Crash");
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(1f);
		AudioManager.GetAudioPlayer().Play2D(_cockpitCrashClip, AudioMixerChannels.FX);
		PlayTrackInstantly(TrackType.Cockpit_Crash);
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(animationTime - 3f);
		CameraSpeedEffect(90f, 0.1f);
		_crashImpact.SetActive(value: true);
		_throttledEngineAudio.Stop();
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(0.1f);

		_crashImpact.SetActive(value: false);

		Timing.KillCoroutines(_rotatePropeller);
		Timing.KillCoroutines(_clampCamera);
		Timing.KillCoroutines(_crashSequence);
	}

	private void Crashed()
	{
		Timing.RunCoroutine(Crashed_Sequence());
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> Crashed_Sequence()
	{
		UVideoScreenViewAdapter video = UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectOfType<UVideoScreenViewAdapter>();
		video?.Show();
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(12f);
		yield return Singleton<Fader>.Instance.FadeOut_Async(7f);
		video?.Hide();
		UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectOfType<EndGameCreditsController>().Show();
		foreach (IPlayer allPlayer in PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers)
		{
			if (allPlayer.IsOwner)
			{
				allPlayer.Movement.IsInEndGameScene = false;
			}
		}
	}

	private void SetupCrashScene()
	{
		transform.parent.transform.parent = null;
		Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance?.gameObject.SetActive(value: false);
		Ceto.Ocean.Instance.gameObject.SetActive(value: false);
		GameObject.Find("Manager - Terrain Impostors").SetActive(value: false);
		Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.MilitaryTime = 21f;
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new EndGameSequenceEvent());
		_crashAnimation.gameObject.SetActive(value: true);
		_crashAircraftTrans.gameObject.SetActive(value: true);
		_aircraft.transform.parent = _crashAircraftTrans;
		_aircraft.localPosition = Vector3.zero;
		_aircraft.localRotation = Quaternion.identity;
	}

	private void RotatePropellers()
	{
		_rotatePropeller = Timing.RunCoroutine(RotatePropeller());
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> RotatePropeller()
	{
		while (true)
		{
			if (_curPropellerSpeed < _maxPropellerSpeed)
			{
				_curPropellerSpeed += 0.1f * Time.deltaTime;
			}
			float num = 500f * _curPropellerSpeed * Time.deltaTime;
			_propeller.transform.Rotate(0f, 0f, 0f - num);
			yield return 0f;
		}
	}

	private void ClampCameras()
	{
		_player1.PlayerCamera.CameraMovement.ResetCameraTarget();
		if (_player2 != null)
		{
			_player2.PlayerCamera.CameraMovement.ResetCameraTarget();
		}
		_clampCamera = Timing.RunCoroutine(ClampCameraUpdate());
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> ClampCameraUpdate()
	{
		while (true)
		{
			ClampCamera(_player1, _player1.Character.CharacterFirstPerson.CameraRigPosition);
			if (_player2 != null)
			{
				ClampCamera(_player2, _player2.Character.CharacterFirstPerson.CameraRigPosition);
			}
			yield return 0f;
		}
	}

	private void ClampCamera(IPlayer player, Transform target)
	{
		if (_tightCameraClamp)
		{
			player.PlayerCamera.MouseLook.ClampViewToPosUpdate(target.forward, 10f, 10f, lerpAngles: true);
		}
		else
		{
			player.PlayerCamera.MouseLook.ClampViewToPosUpdate(target.forward, 60f, 45f);
		}
	}

	private void ActivateParts()
	{
		_enginePart.SetActive(value: true);
		_propellerPart.SetActive(value: true);
	}

	private void CloseEngineHatch()
	{
		_trolley.SetActive(value: false);
		float z = _engingeHatch.localRotation.z;
		LeanTween.value(gameObject, RotateEngineHatch, z, 0f, 3f).setEase(LeanTweenType.easeInOutCubic);
	}

	private void RotateEngineHatch(float rotation)
	{
		_engingeHatch.localRotation = Quaternion.Euler(_engingeHatch.localRotation.x, _engingeHatch.localRotation.y, rotation);
	}

	private void CloseFuelHatches()
	{
		float x = _fuelHatch1.localRotation.x;
		LeanTween.value(gameObject, RotateFuelHatch, x, 0f, 1f).setEase(LeanTweenType.easeInOutCubic);
	}

	private void RotateFuelHatch(float rotation)
	{
		_fuelHatch1.localRotation = Quaternion.Euler(rotation, _fuelHatch1.localRotation.y, _fuelHatch1.localRotation.z);
		_fuelHatch2.localRotation = Quaternion.Euler(rotation, _fuelHatch2.localRotation.y, _fuelHatch2.localRotation.z);
	}

	private void RaiseRail()
	{
		_ = _rail.localRotation;
		LeanTween.value(gameObject, RotateRail, 0f, 5f, 2f).setEase(LeanTweenType.easeInOutCubic);
	}

	private void RotateRail(float rotation)
	{
		_rail.localRotation = Quaternion.Euler(rotation, 0f, 0f);
	}

	private void SkipToLaunch()
	{
		_player1.Character.PlayingEventAnimation = true;
		SetPlayer2();
		_throttledEngineAudio.Play();
		_cockpitLights.SetActive(value: true);
		SetCharacterPosition(_player1, _cockpitOperatingPosition);
		_player1.Character.transform.parent = _cockpitOperatingPosition;
		_player1.Character.transform.localPosition = Vector3.zero;
		_maxPropellerSpeed = 2f;
		RotatePropellers();
		CloseEngineHatch();
		ActivateParts();
		_aircraftRail.localRotation = Quaternion.identity;
		_aircraft.localRotation = Quaternion.identity;
		RaiseRail();
		InteractionCheck(InteractionSequence.TakeOff);
		Timing.KillCoroutines(_enterCockpitSequence);
	}

	private void SkipToCrash()
	{
		CrashAircraft();
	}

	public void PlayTrackInstantly(TrackType track)
	{
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new TrackEvent(track, TrackEventType.Play_Instantly));
	}

	public void PlayTrack(TrackType track)
	{
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new TrackEvent(track, TrackEventType.Play));
	}

	public void StopTrack(TrackType track)
	{
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new TrackEvent(track, TrackEventType.Stop));
	}

	public new JObject Save()
	{
		JObject jObject = new JObject();
		jObject.AddField("Entered", _enteredHangar);
		jObject.AddField("EnteredHangar", _enteredHangar);
		jObject.AddField("Completed", _completed);
		return jObject;
	}

	public new void Load(JObject data)
	{
		if (data.GetField("EnteredHangar") != null)
		{
			_enteredHangar = data.GetField("EnteredHangar").GetValue<bool>();
		}
		_completed = data.GetField("Completed").GetValue<bool>();
	}
}

using System.Collections.Generic;
using Beam.Utilities;
using Sirenix.Utilities;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Beam.Rendering;

public class LodController : MonoBehaviour, IImpostorParent
{
	public const int MAX_LOD_CULLING_DISTANCE = 100;

	[SerializeField]
	private LodGroup _lodGroup = new LodGroup();

	[PREFAB_PROCESSOR_GetComponent]
	[SerializeField]
	private ImpostorBase _impostor;

	[SerializeField]
	private ImpostorMode _mode;

	[SerializeField]
	private ImposterScope _scope;

	[SerializeField]
	private int _localImpostorCullingDistance = 200;

	[SerializeField]
	private int _id;

	[Tooltip("Will only apply to objects without a terrain impostor lod.")]
	[SerializeField]
	private bool _dither;

	[Tooltip("Length of dither fade. Used by last lod renderer /or impostor.")]
	[SerializeField]
	private float _ditherFadeWidth = 7f;

	public LodGroup LodGroup => _lodGroup;

	public ImpostorBase Impostor => _impostor;

	public ImpostorMode Mode => _mode;

	public ImposterScope Scope => _scope;

	int IImpostorParent.Id => _id;

	Vector3 IImpostorParent.Position => transform.position;

	Quaternion IImpostorParent.Rotation => transform.rotation;

	IList<Renderer> IImpostorParent.Renderables => _lodGroup.Lods.LastOrDefault_NonAlloc()?.Renderers;

	private void Start()
	{
		Singleton<LodManager>.Instance?.Add(this);
		if (_scope == ImposterScope.None || _scope.HasFlag(ImposterScope.Manual))
		{
			return;
		}
		if (LevelLoader.IsLoading(gameObject))
		{
			LevelLoader.CurrentLoader.PostLoading.Add(FindImpostor);
			return;
		}
		FindImpostor();
		if (_impostor == null)
		{
			CreateImpostor();
		}
	}

	private void OnDestroy()
	{
		Singleton<LodManager>.Instance?.Remove(this);
	}

	public void AdoptLodGroup(LodGroup lodGroup)
	{
		_lodGroup.Lods.Clear();
		_lodGroup.Lods.AddRange(lodGroup.Lods);
		if (_impostor != null)
		{
			_lodGroup.Lods.Add(_impostor.Lod);
		}
	}

	public void UpdateLodGroup(Camera camera)
	{
		float magnitude = (camera.transform.position - transform.position).magnitude;
		Lod lod = null;
		for (int i = 0; i < _lodGroup.Lods.Count; i++)
		{
			Lod lod2 = _lodGroup.Lods[i];
			float num = (((float?)lod?.CullingDistance) ?? 0f) * LodManager.LOD_BIAS;
			float num2 = (float)lod2.CullingDistance * LodManager.LOD_BIAS;
			bool flag = magnitude > num;
			bool flag2 = magnitude < num2;
			bool active = flag & flag2;
			lod2.SetActive(active);
			if (_dither && lod2.Active && _lodGroup.Lods.IsLast(i))
			{
				float num3 = Mathf.Min(_ditherFadeWidth, num2);
				float num4 = num2 - num3;
				float value = Mathf.Clamp01((magnitude - num4) / num3);
				lod2.Crossfade(value);
			}
			lod = lod2;
		}
	}

	private void FindImpostor()
	{
		if (_impostor != null)
		{
			Debug.LogError("We have impostor.", gameObject);
			return;
		}
		ImpostorBase impostorBase = StrandedWorld.GetZone(transform.position).FindImpostor(gameObject);
		if (impostorBase != null)
		{
			AdoptImpostor(impostorBase);
		}
	}

	private void CreateImpostor()
	{
		if (_impostor != null)
		{
			Debug.LogError("We have impostor.", gameObject);
			return;
		}
		ImpostorBase impostorBase = StrandedWorld.GetZone(transform.position).CreateImpostor(_id, transform.position, transform.rotation);
		if (impostorBase != null)
		{
			impostorBase.SetRenderables(((IImpostorParent)this).Renderables);
			AdoptImpostor(impostorBase);
		}
	}

	private void AdoptImpostor(ImpostorBase impostor)
	{
		_impostor = impostor;
		_impostor.Lod.IsImpostor = true;
		_impostor.Lod.CullingDistance = (_scope.HasFlag(ImposterScope.Terrain) ? 1000 : _localImpostorCullingDistance);
		_lodGroup.Lods.Add(_impostor.Lod);
	}

	private bool ValidateLodGroup(LodGroup lodGroup, ref string errorMessage)
	{
		if (_scope.HasFlag(ImposterScope.Manual))
		{
			return true;
		}
		foreach (Lod lod in lodGroup.Lods)
		{
			if (lod.CullingDistance <= 0 || lod.CullingDistance > 100)
			{
				errorMessage = $"Lod culling distances must be between 0-{100} units.";
				return false;
			}
		}
		return true;
	}

	private bool CheckTerrain()
	{
		return _scope.HasFlag(ImposterScope.Terrain);
	}

	private void UpdateMode()
	{
		if (_mode == ImpostorMode.Dynamic)
		{
			_id = -2;
		}
	}

	private void UpdateDitherMode()
	{
		Lod lod = _lodGroup.Lods.LastOrDefault_NonAlloc();
		if (lod == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < lod.Renderers.Length; i++)
		{
			Material sharedMaterial = lod.Renderers[i].sharedMaterial;
			if (_dither)
			{
				sharedMaterial.EnableKeyword("LOD_FADE_CROSSFADE");
				sharedMaterial.DisableKeyword("_ENABLE_DISTANCE_CROSSFADE");
				if (sharedMaterial.HasProperty("_DitherMode"))
				{
					sharedMaterial.SetInt("_DitherMode", 1);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				sharedMaterial.DisableKeyword("LOD_FADE_CROSSFADE");
				sharedMaterial.DisableKeyword("_ENABLE_DISTANCE_CROSSFADE");
				if (sharedMaterial.HasProperty("_DitherMode"))
				{
					sharedMaterial.SetInt("_DitherMode", 0);
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

[Serializable]
public class Map

	public JObject ObjectData;

	public float[,] HeightmapData;

	public Map()

	public bool IsProceduralMap()
	{
		if (EditorData == null)
		{
			return false;

		if (EditorData == null)

		return !IsProceduralMap();

	private bool IsInternalMap()
	{
		if (EditorData == null)
		{
			return false;
		}
		return EditorData.Id.Contains("INTERNAL");
	}

	public bool IsUserMap()
	{
		if (EditorData == null)
		{
			return false;
		}
		return !IsInternalMap();
	}
}



/* SOURCE_FILE: /storage/emulated/0/Map Check/reports/V15_SOURCE_EXTRACTED/Assembly-CSharp/Beam.Terrain/Maps.cs

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Runtime.Serialization.Formatters.Binary;
using Beam.Serialization;
using Beam.Serialization.Json;
using Beam.Utilities;
using Funlabs;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Beam.Terrain;

public static class Maps
{
	public const string MAP_EXTENSION = ".map";

	public const string MAP_PREFIX = "MAP_";

	public const string MAP_EDITOR_SUFFIX = "_EDITOR";

	public const string MAP_OBJECT_SUFFIX = "_OBJECT";

	public const string MAP_HEIGHT_SUFFIX = "_HEIGHT";

	public const string MAP_INTERNAL_ID = "INTERNAL";

	public const string MAP_PROCEDURAL_ID = "INTERNAL_PROCEDURAL";

	public const string MAP_MISSION_ID = "INTERNAL_MISSION";

	private static List<Map> _defaultMapList;

	private static List<Map> _remoteMaps;

	private static List<Map> _userMapList;

	public static IList<Map> DefaultMapList => _defaultMapList;

	public static IEnumerable<Map> RemoteMaps => _remoteMaps;

	public static IEnumerable<Map> UserMapList => _userMapList;

	public static IEnumerable<Map> AllMapList => _defaultMapList.Concat(_userMapList).Concat(_remoteMaps);

	static Maps()
	{
		_defaultMapList = new List<Map>();
		_remoteMaps = new List<Map>();
		_userMapList = new List<Map>();
		Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable("MONO_REFLECTION_SERIALIZER", "yes");
	}

	private static LoadingResult CreateMapFolders()
	{
		try
		{
			if (!Directory.Exists(FilePath.LOCAL_MAPS_FOLDER))
			{
				Directory.CreateDirectory(FilePath.LOCAL_MAPS_FOLDER);
			}
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			return new LoadingResult
			{
				Message = "MAP_MSG_MAP_DIR_NOT_FOUND " + ex.Message,
				Succeeded = false
			};
		}
		return new LoadingResult
		{
			Succeeded = true
		};
	}

	public static bool ValidateMapFolder(string mapPath, string mapName)
	{
		if (File.Exists(PathTools.Combine(mapPath, mapName + "_EDITOR.map")) && File.Exists(PathTools.Combine(mapPath, mapName + "_OBJECT.map")))
		{
			return File.Exists(PathTools.Combine(mapPath, mapName + "_HEIGHT.map"));
		}
		return false;
	}

	public static string GetMapFolderName(Map map)
	{
		return "MAP_" + MapTools.FormatNameForSave(map.EditorData.Id);
	}

	public static void SaveMap(Map map, string directoryPath)
	{
		string mapFolderName = GetMapFolderName(map);
		string text = PathTools.Combine(directoryPath, mapFolderName);
		if (!Directory.Exists(text))
		{
			Directory.CreateDirectory(text);
		}
		using FileStream streamEditor = new FileStream(PathTools.Combine(text, mapFolderName + "_EDITOR.map"), FileMode.Create, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.ReadWrite);
		using FileStream streamObject = new FileStream(PathTools.Combine(text, mapFolderName + "_OBJECT.map"), FileMode.Create, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.ReadWrite);
		using FileStream streamHeight = new FileStream(PathTools.Combine(text, mapFolderName + "_HEIGHT.map"), FileMode.Create, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.ReadWrite);
		map.Save(streamEditor, streamObject, streamHeight);
	}

	public static void Save(this Map map, Stream streamEditor, Stream streamObject, Stream streamHeight)
	{
		if (!MPExtensions.IsCompressStableValuesInitialized())
		{
			MPExtensions.InitializeCompressStableValues();
		}
		try
		{
			new BinaryFormatter().Serialize(streamEditor, map.EditorData);
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			Debug.LogError("Map::SaveMap:: Error saving map editor data: " + ex.Message);
			throw;
		}
		try
		{
			using StreamWriter streamWriter = new StreamWriter(streamObject);
			streamWriter.Write(map.ObjectData.ToString());
		}
		catch (Exception ex2)
		{
			Debug.LogError("Map::SaveMap:: Error saving map object data: " + ex2.Message);
			throw;
		}
		try
		{
			using BinaryWriter binaryWriter = new BinaryWriter(streamHeight);
			for (int i = 0; i < 257; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < 257; j++)
				{
					binaryWriter.Write(map.HeightmapData[i, j].Compress());
				}
			}
		}
		catch (Exception ex3)
		{
			Debug.LogError("Map::SaveMap:: Error saving map heightmap data: " + ex3.Message);
			throw;
		}
	}

	public static Map LoadMap(string mapPath, string mapName, bool checkVersion = false)
	{
		using FileStream editorStream = new FileStream(PathTools.Combine(mapPath, mapName + "_EDITOR.map"), FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read);
		using FileStream objectStream = new FileStream(PathTools.Combine(mapPath, mapName + "_OBJECT.map"), FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read);
		using FileStream heightStream = new FileStream(PathTools.Combine(mapPath, mapName + "_HEIGHT.map"), FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read);
		Map map = new Map();
		map.Load(editorStream, objectStream, heightStream, checkVersion);
		return map;
	}

	public static void CreateTextures(this Map map)
	{
		if (!(map?.EditorData?.LargePreviewImage != null))
		{
			Texture2D texture2D = new Texture2D(1, 1);
			texture2D.LoadImage(map.EditorData.LargePreviewImageBytes);
			texture2D.wrapMode = TextureWrapMode.Clamp;
			map.EditorData.LargePreviewImage = texture2D;
			map.EditorData.Valid = true;
			if (map.EditorData.Biome == Zone.BiomeType.CARRIER)
			{
				map.EditorData.SmallPreviewImage = Resources.Load("Icons/WorldMap_Icon_Carrier") as Texture2D;
			}
			else if (map.EditorData.Biome == Zone.BiomeType.MISSION)
			{
				map.EditorData.SmallPreviewImage = Resources.Load("Icons/WorldMap_Icon_Mission") as Texture2D;
			}
			else
			{
				map.EditorData.SmallPreviewImage = MapTools.CreateHeightmapTexture(map.HeightmapData);
			}
		}
	}

	public static void Load(this Map map, Stream editorStream, Stream objectStream, Stream heightStream, bool checkVersion, bool createTextures = true)
	{
		if (!MPExtensions.IsCompressStableValuesInitialized())
		{
			MPExtensions.InitializeCompressStableValues();
		}
		try
		{
			MapEditorData editorData = (MapEditorData)new BinaryFormatter().Deserialize(editorStream);
			map.EditorData = editorData;
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			Debug.LogError("Map::LoadMap:: Error loading map editor data:\n\n" + ex.Message + "\n" + ex.StackTrace);
			throw;
		}
		if (checkVersion)
		{
			try
			{
				if (!SaveManager.ValidateVersionNumber(new Version(map.EditorData.GameVersionNumber)))
				{
					throw new VersionException("Map [" + map.EditorData.Name + "] is out of date and no longer supported.");
				}
			}
			catch (ArgumentNullException)
			{
				throw new VersionException("Map [" + map.EditorData.Name + "] is out of date and no longer supported.");
			}
		}
		try
		{
			using StreamReader streamReader = new StreamReader(objectStream);
			try
			{
				JObject jObject = new JObject(streamReader.ReadToEnd());
				PatchObjectsReferenceId(jObject);
				map.ObjectData = jObject;
			}
			catch (JSerializerException ex3)
			{
				Debug.LogError(ex3.Message);
				throw;
			}
		}
		catch (Exception ex4)
		{
			Debug.LogError("Map::LoadMap:: Error loading map [" + map.EditorData.Name + "] object data:\n\n" + ex4.Message + "\n" + ex4.StackTrace);
			throw;
		}
		try
		{
			using BinaryReader binaryReader = new BinaryReader(heightStream);
			binaryReader.BaseStream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			float[,] array = new float[257, 257];
			for (int i = 0; i < 257; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < 257; j++)
				{
					ushort value = binaryReader.ReadUInt16().ToCompressStable();
					array[i, j] = value.Decompress();
				}
			}
			map.HeightmapData = array;
		}
		catch (Exception ex5)
		{
			Debug.LogError("Map::LoadMap:: Error loading map heightmap data:\n\n" + ex5.Message + "\n" + ex5.StackTrace);
			throw;
		}
		if (createTextures)
		{
			map.CreateTextures();
		}
	}

	private static void PatchObjectsReferenceId(JObject objects)
	{
		if (objects == null || objects.Children == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		foreach (JObject child in objects.Children)
		{
			if (child != null)
			{
				uint prefabId = Prefabs.GetPrefabId(child);
				if (prefabId != 0 && Prefabs.GetReferenceId(child, safe: false).IsDefault())
				{
					Prefabs.SetReferenceId(child, MiniGuid.NewFrom(Prefabs.GetPosition(child), prefabId, 48879));
				}
			}
		}
	}

		IList<Map> list = LoadMaps(Directory.GetDirectories(FilePath.DEFAULT_MAPS_FOLDER), out result);
		if (list != null && list.Count > 0)

			_defaultMapList.AddRange(list);

		return _defaultMapList;
	}

	public static IEnumerable<Map> LoadLocalMaps(out LoadingResult result)
	{
		_userMapList.Clear();
		result = CreateMapFolders();
		if (!result.Succeeded)
		{
			return _userMapList;
		}
		IList<Map> list = LoadMaps(Directory.GetDirectories(FilePath.LOCAL_MAPS_FOLDER), out result);
		if (list != null && list.Count > 0)
		{
			_userMapList.AddRange(list);
		}
		return _userMapList;
	}

	public static IEnumerable<Map> LoadRemoteMaps(IEnumerable<string> paths, out LoadingResult result)
	{
		IList<Map> list = LoadMaps(paths, out result);
		if (list != null && list.Count > 0)
		{
			_remoteMaps.Clear();
			foreach (Map item in list)
			{
				item.EditorData.Source = MapEditorData.EMapSource.Community;
				_remoteMaps.Add(item);
			}
		}
		return _remoteMaps;
	}

	private static IList<Map> LoadMaps(IEnumerable<string> paths, out LoadingResult result)
	{
		result = new LoadingResult
		{
			Succeeded = true
		};
		if (paths == null)
		{
			Debug.LogError("Map paths were null.");
			return null;
		}
		if (paths.Count() == 0)
		{
			Debug.LogWarning("Map paths were empty.");
			return null;
		}
		List<Map> list = new List<Map>();
		try
		{
			foreach (string path in paths)
			{
				string fileName = Path.GetFileName(path);
				if (ValidateMapFolder(path, fileName))
				{
					try
					{
						Map item = LoadMap(path, fileName, checkVersion: true);
						list.Add(item);
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						LoadingResult loadingResult = result;
						loadingResult.Message = loadingResult.Message + "MAP_MSG_ERROR_LOADING_MAP " + path + "\n\n" + ex.Message;
						result.Succeeded = false;
						Debug.LogError("Map::LoadMaps:: " + ex.Message);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					LoadingResult obj = result;
					obj.Message = obj.Message + "MAP_MSG_ERROR_LOADING_MAP_FILES_NOT_FOUND " + path + "\n ";
					result.Succeeded = false;
					Debug.LogError("Error loading map. Not all files were found: " + path);
				}
			}
		}
		catch (Exception ex2)
		{
			result.Message = "MAP_MSG_ERROR_LOADING_MAPS " + ex2.Message;
			result.Succeeded = false;
			Debug.LogError("Map::LoadMaps:: " + ex2.Message);
		}
		return list;
	}

	public static void DeleteUserMap(Map map)
	{
		if (map != null)
		{
			_userMapList.Remove(map);
			DeleteMap(map);
		}
	}

	public static void DeleteMap(Map map)
	{
		if (map != null)
		{
			string text = PathTools.Combine(FilePath.LOCAL_MAPS_FOLDER, GetMapFolderName(map));
			DeleteMapFolder(new string[1] { text });
		}
	}

	public static void DeleteMapFolder(string[] folder)
	{
		try
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < folder.Length; i++)
			{
				Directory.Delete(folder[i], recursive: true);
			}
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			Debug.LogError("Map::DeleteMapFolder:: Error deleting map folder: " + ex.Message);
		}
	}

	private static void DeleteFilesInFolder(string folder)
	{
		try
		{
			string[] files = Directory.GetFiles(folder);
			for (int i = 0; i < files.Length; i++)
			{
				File.Delete(files[i]);
			}
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			Debug.LogError("Map::DeleteFilesInFolder:: Error deleting files in folder: " + ex.Message);
		}
	}

				foreach (Map map in maps)

				num /= Maps.Length;
				int num2 = (int)Mathf.Sqrt(num);
				text += $"\nMaps[{Maps.Length}] {num2}x{num2}";

	public static bool ReplaceMapWithProceduralMap(Map replaceMap, out Map proceduralMap)
	{
		proceduralMap = null;
		int num = 0;
		for (int i = 0; i < 49; i++)

				Map map = CreateProceduralMap(i, num);
				_mapList[i] = map;

	}

	public static void CreateWorld(bool legacy = false)
	{
		CreateWorldZonePoints(StrandedWorld.WORLD_SEED);
		_mapList = new Map[49];
		for (int i = 0; i < _generationZonePositons.Length; i++)
		{
			int seed = i;
			Map map = CreateProceduralMap(i, seed);
			_mapList[i] = map;
		}
		if (legacy)
		{
			return;
		}
		int[] array = CreateMissionTiles();
		int num = 0;
		if (Maps.DefaultMapList.Count == 0)
		{
			Maps.LoadDefaultMaps(out var result);
			_ = result.Succeeded;
		}
		for (int j = 0; j < 49; j++)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
			{
				if (j == array[k])
				{
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (flag && num < Maps.DefaultMapList.Count)
			{
				Map map2 = Maps.DefaultMapList[num];
				_mapList[j] = map2;
				if (map2.EditorData.Biome == Zone.BiomeType.CARRIER)
				{
					map2.EditorData.SmallPreviewImage = Resources.Load("Icons/WorldMap_Icon_Carrier") as Texture2D;
				}
				else if (map2.EditorData.Biome == Zone.BiomeType.MISSION)
				{
					map2.EditorData.SmallPreviewImage = Resources.Load("Icons/WorldMap_Icon_Mission") as Texture2D;
				}
				num++;
			}
			else
			{
				int seed2 = j;
				Map map3 = CreateProceduralMap(j, seed2);
				_mapList[j] = map3;
			}
		}
	}

	public static void CreateWorldZonePoints(int seed)
	{
		int num = 49;
		float num2 = 500f;
		float num3 = num2 * 1.25f * 7f;
		int numSamplesBeforeRejection = 30;
		_generatedZonePoints = ZonePositionGenerator.GeneratePoints(seed, num2, new Vector2(num3, num3), numSamplesBeforeRejection);
		_generationZonePositons = new Vector2[num];
		FastRandom fastRandom = new FastRandom(seed);
		List<int> list = new List<int>();
		int upperBound = _generatedZonePoints.Length;
		for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
		{
			int num4 = fastRandom.Next(0, upperBound);
			while (list.Contains(num4))
			{
				num4 = fastRandom.Next(0, upperBound);
			}
			if (i == 0)
			{
				num4 = 0;
			}
			list.Add(num4);
			_generationZonePositons[i] = _generatedZonePoints[num4];
		}
		if (_generationZonePositons.Length < num - 1)
		{
			Debug.LogError("Error: Not enough island positions");
		}
	}

	public static void SaveWorld(WorldSavedCallback callback)
	{
		LoadingResult loadingResult = CreateWorldFolders();
		if (loadingResult.Succeeded)
		{
			loadingResult = SaveWorldSeed();
		}
		if (loadingResult.Succeeded)
		{
			loadingResult = SaveWorldMaps();
		}
		if (!loadingResult.Succeeded)
		{
			DeleteWorld(FilePath.WORLD_FOLDER);
			callback?.Invoke(loadingResult);
		}
		else
		{
			callback?.Invoke(loadingResult);
		}
	}

	private static void DeleteWorld(string folderPath)
	{
		if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(folderPath))
		{
			return;
		}
		try
		{
			if (!Directory.Exists(folderPath))
			{
				return;
			}
			DirectoryInfo directoryInfo = new DirectoryInfo(folderPath);
			foreach (FileInfo item in directoryInfo.EnumerateFiles())
			{
				item.Delete();
			}
			foreach (DirectoryInfo item2 in directoryInfo.EnumerateDirectories())
			{
				item2.Delete(recursive: true);
			}
		}
		catch (Exception exception)
		{
			Debug.LogException(exception);
		}
	}

	private static string GetWorldMapFolderName(int index, bool legacy = false)
	{
		if (legacy)

			int num2 = (index - num) / 5;
			return $"{num}_{num2}";
		}
		return index.ToString();
	}

	public static float[,] ImportHeightmapFromRawFile(string path)
	{
		float[,] array = new float[257, 257];
		int num = 66049;
		num *= 2;
		byte[] array2 = new byte[num];
		try
		{
			using FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(path, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read);
			try
			{
				fileStream.Read(array2, 0, num);
			}
			catch (ArgumentException)
			{
				throw new Exception("Error raw heightmap import.");
			}
		}
		catch (Exception ex2)
		{
			Debug.LogError("World::ImportHeightmapFromRawFile::\n\n" + ex2.Message);
			return array;
		}
		int num2 = 0;
		for (int i = 0; i < 257; i++)
		{
			for (int j = 0; j < 257; j++)
			{
				float num3 = (float)(int)array2[num2++] + (float)(int)array2[num2++] * 256f;
				array[257 - i - 1, j] = num3 / 65535f;
			}
		}
		return array;
	}

using System;
using Beam.Events;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Beam.Terrain;

public class ZoneEvents : MonoBehaviour
{
	public event Action<Zone> CampFirePlaced;

	public event Action<Zone, PlantType> CropPlanted;

	private void Awake()
	{
		EventManager.AddListener<CampFirePlacedEvent>(EventManager_CampFirePlacedEvent);
		EventManager.AddListener<CropPlantedEvent>(EventManager_PlantedCropEvent);
	}

	private void OnDestroy()
	{
		EventManager.RemoveListener<CampFirePlacedEvent>(EventManager_CampFirePlacedEvent);
		EventManager.RemoveListener<CropPlantedEvent>(EventManager_PlantedCropEvent);
		CampFirePlaced = null;
		CropPlanted = null;
	}

	private void EventManager_CampFirePlacedEvent(CampFirePlacedEvent e)
	{
		Zone zone = StrandedWorld.GetZone(e.Position);
		if (zone != null)
		{
			zone.Attributes.CampFires++;
			CampFirePlaced?.Invoke(zone);
			Debug.Log("ZoneEvents: '" + zone.name + "' campfires: " + zone.Attributes.CampFires);
		}
	}

	private void EventManager_PlantedCropEvent(CropPlantedEvent e)
	{
		Zone zone = StrandedWorld.GetZone(e.Position);
		if (zone != null && zone.Attributes.Crops.ContainsKey(e.PlantType))
		{
			zone.Attributes.Crops[e.PlantType]++;
			CropPlanted?.Invoke(zone, e.PlantType);
			Debug.Log("ZoneEvents: '" + zone.name + "' crops: " + zone.Attributes.CampFires);
		}
	}
}

	private void GenerateObjects(Zone zone, GenerationCallback generationCallback)

			}
			num7 += num9;
			if (num7 >= num3 * num3)
			{
				continue;
			}
			int num10 = num7 / num3;
			int num11 = num7 % num3;
			if (num10 >= num3 - 1 || num11 >= num3 - 1 || !((float)_random.NextDouble() < (float)zoneObjects.spawnChance / 100f))
			{
				continue;
			}
			GenerationPoints generationPoints = zone.GenerationPoints[num10, num11];
			bool flag = false;
			for (int j = num10 - num2; j <= num10 + num2; j++)
			{
				if (j < 0 || j >= num3 - 1)
				{
					continue;
				}
				for (int k = num11 - num2; k <= num11 + num2; k++)
				{
					if (k >= 0 && k < num3 - 1 && zone.GenerationPoints[j, k].Occupied)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
			}
			if (flag || ((!zoneObjects.occupyPoint || generationPoints.Occupied) && zoneObjects.occupyPoint) || !(generationPoints.Position.y >= zoneObjects.minHeight) || !(generationPoints.Position.y < zoneObjects.maxHeight) || !(generationPoints.Soilmap >= zoneObjects.minStrength) || !(generationPoints.Soilmap < zoneObjects.maxStrength) || !(generationPoints.steepNess < zoneObjects.maxSteepness) || !(generationPoints.steepNess > zoneObjects.minSteepness))
			{
				continue;
			}
			Vector3 vector = new Vector3((float)_random.Next((int)(zoneObjects.minPositionOffset.x * 100f), (int)(zoneObjects.maxPositionOffset.x * 100f)) / 100f, (float)_random.Next((int)(zoneObjects.minPositionOffset.y * 100f), (int)(zoneObjects.maxPositionOffset.y * 100f)) / 100f, (float)_random.Next((int)(zoneObjects.minPositionOffset.z * 100f), (int)(zoneObjects.maxPositionOffset.z * 100f)) / 100f);
			Vector3 position = generationPoints.Position + zoneObjects.offsetPosition + vector;
			Quaternion quaternion = Quaternion.identity;
			if (zoneObjects.terrainSnap)
			{
				quaternion = Quaternion.Lerp(Quaternion.identity, generationPoints.Rotation, zoneObjects.TerrainSnapBias);
			}
			int num12 = _random.Next(0, 360);
			if (zoneObjects.randomRotation)
			{
				quaternion = (zoneObjects.terrainSnap ? (quaternion * Quaternion.Euler(Vector3.up * num12)) : Quaternion.Euler(Vector3.up * num12));
			}
			else if (zoneObjects.randomFullRotation)
			{
				int num13 = _random.Next(0, 360);
				int num14 = _random.Next(0, 360);
				quaternion = (zoneObjects.terrainSnap ? (quaternion * Quaternion.Euler(new Vector3(num13, num12, num14))) : Quaternion.Euler(new Vector3(num13, num12, num14)));
			}
			if (zoneObjects.occupyPoint)
			{
				generationPoints.Occupied = true;
				for (int l = num10 - num2; l <= num10 + num2; l++)
				{
					if (l < 0 || l >= num3 - 1)
					{
						continue;
					}
					for (int m = num11 - num2; m <= num11 + num2; m++)
					{
						if (m >= 0 && m < num3 - 1)
						{
							zone.GenerationPoints[l, m].Occupied = true;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			IGenerationObject obj = zoneObjects.Objects[shelterType].Obj;
			generationCallback(obj, position, quaternion, zone);
			num++;
		}
	}

	private void GenerateObject(IGenerationObject generationObject, Vector3 position, Quaternion rotation, Zone zone)
	{
		GeneratedObject generatedObject = new GeneratedObject();
		generatedObject.Prefab = generationObject.gameObject;
		generatedObject.Position = position;
		generatedObject.Rotation = rotation;
		generatedObject.ImpostorParentPrefab = generationObject.gameObject.GetInterface<IImpostorParent>();
		zone.OnObjectGenerated(generatedObject);
	}

	private void CreateGeneratedPrefab(GeneratedObject objectData, Zone zone)
	{
		SaveablePrefab component = objectData.Prefab.GetComponent<SaveablePrefab>();
		GameObject gameObject;
		if (component != null)
		{
			uint prefabId = component.PrefabId;
			MiniGuid referenceId = MiniGuid.NewFrom(objectData.Position, prefabId, 48879);
			if (Game.Mode.IsClient() && component.IsMultiplayerEntity)
			{
				MultiplayerZoneSync.Instance.LinkData(MultiplayerZoneSync.Usage.ZoneGeneration, referenceId, ClientSetParent, null, zone);
				return;
			}
			gameObject = MultiplayerMng.Instantiate<SaveablePrefab>(prefabId, objectData.Position, objectData.Rotation, referenceId).gameObject;
		}
		else
		{
			gameObject = UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(objectData.Prefab, objectData.Position, objectData.Rotation);
		}
		gameObject.transform.SetParent(zone.SaveContainer, worldPositionStays: false);
		gameObject.transform.position = objectData.Position;
		gameObject.transform.rotation = objectData.Rotation;
		zone.OnObjectCreated(gameObject);
	}

	private void CreateLoadedPrefab(JObject data, Zone zone)
	{
		JObject field = data.GetField("prefab");
		if (field == null)
		{
			UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("ZoneLoader::LoadZoneAsync:: Error loading. No prefab id field found for object data.");
			return;
		}
		uint num = Prefabs.ConvertLegacyPrefabId(field);
		if (num == 0)
		{
			UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("ZoneLoader::LoadZoneAsync:: Error loading instantiated object with empty prefab id.");
			return;
		}
		bool flag = Prefabs.TryGetMultiplayerPrefabName(num, out var _);
		if (Game.Mode.IsClient() & flag)
		{
			MultiplayerZoneSync.Instance.LinkData(MultiplayerZoneSync.Usage.ZoneLoading, Prefabs.GetReferenceId(data), ClientLoad, data, zone);
		}
		else
		{
			Load(data, _position, zone, MultiplayerMng.Instantiate<SaveablePrefab>(num, Prefabs.GetReferenceId(data)));
		}
		_position += new Vector3(0f, 0f, 50f);
	}

	private void Load(JObject data, Vector3 position, Zone zone, SaveablePrefab instance)
	{
		LevelLoader.Instance.HashCodes.Add(instance.gameObject.GetHashCode());
		instance.transform.SetParent(zone.SaveContainer, worldPositionStays: false);
		instance.transform.position = position;
		string prefabName = instance.name;
		_internalDeferredLoading.Add(() =>
		{
			if (instance.gameObject == null)
			{
				UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("ZoneLoader::LoadZoneAsync:: Error loading prefab [" + prefabName + "]->Object was modified before loading began.\nCheck the object's Awake, Start, Update and FixedUpdate methods for missing [LevelLoader.IsLoading] checks.");
			}
			else
			{
				if (zone.IsMapEditor && !zone.HasVisited)
				{
					try
					{
						JSerializer.DeserializeInto(data.GetField("Transform"), instance.gameObject.transform);
						instance.CompleteTransformSerialization();
						instance.OnCustomMapLoaded();
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("ZoneLoader::LoadZoneAsync:: Error loading editor object [" + instance.name + "] Object has now been destroyed.\n\n" + ex);
						MultiplayerMng.Destroy(instance, DestroyDelay.LATE);
					}
				}
				else if (!SavingUtilities.Load(instance, data))
				{
					UnityEngine.Debug.LogError($"ZoneLoader::LoadZoneAsync:: Error loading [{instance.name}] [{instance.ReferenceId}]->Object has now been destroyed.");
					MultiplayerMng.Destroy(instance, DestroyDelay.LATE);
				}
				if (instance.gameObject != null)
				{
					zone.OnObjectLoaded(instance.gameObject);
				}
			}
		});
	}

	private void ClientLoad(MultiplayerZoneSync.Command command)
	{
		Load(command.Data, Vector3.zero, command.Zone, command.Instance);
	}

	private void ClientSetParent(MultiplayerZoneSync.Command command)
	{
		command.Instance.transform.SetParent(command.Zone.SaveContainer);
	}

	private void InvokeCallback(Action action, Zone zone)
	{
		LoadingActionUtilities.ExecuteDeferredAction(action);
	}

	private void ResetTemporaryLoadingPosition()
	{
		_position = new Vector3(0f, 5000f, 0f);
	}

	private float ProcessCollection_Async<T>(ICollection<T> collection, ProcessCollectionCallback<T> callback, Zone zone)
	{
		return Timing.WaitUntilDone(ProcessCollection(collection, callback, zone));
	}

	private CoroutineHandle ProcessCollection<T>(ICollection<T> collection, ProcessCollectionCallback<T> callback, Zone zone)
	{
		return Timing.RunCoroutine(ProcessCollection_Sequence(collection, callback, zone), Segment.Update, 100);
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> ProcessCollection_Sequence<T>(ICollection<T> collection, ProcessCollectionCallback<T> callback, Zone zone)
	{
		IEnumerator<T> enumerator = collection.GetEnumerator();
		int index = 0;
		bool stop = false;
		while (!stop)
		{
			_ = collection.Count;
			_ = index;
			int processingSteps = GetProcessingSteps(collection.Count, zone.transform.position);
			for (int i = 0; i < processingSteps; i++)
			{
				if (!enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					stop = true;
					break;
				}
				callback?.Invoke(enumerator.Current, zone);
				index++;
			}
			yield return float.NegativeInfinity;
		}
		enumerator.Dispose();
	}

	private int GetProcessingSteps(int quantity, Vector3 position)
	{
		int b = ((ObjectProcessingMode == EObjectProcessingMode.Faster) ? 200 : 4);
		Transform closestPlayer = GetClosestPlayer(position);
		if (closestPlayer.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			return 1;
		}
		float num = (position - closestPlayer.position).magnitude - 125f;
		num /= (float)_processes;
		return Mathf.Max(Mathf.CeilToInt((float)quantity / Mathf.Max(1f, num)), b);
	}

	private Transform GetClosestPlayer(Vector3 position)
	{
		if (PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers.IsNullOrDestroyed() || PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers.Count == 0)
		{
			return null;
		}
		IPlayer player = PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers[0];
		if (Game.Mode.GetPlayersCount() == 1)
		{
			return player.transform;
		}
		float num = float.PositiveInfinity;
		for (int i = 1; i < PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers.Count; i++)
		{
			IPlayer player2 = PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers[i];
			float magnitude = (position - player2.transform.position).magnitude;
			if (magnitude < num)
			{
				num = magnitude;
				player = player2;
			}
		}
		return player.transform;
	}

	private void UpdateSessionToken_IsBusy(bool isBusy)
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsServer())
		{
			if (isBusy && !MultiplayerMng.GetSessionToken().IsBusy)
			{
				MultiplayerMng.UpdateSessionToken_IsBusy(isBusy: true);
			}
			else if (!isBusy && !LevelLoader.IsCreatingOrLoading)
			{
				MultiplayerMng.UpdateSessionToken_IsBusy(isBusy: false);
			}
		}
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> ClientLinking()
	{
		float startTime = Time.unscaledTime;
		bool shutdown = false;
		do
		{
			if (Time.unscaledTime - startTime > MultiplayerZoneSync.CLIENT_LINK_TIME && !shutdown)
			{
				shutdown = true;
				PlayerRegistry.LocalPeer.ReplicatedDisconnect(DisconnectDetail.Timeout_Linking, null, forceLocalShutdown: true);
				MultiplayerZoneSync.Instance.DumpNotCompleted();
			}
			yield return 0f;
		}
		while (!MultiplayerZoneSync.Instance.IsLinked());
	}
}

using UnityEngine;

namespace Beam.Terrain;

public static class ZoneObjectGenerator
{
	private const int INDEX_SIZE = 256;

	public static GenerationPoints[,] GenerateGridData(Zone zone, int seed)
	{
		float num = 125f / 128f;
		GenerationPoints[,] array = new GenerationPoints[256, 256];
		UnityEngine.Terrain terrain = zone.Terrain;
		TerrainData terrainData = zone.Terrain.terrainData;
		float[,] heights = terrainData.GetHeights(0, 0, 257, 257);
		float[,] array2 = WorldTools.GENERATE_ISLAND_HEIGHTMAP(StrandedWorld.WORLD_SEED - seed, zone.Biome, soilMapGeneration: true);
		for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++)
		{
			for (int j = 0; j < 256; j++)
			{
				float y = 150f * heights[i, j] + -100f;
				Vector3 pos = new Vector3(terrain.transform.position.x + num * (float)j, y, terrain.transform.position.z + num * (float)i);
				float x = (pos.x - terrain.transform.position.x) / 250f;
				float y2 = (pos.z - terrain.transform.position.z) / 250f;
				Quaternion rot = Quaternion.LookRotation(Vector3.forward, terrainData.GetInterpolatedNormal(x, y2));
				float steepness = terrainData.GetSteepness(x, y2);
				array[i, j] = new GenerationPoints(pos, rot, occupied: false, steepness, array2[i, j]);
			}
		}
		array2 = null;
		heights = null;
		return array;
	}

	private static void DebugSoilMap(Zone zone, float[,] soilMap)
	{
		GameObject gameObject = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Plane);
		gameObject.gameObject.name = "Debug_SoilMap";
		gameObject.transform.parent = zone.transform;
		gameObject.transform.position = zone.transform.position + Vector3.up * 50f;
		gameObject.transform.localRotation = Quaternion.Euler(new Vector3(0f, -90f, 0f));
		gameObject.transform.localScale = new Vector3(-25f, 1f, 25f);
		Texture2D texture2D = IslandDebugTexture.RenderSoilMapImageIcon(soilMap, 257);
		texture2D.wrapMode = TextureWrapMode.Clamp;
		texture2D.Apply();
		gameObject.GetComponent<Renderer>().material.mainTexture = texture2D;
	}
}

			Map map = World.MapList[i];

			uWorldMapSlot.transform.SetParent(_view.MapSlotsContainer.transform, worldPositionStays: false);
			uWorldMapSlot.SetMap(map);
			uWorldMapSlot.Click += WorldMapSlot_Click;
			uWorldMapSlot.Enter += WorldMapSlot_Enter;
			uWorldMapSlot.Leave += WorldMapSlot_Leave;
			uWorldMapSlot.Drop += WorldMapSlot_Drop;
			if ((_reservedZoneIds.Count == 0 && i == 0) || _reservedZoneIds.Contains(map.EditorData.Id) || map.EditorData.Id.Contains("INTERNAL_MISSION"))
			{
				uWorldMapSlot.Map.EditorData.Valid = false;
				uWorldMapSlot.Button.Enabled = false;
			}
			else
			{
				uWorldMapSlot.Map.EditorData.Valid = true;
				uWorldMapSlot.Button.Enabled = true;
			}
			Vector2 vector = World.GenerationZonePositons[i];
			RectTransform rectTransform = (RectTransform)uWorldMapSlot.transform;
			rectTransform.localPosition = new Vector3(vector.x, vector.y, 0f);
			rectTransform.sizeDelta = new Vector2(257f, 257f);
		}
		componentInParent.ScaleToFitContent();
		componentInParent.SetScale(0.5f);
		_currentMapSlot = null;
	}

	private void WorldMapSlot_Drop(IWorldMapSlot sender, PointerEventData eventData)
	{
		if (!sender.Map.EditorData.Valid || _currentDraggingMapListElement.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			return;
		}
		Map map = _currentDraggingMapListElement.Map;
		if (sender.Map.EditorData.Id != map.EditorData.Id && !sender.Map.EditorData.Id.Contains("INTERNAL_PROCEDURAL"))
		{
			if (!ValidateDuplicateMap(map))
			{
				string message = Localization.GetLanguageHandler().Localize("CARTOGRAPHER_MENU_DB_SORRY_MAP_EXISTS_DESC", map.EditorData.Name);
				DialogueBox.Show(GetPlayerInput(), "CARTOGRAPHER_MENU_DB_SORRY_TITLE", message, DialogueButton.Ok);
			}
			else
			{
				ReplaceWorldMap(sender, map);
			}
		}
		else if (sender.Map.EditorData.VersionNumber != map.EditorData.VersionNumber && !sender.Map.EditorData.Id.Contains("INTERNAL_PROCEDURAL"))
		{
			if (sender.Map.EditorData.Source == map.EditorData.Source)
			{
				_currentMapSlot = sender;
				UpdateWorldMap(_currentMapSlot);
			}
			else
			{
				ReplaceWorldMap(sender, map);
			}
		}
		else if (!ValidateDuplicateMap(map))
		{
			string message2 = Localization.GetLanguageHandler().Localize("CARTOGRAPHER_MENU_DB_SORRY_MAP_EXISTS_DESC", map.EditorData.Name);
			DialogueBox.Show(GetPlayerInput(), "CARTOGRAPHER_MENU_DB_SORRY_TITLE", message2, DialogueButton.Ok);
		}
		else
		{
			World.ReplaceMap(sender.Map, map);
			UpdateWorldMapSlot(sender, map);
			SetDirty();
		}
		_tooltipPresenter.Hide();
	}

	private void Load(Action onComplete)
	{
		_validSave = SaveManager.ValidateSaveFile(GameMode.SinglePlayer) || SaveManager.ValidateSaveFile(GameMode.Coop_2) || SaveManager.ValidateSaveFile(GameMode.Coop_Server);
		LoadingResult loadingResult = LoadMaps();
		if (!loadingResult.Succeeded)
		{
			string message = Localization.GetLanguageHandler().Localize("CARTOGRAPHER_MENU_DB_ERROR_LOADING_MAPS_DESC", loadingResult.Message.Truncate());
			DialogueBox.Show(GetPlayerInput(), "CARTOGRAPHER_MENU_DB_ERROR_TITLE", message, DialogueButton.Ok, DialogueIcon.Warning).Accept += () =>
			{
				InvokeDelayed(0.3f, () =>
				{
					LoadWorld();
					onComplete?.Invoke();
				});
			};
		}
		else
		{
			LoadWorld();
			onComplete?.Invoke();
		}
	}

	private LoadingResult LoadMaps()
	{
		LoadingResult loadingResult = new LoadingResult
		{
			Succeeded = true
		};
		Maps.LoadDefaultMaps(out var result);
		if (!result.Succeeded)
		{
			loadingResult.Succeeded = false;
			loadingResult.Message = result.Message;
		}
		Maps.LoadLocalMaps(out var result2);
		if (!result2.Succeeded)
		{
			loadingResult.Succeeded = false;
			loadingResult.Message += result2.Message;
		}
		LoadRemoteMaps();
		return loadingResult;
	}

	private void LoadWorld()
	{
		if (!World.CheckWorldSeedFileExists())
		{
			ShowCreateNewWorldDialogue();
			return;
		}
		LoadingResult loadingResult = World.LoadWorld();
		if (!loadingResult.Succeeded)
		{
			string message = Localization.GetLanguageHandler().Localize("CARTOGRAPHER_MENU_DB_ERROR_LOADING_WORLD_DESC", loadingResult.Message.Truncate());
			DialogueBox.Show(GetPlayerInput(), "CARTOGRAPHER_MENU_DB_ERROR_TITLE", message, DialogueButton.Ok, DialogueIcon.Warning).Accept += ShowCreateNewWorldDialogue;
		}
		else
		{
			ResetWorldView();
		}
	}

	private void CreateWorld(string seedValue)
	{
		StrandedWorld.SetWorldSeed(seedValue);
		World.CreateWorld();
		SaveWorld();
		OnCreatedNewWorld();
	}

	public void CreateRandomWorld()
	{
		CreateWorld(string.Empty);
	}

	private void SaveWorld(Action onSuccess = null)
	{
		World.SaveWorld((LoadingResult result) =>
		{
			if (result.Succeeded)
			{
				UpdateMapsStatus();
				onSuccess?.Invoke();
				_mapsInserted = 0;
				ResetDirty();
			}
			else
			{
				string message = Localization.GetLanguageHandler().Localize("CARTOGRAPHER_MENU_DB_ERROR_SAVING_WORLD_DESC", result.Message.Truncate());
				DialogueBox.Show(GetPlayerInput(), "CARTOGRAPHER_MENU_DB_ERROR_TITLE", message, DialogueButton.Ok, DialogueIcon.Warning);
			}
		});
	}

		_view.SelectFirstButton();

	private void UserContentProvider_LoadedUserContent(LoadedContentArgs args)
	{
		if (_retrievedUGC)
		{
			return;
		}
		_remoteMapPaths = args.LoadedContent.Where((LoadedContent c) => c.Tags.Any_NonAlloc((string tag) => tag.Equals(UgcTags.MAPS))).SelectMany((LoadedContent c) => Directory.GetDirectories(c.Path));
		_retrievedUGC = true;
	}

	private void LoadRemoteMaps()
	{
		if (_retrievedUGC && !_loadedUGC)
		{
			Maps.LoadRemoteMaps(_remoteMapPaths, out _loadingUGCResult);
			_loadedUGC = _loadingUGCResult.Succeeded || (Maps.RemoteMaps != null && Maps.RemoteMaps.Count() > 0);
		}
	}

	private void ShowRemoteMaps()
	{
		LoadRemoteMaps();
		if (_loadedUGC)
		{
			if (!_loadingUGCResult.Succeeded)
			{
				string message = Localization.GetLanguageHandler().Localize("CARTOGRAPHER_MENU_DB_ERROR_LOADING_MAPS_DESC", _loadingUGCResult.Message.Truncate());
				DialogueBox.Show(GetPlayerInput(), "CARTOGRAPHER_MENU_DB_ERROR_TITLE", message, DialogueButton.Ok, DialogueIcon.Warning);
			}
			CreateMapListElements(Maps.RemoteMaps, _view.RemoteMapListContainer.transform);
			UpdateMapsStatus();
			_view.RetrievingLabel.transform.gameObject.SetActive(value: false);
			_view.NoMapsLabel.transform.gameObject.SetActive(_view.RemoteMapListContainer.transform.childCount == 0);
		}
	}

	private void LoadPlayerMaps()
	{
		_reservedZoneIds.Clear();
		if (_validSave)
		{
			LoadPlayerMap(GameMode.SinglePlayer);
			LoadPlayerMap(GameMode.Coop_2);
			LoadPlayerMap(GameMode.Coop_Server);
		}
	}

	private void LoadPlayerMap(GameMode mode)
	{
		if (!SaveManager.TryGetSaveFilePath(mode, out var saveFilePath))
		{
			return;
		}
		JToken jToken = SaveManager.LoadSaveFileFast(saveFilePath)["Persistent"]["StrandedWorld"];
		JToken jToken2 = jToken["PlayersData"];
		if (jToken2 != null && jToken2.HasValues)
		{
			IJEnumerable<JToken> iJEnumerable = jToken2.Children();
			if (jToken2.Type == JTokenType.Object)
			{
				iJEnumerable = jToken2.Children().Children();
			}
			{
				foreach (JToken item2 in iJEnumerable)
				{
					string item = item2["ZoneId"].ToObject<string>();
					_reservedZoneIds.Add(item);
				}
				return;
			}
		}
		if (LegacyUtilities.LoadStrandedWorldPlayerZoneId_PreCoop(jToken, out var zoneId))
		{
			_reservedZoneIds.Add(zoneId);
		}
		else
		{
			Debug.LogError("LoadPlayerMap:: Could not load player data.");
		}
	}

	private void UpdateMapsStatus()
	{
		Map[] mapList = World.MapList;
		foreach (Map map in mapList)
		{
			UpdateMapStatus(map);
		}
	}

	private void UpdateMapStatus(Map map)
	{
		if (map == null || map.EditorData.Id.Contains("INTERNAL_PROCEDURAL"))
		{
			return;
		}
		Map map2 = Maps.AllMapList.FirstOrDefault((Map m) => m.EditorData.Id == map.EditorData.Id && m.EditorData.Source == map.EditorData.Source);
		if (map2 != null)
		{
			if (map.EditorData.VersionNumber < map2.EditorData.VersionNumber)
			{
				map.EditorData.State = MapEditorData.EMapState.Older;
			}
			else
			{
				map.EditorData.State = MapEditorData.EMapState.Current;
			}
		}
		else
		{
			map.EditorData.State = MapEditorData.EMapState.Unavailable;
		}
	}

	private bool ValidateDuplicateMap(Map newMap, bool checkSource = true)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < 49; i++)
		{
			Map map = World.MapList[i];
			if (map.EditorData.Id == newMap.EditorData.Id && (!checkSource || map.EditorData.Source == newMap.EditorData.Source))
			{
				return false;
			}
		}
		return true;
	}

	private void DeleteSave()
	{
		SaveManager.BackupSaveFiles();
		SaveManager.DeleteSaveFiles();
		_validSave = false;
	}

	private void InvokeDelayed(float delay, Action callback)
	{
		if (callback != null)
		{
			StartCoroutine(InvokeDelayed_Sequence(delay, callback));
		}
	}

	private IEnumerator InvokeDelayed_Sequence(float delay, Action callback)
	{
		yield return new WaitForEndOfFrame();
		float timer = 0f;
		while (timer < delay)
		{
			timer += Time.unscaledDeltaTime;
			yield return null;
		}
		callback?.Invoke();
	}
}
