		newGameMenuPresenter.StartCallback = (Action<GameSettings>)Delegate.Combine(newGameMenuPresenter.StartCallback, new Action<GameSettings>(StartNewGame));
		NewGameMenuPresenter newGameMenuPresenter2 = _newGameMenuPresenter;
		newGameMenuPresenter2.StartMultiplayerContinueCallback = (Action)Delegate.Combine(newGameMenuPresenter2.StartMultiplayerContinueCallback, new Action(StartContinueGame));
		_changeSaveSlotPresenter.ShowView += MenuPresenter_ShowView;
		_changeSaveSlotPresenter.HideView += MenuPresenter_HideView;
		_changeSaveSlotPresenter.SlotChanged += ChangeSaveSlotMenuPresenter_SlotChanged;
		_optionsMenuPresenter.ShowView += MenuPresenter_ShowView;
		_optionsMenuPresenter.HideView += MenuPresenter_HideView;
		_cartographerMenuPresenter.ShowView += MenuPresenter_ShowView;
		_cartographerMenuPresenter.HideView += MenuPresenter_HideView;
		_cartographerMenuPresenter.CreatedNewWorld += CartographerMenuPresenter_CreatedNewWorld;
		_leaderboardsMenuPresenter.ShowView += MenuPresenter_ShowView;
		_leaderboardsMenuPresenter.HideView += MenuPresenter_HideView;
		_createSessionMenuPresenter.ShowView += MenuPresenter_ShowView;
		_createSessionMenuPresenter.HideView += MenuPresenter_HideView;
		_lobbyMenuPresenter.ShowView += MenuPresenter_ShowView;
		_lobbyMenuPresenter.HideView += MenuPresenter_HideView;
		ReInput.ControllerDisconnectedEvent += Rewired_OnControllerDisconnected;
		SaveManager.DeletedSaveFile += SaveManager_DeletedSaveFile;
		CheckBuildVersion();
		SetControlEvents();
		SubscribeToInputEvents();
		Game.Mode = GameMode.SinglePlayer;
		Timing.RunCoroutine(Initialize_Sequence());
		_currentSubScreen = MainMenuScreen.MAIN;
	}

	private void Start()
	{
		ControllerFocus.Instance?.Subscribe(_view);
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> Initialize_Sequence()
	{
		_view.CanvasGroup.Interactable = false;
		if (Game.PreviousState == GameState.MAIN_MENU)
		{
			Singleton<Fader>.Instance.SetFadeColor(Color.black);
		}
		Singleton<Fader>.Instance.FadeOut(0f);
		_view.Hide();
		_loadingScreenPresenter.Show();
		Rewired.Player input = (_currentPlayerInput = ReInput.players.GetPlayer(0));
		bool checkFilePermissions = FilePath.CheckFilePermissions() && FilePath.CreateDirectories();
		if (!checkFilePermissions)
		{
			_loadingScreenPresenter.Hide();
			string message = Localization.GetLanguageHandler().Localize("MAIN_MENU_DB_FILE_PERMISSIONS_DESC", FilePath.SAVE_FOLDER);
			DialogueBoxViewAdapter dialogueBoxViewAdapter = DialogueBox.Show(_currentPlayerInput, "MAIN_MENU_DB_WARNING_TITLE", message, "MAIN_MENU_DB_BUTTON_VISIT", "MAIN_MENU_BUTTON_QUIT", "", DialogueIcon.Warning);
			dialogueBoxViewAdapter.Accept += () =>
			{
				Application.OpenURL("https://forums.strandeddeepgame.com");
				Singleton<Fader>.Instance.FadeOut(3f, FadeMode.Solid, QuitToDesktop);
			};
			dialogueBoxViewAdapter.Decline += () =>
			{
				Singleton<Fader>.Instance.FadeOut(3f, FadeMode.Solid, QuitToDesktop);
			};
		}
		while (!checkFilePermissions)
		{
			yield return 0f;
		}
		IAccountService accountService = GAccountService.Get();
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent("LOADING_PROGRESS_TEXT_INITIALIZING " + accountService.Name));
		yield return 0f;
		CheckAccountServicesInitialized();
		while (!accountService.Initialized)
		{
			yield return 0f;
		}
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent("LOADING_PROGRESS_TEXT_AUTHENTICATING " + accountService.Name));
		yield return 0f;
		IAuthenticationHandler authentication = accountService.GetAuthenticationHandler();
		authentication.Login(Authentication_OnLoginCallback);
		while (!authentication.LoggedIn)
		{
			yield return 0f;
		}
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent("LOADING_PROGRESS_TEXT_RETRIEVING_USER_INFO"));
		yield return 0f;
		AccountUser localUser = accountService.LocalUser;
		while (localUser.UserInfo == null)
		{
			yield return 0f;
		}
		UpdateUserName(localUser.UserInfo.DisplayName);
		Options.Load();
		GraphicsUtilities.SetFixedFrameRate(Options.GraphicsSettings.FixedFrameRate);
		GraphicsUtilities.SetVSync(Options.GraphicsSettings.VerticalSync);
		yield return Timing.WaitUntilDone(Timing.RunCoroutine(Load_Sequence()));
		input.SetCursorEnabled(enabled: true);
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> Reload_Sequence()
	{
		_view.CanvasGroup.Interactable = false;
		yield return Singleton<Fader>.Instance.FadeOut_Async(0f);
		_view.Hide();
		_loadingScreenPresenter.Show();
		yield return Timing.WaitUntilDone(Timing.RunCoroutine(Load_Sequence()));
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> Load_Sequence()
	{
		SaveManager.ChangeCurrentSlot(Options.GeneralSettings.LastSaveSlotUsed);
		yield return Timing.WaitUntilDone(Timing.RunCoroutine(Migrate_Sequence()));
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent("LOADING_PROGRESS_TEXT_LOADING_WORLD"));
		yield return 0f;
		Prefabs.LoadPrefabMap();
		yield return Timing.WaitUntilDone(Timing.RunCoroutine(LoadWorld()));
		_loadingScreenPresenter.Hide();
		Show(_currentPlayerInput);
		if (Game.PreviousState == GameState.MAP_EDITOR)
		{
			Singleton<Fader>.Instance.ResetFade(FadeMode.Solid, FadeDirection.Out);
			CartographerButton_Click(null);
		}
		else
		{
			LeanTween.value(gameObject, 0f, 1f, 1f).setOnUpdate((float value) =>
			{
				AudioListener.volume = Mathf.Clamp01(value);
			}).setIgnoreTimeScale(useUnScaledTime: true);
			yield return Singleton<Fader>.Instance.FadeIn_Async(1f);
			Singleton<Fader>.Instance.ResetColor();
		}
		_view.CanvasGroup.Interactable = true;
		if (Game.PreviousState != GameState.MAP_EDITOR)
		{
			_view.SelectFirstButton();
		}
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> Migrate_Sequence()
	{
		if (Options.GeneralSettings.LastSaveSlotUsed != 0 || Directory.Exists(PathTools.Combine(SaveManager.GetSaveFolderPath(), "World", "0")))
		{
			yield break;
		}
		string filePath = string.Empty;
		if (!LegacyUtilities.HasSaveFilePre_74_00(GameMode.SinglePlayer, out filePath) && !LegacyUtilities.HasSaveFilePre_74_00(GameMode.Coop_2, out filePath))
		{
			yield break;
		}
		bool import = false;
		DialogueBox.Show(_currentPlayerInput, "IMPORT", "Save data location has changed for game versions 0.75.00 and above.\n\nNo save data was found in the new location, but save data was found in the old location at:\n\n" + filePath + "\n\nDo you want to import?", DialogueButton.YesNo, DialogueIcon.Information).Accept += () =>
		{
			import = true;
		};
		while (DialogueBox.Notifying)
		{
			yield return 0f;
		}
		if (!import)
		{
			yield break;
		}
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent("IMPORTING LEGACY SAVE DATA"));
		yield return 0f;
		string text = string.Empty;
		bool flag;
		try
		{
			LegacyUtilities.MigrateSaveDataPre_74_00();
			flag = true;
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			flag = false;
			text = ex.Message;
			Debug.LogException(ex);
		}
		if (!flag)
		{
			DialogueBox.Show(_currentPlayerInput, "TEXT_ERROR", "There was an error importing:\n" + text + "\n\nPlease visit the Stranded Deep Steam forum below for more information on how to migrate your old save data manually.", "MAIN_MENU_DB_BUTTON_VISIT", "MAIN_MENU_DB_BUTTON_CLOSE", "", DialogueIcon.Warning).Accept += () =>
			{
				Application.OpenURL("https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2265407307");
			};
			while (DialogueBox.Notifying)
			{
				yield return 0f;
			}
		}
		else
		{
			Options.Load();
			UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectOfType<AudioMenuPresenter>()?.LoadMixerValues();
		}
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> LoadWorld()
	{
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent("UPGRADING LEGACY WORLD"));
		yield return 0f;
		LegacyUtilities.UpgradeLegacyGame();
		bool flag = World.CheckWorldSeedFileExists();
		if (!SaveManager.ValidateSaveFile(GameMode.SinglePlayer) && !SaveManager.ValidateSaveFile(GameMode.Coop_2) && !SaveManager.ValidateSaveFile(GameMode.Coop_Server) && !flag)
		{
			EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent("LOADING_PROGRESS_TEXT_CREATING_WORLD"));
			yield return 0f;
			_cartographerMenuPresenter.CreateRandomWorld();
			yield break;
		}
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent("LOADING_PROGRESS_TEXT_LOADING_WORLD"));
		yield return 0f;
		if (!World.LoadWorld().Succeeded)
		{
			DialogueBox.Show(_currentPlayerInput, "MAIN_MENU_DB_ERROR_TITLE", "MAIN_MENU_DB_ERROR_LOAD_WORLD_DESC", DialogueButton.Ok, DialogueIcon.Warning).Accept += () =>
			{
				_view.NewGameButton.Enabled = false;
				_cartographerMenuPresenter.Show();
			};
		}
	}

	private bool CheckAccountServicesInitialized()
	{
		IAccountService accountService = GAccountService.Get();
		bool initialized = accountService.Initialized;
		if (!initialized)
		{
			_loadingScreenPresenter.Hide();
			string message = Localization.GetLanguageHandler().Localize("MAIN_MENU_DB_ERROR_INITIALIZE_DRM_DESC", accountService.Name);
			DialogueBox.Show(_currentPlayerInput, "TEXT_ERROR", message, DialogueButton.Ok, DialogueIcon.Warning).Accept += () =>
			{
				Singleton<Fader>.Instance.FadeOut(3f, FadeMode.Solid, QuitToDesktop);
			};
		}
		return initialized;
	}

	private void Authentication_OnLoginCallback(AuthCallbackInfo callbackInfo)
	{
		if (callbackInfo.Result != 0)
		{
			_loadingScreenPresenter.Hide();
			string message = Localization.GetLanguageHandler().Localize("MAIN_MENU_DB_ERROR_AUTHENTICATE_DESC", GAccountService.Get().Name, callbackInfo.Result.ToString("X8"));
			DialogueBox.Show(_currentPlayerInput, "MAIN_MENU_DB_ERROR_TITLE", message, DialogueButton.Ok, DialogueIcon.Warning).Accept += () =>
			{
				Singleton<Fader>.Instance.FadeOut(3f, FadeMode.Solid, QuitToDesktop);
			};
		}
	}

	private void CheckSystemSpecs()
	{
	}

	private void CheckBuildVersion()
	{
		_view.VersionNumberLabel.Text = BuildInformation.GetPrettyString();
	}

	private void OnDestroy()
	{
		QuittingToMenu = null;
		if ((bool)ControllerFocus.Instance)
		{
			ControllerFocus.Instance.Unsubscribe(_view);
		}
		_view.HideView -= _newGameMenuPresenter.Hide;
		_view.HideView -= _changeSaveSlotPresenter.Hide;
		_view.HideView -= _optionsMenuPresenter.Hide;
		_view.HideView -= _cartographerMenuPresenter.Hide;
		_view.HideView -= _createSessionMenuPresenter.Hide;
		_newGameMenuPresenter.ShowView -= MenuPresenter_ShowView;
		_newGameMenuPresenter.HideView -= MenuPresenter_HideView;
		_changeSaveSlotPresenter.ShowView -= MenuPresenter_ShowView;
		_changeSaveSlotPresenter.HideView -= MenuPresenter_HideView;
		_changeSaveSlotPresenter.SlotChanged -= ChangeSaveSlotMenuPresenter_SlotChanged;
		_optionsMenuPresenter.ShowView -= MenuPresenter_ShowView;
		_optionsMenuPresenter.HideView -= MenuPresenter_HideView;
		_cartographerMenuPresenter.ShowView -= MenuPresenter_ShowView;
		_cartographerMenuPresenter.HideView -= MenuPresenter_HideView;
		_leaderboardsMenuPresenter.ShowView -= MenuPresenter_ShowView;
		_leaderboardsMenuPresenter.HideView -= MenuPresenter_HideView;
		_createSessionMenuPresenter.ShowView -= MenuPresenter_ShowView;
		_createSessionMenuPresenter.HideView -= MenuPresenter_HideView;
		_lobbyMenuPresenter.ShowView -= MenuPresenter_ShowView;
		_lobbyMenuPresenter.HideView -= MenuPresenter_HideView;
		_cartographerMenuPresenter.CreatedNewWorld -= CartographerMenuPresenter_CreatedNewWorld;
		ReInput.ControllerDisconnectedEvent -= Rewired_OnControllerDisconnected;
		SaveManager.DeletedSaveFile -= SaveManager_DeletedSaveFile;
		UnsubscribeFromInputEvents();
		EventManager.RemoveListener<PlayerConnectedEvent>(OnPlayerConnected);
	}

	private void SetControlEvents()

		_view.PlayButton.Click += PlayButton_Click;
		_view.PlaySubMenuBackButton.Click += PlayBackButton_Click;
		_view.PlayOnlineButton.Click += PlayOnlineButton_Click;
		_view.PlayOnlineContinueButton.Click += PlayOnlineContinueButton_Click;
		_view.PlayOnlineNewGameButton.Click += PlayOnlineNewGameButton_Click;

		_view.PlayOnlineJoinButton.Click += PlayOnlineJoinButton_Click;

	private void CopyLobbyCodeButton_Click(object sender)
	{
		_view.LobbyCodeLabel.Text.CopyToClipboard();
	}

	private void SubscribeToInputEvents()
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < RewiredUtilities.Players.Count; i++)
		{
			RewiredUtilities.Players[i].AddInputEventDelegate(RewiredPlayer_EscapeButtonDown, UpdateLoopType.Update, InputActionEventType.ButtonJustPressed, 39);
		}
	}

	private void UnsubscribeFromInputEvents()
	{
		if (ReInput.isReady)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < RewiredUtilities.Players.Count; i++)
			{
				RewiredUtilities.Players[i].RemoveInputEventDelegate(RewiredPlayer_EscapeButtonDown, UpdateLoopType.Update, InputActionEventType.ButtonJustPressed, 39);
			}
		}
	}

	private void Update()
	{
		Shader.SetGlobalVector("_UnscaledTime", new Vector4(Time.realtimeSinceStartup / 20f, Time.realtimeSinceStartup, Time.realtimeSinceStartup * 2f, Time.realtimeSinceStartup * 3f));
		Rewired.Player player = ReInput.players.GetPlayer(0);
		if ((player.GetButtonDown(39) || player.GetButtonDown(31)) && _view.Visible)
		{
			AttemptToGoToPreviousScreen();
		}
	}

	public void Show(Rewired.Player input)
	{
		Instance = this;
		if (!_view.Visible)
		{
			if ((bool)Singleton<SoundtrackManager>.Instance)
			{
				Singleton<SoundtrackManager>.Instance.PauseTracks();
			}
			AudioSource audioSource = ((Game.State == GameState.MAIN_MENU) ? _mainMenuTrack : _pauseMenuTrack);
			if (!audioSource.isPlaying)
			{
				audioSource.Play();
			}
			IAudioPlayer audioPlayer = AudioManager.GetAudioPlayer();
			audioPlayer.GetAudioMixer().GetChannel(AudioMixerChannels.Environment).Mute = true;
			audioPlayer.GetAudioMixer().GetChannel(AudioMixerChannels.FX).Mute = true;
			audioPlayer.GetAudioMixer().GetChannel(AudioMixerChannels.Voice).Mute = true;
			Time.timeScale = 0f;
			_currentPlayerInput = input;
			if (Game.State != GameState.MAIN_MENU)
			{
				_isGamePaused = true;
				_mapBeforePaused = _currentPlayerInput.GetCurrentMapId();
				_currentPlayerInput.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: false, _mapBeforePaused);
				_currentPlayerInput.AddInputEventDelegate(RewiredPlayer_EscapeButtonDown, UpdateLoopType.Update, InputActionEventType.ButtonJustPressed, 31);
			}
			else
			{
				_currentPlayerInput.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: false, 0);
			}
			_currentPlayerInput.GetOtherPlayers().DisableMaps();
			_currentPlayerInput.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: true, 8);
			_currentPlayerInput.SetCursorEnabled(enabled: true);
			EventManager.RaiseEvent(new MainMenuOpenedEvent(RewiredUtilities.GetPlayerFromInput(input)?.Id ?? input.id, opened: true));
			IPlayer playerFromInput = RewiredUtilities.GetPlayerFromInput(_currentPlayerInput);
			if (!playerFromInput.IsNullOrDestroyed())
			{
				playerFromInput.IsBusy = true;
				++playerFromInput.Movement.IsBusy;
				playerFromInput.Interacter.IsInPauseMenu = true;
				playerFromInput.PlayerCamera.MouseLook.enabled = false;
			}
			Refresh();
			_view.LobbyCodeGroup.transform.gameObject.SetActive(_isGamePaused && Game.Mode.IsServer());
			if (Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
			{
				_view.LobbyCodeLabel.Text = Game.MultiplayerSessionName.ToCode(MultiplayerMng.GetCloudRegionIndex());
			}
			_view.SetInput(_currentPlayerInput);
			_view.Show();
			_view.SelectFirstButton();
			if (Game.Mode.IsServer())
			{
				EventManager.AddListener<PlayerConnectedEvent>(OnPlayerConnected);
			}
		}
	}

	private void OnPlayerConnected(PlayerConnectedEvent @event)
	{
		Hide();
	}

	private void Refresh()
	{
		InitializeControls();
		InitializeStats();
	}

	private void Hide()
	{
		EventManager.RemoveListener<PlayerConnectedEvent>(OnPlayerConnected);
		if (_view.Visible)
		{
			_mainMenuTrack.Stop();
			_pauseMenuTrack.Stop();
			if ((bool)Singleton<SoundtrackManager>.Instance)
			{
				Singleton<SoundtrackManager>.Instance.ResumeTracks();
			}
			IAudioPlayer audioPlayer = AudioManager.GetAudioPlayer();
			audioPlayer.GetAudioMixer().GetChannel(AudioMixerChannels.Environment).Mute = false;
			audioPlayer.GetAudioMixer().GetChannel(AudioMixerChannels.FX).Mute = false;
			audioPlayer.GetAudioMixer().GetChannel(AudioMixerChannels.Voice).Mute = false;
			Time.timeScale = 1f;
			EventManager.RaiseEvent(new MainMenuOpenedEvent(RewiredUtilities.GetPlayerFromInput(_currentPlayerInput)?.Id ?? _currentPlayerInput.id, opened: false));
			IPlayer playerFromInput = RewiredUtilities.GetPlayerFromInput(_currentPlayerInput);
			if (!playerFromInput.IsNullOrDestroyed())
			{
				playerFromInput.IsBusy = false;
				--playerFromInput.Movement.IsBusy;
				playerFromInput.Interacter.IsInPauseMenu = false;
				playerFromInput.PlayerCamera.MouseLook.enabled = true;
			}
			if (Game.State != GameState.MAIN_MENU)
			{
				_isGamePaused = false;
				_currentPlayerInput.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: true, _mapBeforePaused);
				_currentPlayerInput.RemoveInputEventDelegate(RewiredPlayer_EscapeButtonDown, UpdateLoopType.Update, InputActionEventType.ButtonJustPressed, 31);
			}
			else
			{
				_currentPlayerInput.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: true, 0);
			}
			_currentPlayerInput.GetOtherPlayers().RestoreMapsEnabled();
			_currentPlayerInput.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: false, 8);
			_currentPlayerInput.SetCursorEnabled(enabled: false);
			_currentPlayerInput = null;
			_view.Hide();
		}
	}

	private void InitializeControls()
	{
		_view.PlaySubMenu.SetActive(value: false);
		_view.PlayOnlineSubMenu.SetActive(value: false);
		_view.UserDetailsGroup.SetActive(value: true);
		if (Game.State == GameState.MAIN_MENU)
		{
			_view.MainMenuControlGroup.SetActive(value: true);
			_view.PauseMenuControlGroup.SetActive(value: false);
			ValidateContinueButtons();
		}
		else
		{
			_view.MainMenuControlGroup.SetActive(value: false);
			_view.PauseMenuControlGroup.SetActive(value: true);
		}
		_view.SetNavigation();
	}

	private void InitializeStats()
	{
		if (Game.State == GameState.MAIN_MENU)
		{
			if (IsContinueButtonAvailable())
			{
				LoadStats(GameMode.SinglePlayer);
				UpdateUserStats(GAccountService.Get().LocalUser.UserStats.SessionStats);
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateUserStats("---", "---");
			}
		}
		else if (Game.State == GameState.NEW_GAME || Game.State == GameState.LOAD_GAME)
		{
			UpdateUserStats(Singleton<GameCalendar>.Instance.DaysAlive, Mathf.FloorToInt(Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.SessionDuration));
		}
	}

	private void LoadStats(GameMode mode)
	{
		GAccountService.Get().LocalUser.UserStats.Load(mode);
	}

	private void ResetStats()
	{
		GAccountService.Get().LocalUser.UserStats.Reset();
	}

	private void ValidateContinueButtons()
	{
		if (SaveManager.ValidateSaveFile(GameMode.SinglePlayer))
		{
			_view.ContinueButton.Show();
		}
		else
		{
			_view.ContinueButton.Hide();
		}
		if (SaveManager.ValidateSaveFile(GameMode.Coop_2))
		{
			_view.ContinueCoopButton.Show();
			_view.ContinueCoopButton.Enabled = ReInput.players.playerCount == 2;
		}
		else
		{
			_view.ContinueCoopButton.Hide();
		}
	}

	private void UpdateUserName(string name)
	{
		_view.UserNameLabel.Text = name;
	}

	private void UpdateUserStats(Stats stats)
	{
		UpdateUserStats(stats.DaysSurvived + 1, stats.TimePlayed);
	}

	private void UpdateUserStats(int days, int seconds)
	{
		TimeSpan timeSpan = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(seconds);
		UpdateUserStats(days.ToString(), $"{timeSpan.Days:0}d {timeSpan.Hours:00}h {timeSpan.Minutes:00}m");
	}

	private void UpdateUserStats(string days, string seconds)
	{
		_view.UserDetailsDaysLabel.Text = days;
		_view.UserDetailsHoursLabel.Text = seconds;
	}

	private void RewiredPlayer_EscapeButtonDown(InputActionEventData eventData)
	{
		if (!_suspend && !_childPanelOpen && Game.State != GameState.MAIN_MENU && Game.State != GameState.INTRO && !Singleton<Fader>.Instance.IsFading && !LevelLoader.IsLoading() && !LevelLoader.IsServerJoinInProgress && !SaveManager.IsSaving && !DialogueBox.Notifying && !RewiredUtilities.GetPlayerFromInput(eventData.player).IsNullOrDestroyed() && !RewiredUtilities.GetPlayerFromInput(eventData.player).Lighter.IsLightingFire && !RewiredUtilities.GetPlayerFromInput(eventData.player).Movement.IsInEndGameScene)
		{
			if (_view.Visible && _currentPlayerInput == eventData.player)
			{
				Hide();
			}
			else if (!_view.Visible && _currentPlayerInput == null)
			{
				Show(eventData.player);
			}
		}
	}

	private void MenuPresenter_ShowView()
	{
		_childPanelOpen = true;
		_view.MainMenuGameObject.SetActive(value: false);
	}

	private void MenuPresenter_HideView()
	{
		_childPanelOpen = false;
		_view.MainMenuGameObject.SetActive(value: true);
		_view.SelectFirstButton();
	}

	private void ChangeSaveSlotMenuPresenter_SlotChanged()
	{
		Timing.RunCoroutine(Reload_Sequence());
	}

	private void CartographerMenuPresenter_CreatedNewWorld()
	{
		NEW_RANDOM_WORLD_CREATED = true;
		_view.NewGameButton.Enabled = true;
	}

	private void SaveManager_DeletedSaveFile(GameMode mode)
	{
		ValidateContinueButtons();
		InitializeStats();
	}

	private void PlayButton_Click(object sender)
	{
		Game.Mode = GameMode.SinglePlayer;
		ContinuingMultiplayerGame = false;
		if (!IsContinueButtonAvailable())
		{
			NewGameButton_Click(null);
			return;
		}
		_view.MainMenuControlGroup.SetActive(value: false);
		_view.PlaySubMenu.SetActive(value: true);
		_view.UserDetailsGroup.SetActive(value: false);
		_currentSubScreen = MainMenuScreen.PLAY;
		_view.SelectFirstButton();
	}

	private void PlayBackButton_Click(object sender)
	{

	private void Rewired_OnControllerDisconnected(ControllerStatusChangedEventArgs args)
	{
		if (Game.Mode != GameMode.Coop_2 || _currentPlayerInput == null || _currentPlayerInput.id != 1 || !_view.Visible)
		{
			return;
		}
		_currentPlayerInput.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: true, 0);
		_currentPlayerInput.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: false, 8);
		_currentPlayerInput.DisableMaps();
		_currentPlayerInput = ReInput.players.GetPlayer(0);
		_currentPlayerInput.RestoreMapsEnabled();
		foreach (IPlayer allPlayer in PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers)
		{
			if (allPlayer.Input.IsNullOrDestroyed())
			{
				return;
			}
			allPlayer.PlayerUI.UserInterface.EventSystem.Suspend(allPlayer.Input.id != _currentPlayerInput.id);
			allPlayer.PlayerUI.UserInterface.EventSystem.SetSelectedGameObject(null);
		}
		_currentPlayerInput.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: false, 0);
		_currentPlayerInput.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: true, 8);
		_currentPlayerInput.SetCursorEnabled(enabled: true);
		_view.SetInput(_currentPlayerInput);
		if (_optionsMenuPresenter.CurrentPanel == null)
		{
			_view.SelectFirstButton();
		}
		else
		{
			_optionsMenuPresenter.ResetControls(_currentPlayerInput);
		}
	}

	private void AttemptToGoToPreviousScreen()
	{
		if (_view.Visible && !DialogueBox.Notifying && Game.State == GameState.MAIN_MENU)
		{
			switch (_currentSubScreen)
			{
			case MainMenuScreen.PLAY:
				PlayBackButton_Click(null);
				break;
			case MainMenuScreen.PLAY_ONLINE:
				PlayOnlineBackButton_Click(null);
				break;
			case MainMenuScreen.HOST:
				PlayOnlineHostBackButton_Click(null);
				break;
			case MainMenuScreen.HOST_CONTINUE_GAME:
				_currentSubScreen = MainMenuScreen.HOST;
				break;
			case MainMenuScreen.HOST_NEW_GAME:
				_currentSubScreen = MainMenuScreen.HOST;
				break;
			case MainMenuScreen.JOIN:
				_currentSubScreen = MainMenuScreen.PLAY_ONLINE;
				break;
			}
		}
	}

	private void StartNewGame(GameSettings settings)
	{
		AccountUserStats userStats = GAccountService.Get().LocalUser.UserStats;
		userStats.SessionStats.Reset();
		userStats.Rebase();
		GameMode mode = Game.Mode;
		if (settings.Mode == EGameMode.Cooperative)
		{
			mode = GameMode.Coop_2;
		}
		GameState state = GameState.INTRO;
		int scene = 2;
		Options.CustomSettings = settings;
		if (settings.World == EGameWorldMode.Existing || (settings.World == EGameWorldMode.Random && NEW_RANDOM_WORLD_CREATED))
		{
			ReplicatedStartGame(mode, state, scene);
		}
		else if (settings.World == EGameWorldMode.Random)
		{
			Timing.RunCoroutine(CreateRandomWorld_Sequence(mode, state, scene));
		}
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> CreateRandomWorld_Sequence(GameMode mode, GameState state, int scene)
	{
		if (mode.IsServer())
		{
			yield return PlayerRegistry.LocalPeer.SetTimeout_Async(Peer.GetSessionTimeout());
		}
		_cartographerMenuPresenter.ShowRandomizeWorldDialogue_NoInput(() =>
		{
			if (mode.IsServer())
			{
				PlayerRegistry.LocalPeer.WorldSeed = StrandedWorld.LOCAL_WORLD_SEED;
			}
			ReplicatedStartGame(mode, state, scene);
			_newGameMenuPresenter.Suspend = false;
		}, () =>
		{
			_newGameMenuPresenter.Suspend = false;
		});
	}

	private void StartContinueGame()
	{
		ReplicatedStartGame(Game.Mode, GameState.LOAD_GAME, 3);
	}

	public void StartGame(GameMode mode, GameState state, int scene)
	{
		Time.timeScale = 1f;
		if ((bool)_view)
		{
			_view.CanvasGroup.Interactable = false;
		}
		else
		{
			Debug.LogError("No _view");
		}
		Game.Mode = mode;
		Game.State = state;
		ResetStats();
		if (Game.Mode.IsMaster() && Game.State == GameState.LOAD_GAME)
		{
			LoadStats(Game.Mode);
		}
		if (!Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
		{
			MultiplayerMng.ConnectToLocal(() =>
			{
				_newGameMenuPresenter.Hide();
				StartScene(scene);
			});
		}
		else
		{
			_newGameMenuPresenter.Hide();
			StartScene(scene);
		}
		_view.PlayOnlineHostSubMenu.SetActive(value: false);
	}

	private void StartScene(int scene)
	{
		FadeMode mode = FadeMode.Custom;
		if (Game.State != GameState.LOAD_GAME || !_customBgd)
		{
			mode = FadeMode.Solid;
		}
		Singleton<Fader>.Instance.FadeOut(3f, mode, () =>
		{
			LoadLevel(scene);
		});
	}

	private void CloseSession(DisconnectDetail detail)
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsClient())
		{
			World.PopWorld();
		}
		SetSceneRootsActive(3, value: false);
		PlayerUtilities.SetPlayerBundlesActive(active: false);
		PlayerRegistry.LocalPeer.ReplicatedDisconnect(detail, null, forceLocalShutdown: true);
		if (!MultiplayerMng.Instance.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(MultiplayerMng.Instance.gameObject);
		}
	}

	public static void SetSceneRootsActive(int sceneBuildIndex, bool value)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < SceneManager.sceneCount; i++)
		{
			Scene sceneAt = SceneManager.GetSceneAt(i);
			if (sceneAt.IsNullOrDestroyed() || sceneAt.buildIndex != sceneBuildIndex)
			{
				continue;
			}
			GameObject[] rootGameObjects = sceneAt.GetRootGameObjects();
			foreach (GameObject gameObject in rootGameObjects)
			{
				if (gameObject != null)
				{
					gameObject.SetActive(value);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public void QuitToMenu(float fadeOutTime = 3f)
	{
		NEW_RANDOM_WORLD_CREATED = false;
		_view.CanvasGroup.Interactable = false;
		_suspend = true;
		QuittingToMenu?.Invoke();
		CloseSession(DisconnectDetail.Intended);
		RewiredUtilities.Players.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: false, 15);
		Singleton<Fader>.Instance.FadeOut(fadeOutTime, FadeMode.Solid, Game.QuitToMenu);
	}

	private void QuitToDesktop()
	{
		Game.QuitToDesktop();
	}

	public void LoadLevel(int level, LoadSceneMode mode = LoadSceneMode.Additive)
	{
		CursorUtils.LockState = CursorLockMode.Locked;
		CursorUtils.Visible = false;
		LevelLoader.LoadLevel(level, mode, SceneLoad_Started, SceneLoad_Finished);
	}

	private void SceneLoad_Started()
	{
		Hide();
		_loadingScreenPresenter.Show();
	}

	private void SceneLoad_Finished()
	{
		_loadingScreenPresenter.Hide();
		_view.BackgroundTexture.Enabled = false;
		_view.BackgroundTexture.transform.gameObject.SetActive(value: false);
	}

	public void ShowJoinSessionDialog(Action onTimeout = null, EmptyEventHandler onSkip = null)
	{
		_currentPlayerInput.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: false, 8);
		_joinSessionDialog = DialogueBox.Show(_currentPlayerInput, "NEW_GAME_MENU_LABEL_TITLE", "PLAY_ONLINE_MENU_CREATE_SESSION_CREATING", DialogueButton.None);
		if (onSkip != null)
		{
			_joinSessionDialog.Decline += onSkip;
		}
		_joinSessionDialogTimeout = Timing.RunCoroutine(TimeOut_Sequence(onTimeout));
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> TimeOut_Sequence(Action onTimeout)
	{
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(30f);
		onTimeout?.Invoke();
	}

	public void HideJoinSessionDialog()
	{
		_currentPlayerInput.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: true, 8);
		if ((bool)_joinSessionDialog)
		{
			_joinSessionDialog.Destroy();
		}
		if (_joinSessionDialogTimeout.IsValid && _joinSessionDialogTimeout.IsRunning)
		{
			_joinSessionDialogTimeout.IsRunning = false;
		}
	}

	public void ShowNewGameMenuPresenter()
	{
		_newGameMenuPresenter.Show();
	}

	private void MPFriendlyQuit()
	{
		MultiplayerMng.UpdateSessionToken_IsBusy(isBusy: false);
		if (Game.Mode.IsServer())
		{
			new ReplicateQuitToMenu().Post();
			BeamTiming.WaitAnd(0.33f, () =>
			{
				QuitToMenu();
			});
		}
		else
		{
			QuitToMenu();
		}
	}

	public void ReplicatedStartGame(GameMode mode, GameState state, int scene)
	{
		if (mode.IsServer())
		{
			ReplicateStartGame replicateStartGame = new ReplicateStartGame();
			replicateStartGame.Mode = ((mode == GameMode.Coop_Server) ? 5 : 4);
			replicateStartGame.State = (int)state;
			replicateStartGame.Scene = scene;
			replicateStartGame.Post();
		}
		StartGame(mode, state, scene);
	}

	private void SetBackgroundTexture(Texture2D texture)
	{
		if (!_view.BackgroundTexture.transform.gameObject.activeSelf)
		{
			_view.BackgroundTexture.Enabled = true;
			_view.BackgroundTexture.transform.gameObject.SetActive(value: true);
		}
		_view.BackgroundTexture.Texture = texture;
		Singleton<Fader>.Instance.SetCustomTexture(texture);
	}

	private Texture2D LoadTextureBytes(string path)
	{
		if (!File.Exists(path))
		{
			return null;
		}
		byte[] array;
		using (FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(path, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read))
		{
			array = new byte[fileStream.Length];
			fileStream.Read(array, 0, (int)fileStream.Length);
		}
		return LoadTextureBytes(array);
	}

	private Texture2D LoadTextureBytes(byte[] bytes)
	{
		if (bytes == null)
		{
			return null;
		}
		Texture2D texture2D = new Texture2D(1, 1);
		if (texture2D.LoadImage(bytes))
		{
			return texture2D;
		}
		return null;
	}

	protected bool IsContinueButtonAvailable()
	{
		if (!_view.ContinueButton.Visible)
		{
			return _view.ContinueCoopButton.Visible;
		}
		return true;
	}

	public async void CheckOnlineAvailable(Action onAvailable, Action onNotAvailableDialogueDismissed, Action onNotAvailable = null)
	{
		_view.CanvasGroup.Interactable = false;
		if (await NetworkConnectivity.CheckHttpConnectivityAsync() != 0)
		{
			_view.CanvasGroup.Interactable = true;
			onNotAvailable?.Invoke();
			DialogueBox.Show(_currentPlayerInput, "TEXT_ERROR", "PLAY_ONLINE_MENU_CREATE_SESSION_CREATING_ERROR_CONNECTING", DialogueButton.Ok, DialogueIcon.Warning).Accept += () =>
			{
				onNotAvailableDialogueDismissed?.Invoke();
			};
		}
		else
		{
			_view.CanvasGroup.Interactable = true;
			onAvailable?.Invoke();
		}
	}
}

	public override void SetCraftsmanship(float craftsmanship)
	{
		_craftsmanshipLabel.Enabled = craftsmanship <= 0f;
		_craftsmanshipBar.NormalizedValue = craftsmanship;
	}

	public override void SetWatchMode(int mode)
	{
		if (_currentMode == mode && _currentMode != 3 && _currentMode != 2)
		{
			return;
		}
		_currentMode = mode;
		for (int i = 0; i < _watchModes.Length; i++)
		{
			bool active = i == _currentMode;
			_watchModes[i].Active = active;
		}
		if (_currentMode == 3)
		{
			int num = 0;
			Zone[] zones = Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.Zones;
			foreach (Zone zone in zones)
			{
				if ((Game.Mode.IsMaster() && zone.HasVisited) || (Game.Mode.IsClient() && zone.HasVisited))
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			CreateStatusLabels(statisticsNames, _statisticsNamesLabelsContainer, _statisticsNamesLabelPrefab, tryUpdate: true);
		}
		else if (_currentMode == 2)
		{
			IList<string> statusEffectsWatch = _controller.Player.Statistics.GetStatusEffectsWatch();
			if (statusEffectsWatch != null)
			{
				CreateStatusLabels(statusEffectsWatch, _statusLabelsContainer, _statusLabelPrefab, tryUpdate: true);
			}
		}
	}

	public override void CycleWatchModeForward()
	{
		int num = _currentMode + 1;
		if ((Game.Mode.IsClient() || (Game.Mode.IsLocalCoop() && _controller.Player.Id > 0)) && num == 3)
		{
			num++;
		}
		if (num > _watchModes.Length - 1)
		{
			num = 0;
		}
		SetWatchMode(num);
	}

	public override void CycleWatchModeBackward()
	{
		int num = _currentMode - 1;
		if (num < 0)
		{
			num = _watchModes.Length - 1;
		}
		if ((Game.Mode.IsClient() || (Game.Mode.IsLocalCoop() && _controller.Player.Id > 0)) && num == 3)
		{
			num--;
		}
		SetWatchMode(num);
	}

	public void CreateStatusLabels<T>(IList<T> labels, TransformViewAdapter container, TMPLabelViewAdapter prefab, bool tryUpdate = false)
	{
		if (tryUpdate && labels.Count == container.Transform.childCount)
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (num = 0; num < container.Transform.childCount; num++)
			{
				TMPLabelViewAdapter component = container.Transform.GetChild(num).gameObject.GetComponent<TMPLabelViewAdapter>();
				if (component == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				component.Text = labels[num].ToString().ToUpper();
			}
			if (num == container.Transform.childCount)
			{
				return;
			}
		}
		BeamTeam.DestroyAllChildren(container);
		foreach (T label in labels)
		{
			TMPLabelViewAdapter tMPLabelViewAdapter = Object.Instantiate(prefab);
			tMPLabelViewAdapter.transform.SetParent(container.Transform, worldPositionStays: false);
			tMPLabelViewAdapter.Text = label.ToString().ToUpper();
			FormatLabelAutoSizing(tMPLabelViewAdapter, 17f, 8f);
		}
	}

	private void FormatLabelAutoSizing(TMPLabelViewAdapter label, float maxSize, float minSize)
	{
		label.EnableAutoSizing = true;
		label.FontSizeMax = maxSize;
		label.FontSizeMin = minSize;
		label.EnableWordWrapping = false;
	}
}

	{
		if (Maps.UserMapList.FirstOrDefault((Map map) => map.EditorData.Id == CurrentMap.EditorData.Id) != null)
		{
			DialogueBoxViewAdapter dialogueBoxViewAdapter = DialogueBox.Show(ReInput.players.GetPlayer(0), "MAP_EDITOR_SAVE_MENU_DB_SAVE_TITLE", "MAP_EDITOR_SAVE_MENU_DB_SAVE_EXISTING_DESC", DialogueButton.YesNo);

	{

		JObject jObject = new JObject();
		LE_Object[] componentsInChildren = Singleton<LE_LevelEditorMain>.Instance.ObjectDumpContainer.GetComponentsInChildren<LE_Object>(includeInactive: true);
		foreach (LE_Object lE_Object in componentsInChildren)

			jObject2.AddField("reference", MiniGuid.New().ToString());

			jObject2.AddField("Transform", data);
			jObject.Add(jObject2);

		CurrentMap.EditorData.Author = GAccountService.Get().LocalUser.UserInfo.DisplayName;
		CurrentMap.EditorData.Name = _view.NameInputField.Text.Trim();
		CurrentMap.EditorData.Description = _view.DescriptionInputField.Text.Trim();
		CurrentMap.EditorData.VersionNumber++;

		{

			flag = true;
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{

		{

		}
		else
		{

			DialogueBox.Show(ReInput.players.GetPlayer(0), "MAP_EDITOR_SAVE_MENU_DB_ERROR_TITLE", message, DialogueButton.Ok, DialogueIcon.Warning);
		}
		Hide();
	}

using Ceto.Common.Containers.Interpolation;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Ceto;

[AddComponentMenu("Ceto/Overlays/AddAutoShoreMask")]
[DisallowMultipleComponent]
public class AddAutoShoreMask : AddWaveOverlayBase
{
	public bool ignoreQuerys;

	public bool textureFoam = true;

	[Range(0.1f, 100f)]
	public float heightSpread = 10f;

	[Range(0.1f, 10f)]
	public float foamSpread = 2f;

	[Range(0.1f, 10f)]
	public float clipOffset = 4f;

	public int resolution = 1024;

	public bool useHeightMask = true;

	[Range(0f, 1f)]
	public float heightAlpha = 0.9f;

	public bool useNormalMask = true;

	[Range(0f, 1f)]
	public float normalAlpha = 0.8f;

	public bool useEdgeFoam = true;

	[Range(0f, 10f)]
	public float edgeFoamAlpha = 1f;

	public bool useFoamMask = true;

	[Range(0f, 1f)]
	public float foamMaskAlpha = 1f;

	public bool useClipMask = true;

	private bool m_registered;

	private float m_width;

	private float m_height;

	private Texture2D m_heightMask;

	private Texture2D m_edgeFoam;

	private Texture2D m_clipMask;

	private float m_heightSpread;

	private float m_foamSpread;

	private float m_clipOffset;

	private float m_resolution;

	protected override void Start()
	{
		m_overlays.Add(new WaveOverlay());
		UpdateOverlay();
	}

	protected override void Update()
	{
		if (m_overlays != null && m_overlays.Count == 1)
		{
			UpdateOverlay();
		}
	}

	protected override void OnDestroy()
	{
		base.OnDestroy();
		Release();
	}

	private void UpdateOverlay()
	{
		if (Ocean.Instance != null && (!m_registered || SettingsChanged()))
		{
			CreateShoreMasks();
		}
		Vector2 halfSize = new Vector2(m_width * 0.5f, m_height * 0.5f);
		Vector3 position = transform.position;
		position.x += halfSize.x;
		position.z += halfSize.y;
		m_overlays[0].Position = position;
		m_overlays[0].HalfSize = halfSize;
		m_overlays[0].HeightTex.maskAlpha = (useHeightMask ? heightAlpha : 0f);
		m_overlays[0].HeightTex.ignoreQuerys = ignoreQuerys;
		m_overlays[0].NormalTex.maskAlpha = (useNormalMask ? normalAlpha : 0f);
		m_overlays[0].NormalTex.maskMode = OVERLAY_MASK_MODE.WAVES_AND_OVERLAY_BLEND;
		m_overlays[0].FoamTex.alpha = (useEdgeFoam ? edgeFoamAlpha : 0f);
		m_overlays[0].FoamTex.textureFoam = textureFoam;
		m_overlays[0].FoamTex.maskAlpha = (useFoamMask ? foamMaskAlpha : 0f);
		m_overlays[0].ClipTex.alpha = (useClipMask ? 1f : 0f);
		m_overlays[0].ClipTex.ignoreQuerys = ignoreQuerys;
		m_overlays[0].UpdateOverlay();
	}

	private void CreateShoreMasks()
	{
		Release();
		Terrain component = GetComponent<Terrain>();
		if (component == null)
		{
			Ocean.LogWarning("The AddAutoShoreMask script must be attached to a component with a Terrain. The shore mask will not be created.");
			enabled = false;
			return;
		}
		if (component.terrainData == null)
		{
			Ocean.LogWarning("The terrain data is null. The shore mask will not be created.");
			enabled = false;
			return;
		}
		Vector3 size = component.terrainData.size;
		resolution = Mathf.Clamp(resolution, 32, 4096);
		m_width = size.x;
		m_height = size.z;
		float level = Ocean.Instance.level;
		float[] data = ShoreMaskGenerator.CreateHeightMap(component);
		int heightmapResolution = component.terrainData.heightmapResolution;
		InterpolatedArray2f heightMap = new InterpolatedArray2f(data, heightmapResolution, heightmapResolution, 1, wrap: false);
		if (useHeightMask || useNormalMask || useFoamMask)
		{
			m_heightMask = ShoreMaskGenerator.CreateMask(heightMap, resolution, resolution, level, heightSpread, TextureFormat.ARGB32);
		}
		if (useEdgeFoam)
		{
			m_edgeFoam = ShoreMaskGenerator.CreateMask(heightMap, resolution, resolution, level, foamSpread, TextureFormat.ARGB32);
		}
		if (useClipMask)
		{
			m_clipMask = ShoreMaskGenerator.CreateClipMask(heightMap, resolution, resolution, level + clipOffset, TextureFormat.ARGB32);
		}
		if (useHeightMask)
		{
			m_overlays[0].HeightTex.mask = m_heightMask;
		}
		if (useNormalMask)
		{
			m_overlays[0].NormalTex.mask = m_heightMask;
		}
		if (useFoamMask)
		{
			m_overlays[0].FoamTex.mask = m_heightMask;
		}
		if (useEdgeFoam)
		{
			m_overlays[0].FoamTex.tex = m_edgeFoam;
		}
		if (useClipMask)
		{
			m_overlays[0].ClipTex.tex = m_clipMask;
		}
		if (!m_registered)
		{
			Ocean.Instance.OverlayManager.Add(m_overlays[0]);
			m_registered = true;
		}
		m_heightSpread = heightSpread;
		m_foamSpread = foamSpread;
		m_clipOffset = clipOffset;
		m_resolution = resolution;
	}

	private bool SettingsChanged()
	{
		if (m_heightSpread != heightSpread)
		{
			return true;
		}
		if (m_foamSpread != foamSpread)
		{
			return true;
		}
		if (m_clipOffset != clipOffset)
		{
			return true;
		}
		if (m_resolution != (float)resolution)
		{
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	private void Release()
	{
		if (m_heightMask != null)
		{
			Object.Destroy(m_heightMask);
			m_heightMask = null;
		}
		if (m_edgeFoam != null)
		{
			Object.Destroy(m_edgeFoam);
			m_edgeFoam = null;
		}
		if (m_clipMask != null)
		{
			Object.Destroy(m_clipMask);
			m_clipMask = null;
		}
		if (m_overlays != null && m_overlays.Count == 1)
		{
			m_overlays[0].HeightTex.mask = null;
			m_overlays[0].NormalTex.mask = null;
			m_overlays[0].FoamTex.mask = null;
			m_overlays[0].FoamTex.tex = null;
			m_overlays[0].ClipTex.tex = null;
		}
	}
}



/* SOURCE_FILE: /storage/emulated/0/Map Check/reports/V15_SOURCE_EXTRACTED/Assembly-CSharp/Ceto/ShoreMaskGenerator.cs
SOURCE_BYTES: 4038
SOURCE_SHA256: 7e25123e056219f718fa13a40d07e9e0a0e8f86d090c2ed6fb37873846f62b99
MATCHES: TerrainData;GetHeights
*/
using Ceto.Common.Containers.Interpolation;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Ceto;

public static class ShoreMaskGenerator
{
	public static float[] CreateHeightMap(Terrain terrain)
	{
		TerrainData terrainData = terrain.terrainData;
		int heightmapResolution = terrainData.heightmapResolution;
		Vector3 heightmapScale = terrainData.heightmapScale;
		float[,] heights = terrainData.GetHeights(0, 0, heightmapResolution, heightmapResolution);
		float[] array = new float[heightmapResolution * heightmapResolution];
		for (int i = 0; i < heightmapResolution; i++)
		{
			for (int j = 0; j < heightmapResolution; j++)
			{
				array[j + i * heightmapResolution] = heights[i, j] * heightmapScale.y + terrain.transform.position.y;
			}
		}
		return array;
	}

	public static Texture2D CreateMask(float[] heightMap, int size, float shoreLevel, float spread, TextureFormat format)
	{
		Texture2D texture2D = new Texture2D(size, size, format, mipChain: false, linear: true);
		texture2D.filterMode = FilterMode.Bilinear;
		int num = size * size;
		Color[] array = new Color[num];
		for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
		{
			float num2 = Mathf.Clamp(shoreLevel - heightMap[i], 0f, spread);
			num2 = 1f - num2 / spread;
			array[i].r = num2;
			array[i].g = num2;
			array[i].b = num2;
			array[i].a = num2;
		}
		texture2D.SetPixels(array);
		texture2D.Apply();
		return texture2D;
	}

	public static Texture2D CreateMask(InterpolatedArray2f heightMap, int width, int height, float shoreLevel, float spread, TextureFormat format)
	{
		Texture2D texture2D = new Texture2D(width, height, format, mipChain: false, linear: true);
		texture2D.filterMode = FilterMode.Bilinear;
		Color[] array = new Color[width * height];
		bool flag = width == heightMap.SX && height == heightMap.SY;
		for (int i = 0; i < height; i++)
		{
			for (int j = 0; j < width; j++)
			{
				int num = j + i * height;
				float num2 = 0f;
				if (flag)
				{
					num2 = Mathf.Clamp(shoreLevel - heightMap.Data[num], 0f, spread);
				}
				else
				{
					float x = (float)j / ((float)width - 1f);
					float y = (float)i / ((float)height - 1f);
					num2 = Mathf.Clamp(shoreLevel - heightMap.Get(x, y, 0), 0f, spread);
				}
				num2 = 1f - num2 / spread;
				array[num].r = num2;
				array[num].g = num2;
				array[num].b = num2;
				array[num].a = num2;
			}
		}
		texture2D.SetPixels(array);
		texture2D.Apply();
		return texture2D;
	}

	public static Texture2D CreateClipMask(float[] heightMap, int size, float shoreLevel, TextureFormat format)
	{
		Texture2D texture2D = new Texture2D(size, size, format, mipChain: false, linear: true);
		texture2D.filterMode = FilterMode.Bilinear;
		int num = size * size;
		Color[] array = new Color[num];
		for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
		{
			float num2 = Mathf.Clamp(heightMap[i] - shoreLevel, 0f, 1f);
			if (num2 > 0f)
			{
				num2 = 1f;
			}
			array[i].r = num2;
			array[i].g = num2;
			array[i].b = num2;
			array[i].a = num2;
		}
		texture2D.SetPixels(array);
		texture2D.Apply();
		return texture2D;
	}

	public static Texture2D CreateClipMask(InterpolatedArray2f heightMap, int width, int height, float shoreLevel, TextureFormat format)
	{
		Texture2D texture2D = new Texture2D(width, height, format, mipChain: false, linear: true);
		texture2D.filterMode = FilterMode.Bilinear;
		Color[] array = new Color[width * height];
		bool flag = width == heightMap.SX && height == heightMap.SY;
		for (int i = 0; i < height; i++)
		{
			for (int j = 0; j < width; j++)
			{
				int num = j + i * height;
				float num2 = 0f;
				if (flag)
				{
					num2 = Mathf.Clamp(heightMap.Data[num] - shoreLevel, 0f, 1f);
				}
				else
				{
					float x = (float)j / ((float)width - 1f);
					float y = (float)i / ((float)height - 1f);
					num2 = Mathf.Clamp(heightMap.Get(x, y, 0) - shoreLevel, 0f, 1f);
				}
				if (num2 > 0f)
				{
					num2 = 1f;
				}
				array[num].r = num2;
				array[num].g = num2;
				array[num].b = num2;
				array[num].a = num2;
			}
		}
		texture2D.SetPixels(array);
		texture2D.Apply();
		return texture2D;
	}
}



/* SOURCE_FILE: /storage/emulated/0/Map Check/reports/V15_SOURCE_EXTRACTED/Assembly-CSharp/FollowSpawn.cs

*/
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Beam;
using Beam.Events;
using MEC;
using SharpNeatLib.Maths;
using UnityEngine;

public class FollowSpawn : CellObjectSpawner, IHashCollection
{

	private void CheckFollowingPosition()
	{

				{
					spawnGrid = _spawnGrids[i, j];
					num = 1 - i;
					num2 = 1 - j;
					break;
				}
			}
		}
		if (spawnGrid != _spawnGrids[1, 1])
		{
			if (spawnGrid == null)

				_spawnGrids[1, 1].Transform.position = position2;

			}
			for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
			{
				for (int l = 0; l < 3; l++)
				{
					int num3 = k + num;

						for (int m = 0; m < childCount; m++)
						{
							ObjectPoolManager.DestroyPooled(_spawnGrids[k, l].Objects.GetChild(0).gameObject);

						_spawnGrids[k, l].CanGenerate = true;
					}

	private void UpdateGridPositions()
	{
		_spawnGrids[0, 0].Transform.position = new Vector3(_spawnGrids[1, 1].Transform.position.x - (float)GRID_DIMENSION, transform.position.y, _spawnGrids[1, 1].Transform.position.z + (float)GRID_DIMENSION);
		_spawnGrids[0, 1].Transform.position = new Vector3(_spawnGrids[1, 1].Transform.position.x - (float)GRID_DIMENSION, transform.position.y, _spawnGrids[1, 1].Transform.position.z);
		_spawnGrids[0, 2].Transform.position = new Vector3(_spawnGrids[1, 1].Transform.position.x - (float)GRID_DIMENSION, transform.position.y, _spawnGrids[1, 1].Transform.position.z - (float)GRID_DIMENSION);
		_spawnGrids[1, 0].Transform.position = new Vector3(_spawnGrids[1, 1].Transform.position.x, transform.position.y, _spawnGrids[1, 1].Transform.position.z + (float)GRID_DIMENSION);
		_spawnGrids[1, 2].Transform.position = new Vector3(_spawnGrids[1, 1].Transform.position.x, transform.position.y, _spawnGrids[1, 1].Transform.position.z - (float)GRID_DIMENSION);
		_spawnGrids[2, 0].Transform.position = new Vector3(_spawnGrids[1, 1].Transform.position.x + (float)GRID_DIMENSION, transform.position.y, _spawnGrids[1, 1].Transform.position.z + (float)GRID_DIMENSION);
		_spawnGrids[2, 1].Transform.position = new Vector3(_spawnGrids[1, 1].Transform.position.x + (float)GRID_DIMENSION, transform.position.y, _spawnGrids[1, 1].Transform.position.z);
		_spawnGrids[2, 2].Transform.position = new Vector3(_spawnGrids[1, 1].Transform.position.x + (float)GRID_DIMENSION, transform.position.y, _spawnGrids[1, 1].Transform.position.z - (float)GRID_DIMENSION);
	}

	private void UpdateGridObjects()
	{
		_masterUpdateCoroutine = Timing.RunCoroutine(UpdateGridObjects_Sequence(distributed: true));
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> UpdateGridObjects_Sequence(bool distributed)
	{
		_samplesCounter = 0;
		for (int x = 0; x < 3; x++)
		{
			for (int y = 0; y < 3; y++)
			{
				SpawnGrid spawnGrid = _spawnGrids[x, y];
				if (spawnGrid.CanGenerate && !HashCollectionCache.HasHash(this, spawnGrid.Transform.position.Hash()))
				{
					_gridUpdateCoroutine = Timing.RunCoroutine(CreateGridObjects_Sequence(spawnGrid, 400));
					yield return Timing.WaitUntilDone(_gridUpdateCoroutine);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> CreateGridObjects_Sequence(SpawnGrid grid, int samplesPerStep)
	{
		if (Following == null)
		{
			yield break;
		}
		grid.CanGenerate = false;
		_random.Reinitialise((int)(grid.Transform.position.x + grid.Transform.position.z));
		Zone.BiomeType currentBiome = StrandedWorld.GetBiome(Following.position);
		if (currentBiome == Zone.BiomeType.DEEP_SEA)
		{
			yield break;
		}
		_sampler.Init(grid.Transform.position);
		BiomeGrid[] gridObjects = GridObjects2;
		foreach (BiomeGrid biomeGrid in gridObjects)
		{
			GridObject[] biomeParameters = biomeGrid.biomeParameters;
			foreach (GridObject gridObject in biomeParameters)
			{
				if ((!_grass && gridObject.grass) || (currentBiome == Zone.BiomeType.MISSION && biomeGrid._biome != Zone.BiomeType.MISSION))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (gridObject.cycleGrid)
				{
					int curObjectCount = 0;
					for (int x = 0; x < GRID_DIMENSION; x += gridObject.gridCheckDensity)
					{
						for (int y = 0; y < GRID_DIMENSION; y += gridObject.gridCheckDensity)
						{
							if (curObjectCount >= gridObject.maxObjects)
							{
								continue;
							}
							Vector3 pos = grid.Transform.position + new Vector3(x - GRID_DIMENSION / 2, 50f, y - GRID_DIMENSION / 2);
							int randRot = _random.Next(360);
							if (_random.Next(100) > gridObject.rarity)
							{
								continue;
							}
							_samplesCounter++;
							if (_samplesCounter % samplesPerStep == 0)
							{
								yield return 0f;
							}
							if (!_sampler.TryGetSample(pos, out var sample))
							{
								continue;
							}
							float num = Mathf.Acos(Vector3.Dot(sample.Normal, Vector3.up)) * 57.29578f;
							Vector3 point = sample.Point;
							if (num >= gridObject.minslope && num <= gridObject.maxslope && point.y >= gridObject.minHeight && point.y <= gridObject.maxHeight)
							{
								point = transform.worldToLocalMatrix.MultiplyPoint3x4(point);
								Vector3 b = transform.worldToLocalMatrix.MultiplyVector(sample.Normal);
								Vector3 normalized = Vector3.Lerp(Vector3.up, b, gridObject.align).normalized;
								Quaternion rotation = Quaternion.FromToRotation(Vector3.up, normalized);
								GameObject gameObject = ObjectPoolManager.CreatePooled(gridObject.objectsToSpawn[_random.Next(gridObject.objectsToSpawn.Length)], point, rotation);
								if (gridObject.randomYRotation)
								{
									gameObject.transform.Rotate(Vector3.up * randRot);
								}
								gameObject.transform.parent = grid.Objects;
								curObjectCount++;
							}
						}
					}
					continue;
				}
				for (int curObjectCount = 0; curObjectCount < gridObject.maxObjects; curObjectCount++)
				{
					Vector3 pos = grid.Transform.position + new Vector3(_random.Next(-GRID_DIMENSION / 2, GRID_DIMENSION / 2), 50f, _random.Next(-GRID_DIMENSION / 2, GRID_DIMENSION / 2));
					int x = _random.Next(360);
					if (_random.Next(100) > gridObject.rarity)
					{
						continue;
					}
					_samplesCounter++;
					if (_samplesCounter % samplesPerStep == 0)
					{
						yield return 0f;
					}
					if (!_sampler.TryGetSample(pos, out var sample2))
					{
						continue;
					}
					float num2 = Mathf.Acos(Vector3.Dot(sample2.Normal, Vector3.up)) * 57.29578f;
					Vector3 point2 = sample2.Point;
					if (num2 >= gridObject.minslope && num2 <= gridObject.maxslope && point2.y >= gridObject.minHeight && point2.y <= gridObject.maxHeight)
					{
						point2 = transform.worldToLocalMatrix.MultiplyPoint3x4(point2);
						Vector3 b2 = transform.worldToLocalMatrix.MultiplyVector(sample2.Normal);
						Vector3 normalized2 = Vector3.Lerp(Vector3.up, b2, gridObject.align).normalized;
						Quaternion rotation2 = Quaternion.FromToRotation(Vector3.up, normalized2);
						GameObject gameObject2 = ObjectPoolManager.CreatePooled(gridObject.objectsToSpawn[_random.Next(gridObject.objectsToSpawn.Length)], point2, rotation2);
						if (gridObject.randomYRotation)
						{
							gameObject2.transform.Rotate(Vector3.up * x);
						}
						gameObject2.transform.parent = grid.Objects;
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public void ClearPatch(Vector3 position, float radius)
	{
		SpawnGrid[,] spawnGrids = _spawnGrids;
		int upperBound = spawnGrids.GetUpperBound(0);
		int upperBound2 = spawnGrids.GetUpperBound(1);
		for (int i = spawnGrids.GetLowerBound(0); i <= upperBound; i++)
		{
			for (int j = spawnGrids.GetLowerBound(1); j <= upperBound2; j++)
			{
				foreach (Transform item in spawnGrids[i, j].Transform)
				{
					if (Vector3.Distance(item.position, position) <= radius)
					{
						ObjectPoolManager.DestroyPooled(item.gameObject);
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	bool IHashCollection.HasHash(int hash)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
		{
			for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++)
			{
				if (_spawnGrids[i, j].Transform.position.Hash() == hash)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
		}
		return false;
	}
}

	public static string GetPath(this Transform transform)
	{
		if (transform.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			return string.Empty;
		}
		StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
		stringBuilder.Append(transform.gameObject.name);
		Transform parent = transform.parent;
		while (!parent.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			stringBuilder.Insert(0, "/");
			stringBuilder.Insert(0, parent.gameObject.name);
			parent = parent.parent;
		}
		return stringBuilder.ToString();
	}

	public static Quaternion ExtractRotation(this Matrix4x4 matrix)
	{
		Vector3 forward = default;
		forward.x = matrix.m02;
		forward.y = matrix.m12;
		forward.z = matrix.m22;
		Vector3 upwards = default;
		upwards.x = matrix.m01;
		upwards.y = matrix.m11;
		upwards.z = matrix.m21;
		return Quaternion.LookRotation(forward, upwards);
	}

	public static Vector3 ExtractPosition(this Matrix4x4 matrix)
	{
		Vector3 result = default;
		result.x = matrix.m03;
		result.y = matrix.m13;
		result.z = matrix.m23;
		return result;
	}

	public static Vector3 ExtractScale(this Matrix4x4 matrix)
	{
		Vector3 result = default;
		result.x = new Vector4(matrix.m00, matrix.m10, matrix.m20, matrix.m30).magnitude;
		result.y = new Vector4(matrix.m01, matrix.m11, matrix.m21, matrix.m31).magnitude;
		result.z = new Vector4(matrix.m02, matrix.m12, matrix.m22, matrix.m32).magnitude;
		return result;
	}

	public static void FromMatrix(this Transform transform, Matrix4x4 matrix)
	{
		transform.localScale = matrix.ExtractScale();
		transform.rotation = matrix.ExtractRotation();
		transform.position = matrix.ExtractPosition();
	}

	public static int Range(this System.Random random, int min, int max)

	}

	public static Rect Inflate(this Rect rect, Vector2 value)
	{
		return new Rect(rect.x - value.x, rect.y - value.y, rect.width + 2f * value.x, rect.height + 2f * value.y);
	}

	public static byte[] ToArray(this JObject data, byte[] header = null)
	{
		using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
		using GZipStream gZipStream = new GZipStream(memoryStream, CompressionMode.Compress, leaveOpen: true);
		if (header != null && header.Length != 0)
		{
			gZipStream.Write(header, 0, header.Length);
		}
		using (StreamWriter streamWriter = new StreamWriter(gZipStream))
		{
			streamWriter.Write(data.ToString());
		}
		return memoryStream.ToArray();
	}

	public static JObject ToJObject(this byte[] data, byte[] header = null)
	{
		using MemoryStream stream = new MemoryStream(data);
		using GZipStream gZipStream = new GZipStream(stream, CompressionMode.Decompress, leaveOpen: true);
		if (header != null && header.Length != 0)
		{
			gZipStream.Read(header, 0, header.Length);
		}
		using StreamReader streamReader = new StreamReader(gZipStream);
		return new JObject(streamReader.ReadToEnd());
	}

	public static void Write(this BinaryWriter bw, Vector2 p)

		bw.Write(p.y);

	public static ushort Compress(this float value)
	{
		if ((double)value > 1.0)
		{
			value = 1f;
		}
		if ((double)value < 0.0)
		{
			value = 0f;
		}
		return (ushort)(value * 65535f);
	}

	public static float Decompress(this ushort value)
	{
		return (float)(int)value / 65535f;
	}

	public static bool IsCompressStable(this ushort value)
	{
		return value == value.Decompress().Compress();
	}

	private static ushort GetCompressStable(this ushort value)
	{
		if (value.IsCompressStable())
		{
			return value;
		}
		int num = 1;
		while (true)
		{
			if (value - num >= 0 && ((ushort)(value - num)).IsCompressStable())
			{
				return (ushort)(value - num);
			}
			if (value + num <= 65535 && ((ushort)(value + num)).IsCompressStable())
			{
				break;
			}
			num++;
		}
		return (ushort)(value + num);
	}

	public static ushort ToCompressStable(this ushort value)
	{
		return _toCompressStable[value];
	}

	public static void InitializeCompressStableValues()
	{
		for (int i = 0; i <= 65535; i++)
		{
			_toCompressStable[i] = ((ushort)i).GetCompressStable();
		}
	}

	public static bool IsCompressStableValuesInitialized()
	{
		return _toCompressStable[32768] != 0;
	}

	public static void WriteSaveablePrefab(this UdpPacket packet, ISaveablePrefab value)
	{
		if (value == null)
		{
			packet.WriteBool(value: false);
			packet.WriteMiniGuid(default);
		}
		else if (value.IsMultiplayerEntity)
		{
			packet.WriteBool(value: true);
			packet.WriteULong(value.Entity.NetworkId.PackedValue);
		}
		else
		{
			packet.WriteBool(value: false);
			packet.WriteMiniGuid(value.ReferenceId);
		}
	}

	public static void WriteRigidbody(this UdpPacket packet, Rigidbody rigidbody)
	{
		ISaveablePrefab saveablePrefab = (((object)rigidbody != null) ? rigidbody.transform.GetInParent<ISaveablePrefab>() : null);
		if (null == rigidbody || saveablePrefab == null)
		{
			packet.WriteSaveablePrefab(null);
			packet.WriteByte(0);
		}
		else
		{
			packet.WriteSaveablePrefab(saveablePrefab);
			packet.WriteByte((byte)(saveablePrefab.GetRigidbodyId(rigidbody) + 1));
		}
	}

	public static void WriteCollider(this UdpPacket packet, Collider collider)
	{
		if (null == collider)
		{
			packet.WriteBool(value: true);
			packet.WriteByte(0);
			return;
		}
		if (collider is TerrainCollider)
		{
			packet.WriteBool(value: true);
			packet.WriteByte((byte)(Beam.Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.GetZoneId(collider.transform.GetComponentInParent<Zone>()) + 1));
			return;
		}
		ISaveablePrefab inParent = collider.transform.GetInParent<ISaveablePrefab>();
		if (inParent == null)
		{
			packet.WriteBool(value: true);
			packet.WriteByte(0);
		}
		else
		{
			packet.WriteBool(value: false);
			packet.WriteSaveablePrefab(inParent);
			packet.WriteByte((byte)(inParent.GetColliderId(collider) + 1));
		}
	}

	public static float XZSqr(this Vector3 v)
	{
		return v.x * v.x + v.z * v.z;
	}

				try
				{
					BoltNetwork.Destroy(_gameObject);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					LogError("Error while delay destroying multiplayer game object: " + ex.Message + "\n" + ex.StackTrace);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public static float GetRoundTrip()
	{
		using (IEnumerator<BoltConnection> enumerator = BoltNetwork.Connections.GetEnumerator())
		{
			if (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				return enumerator.Current.PingAliased;
			}
		}
		return 0f;
	}

	public static void ConnectToLocal(Action onSuccess = null)
	{
		ConnectToCloud(0, onSuccess);
	}

	public static void ConnectToCloud(int cloudRegionIndex = 0, Action onSuccess = null, Action<string> onError = null)
	{
		string text = Game.Mode.ToString();
		CloudRegion cloudRegion = (CloudRegion)cloudRegionIndex;
		Log("Connect " + text + " Region " + cloudRegion);
		if (BoltNetwork.IsRunning)
		{
			LogError("Bolt still running - shutting down");
			BoltNetwork.ShutdownImmediate();
			BeamTiming.WaitAnd(3f, () =>
			{
				ConnectTo(cloudRegionIndex, onSuccess, onError);
			});
		}
		else
		{
			ConnectTo(cloudRegionIndex, onSuccess, onError);
		}
	}

	private static void ConnectTo(int cloudRegionIndex = 0, Action onSuccess = null, Action<string> onError = null)
	{
		if (BoltNetwork.IsRunning)
		{
			throw new Exception($"Bolt: Unable to start game mode {Game.Mode.ToString()} IsRunning {BoltNetwork.IsRunning} IsServer {BoltNetwork.IsServer} IsClient {BoltNetwork.IsClient} IsSinglePlayer {BoltNetwork.IsSinglePlayer}");
		}
		string text = Game.Mode.ToString();
		CloudRegion cloudRegion = (CloudRegion)cloudRegionIndex;
		Log("Connect " + text + " Region " + cloudRegion);
		DisconnectPayload = new DisconnectPayLoad();
		_instance._shutdownDisconnectInProgress = false;
		_instance._onSuccess = onSuccess;
		_instance._onError = onError;
		PhotonPlatformConfig photonPlatformConfig = DefaultPhotonPlatformConfig.Copy();
		photonPlatformConfig.Region = PhotonRegion.GetRegion((PhotonRegion.Regions)cloudRegionIndex);
		BoltLauncher.SetUdpPlatform(new PhotonPlatform(photonPlatformConfig));
		BoltConfig configCopy = BoltRuntimeSettings.instance.GetConfigCopy();
		configCopy.disableAutoSceneLoading = true;
		configCopy.serverConnectionAcceptMode = BoltConnectionAcceptMode.Manual;
		switch (Game.Mode)
		{
		case GameMode.SinglePlayer:
		case GameMode.Coop_2:
		case GameMode.Coop_3:
		case GameMode.Coop_4:
			BoltLauncher.StartSinglePlayer(configCopy);
			break;
		case GameMode.Coop_Server:
			BoltLauncher.StartServer(configCopy);
			break;
		case GameMode.Coop_Client:
			BoltLauncher.StartClient(configCopy);
			break;
		}
	}

	public override void BoltStartBegin()
	{
		BoltRuntimeSettings.instance.overrideTimeScale = Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer();
		_zoneStreamChannel = BoltNetwork.CreateStreamChannel("zone", UdpChannelMode.Reliable, 1);
		_worldStreamChannel = BoltNetwork.CreateStreamChannel("world", UdpChannelMode.Reliable, 1);
		MultiplayerTokens.Register();
	}

	public override void BoltStartDone()
	{
		Log("BoltStartDone");
		_prefabPool = new MultiplayerPrefabPool(_receivedEntities);
		BoltNetwork.SetPrefabPool(_prefabPool);
		if (!Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
		{
			PlayerRegistry.CreateLocalPeers();
		}
		PostSuccess();
	}

	public override void BoltStartFailed(UdpConnectionDisconnectReason disconnectReason)
	{
		LogError("BoltStartFailed" + disconnectReason);
		PostError(disconnectReason.ToString());
	}

	public static void ConnectToSession(string sessionId = null, MultiplayerTokens.Session token = null, Action onSuccess = null, Action<string> onError = null)
	{
		if (!Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
		{
			onSuccess?.Invoke();
			return;
		}
		sessionId = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(sessionId) ? DEFAULT_SESSION_ID : sessionId);
		token = token ?? new MultiplayerTokens.Session
		{
			SessionId = sessionId,
			RegionIndex = GetCloudRegionIndex(),
			Name = sessionId,
			IsPrivate = true,
			HasUgc = true
		};
		_instance._onSuccess = onSuccess;
		_instance._onError = onError;
		if (Game.Mode.IsServer())
		{
			BoltMatchmaking.CreateSession(sessionId, token);
		}
		else
		{
			_instance._sessionToJoin = sessionId;
		}
	}

	public override void SessionCreatedOrUpdated(UdpSession session)
	{
		Log("Server connected to " + session.HostName);
		PlayerRegistry.CreateLocalPeers();
		PostSuccess();
	}

	public override void SessionCreationFailed(UdpSession session, UdpSessionError errorReason)
	{
		LogError("SessionCreationFailed");
		PostError(errorReason.ToString());
	}

	public override void SessionListUpdated(Map<Guid, UdpSession> sessionList)
	{
		Log($"SessionListUpdated {sessionList?.Count ?? 0}");
		if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_sessionToJoin))
		{
			return;
		}
		foreach (KeyValuePair<Guid, UdpSession> session in sessionList)
		{
			MultiplayerTokens.Session token = session.Value.GetToken();
			if (token != null && _sessionToJoin.Equals(token.Name))
			{
				BoltMatchmaking.JoinSession(_sessionToJoin, JoinToken);
				_sessionToJoin = null;
				break;
			}
		}
	}

	public override void SessionConnected(UdpSession session, IProtocolToken token)
	{
		Log("SessionConnected");
		PlayerRegistry.CreateLocalPeers();
		PostSuccess();
	}

	public override void SessionConnectFailed(UdpSession session, IProtocolToken token, UdpSessionError errorReason)
	{
		LogError("SessionConnectFailed");
		PostError(errorReason.ToString());
	}

	public static void BlockCurrentClientId()
	{
		if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_connectedClientId) && !_blockedClientList.Contains(_connectedClientId))
		{
			_blockedClientList.Add(_connectedClientId);
		}
	}

	public static void BlockCurrentClientId(string requestClientId)
	{
		if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(requestClientId) && !_blockedClientList.Contains(requestClientId))
		{
			_blockedClientList.Add(requestClientId);
		}
	}

	public static void ClearBlockedClientList()
	{
		_blockedClientList.Clear();
	}

	public static void ListenForSuccesfulClientConnection()
	{
		if (BoltNetwork.IsServer)
		{
			BeamTiming.RunCoroutine(CheckForAvailableEndpoint());
		}
	}

	private static IEnumerator<float> CheckForAvailableEndpoint()
	{
		bool listening = true;
		bool success = false;
		float time = Time.time;
		while (listening && !(Time.time - time > 5f))
		{
			foreach (BoltConnection connection in BoltNetwork.Connections)
			{
				connection.ReceiveData(out var data);
				if (data != null && data[0] == 1)
				{
					listening = false;
					success = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			yield return float.NegativeInfinity;
		}
		if (success)
		{
			yield break;
		}
		LogError("client invalid for connection, disconnecting clients");
		foreach (BoltConnection client in BoltNetwork.Clients)
		{
			client.Disconnect();
		}
	}

	public override void ConnectRequest(UdpEndPoint endpoint, IProtocolToken joinToken)
	{
		Log("ConnectRequest " + joinToken.ToStringSafe());
		if (!Game.Mode.IsServer())
		{
			return;
		}
		MultiplayerTokens.Session token = BoltMatchmaking.CurrentSession.GetToken();
		string id = ((MultiplayerTokens.Join)joinToken).Id;
		string nameClient = ((MultiplayerTokens.Join)joinToken).Name;
		if (Game.State.IsGame())
		{
			if (token == null || !token.IsJoinable() || _blockedClientList.Contains(id) || IsClientOnWaitTime(id))
			{
				if (_permisionPrompt.gameObject.activeSelf)
				{
					_permisionPrompt.Hide();
				}
				BoltNetwork.Refuse(endpoint);
			}
			else
			{
				_permisionPrompt.endpoint = endpoint;
				_permisionPrompt.joinToken = joinToken;
				_permisionPrompt.Show(nameClient, id);
			}
		}
		else if (token == null || !token.IsJoinable() || _blockedClientList.Contains(id))
		{
			BoltNetwork.Refuse(endpoint);
		}
		else
		{
			_connectedClientId = id;
			BoltNetwork.Accept(endpoint, new MultiplayerTokens.Accept
			{
				ServerGameState = Game.State
			});
		}
	}

	public static void UpdateClientOnHold(string requestClientId)
	{
		if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(requestClientId))
		{
			return;
		}
		if (_clientsOnHold.TryGetValue(requestClientId, out var value))
		{
			value.Requests++;
			value.LastRequestTime = Time.unscaledTime;
			_clientsOnHold[requestClientId] = value;
			if (value.Requests > 3)
			{
				BlockCurrentClientId(requestClientId);
				RemoveClientOnHold(requestClientId);
			}
		}
		else
		{
			ClientOnHold value2 = new ClientOnHold(requestClientId);
			_clientsOnHold.Add(requestClientId, value2);
		}
	}

	public static void RemoveClientOnHold(string requestClientId)
	{
		if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(requestClientId) && _clientsOnHold.ContainsKey(requestClientId))
		{
			_clientsOnHold.Remove(requestClientId);
		}
	}

	public static bool IsClientOnWaitTime(string requestClientId)
	{
		if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(requestClientId))
		{
			return false;
		}
		if (_clientsOnHold.TryGetValue(requestClientId, out var value) && Time.unscaledTime - value.LastRequestTime < 30f)
		{
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	public override void Connected(BoltConnection connection)
	{
		Log(string.Format("{0}:: Connection type: {1}, Accept Token: {2}, Connect Token: {3}", "Connected", connection.ConnectionType, connection.AcceptToken, connection.ConnectToken));
		_messageInId = 0;
		_messageOutId = 0;
		_messages.Clear();
		_connectTime = Time.unscaledTime;
		MultiplayerTokens.Accept accept = connection.AcceptToken as MultiplayerTokens.Accept;
		if (BoltNetwork.IsClient && accept == null)
		{
			LogError("Disconnected due to bad token");
			connection.Disconnect();
			return;
		}
		ServerGameState = (BoltNetwork.IsServer ? Game.State : accept.ServerGameState);
		Log($"ServerGameState {ServerGameState}");
		if (!BoltNetwork.IsServer)
		{
			BoltNetwork.Server.SendData(new byte[1] { 1 });
		}
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new PlayerConnectedEvent(BoltNetwork.IsServer ? 1 : 0));
		if (BoltNetwork.IsServer)
		{
			UpdateSessionToken_IsOccupied(isOccupied: true);
		}
	}

	public override void Disconnected(BoltConnection connection)
	{
		if (_shutdownDisconnectInProgress)
		{
			return;
		}
		Log("Disconnected");
		_messageInId = 0;
		_messageOutId = 0;
		_messages.Clear();
		_connectTime = 0f;
		_connectedClientId = null;
		int num = ((BoltNetwork.IsServer && connection != null) ? 1 : 0);
		_shutdownDisconnectInProgress = num == 0 || (BoltNetwork.IsClient && num == 1);
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new PlayerDisconnectedEvent(num, DisconnectPayload));
		if (BoltNetwork.IsServer && num == 1)
		{
			if (Game.State == GameState.LOAD_GAME || Game.State == GameState.NEW_GAME)
			{
				UpdateToken();
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateSessionToken_IsOccupied(isOccupied: false);
			}
		}
	}

	private void UpdateToken()
	{
		try
		{
			MultiplayerTokens.Session token = BoltMatchmaking.CurrentSession.GetToken();
			token.IsOccupied = false;
			Zone zone = StrandedWorld.GetZone(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.transform.position);
			if (zone.Biome == Zone.BiomeType.MISSION && !zone.Equals(Beam.Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.FindEndGameZone()))
			{
				token.IsBusy = true;
			}
			else if (GetSessionToken().IsBusy)
			{
				token.IsBusy = false;
			}
			BoltMatchmaking.UpdateSession(token);
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			LogError("Error updating session token " + ex.Message);
		}
	}

	public override void BoltShutdownBegin(AddCallback registerDoneCallback, UdpConnectionDisconnectReason disconnectReason)
	{
		Log($"BoltShutdownBegin {disconnectReason} isRunning {BoltNetwork.IsRunning}");
		if (BoltNetwork.IsRunning)
		{
			Disconnected(null);
		}
	}

	public static void Shutdown()
	{
		if (BoltNetwork.IsRunning && !_shuttingDown)
		{
			_shuttingDown = true;
			PlayerRegistry.Clear();
			try
			{
				BoltNetwork.ShutdownImmediate();
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			_shuttingDown = false;
		}
	}

	private void PostSuccess()
	{
		Action onSuccess = _onSuccess;
		_onSuccess = null;
		_onError = null;
		onSuccess?.Invoke();
	}

	private void PostError(string reason)
	{
		Action<string> onError = _onError;
		_onSuccess = null;
		_onError = null;
		onError?.Invoke(reason);
	}

	public static IEnumerator<float> FindObject_Sequence<T>(DisconnectDetail disconnectDetail, MiniGuid referenceId, Action<T> onSuccess, Action onTimeout = null, float retryPeriod = 0.5f) where T : ISaveableReference
	{
		T obj = default;
		float startTime = Time.unscaledTime;
		while (obj.IsNullOrDestroyed() && !(Time.unscaledTime > startTime + Peer.DEFAULT_TIMEOUT))
		{
			obj = FindObject<T>(referenceId);
			if (obj.IsNullOrDestroyed())
			{
				yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(retryPeriod);
			}
		}
		if (obj.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			onTimeout?.Invoke();
			PlayerRegistry.LocalPeer.ReplicatedDisconnect(disconnectDetail);
		}
		else
		{
			onSuccess?.Invoke(obj);
		}
	}

	public static int GetLocalPeerId()
	{
		if (!Game.Mode.IsServer())
		{
			return 1;
		}
		return 0;
	}

	public static int GetEntityId(BoltEntity entity)

		{
			return 1;
		}
		return 0;
	}

	public static string GetCloudRegion()
	{
		string value = "NONE";
		if (!BoltNetwork.IsRunning)
		{
			return value;
		}
		try
		{
			Dictionary<string, object> currentMetadata = BoltMatchmaking.CurrentMetadata;
			if (currentMetadata != null)
			{
				currentMetadata.TryGetValue<string>("Region", out value);
			}
		}
		catch (Exception)
		{
		}
		if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
		{
			return value.ToUpper();
		}
		return "NONE";
	}

	public static int GetCloudRegionIndex()
	{
		int result = 0;
		string cloudRegion = GetCloudRegion();
		for (int i = 0; i < BoltRuntimeSettings.photonCloudRegions.Length; i++)
		{
			if (BoltRuntimeSettings.photonCloudRegionsId[i].Equals(cloudRegion.ToLower()))
			{
				result = i;
				break;
			}
		}
		return result;
	}

	private static IEnumerator<SearchContainer> AllSearchContainers()
	{
		if (_instance.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			yield break;
		}
		yield return new SearchContainer(_instance._receivedEntities, includeInactive: true);
		if ((bool)LevelLoader.Instance)
		{
			foreach (Zone loadingZone in LevelLoader.Instance.LoadingZones)
			{
				if (loadingZone.Id != Beam.Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.NmlZone.Id)
				{
					yield return new SearchContainer(loadingZone.SaveContainer);
				}
			}
		}
		Zone[] zones = Beam.Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.Zones;
		foreach (Zone zone in zones)
		{
			if (!LevelLoader.Instance || !LevelLoader.Instance.LoadingZones.Contains(zone))
			{
				yield return new SearchContainer(zone.SaveContainer);
			}
		}
		yield return new SearchContainer(Beam.Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.NmlZone.SaveContainer);
	}

	public static T FindObject<T>(MiniGuid referenceId, bool includeInactive = false) where T : ISaveableReference
	{
		try
		{
			if (referenceId.IsDefault() || _instance.IsNullOrDestroyed())
			{
				return default;
			}
			IEnumerator<SearchContainer> enumerator = AllSearchContainers();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				T val = enumerator.Current.Container.FindObject<T>(referenceId, includeInactive & enumerator.Current.IncludeInactive);
				if (val != null)
				{
					return val;
				}
			}
			foreach (BoltEntity entity in BoltNetwork.Entities)
			{
				if (entity.gameObject.TryGetComponent<T>(out var component) && component.ReferenceId.Equals(referenceId))
				{
					return component;
				}
			}
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			LogError($"Error while finding entity {referenceId}: {ex.Message}\n{ex.StackTrace}");
		}
		return default;
	}

	public static T FindObject<T>(ulong networkId) where T : ISaveableReference
	{
		try
		{
			BoltEntity boltEntity = BoltNetwork.FindEntity(new NetworkId(networkId));
			if (null == boltEntity)
			{
				return default;
			}
			return boltEntity.GetComponent<T>();
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			LogError($"Error while finding entity {networkId}: {ex.Message}\n{ex.StackTrace}");
			return default;
		}
	}

	public void RegisterPrefabs()
	{
		FieldInfo[] fields = typeof(BoltPrefabs).GetFields(BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public);
		FieldInfo[] array = fields;
		foreach (FieldInfo fieldInfo in array)
		{
			_prefabs[fieldInfo.Name] = (PrefabId)fieldInfo.GetValue(null);
		}
		Log($"Multiplayer prefabs {fields.Length}");
		Prefabs.LinkMPPrefabs();
	}

	public static string GetBoltPrefabName(string prefabPath)
	{
		return Path.GetFileName(prefabPath).Split(' ', '-').RemoveEmpty()
			.Join("_");
	}

	public static bool TryGetPrefabName(string prefabPath, out string multiplayerPrefabName)
	{
		multiplayerPrefabName = GetBoltPrefabName(prefabPath);
		PrefabId value;
		return _instance?._prefabs.TryGetValue(multiplayerPrefabName, out value) ?? false;
	}

	public static T Instantiate<T>(PrefabId multiplayerPrefab, IProtocolToken token = null) where T : MonoBehaviour
	{
		return BoltNetwork.Instantiate(multiplayerPrefab, token).GetComponent<T>();
	}

	public static T Instantiate<T>(string prefabPath, MiniGuid referenceId) where T : SaveablePrefab
	{
		if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(prefabPath))
		{
			return null;
		}
		T val = (_instance._prefabs.TryGetValue(GetBoltPrefabName(prefabPath), out var value) ? Instantiate<T>(value, new MultiplayerTokens.SaveablePrefab(referenceId)) : UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(Resources.Load<T>(prefabPath)));
		val.ReferenceId = referenceId;
		return val;
	}

	public static T Instantiate<T>(uint prefabId, MiniGuid referenceId, Transform parent = null) where T : SaveablePrefab
	{
		T val = null;
		if (!_instance.IsNullOrDestroyed() && Prefabs.TryGetMultiplayerPrefabName(prefabId, out var multiplayerPrefabName))
		{
			Log($"Instantiate Bolt Pref for {prefabId} -> {_instance._prefabs[multiplayerPrefabName].Value}", "create/destroy");
			val = Instantiate<T>(_instance._prefabs[multiplayerPrefabName], new MultiplayerTokens.SaveablePrefab(referenceId));
			val.gameObject.transform.parent = parent;
		}
		else
		{
			val = (T)Prefabs.CreatePrefabFromId(prefabId, parent);
		}
		val.ReferenceId = referenceId;
		return val;
	}

	public static T Instantiate<T>(uint prefabId, Vector3 position, Quaternion rotation, MiniGuid referenceId, Transform parent = null) where T : SaveablePrefab
	{
		T val = Instantiate<T>(prefabId, referenceId);
		val.transform.position = position;
		val.transform.rotation = rotation;
		val.gameObject.transform.parent = parent;
		return val;
	}

	public static void DestroyMultiplayerEntity(GameObject gameObject, DestroyDelay destroyDelay = DestroyDelay.SAFE)
	{
		if (gameObject.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			Log($"Destroying {gameObject} - redundant destroy", "create/destroy", "magenta");
			return;
		}
		if (Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer() && destroyDelay != DestroyDelay.NOW)
		{
			_destroyCommands.Add(new BoltDestroyCommand(gameObject, Time.unscaledTime + (float)destroyDelay / 30f));
			gameObject.SetActive(value: false);
			return;
		}
		Log($"Destroying {gameObject} -  no delay", "create/destroy", "magenta");
		try
		{
			BoltNetwork.Destroy(gameObject);
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			LogError("Error while destroying multiplayer game object: " + ex.Message + "\n" + ex.StackTrace);
		}
	}

	public static void Destroy(SaveablePrefab saveablePrefab, DestroyDelay destroyDelay = DestroyDelay.SAFE)
	{
		if (saveablePrefab.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			return;
		}
		if (saveablePrefab.IsMultiplayerEntity)
		{
			if (saveablePrefab.IsOwner)
			{
				DestroyMultiplayerEntity(saveablePrefab.gameObject, destroyDelay);
			}
			else
			{
				saveablePrefab.gameObject.SetActive(value: false);
			}
		}
		else
		{
			BeamTeam.Destroy(saveablePrefab.gameObject);
		}
	}

	private void UpdateDestroyCommands()
	{
		int count = _destroyCommands.Count;
		float unscaledTime = Time.unscaledTime;
		int i = count - 1;
		while (i >= 0)
		{
			_destroyCommands[i].Destroy(unscaledTime, () =>
			{
				_destroyCommands.RemoveAt(i);
			});
			int num = i - 1;
			i = num;
		}
	}

	private void FixedUpdate()
	{
		UpdateDestroyCommands();
		UpdateMessages();
		if (BoltNetwork.IsServer && !BoltNetwork.IsSinglePlayer)
		{
			UpdateSessionOccupied();
		}
	}

	private void UpdateSessionOccupied()
	{
		if (PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers.Count != 0 && Math.Abs(Time.unscaledTime - _sessionOccupiedLastUpdateTime) > 3f)
		{
			bool flag = PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers.Count == 2;
			if (flag != GetSessionToken().IsOccupied)
			{
				UpdateSessionToken_IsOccupied(flag);
			}
			_sessionOccupiedLastUpdateTime = Time.unscaledTime;
		}
	}

	public static void AddListener<T>(Listener<T> listener) where T : Photon.Bolt.Event
	{
		if (_instance._internalListeners.TryGetValue(listener, out var _))
		{
			LogError("Listener for " + typeof(T).Name + " already added");
			return;
		}
		Listener listener2 = (Photon.Bolt.Event e) =>
		{
			listener((T)e);
		};
		_instance._internalListeners[listener] = listener2;
		Type typeFromHandle = typeof(T);
		_instance._listeners.TryGetValue(typeFromHandle, out var value2);
		value2 = (Listener)Delegate.Combine(value2, listener2);
		_instance._listeners[typeFromHandle] = value2;
	}

	public static void RemoveListener<T>(Listener<T> listener) where T : Photon.Bolt.Event
	{
		if (!_instance.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(T);
			if (_instance._internalListeners.TryGetValue(listener, out var value) && _instance._listeners.TryGetValue(typeFromHandle, out var value2))
			{
				value2 = (Listener)Delegate.Remove(value2, value);
				_instance._listeners[typeFromHandle] = value2;
				_instance._internalListeners.Remove(listener);
			}
		}
	}
