	public override void OnEvent(MessageGlobalEvent evnt)
	{
		if (!evnt.FromSelf)
		{
			MultiplayerMessage multiplayerMessage = ((MultiplayerTokens.MessageEnvelope)evnt.Envelope).Get<MultiplayerMessage>();
			multiplayerMessage.ReceivedTime = Time.unscaledTime;
			multiplayerMessage.Ping = ((evnt.RaisedBy == null) ? 0f : evnt.RaisedBy.PingAliased);
			if (BoltNetwork.IsClient && Math.Abs(Time.unscaledTime - _connectTime) < 0.5f && multiplayerMessage.Id > 50)
			{
				Log($"Reject message {multiplayerMessage.GetType().Name} with ID {multiplayerMessage.Id} as it looks as a message posted before the connection was made");
				return;
			}
			Log($"Received message {multiplayerMessage.GetType().Name} with index {multiplayerMessage.Id}");
			_messages.Add(multiplayerMessage);
		}
	}

	public override void OnEvent(I_MessageGlobalEvent evnt)
	{
		if (!evnt.FromSelf)
		{
			I_MultiplayerMessage i_MultiplayerMessage = ((MultiplayerTokens.MessageEnvelope)evnt.Envelope).Get<I_MultiplayerMessage>();
			i_MultiplayerMessage.SetTransportEntity(evnt.Instantiated);
			i_MultiplayerMessage.ReceivedTime = Time.unscaledTime;
			i_MultiplayerMessage.Ping = ((evnt.RaisedBy == null) ? 0f : evnt.RaisedBy.PingAliased);
			if (BoltNetwork.IsClient && Math.Abs(Time.unscaledTime - _connectTime) < 0.5f && i_MultiplayerMessage.Id > 50)
			{
				Log($"Reject message {i_MultiplayerMessage.GetType().Name} with ID {i_MultiplayerMessage.Id} as it looks as a message posted before the connection was made");
				return;
			}
			Log($"Received message  {i_MultiplayerMessage.GetType().Name} with index {i_MultiplayerMessage.Id}");
			_messages.Add(i_MultiplayerMessage);
		}
	}

	private void UpdateMessages()
	{
		bool flag = _messages.Count != 0;
		while (flag)
		{
			int messageIndex = GetMessageIndex(_messageInId, out var oldestMessageTime);
			if (messageIndex != -1)
			{
				MultiplayerMessage multiplayerMessage = _messages[messageIndex];
				_messages.RemoveAt(messageIndex);
				_messageInId++;
				multiplayerMessage.Log("Executing " + multiplayerMessage.ToString());
				try
				{
					multiplayerMessage.OnPeer();
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					LogError("Error executing " + multiplayerMessage.ToString() + " " + ex.Message + "\n" + ex.StackTrace);
				}
				flag = _messages.Count != 0;
			}
			else
			{
				flag = false;
				if (Time.unscaledTime - oldestMessageTime > Peer.DEFAULT_TIMEOUT)
				{
					PlayerRegistry.LocalPeer.ReplicatedDisconnect(DisconnectDetail.Timeout_Messages, null, forceLocalShutdown: true);
				}
			}
		}
		if (_messages.Count != 0)
		{
			Log($"Queued {_messages.Count} with cursor {_messageInId}", "messages");
		}
	}

	private int GetMessageIndex(ushort id, out float oldestMessageTime)
	{
		oldestMessageTime = float.MaxValue;
		int count = _messages.Count;
		for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
		{
			MultiplayerMessage multiplayerMessage = _messages[i];
			if (multiplayerMessage.Id == id)
			{
				oldestMessageTime = multiplayerMessage.ReceivedTime;
				return i;
			}
			if (multiplayerMessage.ReceivedTime < oldestMessageTime)
			{
				oldestMessageTime = multiplayerMessage.ReceivedTime;
			}
		}
		return -1;
	}

	private static void SendGlobalEvent_Core(Photon.Bolt.Event evnt)
	{
		Log($"Send global event {evnt}", "messages");
		evnt.Send();
	}

	private void OnGlobalEventReceived_Core<T>(T evnt) where T : Photon.Bolt.Event
	{
		Log($"Received global event {evnt}", "messages");
		Type typeFromHandle = typeof(T);
		if (_listeners.TryGetValue(typeFromHandle, out var value))
		{
			value?.Invoke(evnt);
		}
	}

	{
		if (_instance != null)
		{
			UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(gameObject);
			return;
		}
		_instance = this;
		UnityEngine.Object.DontDestroyOnLoad(gameObject);
		RegisterPrefabs();
		MultiplayerFence.Register();
		MultiplayerMessageManager.Register();
		SaveManager.BeforeWrite += UpdateSessionToken_BeforeWriteSave;
	}

	{
		Log("Shuting down connection");
		_joinToken = null;
		foreach (BoltDestroyCommand destroyCommand in _destroyCommands)
		{
			destroyCommand.Destroy(Time.frameCount, null, force: true);
		}
		_destroyCommands.Clear();
		if (_instance == this)
		{
			_instance = null;
		}
		SaveManager.BeforeWrite -= UpdateSessionToken_BeforeWriteSave;
	}

	public static void UpdateSessionToken_Player(JObject data)
	{
		if (!BoltNetwork.IsServer || data.IsNullOrDestroyed() || data.IsNull() || BoltMatchmaking.CurrentSession.IsNullOrDestroyed() || BoltMatchmaking.CurrentSession.GetToken().IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{

			JObject field = data.GetField("Persistent").GetField(typeof(GameTime).Name);
			if ((bool)field)
			{
				JObject field2 = field.GetField("SessionDuration");
				if (field2 != null)
				{
					token.TimePlayed = Mathf.FloorToInt(field2.GetValue<float>());
				}
			}
			Stats totalStats = GAccountService.Get().LocalUser.UserStats.TotalStats;
			token.DaysSurvived = totalStats.DaysSurvived;
			token.IslandsHopped = totalStats.IslandsHopped;
			token.IslandsExplored = totalStats.IslandsExplored;
			token.FishFished = totalStats.FishFished;
			token.EnemiesKilled = totalStats.AnimalsKilled;
			token.ItemsCrafted = totalStats.ItemsCrafted;
			token.ShipsScavenged = totalStats.ShipsScavenged;
			token.AnimalsTrapped = totalStats.AnimalsTrapped;
			BoltMatchmaking.UpdateSession(token);
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			LogError("Error updating session token " + ex.Message);
		}
	}

	private static string GetTimeStampCosmeticText(string value, string color = "yellow")
	{
		float unscaledTime = Time.unscaledTime;
		float num = Mathf.Floor(unscaledTime);
		double num2 = Math.Floor((unscaledTime - num) * 1000f);
		return $"[{num}:{num2:0.###}] {value}";
	}

	private static string GetCosmeticText(string value, string color = "yellow")
	{
		string[] array = GetTimeStampCosmeticText(value).Split(new char[1] { '\n' });
		string text = "";
		for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
		{
			string text2 = array[i];
			text = ((i != 0) ? (text + "\n<color=" + color + ">" + text2 + "</color>") : (text + "<color=" + color + ">" + text2 + "</color>"));
		}
		return text;
	}

				ReplicateParam replicateParam = new ReplicateParam();
				replicateParam.Peer = this;
				replicateParam.Param = param;
				replicateParam.Value = value;
				replicateParam.Post();
			}
		}
	}

	private string Get(StringParams param)
	{
		if (param == StringParams.OnlineName)
		{
			return _onlineName;
		}
		return "";
	}

	private void Set(StringParams param, string value, bool replicate, bool bidirectionalReplication)
	{
		if (!string.Equals(value, Get(param)))
		{
			if (param == StringParams.OnlineName)
			{
				_onlineName = value;
			}
			if ((Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer() & replicate) && (bidirectionalReplication || entity.IsOwner))
			{
				ReplicateStringParam replicateStringParam = new ReplicateStringParam();
				replicateStringParam.Peer = this;
				replicateStringParam.Param = param;
				replicateStringParam.Value = value;
				replicateStringParam.Post();
			}
		}
	}

	public EGameGenderMode GetGenderById(int id)
	{
		return id switch
		{
			0 => Gender, 
			1 => Gender2, 
			_ => (EGameGenderMode)(id % 2), 
		};
	}

	public override void Attached()
	{
		base.Attached();
		_id = MultiplayerMng.GetEntityId(entity);
		gameObject.name = $"Peer {_id}";
		PlayerRegistry.Link(this);
		StayAlive(_aliveId);
		if (entity.IsOwner)
		{
			_gender = Options.CustomSettings.Gender;
			_gender2 = Options.CustomSettings.Gender2;
			_gameDifficulty = Options.CustomSettings.Difficulty;
			_permadeath = Options.CustomSettings.Permadeath;
			_wildlife = Options.CustomSettings.Wildlife;
			_gameStartingCrate = Options.CustomSettings.StartingCrate;
			_worldSeed = StrandedWorld.LOCAL_WORLD_SEED;
			_onlineName = GAccountService.Get().LocalUser.UserInfo.DisplayName;
		}
		else
		{
			ReplicateAllParams replicateAllParams = new ReplicateAllParams();
			replicateAllParams.Peer = this;
			replicateAllParams.Post();
		}
	}

	public override void Detached()
	{
		base.Detached();
		PlayerRegistry.Unlink(this);
	}

	private void OnDestroy()
	{
		PlayerRegistry.Unlink(this);
	}

	private void Update()
	{
		UpdateStayAlive();
	}

	private void UpdateStayAlive()
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer() && _id != 0)
		{
			if (entity.IsOwner && Time.unscaledTime - _lastSentTime > ALIVE_INTERVAL)
			{
				_lastSentTime = Time.unscaledTime;
				StayAliveMessage stayAliveMessage = new StayAliveMessage();
				stayAliveMessage.PeerId = (byte)Id;
				stayAliveMessage.AliveId = ++_aliveId;
				stayAliveMessage.Post();
			}
			if (IsTimeout)
			{
				this.ReplicatedDisconnect(DisconnectDetail.Timeout_StayAlive);
			}
		}
	}

	private void StayAlive(int aliveId)
	{
		_aliveTime = Time.unscaledTime;
		if (aliveId > _aliveId)
		{
			_aliveId = aliveId;
			StayAliveMessage stayAliveMessage = new StayAliveMessage();
			stayAliveMessage.PeerId = (byte)Id;
			stayAliveMessage.AliveId = aliveId;
			stayAliveMessage.Post();
		}
	}

	public static float GetDefaultTimeout()
	{
		return DEFAULT_TIMEOUT;
	}

	public static float GetSessionTimeout()
	{
		return (float)BoltRuntimeSettings.instance.GetConfigCopy().connectionTimeout / 1000f;
	}

	public float SetTimeout_Async(float timeout)
	{
		return Timing.WaitUntilDone(Timing.RunCoroutine(SetTimout_Sequence(timeout)));
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> SetTimout_Sequence(float timeout)
	{
		_ = _timeout;
		_ = timeout;
		ReplicatedSetTimeout(timeout);
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(1f);
	}

	public void SetTimeout(float timeout)
	{
		if (_timeout != timeout)
		{
			ReplicatedSetTimeout(timeout);
		}
	}

	private void SetTimeout_Core(float timeout)
	{
		_timeout = timeout;
		StayAlive(_aliveId);
	}

	private void ReplicatedSetTimeout(float timeout)
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
		{
			ReplicateSetTimeout replicateSetTimeout = new ReplicateSetTimeout();
			replicateSetTimeout.PeerId = (byte)Id;
			replicateSetTimeout.TimeOut = timeout;
			replicateSetTimeout.Post();
		}
		SetTimeout_Core(timeout);
	}
}

	public static bool SetObliqueFocusProjectionMatrix(bool p_isObliqueProjectionEnabled)
	{
		if (LE_GUIInterface.Instance.delegates.GetObliqueCameraPerspectiveRightPixelOffset != null)
		{
			if (p_isObliqueProjectionEnabled)
			{
				Camera.main.ResetProjectionMatrix();
				Matrix4x4 projectionMatrix = Camera.main.projectionMatrix;
				projectionMatrix[0, 2] = LE_GUIInterface.Instance.delegates.GetObliqueCameraPerspectiveRightPixelOffset() / (float)Screen.width;
				Camera.main.projectionMatrix = projectionMatrix;
			}
			else
			{
				Camera.main.ResetProjectionMatrix();
			}
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	void LE_IInputHandler.MoveCamera(Vector3 p_fromScreenCoords, Vector3 p_toScreenCoords, bool scrolling = false)
	{
		if (!IS_CAMERA_MOVEMENT)
		{
			return;
		}
		Camera cam = Cam;
		if ((!scrolling || !IsMouseOverGUI()) && cam != null)
		{
			float num = EstimateDistanceToLevel(EEstimateDistanceMode.AVERAGE);
			Vector3 direction = p_toScreenCoords - p_fromScreenCoords;
			direction = cam.transform.TransformDirection(direction);
			Vector3 vector;
			if (cam.orthographic)
			{
				float num2 = Vector3.Dot(direction, cam.transform.forward);
				direction -= cam.transform.forward * num2;
				cam.orthographicSize = Mathf.Clamp(cam.orthographicSize - num2 * (cam.orthographicSize / (float)Screen.width), 5f, 1000f);
				vector = direction * (cam.orthographicSize / (float)Screen.width);
			}
			else
			{
				vector = direction * (num / (float)Screen.width);
			}
			cam.transform.position += vector;
			cam.transform.position = new Vector3(Mathf.Clamp(cam.transform.position.x, -300f, 300f), Mathf.Clamp(cam.transform.position.y, -100f, 150f), Mathf.Clamp(cam.transform.position.z, -300f, 300f));
		}
	}

	void LE_IInputHandler.RotateCamera(Vector3 p_fromScreenCoords, Vector3 p_toScreenCoords)
	{
		if (!IS_CAMERA_MOVEMENT)
		{
			return;
		}
		Camera cam = Cam;
		if (cam != null)
		{
			Ray ray = cam.ScreenPointToRay(p_fromScreenCoords);
			Ray ray2 = cam.ScreenPointToRay(p_toScreenCoords);
			if (cam.orthographic)
			{
				ray.direction = (ray.origin + ray.direction * 100f - cam.transform.position).normalized;
				ray2.direction = (ray2.origin + ray2.direction * 100f - cam.transform.position).normalized;
			}
			float num = Vector3.Angle(ray.direction, ray2.direction);
			Vector3 normalized = Vector3.Cross(ray.direction, ray2.direction).normalized;
			float num2 = Mathf.Abs(cam.transform.forward.y);
			if (num2 > 0.9f)
			{
				num2 = (1f - num2) / 0.100000024f;
				num2 *= num2;
				float num3 = Vector3.Dot(normalized, cam.transform.right);
				normalized -= (1f - num2) * (normalized - num3 * cam.transform.right);
			}
			cam.transform.Rotate(normalized, 0f - num, Space.World);
			if (cam.transform.up.y > 0f)
			{
				cam.transform.LookAt(cam.transform.position + cam.transform.forward, Vector3.up);
			}
			else
			{
				cam.transform.LookAt(cam.transform.position + cam.transform.forward, Vector3.down);
			}
		}
	}

	void LE_IInputHandler.RotateCameraAroundPivot(Vector3 p_fromScreenCoords, Vector3 p_toScreenCoords)
	{
		if (!IS_CAMERA_MOVEMENT)
		{
			return;
		}
		Camera cam = Cam;
		if (cam != null)
		{
			Vector2 vector = new Vector2(p_toScreenCoords.x, p_toScreenCoords.y) - new Vector2(p_fromScreenCoords.x, p_fromScreenCoords.y);
			vector.x /= Screen.width;
			vector.y /= Screen.height;
			cam.transform.RotateAround(m_camPivot, cam.transform.right, vector.y * 300f);
			cam.transform.RotateAround(m_camPivot, cam.transform.up, (0f - vector.x) * 300f);
			if (cam.transform.up.y > 0f)
			{
				cam.transform.LookAt(m_camPivot, Vector3.up);
			}
			else
			{
				cam.transform.LookAt(m_camPivot, Vector3.down);
			}
		}
	}

	private void Start()
	{
		if (LE_GUIInterface.Instance == null)
		{
			Debug.LogError("LE_LevelEditorMain: a LE_GUIInterface object must be added to the scene!");
		}
		LE_ConfigTerrain lE_ConfigTerrain = GetComponentInChildren<LE_ConfigTerrain>();
		if (lE_ConfigTerrain == null)
		{
			Debug.LogError("LE_LevelEditorMain: a LE_ConfigTerrain component must be added to the game object with the LE_LevelEditorMain script!");
			lE_ConfigTerrain = gameObject.AddComponent<LE_ConfigTerrain>();
		}
		if (!IS_TERRAIN_EDITOR)
		{
			if (lE_ConfigTerrain.Brushes.Length != 0)
			{
				Debug.LogWarning("LE_LevelEditorMain: IS_TERRAIN_EDITOR is set to 'false', but you have provided a non empty array for LE_ConfigTerrain.Brushes! This is performance waist and will increase loading time! Remove brushes or reenable terrain editing.");
			}
			if (lE_ConfigTerrain.BrushProjector != null)
			{
				Debug.LogWarning("LE_LevelEditorMain: IS_TERRAIN_EDITOR is set to 'false', but you have provided a value for LE_ConfigTerrain.BrushProjector! This is performance waist and will increase loading time! Remove brush projector from scene or reenable terrain editing.");
			}
		}
		Camera cam = Cam;
		if (cam == null)
		{
			Debug.LogError("LE_LevelEditorMain: Start: could not find main camera!");
		}
		if (IS_OBJECT_EDITOR)
		{
			m_GUI3dObject = gameObject.AddComponent<LE_GUI3dObject>();
			m_GUI3dObject.TERRAIN_LAYER = 14;
			LE_GUI3dObject gUI3dObject = m_GUI3dObject;
			gUI3dObject.OnFocused = (Action<Vector3, float>)Delegate.Combine(gUI3dObject.OnFocused, new Action<Vector3, float>(OnGUI3dObjectFocused));
			m_GUI3dObject.IsKeyComboFocus = (ACTIVE_KEY_COMBOS & LE_EKeyCombo.FOCUS) != 0;
			m_GUI3dObject.IsKeyComboDuplicate = (ACTIVE_KEY_COMBOS & LE_EKeyCombo.DUPLICATE) != 0;
			m_GUI3d.Add(m_GUI3dObject);
		}
		m_input = new LE_Input(this);
		m_camPivot = cam.transform.position + cam.transform.forward * 100f;
		LE_EventInterface.OnChangeLevelData = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(LE_EventInterface.OnChangeLevelData, new EventHandler(OnChangeLevelData));
		LE_GUIInterface.EventHandlers events = LE_GUIInterface.Instance.events;
		events.OnEditModeBtn = (EventHandler<LE_GUIInterface.EventHandlers.EditModeEventArgs>)Delegate.Combine(events.OnEditModeBtn, new EventHandler<LE_GUIInterface.EventHandlers.EditModeEventArgs>(OnEditModeBtn));
		MAP_EDITOR_SEED = StrandedWorld.GetRandowWorldSeed();
	}

	private void Initialize_InFirstUpdate()
	{
		Camera cam = Cam;
		LE_ConfigTerrain componentInChildren = GetComponentInChildren<LE_ConfigTerrain>();
		if (LE_GUIInterface.Instance.delegates.IsCursorOverUI == null)
		{
			Debug.LogError("LE_LevelEditorMain: you have not setup LE_GUIInterface.delegates.IsCursorOverUI. Terrain might be edited behind UI while the user interacts with the UI, same is true for object placement!");
		}
		if (IS_TERRAIN_EDITOR)
		{
			m_GUI3dTerrain = gameObject.AddComponent<LE_GUI3dTerrain>();

			m_logic.Add(m_logicTerrain);
		}
		else if (componentInChildren.CustomDefaultTerrain != null)
		{
			Debug.LogWarning("LE_LevelEditorMain: IS_TERRAIN_EDITOR is set to 'false', but you have provided a value for LE_ConfigTerrain.CustomDefaultTerrain! The value will be ignored!");
		}
		m_logicLevel = new LE_LogicLevel(m_GUI3dTerrain, m_GUI3dObject, IS_OBLIQUE_FOCUS_CENTERING);
		m_logic.Add(m_logicLevel);
		if (IS_OBJECT_EDITOR)

			if (ROOT_OBJECT_MAP == null)
			{
				InitializeObjects();
			}
			m_LogicObjects = new LE_LogicObjects(m_GUI3dObject, ROOT_OBJECT_MAP);
			m_logic.Add(m_LogicObjects);
		}
		if (cam != null && IS_WITH_CAMERA_PERSPECTIVE_GIZMO)
		{
			if (LE_GUIInterface.Instance.delegates.GetCameraPerspectiveGizmoRightPixelOffset != null)
			{
				float num = 0.2f * (float)Screen.width / cam.aspect;
				float height = 0.2f * (float)Screen.height;
				m_perspectiveGizmoRect = new Rect((float)Screen.width - LE_GUIInterface.Instance.delegates.GetCameraPerspectiveGizmoRightPixelOffset() - num, 0f, num, height);
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(LayerMask.LayerToName(CAMERA_PERSPECTIVE_GIZMO_LAYER)))
				{
					Debug.LogWarning("LE_LevelEditorMain: Inspector property 'CAMERA_PERSPECTIVE_GIZMO_LAYER' is set to '" + CAMERA_PERSPECTIVE_GIZMO_LAYER + "', but this layer has no name in 'Tags & Layers' set. Please set the name of this layer to 'CameraPerspectiveGizmo' or change the value of the 'CAMERA_PERSPECTIVE_GIZMO_LAYER' property! To open the 'Tags & Layers' manager select any game object, in the inspector click on the layer drop down at top right then click on 'Add Layer...'.");
				}
				else if (LayerMask.LayerToName(CAMERA_PERSPECTIVE_GIZMO_LAYER) != "CameraPerspectiveGizmo")
				{
					Debug.LogWarning("LE_LevelEditorMain: Inspector property 'CAMERA_PERSPECTIVE_GIZMO_LAYER' is set to '" + CAMERA_PERSPECTIVE_GIZMO_LAYER + "', but the name of this layer is '" + LayerMask.LayerToName(CAMERA_PERSPECTIVE_GIZMO_LAYER) + "'. Is this intended? If not please set the name of this layer to 'CameraPerspectiveGizmo' or change the value of the 'CAMERA_PERSPECTIVE_GIZMO_LAYER' property! To open the 'Tags & Layers' manager select any game object, in the inspector click on the layer drop down at top right then click on 'Add Layer...'.");
				}
				m_cameraPerspectiveGizmo = CPG_CameraPerspectiveGizmo.Create(cam, CAMERA_PERSPECTIVE_GIZMO_LAYER);
				if (m_cameraPerspectiveGizmo != null)
				{
					m_cameraPerspectiveGizmo.transform.position = Vector3.down * -10000f;
					m_cameraPerspectiveGizmo.OrthoOffset = cam.farClipPlane * 0.2f;
					cam.cullingMask &= ~(1 << CAMERA_PERSPECTIVE_GIZMO_LAYER);
					m_cameraPerspectiveGizmo.RelativeScreenSize = 0.2f;
					float num2 = LE_GUIInterface.Instance.delegates.GetCameraPerspectiveGizmoRightPixelOffset() / (float)Screen.width;
					m_cameraPerspectiveGizmo.RelativeScreenPos = new Vector2(1f - 0.1f / cam.aspect - num2, 0.9f);
					CPG_CameraPerspectiveGizmo cameraPerspectiveGizmo = m_cameraPerspectiveGizmo;
					cameraPerspectiveGizmo.m_onBeforeSwitchToOrthographic = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(cameraPerspectiveGizmo.m_onBeforeSwitchToOrthographic, new EventHandler(OnCameraPerspectiveSwitchToOrthographic));
					CPG_CameraPerspectiveGizmo cameraPerspectiveGizmo2 = m_cameraPerspectiveGizmo;
					cameraPerspectiveGizmo2.m_onAfterSwitchToPerspective = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(cameraPerspectiveGizmo2.m_onAfterSwitchToPerspective, new EventHandler(OnCameraPerspectiveSwitchToPerspective));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				Debug.LogError("LE_LevelEditorMain: LE_GUIInterface.delegates.GetCameraPerspectiveGizmoRightPixelOffset was not set from the UI scripts! The camera perspective gizmo cannot be placed to the right screen position! To set this delegate use 'LE_GUIInterface.Instance.delegates.GetCameraPerspectiveGizmoRightPixelOffset = ...' in one of the Start functions of your scripts!");
			}
		}
		if (IS_OBLIQUE_FOCUS_CENTERING && !SetObliqueFocusProjectionMatrix(p_isObliqueProjectionEnabled: true))
		{
			Debug.LogError("LE_LevelEditorMain: IS_OBLIQUE_FOCUS_CENTERING is true, but you have not provided the LE_GUIInterface.delegates.GetObliqueCameraPerspectiveRightPixelOffset delegate! Provide it to bring focused objects in the center of the visible (not covered by UI) screen area!");
		}
	}

	public void InitializeObjects()
	{
		Debug.Log("LevelEditorMain:: Initializing Editor Objects");
		List<LE_ObjectMap> list = new List<LE_ObjectMap>();
		foreach (LE_Object.Categories value in Enum.GetValues(typeof(LE_Object.Categories)))
		{
			if (value != LE_Object.Categories.NONE)
			{
				LE_ObjectMap lE_ObjectMap = new LE_ObjectMap();
				lE_ObjectMap.CategoryName = value.GetAttribute<DescriptionAttribute>().Text;
				lE_ObjectMap.ObjectPrefabs = new List<LE_Object>();
				list.Add(lE_ObjectMap);
			}
		}
		ROOT_OBJECT_MAP = new LE_ObjectMap();
		ROOT_OBJECT_MAP.ObjectPrefabs = new List<LE_Object>();
		Shader.SetGlobalColor("_HighlightRimColor", Color.black);
		Shader.SetGlobalFloat("_HighlightRimPower", 1f);
		LE_Object[] componentsInChildren = ObjectInstanceContainer.GetComponentsInChildren<LE_Object>();
		foreach (LE_Object item in componentsInChildren)
		{
			MapObjectReferences.Add(item);
		}
		ObjectInstanceContainer.gameObject.SetActive(value: false);
		foreach (LE_Object mapObjectReference in MapObjectReferences)
		{
			if (mapObjectReference.Category == LE_Object.Categories.NONE)
			{
				ROOT_OBJECT_MAP.ObjectPrefabs.Add(mapObjectReference);
			}
			else
			{
				list[(int)(mapObjectReference.Category - 1)].ObjectPrefabs.Add(mapObjectReference);
			}
		}
		foreach (LE_ObjectMap item2 in list)

	private void Update()
	{
		if (m_isFirstUpdateInitialized && !m_isSecondUpdateInitialized)
		{
			m_isSecondUpdateInitialized = true;
			Initialize_InSecondUpdate();
		}
		if (!m_isFirstUpdateInitialized)
		{
			m_isFirstUpdateInitialized = true;
			Initialize_InFirstUpdate();
		}
		bool flag = IsMouseOverGUI();
		for (int i = 0; i < m_GUI3d.Count; i++)
		{
			m_GUI3d[i].IsInteractable = !flag && m_GUI3d[i].ActiveEditMode == m_editMode;
		}
		for (int j = 0; j < m_logic.Count; j++)
		{
			m_logic[j].Update();
		}
		m_input.Update();
		UpdateCameraPivotPoint();
		if (m_cameraPerspectiveGizmo != null)
		{
			m_cameraPerspectiveGizmo.Pivot = m_camPivot;
		}
		if (m_executeWhenReady != null && IsReady)
		{
			m_executeWhenReady();
			m_executeWhenReady = null;
		}
	}

	public bool IsMouseOverGUI()
	{
		bool flag = LE_GUIInterface.Instance.delegates.IsCursorOverUI != null && LE_GUIInterface.Instance.delegates.IsCursorOverUI();
		bool flag2 = false;
		if (IS_WITH_CAMERA_PERSPECTIVE_GIZMO && !flag)
		{
			Vector3 mousePosition = Input.mousePosition;
			mousePosition.y = Mathf.Clamp((float)Screen.height - mousePosition.y, 0f, Screen.height);
			mousePosition.x = Mathf.Clamp(mousePosition.x, 0f, Screen.width);
			flag2 = m_perspectiveGizmoRect.Contains(mousePosition);
		}
		return flag | flag2;
	}

	private void OnGUI3dObjectFocused(Vector3 p_focusOn, float p_distance)
	{
		m_camPivot = p_focusOn;
		Camera cam = Cam;
		if (cam != null && cam.orthographic && m_cameraPerspectiveGizmo != null)
		{
			cam.transform.position = m_camPivot - cam.transform.forward * Mathf.Abs(m_cameraPerspectiveGizmo.OrthoOffset + p_distance);
			cam.orthographicSize = p_distance;
		}
	}

	protected override void OnDestroy()
	{
		LE_EventInterface.OnChangeLevelData = (EventHandler)Delegate.Remove(LE_EventInterface.OnChangeLevelData, new EventHandler(OnChangeLevelData));
		if (LE_GUIInterface.Instance != null)
		{
			LE_GUIInterface.EventHandlers events = LE_GUIInterface.Instance.events;
			events.OnEditModeBtn = (EventHandler<LE_GUIInterface.EventHandlers.EditModeEventArgs>)Delegate.Remove(events.OnEditModeBtn, new EventHandler<LE_GUIInterface.EventHandlers.EditModeEventArgs>(OnEditModeBtn));
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < m_GUI3d.Count; i++)
		{
			if (m_GUI3d[i] is LE_GUI3dObject)
			{
				((LE_GUI3dObject)m_GUI3d[i]).OnFocused = null;
			}
		}
		m_executeWhenReady = null;
		if (m_input != null)
		{
			m_input.Destroy();
		}
		for (int j = 0; j < m_logic.Count; j++)
		{
			m_logic[j].Destroy();
		}
		base.OnDestroy();
	}

	private void UpdateCameraPivotPoint()
	{
		Camera cam = Cam;
		if (cam != null)
		{
			Vector3 rhs = m_camPivot - cam.transform.position;
			float num = Vector3.Dot(cam.transform.forward, rhs);
			if (num < 1f)
			{
				float num2 = num - 1.5f;
				m_camPivot = cam.transform.position - cam.transform.forward * num2;
				rhs = m_camPivot - cam.transform.position;
				num = Vector3.Dot(cam.transform.forward, rhs);
			}
			if (Vector3.Cross(cam.transform.forward, rhs).magnitude > 1f)
			{
				m_camPivot = cam.transform.position + cam.transform.forward * num;
			}
		}
	}

	private float EstimateDistanceToLevel(EEstimateDistanceMode p_mode)
	{
		float result = 300f;
		Camera cam = Cam;
		if (cam != null)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			Vector3 vector = Vector3.zero;
			float num2 = float.MaxValue;
			for (float num3 = 0f; num3 < 2f; num3++)
			{
				for (float num4 = 0f; num4 < 2f; num4++)
				{
					if (!Physics.Raycast(cam.ScreenPointToRay(new Vector3(cam.rect.width * (float)Screen.width * (0.25f + 0.5f * num3), cam.rect.height * (float)Screen.height * (0.25f + 0.5f * num4), 0f)), out var hitInfo))
					{
						continue;
					}
					num++;
					if (p_mode == EEstimateDistanceMode.AVERAGE)
					{
						vector += hitInfo.point;
						continue;
					}
					float magnitude = (hitInfo.point - cam.transform.position).magnitude;
					if (num2 > magnitude)
					{
						num2 = magnitude;
						vector = hitInfo.point;
					}
				}
			}
			if (num > 0f)
			{
				if (p_mode == EEstimateDistanceMode.AVERAGE)
				{
					vector /= num;
				}
				result = (vector - cam.transform.position).magnitude;
			}
		}
		return result;
	}

		}
	}

	private Texture2D CreateHeightMapTexture(TerrainData terrain)
	{

	private Texture2D CreateShoreMaskTexture(TerrainData terrain)

	private void AddWaveOverlay(GameObject zone, Texture2D height, Texture2D shore)
	{
		if ((bool)_waveOverlay)
		{
			Object.Destroy(_waveOverlay.heightTexture.tex);
			Object.Destroy(_waveOverlay.heightTexture.mask);
			Object.Destroy(_waveOverlay.normalTexture.tex);
			Object.Destroy(_waveOverlay.normalTexture.mask);
			Object.Destroy(_waveOverlay.foamTexture.tex);
			Object.Destroy(_waveOverlay.foamTexture.mask);
			Object.Destroy(_waveOverlay.gameObject);
		}
		GameObject gameObject = new GameObject("WaveOverlay");
		gameObject.transform.parent = zone.transform;
		gameObject.transform.position = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 0f);
		_waveOverlay = gameObject.AddComponent<AddWaveOverlay>();
		_waveOverlay.width = 250f;
		_waveOverlay.height = 250f;
		_waveOverlay.heightTexture = new OverlayHeightTexture();
		_waveOverlay.heightTexture.tex = shore;
		_waveOverlay.heightTexture.mask = height;
		_waveOverlay.heightTexture.alpha = 0f;
		_waveOverlay.heightTexture.maskMode = OVERLAY_MASK_MODE.WAVES;
		_waveOverlay.normalTexture = new OverlayNormalTexture();
		_waveOverlay.normalTexture.tex = shore;
		_waveOverlay.normalTexture.mask = height;
		_waveOverlay.normalTexture.alpha = 0f;
		_waveOverlay.normalTexture.maskAlpha = 0.4f;
		_waveOverlay.normalTexture.maskMode = OVERLAY_MASK_MODE.WAVES;
		_waveOverlay.foamTexture = new OverlayFoamTexture();
		_waveOverlay.foamTexture.tex = shore;
		_waveOverlay.foamTexture.mask = height;
		_waveOverlay.foamTexture.alpha = 0.4f;
		_waveOverlay.foamTexture.maskMode = OVERLAY_MASK_MODE.WAVES;
	}

			for (int j = 0; j <= num2; j++)
			{
				float v = ((float)(i + o_minX) / o_heightmapMaxX - o_relBrushMinX) / p_relativeBrushSize;
				float u = ((float)(j + o_minY) / o_heightmapMaxY - o_relBrushMinY) / p_relativeBrushSize;
				float a = p_alphaBrushTexture.GetPixelBilinear(u, v).a;
				o_heights[i, j] += p_delta * a;
				o_heights[i, j] = ClampHeightBounds(o_heights[i, j], o_minX + i, o_minY + j);
			}
		}
		m_terrainData.SetHeights(o_minY, o_minX, o_heights);
		LE_EventInterface.LevelDataChanged(this);
	}

	private void ChangeHeightInternal(Texture2D p_alphaBrushTexture, float p_relativeBrushSize, Vector2 p_relativeLocalLocation, out int o_minX, out int o_maxX, out int o_minY, out int o_maxY, out float[,] o_heights, out float o_relBrushMinX, out float o_relBrushMinY, out float o_heightmapMaxX, out float o_heightmapMaxY)
	{
		o_heightmapMaxX = m_terrainData.heightmapResolution - 1;
		o_heightmapMaxY = m_terrainData.heightmapResolution - 1;
		GetAffectedAreaInternal(p_alphaBrushTexture, p_relativeBrushSize, p_relativeLocalLocation, o_heightmapMaxX, o_heightmapMaxY, out o_minX, out o_maxX, out o_minY, out o_maxY, out o_relBrushMinX, out o_relBrushMinY);
		o_heights = m_terrainData.GetHeights(o_minY, o_minX, o_maxY - o_minY + 1, o_maxX - o_minX + 1);
	}

	private void GetAffectedAreaInternal(Texture2D p_alphaBrushTexture, float p_relativeBrushSize, Vector2 p_relativeLocalLocation, float p_maxX, float p_maxY, out int o_minX, out int o_maxX, out int o_minY, out int o_maxY, out float o_relBrushMinX, out float o_relBrushMinY)
	{
		o_minX = 0;
		o_maxX = 0;
		o_minY = 0;
		o_maxY = 0;
		o_relBrushMinX = p_relativeLocalLocation.x - p_relativeBrushSize * 0.5f;
		float num = p_relativeLocalLocation.x + p_relativeBrushSize * 0.5f;
		o_relBrushMinY = p_relativeLocalLocation.y - p_relativeBrushSize * 0.5f;
		float num2 = p_relativeLocalLocation.y + p_relativeBrushSize * 0.5f;
		if (p_alphaBrushTexture == null)
		{
			Debug.LogError("LE_TerrainManager: Parameter 'p_alphaBrushTexture' is null!");
			return;
		}
		if (p_relativeBrushSize != Mathf.Clamp01(p_relativeBrushSize))
		{
			Debug.LogError("LE_TerrainManager: Parameter 'p_relativeBrushSize' is out of bounds expected range [0,1], but was '" + p_relativeBrushSize + "'!");
			return;
		}
		if (p_relativeLocalLocation.x != Mathf.Clamp01(p_relativeLocalLocation.x) || p_relativeLocalLocation.y != Mathf.Clamp01(p_relativeLocalLocation.y))
		{
			Vector2 vector = p_relativeLocalLocation;
			Debug.LogError("LE_TerrainManager: Parameter 'p_relativeLocalLocation' is out of bounds expected range ([0,1],[0,1]), but was '" + vector.ToString() + "'!");
			return;
		}
		o_minX = Mathf.Clamp(Mathf.FloorToInt(p_maxX * o_relBrushMinX), 0, (int)p_maxX);
		o_maxX = Mathf.Clamp(Mathf.CeilToInt(p_maxX * num), 0, (int)p_maxX);
		o_minY = Mathf.Clamp(Mathf.FloorToInt(p_maxY * o_relBrushMinY), 0, (int)p_maxY);
		o_maxY = Mathf.Clamp(Mathf.CeilToInt(p_maxY * num2), 0, (int)p_maxY);
	}
}

using LE_LevelEditor.Core;

public class LE_GUI3dTerrain : LE_GUI3dBase
{
	public int TERRAIN_LAYER = 14;

	private Terrain m_terrain;

	private LE_TerrainManager m_terrainMgr;

	private TerrainData m_defaultTerrainDataPrefab;

	private Projector m_brushProjector;

	private Texture2D m_brushAlphaTexture;

	private LE_LogicTerrain.Heightmap _heightmap;

	private float m_size = 0.1f;

	private float m_targetRelativeValue = 0.5f;

	private bool m_isReadingTerrainSetHeight;

	private int m_isTerrainSetHeightReadInFrame = -1;

	private bool m_isDirectedSmooth;

			return m_size;

			m_size = value;
			if (m_terrainMgr != null)
			{
				float num = 1f / (float)Mathf.Min(m_terrainMgr.TerrainData.heightmapResolution - 1, m_terrainMgr.TerrainData.heightmapResolution - 1);
				m_size = Mathf.Floor(m_size / num) * num;
			}

	public void SetTerrain(Terrain p_terrain)
	{
		if (m_terrainMgr != null)
		{
			Debug.LogError("LE_GUI3dTerrain: SetTerrain: a terrain manager was already set and will be overwritten! Use 'RemoveTerrainManager' to reset the instance.");
		}
		m_terrain = p_terrain;
		m_terrainMgr = new LE_TerrainManager(p_terrain.terrainData);
		LE_EventInterface.LevelDataChanged(m_terrain.gameObject);
	}

	public void RemoveTerrainManager()
	{
		if (m_terrain != null)
		{
			LE_EventInterface.LevelDataChanged(m_terrain.gameObject);
		}
		m_terrain = null;
		m_terrainMgr = null;
	}

	public override void SetCursorPosition(Vector3 p_cursorScreenCoords)
	{
		m_cursorScreenCoords = p_cursorScreenCoords;
		m_cursorRay = Camera.main.ScreenPointToRay(p_cursorScreenCoords);
		if (m_terrain != null)
		{
			SetIsCursorOverSomething(m_terrain.GetComponent<Collider>().Raycast(m_cursorRay, out m_cursorHitInfo, float.MaxValue));
		}
		else
		{
			SetIsCursorOverSomething(p_isHit: false);
		}
	}

	public override void SetIsCursorAction(bool p_isCursorAction)
	{
		if (m_isTerrainSetHeightReadInFrame != -1 && !p_isCursorAction && m_isTerrainSetHeightReadInFrame + 1 < Time.frameCount)
		{
			m_isReadingTerrainSetHeight = false;
			m_isTerrainSetHeightReadInFrame = -1;
		}
		if (((IsCursorOverSomething && IsInteractable) & p_isCursorAction) && m_lastCursorActiveScreenCoords != m_cursorScreenCoords)
		{
			m_lastCursorActiveScreenCoords = m_cursorScreenCoords;
			if (!(m_cursorHitInfo.transform.gameObject.GetComponent<Terrain>() != null))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (m_isReadingTerrainSetHeight)
			{
				Terrain component = m_cursorHitInfo.transform.gameObject.GetComponent<Terrain>();
				float num = component.SampleHeight(m_cursorHitInfo.point);
				m_targetRelativeValue = Mathf.Clamp01(num / component.terrainData.size.y);
				m_isTerrainSetHeightReadInFrame = Time.frameCount;
				return;
			}
			switch (m_editMode)
			{
			case LE_ETerrainEditMode.CHANGE_HEIGHT:
				m_terrainMgr.ChangeHeight(Mathf.Sign(Amount) * Mathf.Max(0.002f, Amount * Amount) * Time.deltaTime * 2f, BrushAlphaTexture, Size, GetRelativeLocalLocation(m_cursorHitInfo));
				break;
			case LE_ETerrainEditMode.CHANGE_HEIGHT_TO_TARGET_VALUE:
				m_terrainMgr.ChangeHeight(Mathf.Max(0.002f, Amount * Amount) * Time.deltaTime * 2f, TargetRelativeValue, BrushAlphaTexture, Size, GetRelativeLocalLocation(m_cursorHitInfo));
				break;
			case LE_ETerrainEditMode.SMOOTH_HEIGHT:
			{
				int p_neighbourCount = 3 + 2 * Mathf.RoundToInt(Mathf.Abs(Amount) * 3f);
				m_terrainMgr.SmoothHeight(Time.deltaTime * 2f, p_neighbourCount, BrushAlphaTexture, Size, GetRelativeLocalLocation(m_cursorHitInfo), m_isDirectedSmooth, m_directedSmoothAngle);
				break;
			}
			default:
				Debug.LogError("LE_GUI3dTerrain: unknown EditMode!");
				break;
			case LE_ETerrainEditMode.PROCEDURAL:
				break;
			}
		}
		else
		{
			m_lastCursorActiveScreenCoords = -1f * Vector3.one;
		}
	}

	public void HideCursor()
	{
		BrushProjector.orthographicSize = 0f;
		if (BrushProjector.transform.childCount > 0)
		{
			BrushProjector.transform.GetChild(0).gameObject.SetActive(value: false);
		}
		SetIsCursorOverSomething(p_isHit: false);
	}

	private void Start()
	{
		if (m_brushProjector == null)
		{
			Debug.LogError("LE_GUI3dTerrain: m_brushProjector was not initialized!");
		}
		if (m_brushAlphaTexture == null)
		{
			Debug.LogError("LE_GUI3dTerrain: m_brushAlphaTexture was not initialized!");
		}
	}

	private void Update()
	{
		UpdateBrushProjector(IsCursorOverSomething, m_cursorHitInfo);
		if (ReInput.players.GetPlayer(0).GetButtonDown(53))
		{
			Focus();
		}
	}

	public void Focus()
	{
		if (IsCursorOverSomething)
		{
			Vector3 point = m_cursorHitInfo.point;
			Vector3 vector = new Vector3(m_brushProjector.orthographicSize, m_brushProjector.orthographicSize * 0.7f, m_brushProjector.orthographicSize);
			Vector3 vector2 = Camera.main.transform.position - point;
			float num = Mathf.Max(vector.x, vector.y, vector.z) * 3f;
			Camera.main.transform.position = point + vector2.normalized * num;
			if (Camera.main.transform.position.y < point.y)
			{
				Vector3 position = Camera.main.transform.position;
				position.y = point.y;
				Camera.main.transform.position = position;
			}
			Camera.main.transform.LookAt(point, Vector3.up);
		}
	}

	private void UpdateBrushProjector(bool p_isHit, RaycastHit p_hitInfo)
	{
		if (p_isHit)
		{
			Vector3 size = m_terrainMgr.TerrainData.size;
			Vector2 relativeLocalLocation = GetRelativeLocalLocation(p_hitInfo);
			BrushProjector.transform.position = new Vector3(p_hitInfo.transform.position.x + relativeLocalLocation.y * size.x, p_hitInfo.point.y, p_hitInfo.transform.position.z + relativeLocalLocation.x * size.z);
			BrushProjector.orthographicSize = m_terrainMgr.TerrainData.size.z * m_size * 0.5f;
			BrushProjector.aspectRatio = m_terrainMgr.TerrainData.size.x / m_terrainMgr.TerrainData.size.z;
			if (BrushProjector.transform.childCount > 0)
			{
				BrushProjector.transform.GetChild(0).gameObject.SetActive(m_editMode == LE_ETerrainEditMode.SMOOTH_HEIGHT && IsDirectedSmooth);
			}
		}
		else
		{
			BrushProjector.orthographicSize = 0f;
			if (BrushProjector.transform.childCount > 0)
			{
				BrushProjector.transform.GetChild(0).gameObject.SetActive(value: false);
			}
		}
	}

	private Vector2 GetRelativeLocalLocation(RaycastHit hit)
	{
		Terrain component = hit.transform.gameObject.GetComponent<Terrain>();
		Vector3 size = component.terrainData.size;
		Vector3 vector = hit.transform.InverseTransformPoint(hit.point);
		Vector2 zero = Vector2.zero;
		zero.x = vector.z / size.z;
		zero.y = vector.x / size.x;
		float num = 1f / (float)(component.terrainData.heightmapResolution - 1);
		float num2 = 1f / (float)(component.terrainData.heightmapResolution - 1);
		zero.x = Mathf.Round(zero.x / num) * num;
		zero.y = Mathf.Round(zero.y / num2) * num2;
		return zero;
	}
}

				AddButtonClickSoundsToGeneratedUI(p_texPicker.transform as RectTransform);
			}));
			p_texPicker.ButtonCallback = p_buttonCallback;
			r_onChangedEvent = (EventHandler<LE_GUIInterface.EventHandlers.IntEventArgs>)Delegate.Combine(r_onChangedEvent, (EventHandler<LE_GUIInterface.EventHandlers.IntEventArgs>)((object p_obj, LE_GUIInterface.EventHandlers.IntEventArgs p_args) =>
			{
				if (p_texPicker != null)
				{
					p_texPicker.SetSelection(p_args.Value);
				}
			}));
		}
		else
		{
			Debug.LogError("LE_GUIInterface_uGUIimpl: " + p_errorPickerName + " is not set in inspector!");
		}
	}

	private void SetObjects(LE_ObjectMap p_objectMap)
	{
		if (OBJECT_BROWSER != null)
		{
			OBJECT_BROWSER.BuildTree(SetObjectsRecursive(p_objectMap, 0));
			AddButtonClickSoundsToGeneratedUI(OBJECT_BROWSER.transform as RectTransform);
			uMyGUI_TreeBrowser oBJECT_BROWSER = OBJECT_BROWSER;
			oBJECT_BROWSER.OnInnerNodeClick = (EventHandler<uMyGUI_TreeBrowser.NodeClickEventArgs>)Delegate.Combine(oBJECT_BROWSER.OnInnerNodeClick, (EventHandler<uMyGUI_TreeBrowser.NodeClickEventArgs>)((object p_object, uMyGUI_TreeBrowser.NodeClickEventArgs p_args) =>
			{
				AddButtonClickSoundsToGeneratedUI(OBJECT_BROWSER.transform as RectTransform);
			}));
			uMyGUI_TreeBrowser oBJECT_BROWSER2 = OBJECT_BROWSER;
			oBJECT_BROWSER2.OnLeafNodeClick = (EventHandler<uMyGUI_TreeBrowser.NodeClickEventArgs>)Delegate.Combine(oBJECT_BROWSER2.OnLeafNodeClick, (EventHandler<uMyGUI_TreeBrowser.NodeClickEventArgs>)((object p_object, uMyGUI_TreeBrowser.NodeClickEventArgs p_args) =>
			{
				if (!m_nodeToObject.TryGetValue(p_args.ClickedNode, out var value))
				{
					Debug.LogError("LE_GUIInterface_uGUIimpl: could not find selected node's object!");
				}
				if (value != null)
				{
					LE_GUIInterface.Instance.OnObjectSelectDraggable(value);
				}
			}));
		}
		else
		{
			Debug.LogError("LE_GUIInterface_uGUIimpl: SetObjects: OBJECT_BROWSER is not set in inspector!");
		}
	}

	private uMyGUI_TreeBrowser.Node[] SetObjectsRecursive(LE_ObjectMap p_objectMap, int p_indentLevel)
	{
		List<uMyGUI_TreeBrowser.Node> list = new List<uMyGUI_TreeBrowser.Node>();
		foreach (LE_ObjectMap subObjectMap in p_objectMap.SubObjectMaps)
		{
			if (subObjectMap != null)
			{
				LE_ObjectCategoryNode.SendMessageInitData p_sendMessageData = new LE_ObjectCategoryNode.SendMessageInitData(subObjectMap.CategoryName, p_indentLevel);
				list.Add(new uMyGUI_TreeBrowser.Node(p_sendMessageData, SetObjectsRecursive(subObjectMap, p_indentLevel + 1)));
			}
		}
		foreach (LE_Object objectPrefab in p_objectMap.ObjectPrefabs)
		{
			if (objectPrefab != null)
			{
				uMyGUI_TreeBrowser.Node node = new uMyGUI_TreeBrowser.Node(new LE_ObjectPrefabNode.SendMessageInitData(objectPrefab, p_indentLevel), null);
				list.Add(node);
				m_nodeToObject.Add(node, objectPrefab);
			}
			else
			{
				Debug.LogError("LE_GUIInterface_uGUIimpl: SetObjectsRecursive: object from map '" + p_objectMap.CategoryName + "' at index '' is null!");
			}
		}
		return list.ToArray();
	}

	private void AddButtonClickSoundsToGeneratedUI(RectTransform p_root)
	{
		if (p_root != null && BUTTON_CLICK_AUDIO_SOURCE != null)
		{
			Button[] componentsInChildren = p_root.GetComponentsInChildren<Button>(includeInactive: true);
			for (int i = 0; i < componentsInChildren.Length; i++)
			{
				componentsInChildren[i].onClick.RemoveListener(OnButtonClickSound);
				componentsInChildren[i].onClick.AddListener(OnButtonClickSound);
			}
			Toggle[] componentsInChildren2 = p_root.GetComponentsInChildren<Toggle>(includeInactive: true);
			for (int j = 0; j < componentsInChildren2.Length; j++)
			{
				componentsInChildren2[j].onValueChanged.RemoveListener(OnToggleClickSound);
				componentsInChildren2[j].onValueChanged.AddListener(OnToggleClickSound);
			}
		}
	}

	private void OnButtonClickSound()
	{
		if (BUTTON_CLICK_AUDIO_SOURCE != null)
		{
			BUTTON_CLICK_AUDIO_SOURCE.Play();
		}
	}

	private void OnToggleClickSound(bool p_isOn)
	{
		if (BUTTON_CLICK_AUDIO_SOURCE != null)
		{
			BUTTON_CLICK_AUDIO_SOURCE.Play();
		}
	}

public class LevelLoader : MonoBehaviour, ILoader
{
	private static LevelLoader _Instance;

	private bool _creating;

	private Stack<ILoader> _loaders = new Stack<ILoader>();

	private ILoader _currentLoader;

	private HashSet<int> _hashCodes = new HashSet<int>();

	private HashSet<Zone> _loadingZones = new HashSet<Zone>();

	private List<Action> _deferredLoading = new List<Action>();

	private List<Action> _postLoading = new List<Action>();

	private List<Action> _physicalLoading = new List<Action>();

	private bool _isLoadingScene;

	private CoroutineHandle _serverJoinInProgress;

	private JObject _serverClientCopy;

	private CoroutineHandle _syncWorldCoroutine;

	private CoroutineHandle _syncWorldCoroutineSend;

	private CoroutineHandle _syncWorldCoroutineRecv;

	private CoroutineHandle _syncSaveCoroutine;

	private CoroutineHandle _syncSaveCoroutineSend;

	private CoroutineHandle _syncSaveCoroutineRecv;

	public static LevelLoader Instance
	{
		get
		{
			if (_Instance == null && !Game.IsQuitting)
			{
				_Instance = new GameObject("~LevelLoader").AddComponent<LevelLoader>();
				_Instance.transform.SetAsFirstSibling();
				_Instance.transform.position = Vector3.zero;
				_Instance.transform.rotation = Quaternion.identity;
			}
			return _Instance;
		}
	}

	public static bool IsCreatingOrLoading
	{
		get
		{
			if ((!Instance || !Instance._creating) && !IsLoading())
			{
				if ((bool)Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance && Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.ZoneLoader != null)
				{
					return Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.ZoneLoader.IsGenerating;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

	public static ILoader CurrentLoader
	{
		get
		{
			return Instance._currentLoader;
		}
		set
		{
			Instance.SetCurrentLoader(value);
		}
	}

	bool ILoader.IsLoading { get; set; }

	public ICollection<int> HashCodes => _hashCodes;

	public ICollection<Zone> LoadingZones => _loadingZones;

	public IList<Action> DeferredLoading => _deferredLoading;

	public IList<Action> PostLoading => _postLoading;

	public IList<Action> PhysicalLoading => _physicalLoading;

	public Transform LoadingContainer => _loadingContainer;

	public JObject ServerClientCopy

	public static bool IsLoading()

		return CurrentLoader?.IsLoading ?? false;
	}

	public static bool IsLoading(GameObject gameObject)
	{
		if (IsLoading())
		{
			return Instance.HashCodes.Contains(gameObject.GetHashCode());
		}
		return false;
	}

	public static bool IsLoadingScene()
	{
		return Instance._isLoadingScene;
	}

	private void SetCurrentLoader(ILoader value)
	{
		if (value == null)
		{
			ILoader currentLoader = null;
			if (_loaders.Count > 0)
			{
				currentLoader = _loaders.Pop();
			}
			_currentLoader = currentLoader;
		}
		else
		{
			if (!_currentLoader.IsNullOrDestroyed())
			{
				_loaders.Push(_currentLoader);
			}
			_currentLoader = value;
		}
	}

	public static bool IsPlayable()
	{
		if (!IsLoading())
		{
			return PlayerUtilities.AllPlayersPresent();
		}
		return false;
	}

	public static bool IsClientJoinInProgress()
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsClient())
		{
			return MultiplayerMng.ServerGameState.IsGame();
		}
		return false;
	}

	private void Awake()
	{
		if ((bool)_Instance)
		{
			BeamTeam.Destroy(gameObject);
			return;
		}
		_Instance = this;
		Debug.Log(string.Format("{0}:: Created instance, #{1}", "LevelLoader", GetHashCode()));
		UnityEngine.Object.DontDestroyOnLoad(gameObject);
		_loadingContainer = new GameObject("LoadingContainer").transform;
		_loadingContainer.gameObject.SetActive(value: false);
		_loadingContainer.parent = _Instance.transform;
		_loadingContainer.transform.position = Vector3.zero;
		_loadingContainer.transform.rotation = Quaternion.identity;
		EventManager.AddListener<PlayerConnectedEvent>(OnConnect);
		EventManager.AddListener<PlayerDisconnectedEvent>(OnDisconnect);
		SceneManager.sceneLoaded += SceneManager_SceneLoaded;
	}

	private void OnDestroy()
	{
		_loaders.Clear();
		_currentLoader = null;
		BeamTeam.Destroy(_loadingContainer.gameObject);
		EventManager.RemoveListener<PlayerConnectedEvent>(OnConnect);
		EventManager.RemoveListener<PlayerDisconnectedEvent>(OnDisconnect);
		SceneManager.sceneLoaded -= SceneManager_SceneLoaded;
	}

	private void SceneManager_SceneLoaded(Scene scene, LoadSceneMode mode)
	{
		if (scene.buildIndex == 1)
		{
			Debug.Log("LevelLoader:: Destroying instance...");
			BeamTeam.Destroy(gameObject);
		}
	}

	private void OnConnect(PlayerConnectedEvent @event)
	{
		if (!Game.State.IsMenu() && Game.Mode.IsServer() && @event.PlayerId == 1 && !_loadingSequence.IsRunning)
		{
			_serverJoinInProgress = Timing.RunCoroutine(ServerJoinInProgress());
		}
	}

	private void OnDisconnect(PlayerDisconnectedEvent @event)
	{
		if (!Game.State.IsMenu())
		{
			Debug.LogError($"OnDisconnect {@event.PlayerId} {Game.State} Loading: {_loadingSequence.IsRunning} Join {_serverJoinInProgress.IsRunning}");
			if (Game.Mode.IsServer() && IsInNormalGameplay())
			{
				UpdateServerClientCopy(PlayerUtilities.GetPlayerFromId(1));
			}
			Timing.RunCoroutine(OnDisconnect_Sequence(@event));
		}
	}

	private bool IsInNormalGameplay()
	{
		if (!_serverJoinInProgress.IsRunning)
		{
			return !_loadingSequence.IsRunning;
		}
		return false;
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> OnDisconnect_Sequence(PlayerDisconnectedEvent @event)
	{
		yield return 0f;
		if (Game.Mode.IsServer() && @event.PlayerId == 1)
		{
			if (_serverJoinInProgress.IsRunning)
			{
				_serverJoinInProgress.IsRunning = false;
				StopSync();
			}
			else if (_loadingSequence.IsRunning)
			{
				StopSync();
			}
		}
		bool hostDisconnected = @event.PlayerId == 0;
		if (hostDisconnected)
		{
			Timing.KillCoroutines();
		}
		Rewired.Player player = ReInput.players.GetPlayer(0);
		if (player.IsValid() && @event.TryGetDisconnectDialog(out var title, out var content))
		{
			player.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: false, 0);
			player.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: true, 16);
			player.SetCursorEnabled(enabled: true);
			DialogueBox.Show(player, title, content, DialogueButton.Ok, DialogueIcon.Warning).Accept += () =>
			{
				if (hostDisconnected)
				{
					StartCoroutine(QuitToMenu_Sequence());
				}
			};
		}
		else if (hostDisconnected)
		{
			StartCoroutine(QuitToMenu_Sequence());
		}
	}

	private void StopSync()
	{
		_syncSaveCoroutine.IsRunning = false;
		_syncSaveCoroutineSend.IsRunning = false;
		_syncSaveCoroutineRecv.IsRunning = false;
		_syncWorldCoroutine.IsRunning = false;
		_syncWorldCoroutineSend.IsRunning = false;
		_syncWorldCoroutineRecv.IsRunning = false;
	}

	public void ShutdownToMainMenu()
	{
		Timing.KillCoroutines();
		StartCoroutine(QuitToMenu_Sequence());
	}

	private IEnumerator QuitToMenu_Sequence()
	{
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent("LOADING_PROGRESS_TEXT_CLEANING_UP"));
		yield return 0f;
		MainMenuPresenter.Instance.QuitToMenu();
	}

	public void UpdateServerClientCopy(IPlayer client)
	{
		if (client.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			return;
		}
		try
		{
			_serverClientCopy = new JObject().Set(string.Format("Persistent/{0}/#{1}", "PlayerRegistry", client.Id), SavingUtilities.Save(client).Clear("Movement"));
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			Debug.LogError("Error in UpdateServerClientCopy\n" + ex.Message + "\n" + ex.StackTrace);
		}
	}

	public void PatchServerClientCopy(JObject save)
	{
		if (!Game.Mode.IsClient() && !_serverClientCopy.IsNullOrDestroyed() && !save.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			string path = "Persistent/PlayerRegistry/#1";
			if (!save.Get(path).IsValid())
			{
				save.Clear(path).ApplyPatch(_serverClientCopy);
			}
		}
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> ServerJoinInProgress()
	{
		yield return BeamTiming.WaitForPeer(1, 10f);
		if (PlayerUtilities.GetPeerFromId(1).IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			yield break;
		}
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new ServerJoinInProgressStarted());
		EventManager.EventDelegate<PlayerDisconnectedEvent> onDisconnect = null;
		onDisconnect = (PlayerDisconnectedEvent @event) =>
		{
			if (@event.PlayerId == 1)
			{
				EventManager.RemoveListener(onDisconnect);
				Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.Paused = false;
				Physics.autoSimulation = true;
				--PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.Movement.IsBusy;
				PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.Input.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: true, PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.Input.GetCurrentMapId());
				PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.PlayerUI.Refresh(RefreshUIMode.Clear);
				MainMenuPresenter.Instance.LoadingScreenPresenter.Hide();
				Singleton<Fader>.Instance.FadeIn(0.1f);
				AudioListener.volume = 1f;
				PlayerRegistry.LocalPeer.SetTimeout(Peer.GetDefaultTimeout());
				MultiplayerWorldSync.Instance?.Reset();
				EventManager.RaiseEvent(new ServerJoinInProgressEnded(PlayerRegistry.IsClientPeerValid));
			}
		};
		while (IsLoading())
		{
			yield return 0f;
		}
		EventManager.AddListener(onDisconnect);
		Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.Paused = true;
		Physics.autoSimulation = false;
		Singleton<Fader>.Instance.FadeOut(0.1f);
		AudioListener.volume = 0f;
		MainMenuPresenter.Instance.LoadingScreenPresenter.Show();
		++PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.Movement.IsBusy;
		yield return PlayerRegistry.LocalPeer.SetTimeout_Async(Peer.GetSessionTimeout());
		JObject save = new JObject();
		JObject persistent = new JObject();
		bool succeeded = true;
		yield return Timing.WaitUntilDone(Timing.Instance.RunCoroutine(SaveManager.GenerateSave_Sequence(save, persistent), (Exception ex) =>
		{
			if (ex != null)
			{
				succeeded = false;
				Debug.LogException(ex);
			}
		}));
		if (succeeded)
		{
			yield return Timing.WaitUntilDone(SyncSave_Async((JObject saveData) =>
			{
				persistent = SaveManager.GetPersistentData(saveData);
			}, save));
			yield return Timing.WaitUntilDone(SyncWorld_Async(serverLoadWorld: false));
			yield return BeamTiming.WaitForAllPlayers();
			PlayerRegistry.InitializeReplicants();
			yield return Timing.WaitUntilDone(Timing.RunCoroutine(ServerJoinInProgress_LoadPlayerReplicant(persistent)));
			yield return Timing.WaitUntilDone(MultiplayerFence.Sync(Fence.FinishLoading));
			onDisconnect(new PlayerDisconnectedEvent(1, null));
		}
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> ServerJoinInProgress_LoadPlayerReplicant(JObject persistent)
	{
		IPlayer playerFromId = PlayerUtilities.GetPlayerFromId(1);
		if (playerFromId.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			yield break;
		}
		StorageLoader storageLoader = new StorageLoader
		{
			IsLoading = true
		};
		CurrentLoader = storageLoader;
		if (persistent.IsValid())
		{
			JObject jObject = persistent.Get("PlayerRegistry");
			if (jObject.IsValid() && jObject.Children.IsValid() && jObject.Children.Count > 1)
			{
				JObject jObject2 = jObject.Children[1];
				if (jObject2.IsValid() && !jObject2.IsNull())
				{
					SavingUtilities.Load(playerFromId, jObject2);
				}
			}
		}
		Zone zone = StrandedWorld.GetZone(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.transform.position);
		int numLoadedZones = (zone ? 1 : 0);
		if (!persistent.Get("StrandedWorld/Zones").GetZoneData(Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.NmlZone.Id).GetField("Objects")
			.IsNull())
		{
			numLoadedZones++;
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < numLoadedZones; i++)
		{
			yield return Timing.WaitUntilDone(MultiplayerFence.Sync(Fence.ProcessLoading));
		}
		for (int j = 0; j < storageLoader.DeferredLoading.Count; j++)
		{
			LoadingActionUtilities.ExecuteDeferredAction(storageLoader.DeferredLoading[j]);
		}
		for (int k = 0; k < storageLoader.PostLoading.Count; k++)
		{
			LoadingActionUtilities.ExecuteDeferredAction(storageLoader.PostLoading[k]);
		}
		for (int l = 0; l < storageLoader.PhysicalLoading.Count; l++)
		{
			LoadingActionUtilities.ExecuteDeferredAction(storageLoader.PhysicalLoading[l]);
		}
		storageLoader.IsLoading = false;
		CurrentLoader = null;
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> ClientActivateEntities()
	{
		yield return BeamTiming.WaitForPeer(0);
		MultiplayerMng.ReceivedEntitiesActive = true;
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(1f);
	}

	private CoroutineHandle SyncWorld_Async(bool serverLoadWorld = true)
	{
		return _syncWorldCoroutine = Timing.RunCoroutine(SyncWorld_Sequence(serverLoadWorld));
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> SyncWorld_Sequence(bool serverLoadWorld = true)
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsServer() & serverLoadWorld)
		{
			LoadingResult loadingResult = World.LoadWorld();
			if (loadingResult.Succeeded)
			{
				Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.ApplyWorldToZones();
			}
			else
			{
				Debug.LogError("StrandedWorld:: Error loading world: " + loadingResult.Message);
			}
			PlayerRegistry.ServerPeer.WorldSeed = StrandedWorld.LOCAL_WORLD_SEED;
		}
		if (Game.Mode.IsServer() && PlayerRegistry.IsClientPeerValid)
		{
			yield return MultiplayerWorldSync.Instance.SendWorld_Async(World.CurrentWorld, (CoroutineHandle coroutine) =>
			{
				_syncWorldCoroutineSend = coroutine;
			}, (float ratio) =>
			{
				EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent(string.Format("{0} [{1}%]", "LOADING_PROGRESS_SYNC_WORLD", (int)((double)ratio * 100.0))));
			}, () =>
			{
			}, ShutdownToMainMenu);
		}
		if (Game.Mode.IsClient())
		{
			yield return MultiplayerWorldSync.Instance.ReceiveWorld_Async((CoroutineHandle coroutine) =>
			{
				_syncWorldCoroutineRecv = coroutine;
			}, (float ratio) =>
			{
				EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent(string.Format("{0} [{1}%]", "LOADING_PROGRESS_SYNC_WORLD", (int)((double)ratio * 100.0))));
			}, (World.Bundle world) =>
			{
				World.PushWorld(world);
				Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.ApplyWorldToZones();
			}, ShutdownToMainMenu);
		}
	}

	private CoroutineHandle SyncSave_Async(Action<JObject> onSaveFile, JObject saveFile = null)
	{
		return _syncSaveCoroutine = Timing.RunCoroutine(SyncSave_Sequence(onSaveFile, saveFile));
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> SyncSave_Sequence(Action<JObject> onSaveFile, JObject saveFile)
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsServer())
		{
			saveFile = saveFile ?? (SaveManager.ValidateSaveFile(Game.Mode) ? SaveManager.LoadSaveFile(Game.Mode) : null);
			if (PlayerRegistry.IsClientPeerValid)
			{
				yield return MultiplayerWorldSync.Instance.SendSave_Async(saveFile, (CoroutineHandle coroutine) =>
				{
					_syncSaveCoroutineSend = coroutine;
				}, (float ratio) =>
				{
					EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent(string.Format("{0} [{1}%]", "LOADING_PROGRESS_SYNC_SAVE", (int)((double)ratio * 100.0))));
				}, onSaveFile, ShutdownToMainMenu);
			}
			else
			{
				onSaveFile?.Invoke(saveFile);
			}
		}
		if (Game.Mode.IsClient())
		{
			yield return MultiplayerWorldSync.Instance.ReceiveSave_Async((CoroutineHandle coroutine) =>
			{
				_syncSaveCoroutineRecv = coroutine;
			}, (float ratio) =>
			{
				EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent(string.Format("{0} [{1}%]", "LOADING_PROGRESS_SYNC_SAVE", (int)((double)ratio * 100.0))));
			}, onSaveFile, ShutdownToMainMenu);
		}
	}

	public static void LoadLevel(int level, LoadSceneMode mode, Action OnStart, Action OnComplete)
	{
		Instance.Load(level, mode, OnStart, OnComplete);
	}

	public void Load(int level, LoadSceneMode mode, Action OnStart, Action OnComplete)
	{
		Timing.KillCoroutines(_loadingSequence);
		_loadingSequence = Timing.RunCoroutine(LoadScene_Sequence(level, mode, OnStart, OnComplete));
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> LoadScene_Sequence(int level, LoadSceneMode mode, Action OnStart, Action OnComplete)
	{
		_serverClientCopy = null;
		_isLoadingScene = true;
		if (Game.State == GameState.LOAD_GAME)
		{
			CurrentLoader = this;
			CurrentLoader.IsLoading = true;
		}
		_creating = Game.State == GameState.NEW_GAME;
		OnStart?.Invoke();
		RewiredUtilities.Players.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: false, 0);
		AudioListener.volume = 0f;
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent("LOADING_PROGRESS_TEXT_INITIALIZING_OBJECTS"));
		yield return 0f;
		float timeout = Peer.GetDefaultTimeout();
		if (Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
		{
			if (Game.Mode.IsServer())
			{
				MultiplayerMng.UpdateSessionToken_IsBusy(isBusy: true);
			}
			else
			{
				MainMenuPresenter.Instance.LoadingScreenPresenter.Show("TEXT_SCREEN_LABEL_JOINING");
			}
			timeout = PlayerRegistry.LocalPeer.Timeout;
			yield return PlayerRegistry.LocalPeer.SetTimeout_Async(Peer.GetSessionTimeout());
		}
		Prefabs.Initialize();
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent("LOADING_PROGRESS_TEXT_LOADING_SCENE"));
		yield return 0f;
		AsyncOperation async = SceneManager.LoadSceneAsync(level, mode);
		async.allowSceneActivation = false;
		bool loaded = false;
		JObject rootData = null;
		while (!async.isDone)
		{
			if (async.progress >= 0.9f)
			{
				if (Game.State == GameState.LOAD_GAME)
				{
					if (Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
					{
						if (Game.State == GameState.LOAD_GAME && !loaded)
						{
							yield return Timing.WaitUntilDone(SyncSave_Async((JObject save) =>
							{
								rootData = save;
								loaded = true;
								async.allowSceneActivation = true;
							}));
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (Game.State == GameState.LOAD_GAME && !loaded)
						{
							rootData = SaveManager.LoadSaveFile(Game.Mode);
							loaded = true;
						}
						async.allowSceneActivation = true;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					async.allowSceneActivation = true;
				}
			}
			yield return 0f;
		}
		Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.Paused = true;
		if ((Game.State == GameState.NEW_GAME || Game.State == GameState.LOAD_GAME) && Game.Mode.IsClient())
		{
			Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.PostReplicateTick();
		}
		if ((bool)SceneCallbacks.Instance)
		{
			yield return Timing.WaitUntilDone(SceneCallbacks.Instance.Level_SceneLoaded(level));
		}
		foreach (IGameCamera allCamera in Cameras.AllCameras)
		{
			allCamera.gameObject.SetActive(value: false);
		}
		if (Game.State == GameState.INTRO)
		{
			PrivateJet_Assetloader privateJet_Assetloader = UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectOfType<PrivateJet_Assetloader>();
			if (privateJet_Assetloader != null)
			{
				yield return privateJet_Assetloader.Load_Async();
			}
		}
		else if (Game.State == GameState.NEW_GAME)
		{
			if (Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
			{
				yield return Timing.WaitUntilDone(SyncWorld_Async());
			}
			yield return CreateGame_Async();
		}
		else if (Game.State == GameState.LOAD_GAME)
		{
			if (Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
			{
				yield return Timing.WaitUntilDone(SyncWorld_Async());
			}
			yield return LoadGame_Async(rootData);
		}
		else if (Game.State == GameState.MAP_EDITOR)
		{
			AudioListener.volume = 1f;
			yield break;
		}
		if (Game.State.IsGame() && Game.Mode.IsClient())
		{
			yield return Timing.WaitUntilDone(Timing.RunCoroutine(ClientActivateEntities()));
		}
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent("LOADING_PROGRESS_TEXT_UNLOADING_ASSETS"));
		yield return 0f;
		Resources.UnloadUnusedAssets();
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent("LOADING_PROGRESS_TEXT_CLEANING_UP"));
		yield return 0f;
		GC.Collect();
		OnComplete?.Invoke();
		if (Game.State == GameState.LOAD_GAME)
		{
			CurrentLoader.DeferredLoading.Clear();
			CurrentLoader.PostLoading.Clear();
			CurrentLoader.PhysicalLoading.Clear();
			CurrentLoader.IsLoading = false;
			CurrentLoader = null;
		}
		_creating = false;
		_isLoadingScene = false;
		foreach (IGameCamera allCamera2 in Cameras.AllCameras)
		{
			allCamera2.gameObject.SetActive(value: true);
		}
		FollowSpawn[] spawners = UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsOfType<FollowSpawn>();
		bool generating;
		do
		{
			generating = false;
			FollowSpawn[] array = spawners;
			foreach (FollowSpawn followSpawn in array)
			{
				generating |= followSpawn.IsGenerating;
			}
			if (generating)
			{
				yield return 0f;
			}
		}
		while (generating);
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(2f);
		yield return Timing.WaitUntilDone(MultiplayerFence.Sync(Fence.FinishLoading));
		if (Game.State == GameState.NEW_GAME || Game.State == GameState.LOAD_GAME)
		{
			if (Game.Mode.IsServer())
			{
				Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.ReplicateTickRepeating();
			}
			Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.Paused = false;
			Singleton<Fader>.Instance.ResetFade(FadeMode.Solid, FadeDirection.In);
			Singleton<Fader>.Instance.SetFadeColor(Color.black);
			Singleton<Fader>.Instance.SetFadeEasing(EasingType.Linear);
			yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(1f);
			TMPTextScreenViewAdapter textScreen = UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectOfType<TMPTextScreenViewAdapter>();
			string headerText = string.Format("{0} {1}", Localization.GetLanguageHandler().Localize("MAIN_MENU_LABEL_DAY"), Singleton<GameCalendar>.Instance.DaysAlive);
			textScreen.SetHeaderText(headerText);
			textScreen.SetSubheaderText(string.Empty);
			textScreen.SetText(string.Empty);
			textScreen.SetTooltipText(string.Empty);
			textScreen.Show();
			yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(IsClientJoinInProgress() ? 2f : 4f);
			textScreen.Hide();
		}
		Singleton<Fader>.Instance.FadeIn(2.7f);
		float timer = 0f;
		while (timer < 2.7f)
		{
			timer += Time.unscaledDeltaTime;
			AudioListener.volume += 10f / 27f * Time.unscaledDeltaTime;
			yield return 0f;
		}
		AudioListener.volume = 1f;
		Singleton<Fader>.Instance.ResetColor();
		Singleton<Fader>.Instance.ResetEase();
		if (Game.State == GameState.NEW_GAME || Game.State == GameState.LOAD_GAME)
		{
			for (int num2 = 0; num2 < PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers.Count; num2++)
			{
				PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers[num2].Movement.IsBusy = default;
			}
			RewiredUtilities.Players.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: false, 9);
			RewiredUtilities.Players.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: true, 0);
			if (Game.Mode.IsServer())
			{
				MultiplayerMng.UpdateSessionToken_IsBusy(isBusy: false);
			}
		}
		else if (Game.State == GameState.INTRO)
		{
			RewiredUtilities.Players.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: true, 9);
		}
		if (Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
		{
			PlayerRegistry.LocalPeer.SetTimeout(timeout);
		}
	}

	private float CreateGame_Async()
	{
		return Timing.WaitUntilDone(CreateGame());
	}

	private float LoadGame_Async(JObject rootData)
	{
		return Timing.WaitUntilDone(LoadGame(rootData));
	}

	private CoroutineHandle CreateGame()
	{
		return Timing.RunCoroutine(CreateGame_Sequence());
	}

	private CoroutineHandle LoadGame(JObject rootData)
	{
		return Timing.RunCoroutine(LoadGame_Sequence(rootData));
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> CreateGame_Sequence()
	{
		yield return Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.CreateWorld_Async();
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> LoadGame_Sequence(JObject rootData)
	{
		JObject persistentData = SaveManager.GetPersistentData(rootData);
		Vector3 originalP1position = Vector3.zero;
		if (persistentData != null && !persistentData.IsNull())
		{
			JObject field = persistentData.GetField("GameTime");
			SavingUtilities.Load(Singleton<GameTime>.Instance, field);
			JObject field2 = persistentData.GetField("GameCalendar");
			SavingUtilities.Load(Singleton<GameCalendar>.Instance, field2);
			Physics.autoSimulation = false;
			float fixedDeltaTime = Time.fixedDeltaTime;
			if (!Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
			{
				Time.fixedDeltaTime = 10f;
			}
			LegacyUtilities.LoadPlayer(persistentData);
			IPlayer player = PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers[0];
			player.Character.RefreshPosition();
			player.Character.RefreshRotation();
			player.Character.SetCameraMode(player.PlayerCamera.CameraMode);
			player.PlayerCamera.CameraMovement.SetPosition(player.Character.CameraRigTransform);
			player.PlayerCamera.CameraMovement.SetRotation(player.Character.CameraRigTransform);
			player.PlayerCamera.UpdateCameraPosition(force: true);
			originalP1position = player.transform.position;
			JObject field3 = persistentData.GetField("StrandedWorld");
			yield return Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.LoadWorld_Async(rootData, field3);
			(from behaviour in UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsOfType<MonoBehaviour>()
				where behaviour is IPersistentSaveable && !(behaviour is GameTime) && !(behaviour is GameCalendar) && !(behaviour is StrandedWorld)
				select behaviour).Cast<IPersistentSaveable>().ToList().ForEach((IPersistentSaveable saveableObject) =>
			{
				string text = saveableObject.GetType().Name;
				JObject field4 = persistentData.GetField(text);
				if (field4 != null)
				{
					SavingUtilities.Load(saveableObject, field4);
				}
				else
				{
					Debug.LogWarning("LevelLoader:: No data was saved for persistent object [" + text + "].");
				}
			});
			for (int num = 0; num < DeferredLoading.Count; num++)
			{
				LoadingActionUtilities.ExecuteDeferredAction(DeferredLoading[num]);
			}
			for (int num2 = 0; num2 < PostLoading.Count; num2++)
			{
				LoadingActionUtilities.ExecuteDeferredAction(PostLoading[num2]);
			}
			if (!Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
			{
				Time.fixedDeltaTime = fixedDeltaTime;
			}
			Physics.autoSimulation = true;
		}
		else
		{
			Debug.LogError("LevelLoader:: [Persistent] node is null or empty.");
		}
		if (!Game.State.IsGame() || !Game.Mode.IsClient() || !(originalP1position != Vector3.zero))
		{
			yield break;
		}
		IPlayer playerFromId = PlayerUtilities.GetPlayerFromId(1);
		LayerMask physicsLayerMask = GetPhysicsLayerMask(Layers.PLAYER);
		physicsLayerMask = (int)physicsLayerMask ^ (1 << Layers.PLAYER);
		if (!Physics.CheckSphere(playerFromId.transform.position, 0.7f, physicsLayerMask))
		{
			yield break;
		}
		Vector3 vector = Vector3.zero;
		bool flag = false;
		float num3 = 0f;
		int num4 = 180;
		for (int num5 = 0; num5 < num4; num5++)
		{
			float x = Mathf.Sin(num3);
			float z = Mathf.Cos(num3);
			num3 += MathF.PI * 2f / (float)num4;
			vector = new Vector3(x, 0f, z);
			float radius = 0.25f;
			if (!Physics.CheckSphere(originalP1position + vector, radius, physicsLayerMask) && !Physics.Raycast(originalP1position + vector, originalP1position - (originalP1position + vector), vector.magnitude, physicsLayerMask))
			{
				flag = true;
				break;
			}
		}
		if (flag)
		{
			playerFromId.transform.position = originalP1position + vector;
		}
	}

	private LayerMask GetPhysicsLayerMask(int currentLayer)
	{
		int num = 0;
		for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++)
		{
			if (!Physics.GetIgnoreLayerCollision(currentLayer, i))
			{
				num |= 1 << i;
			}
		}
		return num;
	}
}

		public bool occupied;
	}

	[Serializable]
	public class Container
	{
		[HideInInspector]
		public string Name;

		public GameObject prefab;

		public float rarity;
	}

	[HideInInspector]
	public bool debugGizmos;

	[SerializeField]
	private Transform _shipwreckMarker;

	[SerializeField]
	private bool IsOnShipwreck = true;

	[SerializeField]
	private List<Spawn> _containerSpawn;

	private List<MiniGuid> _containerIds = new List<MiniGuid>();

	private bool _containersGenerated;

	private bool _scavenged;

	private bool _customMap;

	public List<Spawn> containerSpawn => _containerSpawn;

	private void Start()
	{
		debugGizmos = false;
		if (!LevelLoader.IsLoading(gameObject))
		{
			Initialize();
		}
	}

	public override void OnCustomMapLoaded()
	{
		base.OnCustomMapLoaded();
		_customMap = true;
		Initialize();
	}

	private void Initialize()
	{
		SpawnContainers();
		if (_shipwreckMarker != null)
		{
			_shipwreckMarker.transform.position = new Vector3(transform.position.x, 0.2f, transform.position.z);
		}
	}

	private void SpawnContainers()
	{
		if (_containersGenerated)
		{
			return;
		}
		WollieSpawner component = gameObject.GetComponent<WollieSpawner>();
		if (component != null)
		{
			Zone zone = StrandedWorld.GetZone(transform.position);
			if (zone != null)
			{
				if (zone.HasShelter && zone.HasWollie)
				{
					_containerSpawn.Add(new Spawn
					{
						position = component.WolliePosition,
						containers = new Container[1]
						{
							new Container
							{
								prefab = Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.ProceduralObjectsManager.WolliePrefab,
								rarity = 100f
							}
						}
					});
				}
			}
			else
			{
				Debug.LogWarning("LootContainerSpawner :: Error finding zone for Wollie Spawner!");
			}
		}
		System.Random random = Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.GenerateLocalSeed(transform.position);
		foreach (Spawn item in containerSpawn)
		{
			float num = random.Next(1000) / 10;
			float num2 = 0f;
			Container[] containers = item.containers;
			foreach (Container container in containers)
			{
				if (num <= num2 + container.rarity && !item.occupied)
				{
					Vector3 position = item.position.position;
					Quaternion rotation = item.position.rotation;
					ISaveablePrefab saveablePrefab = container.prefab.GetInterface<ISaveablePrefab>();
					if (!saveablePrefab.IsNullOrDestroyed())
					{
						uint prefabId = saveablePrefab.PrefabId;
						MiniGuid referenceId = MiniGuid.NewFrom(position, prefabId, 48879);
						bool flag = Prefabs.IsMultiplayerEntity(prefabId);
						if (Game.Mode.IsMaster() || !flag)
						{
							Setup(MultiplayerMng.Instantiate<SaveablePrefab>(prefabId, position, rotation, referenceId));
						}
						else
						{
							MultiplayerZoneSync.Instance.LinkData(MultiplayerZoneSync.Usage.LootContainerSpawner, referenceId, (MultiplayerZoneSync.Command command) =>
							{
								Setup(command.Instance);
							});
						}
					}
					else
					{
						UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(container.prefab, position, rotation, transform.parent);
					}
					item.occupied = true;
				}
				num2 += container.rarity;
			}
		}
		_containersGenerated = true;
	}

	private void Setup(SaveablePrefab saveablePrefab)
	{
		InteractiveObject interactiveObject = saveablePrefab as InteractiveObject;
		if (interactiveObject != null)
		{
			interactiveObject.transform.parent = transform.parent;
			interactiveObject.TransformParent = transform.parent;
			if (_customMap)
			{
				interactiveObject.OnCustomMapLoaded();
			}
			Interactive_STORAGE interactive_STORAGE = interactiveObject as Interactive_STORAGE;
			if (interactive_STORAGE != null)
			{
				interactive_STORAGE.PickedUp += Storage_PickedUp;
				interactive_STORAGE.BeginDragged += Storage_BeginDragged;
				interactive_STORAGE.Opened += Storage_Opened;
				_containerIds.Add(interactive_STORAGE.ReferenceId);
			}
		}
	}

	private void Storage_Opened(Interactive_STORAGE sender)
	{
		CheckScavenged(sender.ReferenceId);
	}

	private void Storage_PickedUp(IPickupable sender)
	{
		CheckScavenged(sender.ReferenceId);
	}

	private void Storage_BeginDragged(IDraggable sender)
	{
		ISaveablePrefab saveablePrefab = sender as ISaveablePrefab;
		if (!saveablePrefab.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			CheckScavenged(saveablePrefab.ReferenceId);
		}
	}

	private void CheckScavenged(MiniGuid refId)
	{
		if (!_containersGenerated || _scavenged)
		{
			return;
		}
		int num = _containerIds.FindIndex((MiniGuid id) => id.Equals(refId));
		if (num == -1)
		{
			return;
		}
		_containerIds.RemoveAt(num);
		if (_containerIds.Count == 0)
		{
			if (IsOnShipwreck)
			{
				EventManager.RaiseEvent(new AddStatsEvent(0, new Stats
				{
					ShipsScavenged = 1
				}));
			}
			else
			{
				EventManager.RaiseEvent(new ScavengedShelterEvent());
			}
			_scavenged = true;
		}
	}

	public override JObject Save()
	{
		JObject jObject = base.Save();
		JObject data = JSerializer.Serialize(transform);
		jObject.AddField("Transform", data);
		jObject.AddField("containersGenerated", JSerializer.Serialize(_containersGenerated));
		jObject.AddField("Scavenged", JSerializer.Serialize(_scavenged));
		JObject jObject2 = new JObject();
		for (int i = 0; i < _containerIds.Count; i++)
		{
			jObject2.Add(JSerializer.Serialize(_containerIds[i].ToString()));
		}
		jObject.AddField("ContainerIDs", jObject2);
		return jObject;
	}

	public override void Load(JObject data)
	{
		base.Load(data);
		if (data != null && !data.IsNull())
		{
			JSerializer.DeserializeInto(data.GetField("Transform"), transform);
			CompleteTransformSerialization();
			bool value = data.GetField("containersGenerated").GetValue<bool>();
			_containersGenerated = value;
			JObject field = data.GetField("Scavenged");
			if (field != null)
			{
				_scavenged = field.GetValue<bool>();
			}
			JObject field2 = data.GetField("ContainerIDs");
			if (field2 != null && field2.Children != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < field2.Children.Count; i++)
				{
					MiniGuid miniGuid = field2.Children[i].GetValue<string>().ToMiniGuid();
					if (!miniGuid.IsDefault())
					{
						Interactive_STORAGE interactive_STORAGE = MultiplayerMng.FindObject<Interactive_STORAGE>(miniGuid);
						if (interactive_STORAGE != null)
						{
							interactive_STORAGE.PickedUp += Storage_PickedUp;
							interactive_STORAGE.BeginDragged += Storage_BeginDragged;
							interactive_STORAGE.Opened += Storage_Opened;
							_containerIds.Add(miniGuid);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		Initialize();
	}
}

using System;

public static class MapNameGenerator
{
	private static readonly string[] Prefixes = new string[8] { "MAP_NAME_PREFIX_1", "MAP_NAME_PREFIX_2", "MAP_NAME_PREFIX_3", "MAP_NAME_PREFIX_4", "MAP_NAME_PREFIX_5", "MAP_NAME_PREFIX_6", "MAP_NAME_PREFIX_7", "MAP_NAME_PREFIX_8" };

	private static readonly string[] Stems = new string[10] { "MAP_NAME_STEM_1", "MAP_NAME_STEM_2", "MAP_NAME_STEM_3", "MAP_NAME_STEM_4", "MAP_NAME_STEM_5", "MAP_NAME_STEM_6", "MAP_NAME_STEM_7", "MAP_NAME_STEM_8", "MAP_NAME_STEM_9", "MAP_NAME_STEM_10" };

	private static readonly string[] Suffixes = new string[6] { "MAP_NAME_SUFFIX_1", "MAP_NAME_SUFFIX_2", "MAP_NAME_SUFFIX_3", "MAP_NAME_SUFFIX_4", "MAP_NAME_SUFFIX_5", "MAP_NAME_SUFFIX_6" };

	public static string GenerateRandomMapName(int seedEffect)
	{
		Random random = new Random(StrandedWorld.WORLD_SEED + seedEffect);
		return string.Join(" ", Prefixes[random.Next(0, Prefixes.Length)], Stems[random.Next(0, Stems.Length)], Suffixes[random.Next(0, Suffixes.Length)]);
	}
}

	private class PlayerGridGroup

		public SpawnGrid[,] SpawnGrids;

	private void Start()

	private void CreateGrid()
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsClient())
		{
			return;
		}
		SetDifficultyParams();
		int count = PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers.Count;
		_playerGridGroup = new PlayerGridGroup[count];
		for (int i = 0; i < PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers.Count; i++)
		{
			_ = PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers[i];

	private void MoveGrid()
	{
		if (LevelLoader.IsServerJoinInProgress)
		{
			return;
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < _playerGridGroup.Length; i++)
		{
			PlayerGridGroup playerGridGroup = _playerGridGroup[i];
			if (playerGridGroup.Player != null && playerGridGroup.SpawnGrids[2, 2] == null)
			{
				return;
			}
		}
		for (int j = 0; j < _playerGridGroup.Length; j++)
		{
			PlayerGridGroup playerGridGroup2 = _playerGridGroup[j];
			if (playerGridGroup2.Player == null)
			{
				continue;
			}
			Vector3 position = playerGridGroup2.Player.transform.position;
			SpawnGrid spawnGrid = null;

			int num2 = 0;

						playerGridGroup2.SpawnGrids[m, n].CanGenerate = true;
						playerGridGroup2.SpawnGrids[m, n].Generated = false;
					}
					if (num3 < 0)
					{
						num3 = 2;
					}
					else if (num3 > 2)
					{
						num3 = 0;
					}
					if (num4 < 0)
					{
						num4 = 2;

	private void UpdateGridPositions()
	{

			playerGridGroup.SpawnGrids[2, 0].Grid.position = new Vector3(playerGridGroup.SpawnGrids[1, 1].Grid.position.x + 250f, transform.position.y, playerGridGroup.SpawnGrids[1, 1].Grid.position.z + 250f);

					SpawnGrid spawnGrid = playerGridGroup.SpawnGrids[j, k];

	private void CreateGridObjects(SpawnGrid grid)
	{
		Zone[] zones = Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.Zones;
		foreach (Zone zone in zones)
		{
			if ((grid.Grid.position - zone.transform.position).magnitude < 150f || grid.Grid.position.x > 2500f || grid.Grid.position.x < -2500f || grid.Grid.position.z > 2500f || grid.Grid.position.z < -2500f)
			{
				return;
			}
		}
		for (int j = 0; j < _playerGridGroup.Length; j++)
		{
			PlayerGridGroup playerGridGroup = _playerGridGroup[j];
			if (playerGridGroup.Player == null)
			{
				continue;
			}
			for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
			{
				for (int l = 0; l < 3; l++)
				{
					if ((grid.Grid.position - playerGridGroup.SpawnGrids[k, l].Grid.transform.position).magnitude < 10f && playerGridGroup.SpawnGrids[k, l].Generated)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		grid.CanGenerate = false;
		grid.Generated = true;
		GameObject gameObject = ChooseCreature();
		if (!(gameObject == null))
		{
			GameObject gameObject2 = UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(gameObject, grid.Grid.position, Quaternion.identity);
			grid.piscusManager = gameObject2.GetComponent<PiscusManager>();
			grid.piscusManager.SpawnDistance = 150f;
			gameObject2.transform.parent = grid.Grid.transform;
			grid.piscusManager.transform.position = grid.Grid.position;
		}
	}

	private GameObject ChooseCreature()
	{
		float num = 0f;
		CreatureToSpawn[] creatures = Creatures;
		foreach (CreatureToSpawn creatureToSpawn in creatures)
		{
			num += creatureToSpawn.Rarity;
		}
		float num2 = UnityEngine.Random.value * num;
		for (int j = 0; j < Creatures.Length; j++)
		{
			if (num2 < Creatures[j].Rarity)
			{
				return Creatures[j].CreatureObj;
			}
			num2 -= Creatures[j].Rarity;
		}
		return null;
	}

	public JObject Save()
	{
		JObject jObject = new JObject();
		for (int i = 0; i < _playerGridGroup.Length; i++)
		{
			PlayerGridGroup playerGridGroup = _playerGridGroup[i];
			jObject.AddField("CenterGridPos_" + i, JSerializer.Serialize(playerGridGroup.SpawnGrids[1, 1].Grid.position));
		}
		return jObject;
	}

	public void Load(JObject data)
	{
		int playersCount = Game.Mode.GetPlayersCount();
		_loadedCenterGridPos = new Vector3[playersCount];
		if (data != null && !data.IsNull())
		{
			JObject field = data.GetField("CenterGridPos");
			if (field != null)
			{
				Vector3 vector = JSerializer.Deserialize<Vector3>(field);
				for (int i = 0; i < playersCount; i++)
				{
					_loadedCenterGridPos[i] = vector;
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < playersCount; j++)
			{
				JObject field2 = data.GetField("CenterGridPos_" + j);
				if (field2 != null)
				{
					_loadedCenterGridPos[j] = JSerializer.Deserialize<Vector3>(field2);
				}
			}
		}
		if ((bool)Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance)
		{
			Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.WorldGenerated += CreateGrid;
		}
		CreateGrid();
	}
}
