	public static bool TryGetSaveFilePath(GameMode mode, out string saveFilePath)
	{
		saveFilePath = string.Empty;
		if (!GAccountService.Get().Initialized)
		{
			Debug.LogError("SaveManager::CheckSaveFileExists:: DRM not initialized.");
			return false;
		}
		string saveFolderPath = GetSaveFolderPath();
		if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(saveFolderPath) || !Directory.Exists(saveFolderPath))
		{
			return false;
		}
		string saveFilePath2 = GetSaveFilePath(mode);
		if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(saveFilePath2))
		{
			return false;
		}
		saveFilePath = saveFilePath2;
		return File.Exists(saveFilePath);
	}

	public static bool CheckSaveFileVersion(GameMode mode)
	{
		try
		{
			Version saveFileVersion = GetSaveFileVersion(mode);
			if (saveFileVersion == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!ValidateVersionNumber(saveFileVersion))
			{
				Debug.LogError($"SaveManager::CheckSaveFileVersion:: {mode} save file is an older version.");
				return false;
			}
			Debug.Log($"SaveManager::CheckSaveFileVersion:: Valid {mode} save file version [" + saveFileVersion?.ToString() + "]");
			return true;
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			Debug.LogError("SaveManager::CheckSaveFileVersion:: There was an error parsing save file version:\n" + ex.Message);
			return false;
		}
	}

	public static VersionStatus CompareSaveFileVersion(GameMode mode, Version otherVersion)
	{
		if (otherVersion == null)
		{
			return VersionStatus.Newer;
		}
		Version saveFileVersion = GetSaveFileVersion(mode);
		if (saveFileVersion == null)
		{
			return VersionStatus.Older;
		}
		return (VersionStatus)saveFileVersion.CompareTo(otherVersion);
	}

	public static Version GetSaveFileVersion(GameMode mode)
	{
		if (!GAccountService.Get().Initialized)
		{
			Debug.LogError("SaveManager::GetSaveFileVersion:: Steam not initialized.");
			return null;
		}
		if (!TryGetSaveFilePath(mode, out var saveFilePath))
		{
			Debug.Log($"SaveManager::GetSaveFileVersion:: {mode} save file does not exist.");
			return null;
		}
		try
		{
			using FileStream stream = new FileStream(saveFilePath, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read);
			using StreamReader streamReader = new StreamReader(stream);
			streamReader.Read();
			bool flag = streamReader.Peek() == 13;
			if (flag)
			{
				streamReader.Read();
			}
			bool flag2 = streamReader.Peek() == 10;
			if (flag2)
			{
				streamReader.Read();
			}
			string version;
			if (flag | flag2)
			{
				version = streamReader.ReadLine().Trim().Substring(12, 7);
			}
			else
			{
				char[] array = new char[20];
				streamReader.Read(array, 0, array.Length);
				version = new string(array).Substring(11, 7);
			}
			return new Version(version);
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			Debug.LogError("SaveManager::GetSaveFileVersion:: Error loading version data from save file:\n\n" + ex.Message);
			return null;
		}
	}

	public static bool ValidateVersionNumber(Version version)
	{
		VersionStatus versionStatus = (VersionStatus)version.CompareTo(BuildInformation.MinimumVersion);
		if (versionStatus != VersionStatus.Equal)
		{
			return versionStatus == VersionStatus.Newer;
		}
		return true;
	}

	public static bool ValidateSaveFile(GameMode mode)

	private static bool ValidateSaveFileFast(GameMode mode)
	{
		if (!TryGetSaveFilePath(mode, out var saveFilePath))
		{
			Debug.LogError("SaveManager:: Error loading save file. File does not exist.");
			return false;
		}
		try
		{
			using FileStream stream = new FileStream(saveFilePath, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read);
			using StreamReader reader = new StreamReader(stream);
			using JsonTextReader reader2 = new JsonTextReader(reader);
			JToken jToken = JToken.ReadFrom(reader2);
			if (jToken == null || !jToken.HasValues)
			{
				Debug.LogError("SaveManager:: Error loading save file. Data was null or empty.");
				return false;
			}
			JToken jToken2 = jToken.SelectToken("Persistent.StrandedWorld");
			if (jToken2.IsNullOrDestroyed() || !jToken2.HasValues)
			{
				Debug.LogError("SaveManager:: Error loading save file. Stranded world data was null or empty.");
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			Debug.LogError("SaveManager:: Error loading save file:\n\n" + ex);
			return false;
		}
	}

	public static Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject LoadSaveFile(GameMode mode)
	{
		if (!TryGetSaveFilePath(mode, out var saveFilePath))
		{
			Debug.LogError($"SaveManager::LoadSaveFile:: Error loading {mode} save file. File does not exist.");
			return null;
		}
		Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject jObject = null;
		using (FileStream stream = new FileStream(saveFilePath, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read))
		{
			using StreamReader streamReader = new StreamReader(stream);
			jObject = new Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject(streamReader.ReadToEnd());
		}
		if (jObject.IsNull())
		{
			Debug.LogError("SaveManager::LoadSaveFile:: Error loading save file. Data was null or empty.");
			return null;
		}
		Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject jObject2 = jObject.Get("Persistent/StrandedWorld");
		if (jObject2.IsNullOrDestroyed() || jObject2.IsNull())
		{
			Debug.LogError("SaveManager::LoadSaveFile:: Error loading save file. Stranded world data was null or empty.");
			return null;
		}
		Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject field = jObject.GetField("CustomSettings");
		if (field != null)
		{
			GameSettings gameSettings = new GameSettings();
			if (!SavingUtilities.Load(gameSettings, field))
			{
				Debug.LogError("SaveManager::Load:: Could not load [CustomSettings] data.");
			}
			Options.CustomSettings = gameSettings;
		}
		else
		{
			Debug.LogError("SaveManager::Load:: Old Save Detected. No [CustomSettings] data was found.");
		}
		return jObject;
	}

	public static JToken LoadSaveFileFast(string path)
	{
		try
		{
			using FileStream stream = new FileStream(path, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.ReadWrite);
			using StreamReader reader = new StreamReader(stream);
			using JsonTextReader reader2 = new JsonTextReader(reader);
			JToken jToken = JToken.ReadFrom(reader2);
			if (jToken == null)
			{
				throw new Exception("Root data null.");
			}
			if (!jToken.HasValues)
			{
				throw new Exception("Root data empty.");
			}
			return jToken;
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			Debug.LogError("SaveManager:: Error loading save file:\n\n" + ex);
			return null;
		}
	}

		if (TryGetSaveFilePath(GameMode.Coop_Server, out saveFilePath))

	}

	public static void SaveGame(IPlayer invokingPlayer)
	{

		{
			return;
		}

	}

	private static CoroutineHandle Save(IPlayer player, SaveCallback callback)
	{
		return Timing.RunCoroutine(Save_Sequence(player, callback));
	}

	private static IEnumerator<float> Save_Sequence(IPlayer player, SaveCallback callback)
	{
		bool succeeded = true;
		Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject save = new Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject();
		Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject persistent = new Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject();
		yield return Timing.WaitUntilDone(Timing.Instance.RunCoroutine(GenerateSave_Sequence(save, persistent), (Exception ex) =>
		{
			if (ex != null)
			{
				succeeded = false;
				Debug.LogException(ex);
				callback(57005);
			}
		}));
		if (!succeeded)
		{
			yield break;
		}
		yield return Timing.WaitUntilDone(Timing.Instance.RunCoroutine(AfterSave_Sequence(player, save, callback), (Exception ex) =>
		{
			if (ex != null)
			{
				succeeded = false;
				Debug.LogException(ex);
				callback(48879);
			}
		}));
	}

	private static IEnumerator<float> AfterSave_Sequence(IPlayer player, Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject save, SaveCallback callback)
	{
		try
		{
			BeforeWrite?.Invoke(save);
		}
		catch (Exception)
		{
			Debug.Log("SaveManager::Save:: Errors were thrown in BeforeWrite event.");
			throw;
		}
		using (FileStream stream = new FileStream(GetSaveFilePath(Game.Mode), FileMode.Create, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.ReadWrite))
		{
			using StreamWriter streamWriter = new StreamWriter(stream);
			string value = save.ToString();
			streamWriter.Write(value);
		}
		Debug.LogError("Yield 4");
		yield return 0f;
		int result = 0;
		callback(result);
		Debug.LogError("Yield 5");
		yield return 0f;
		GC.Collect();
		Debug.LogError("Garbage collect finished");
	}

	public static IEnumerator<float> GenerateSave_Sequence(Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject save, Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject persistent)
	{
		try
		{
			PreSave?.Invoke();
		}
		catch (Exception)
		{
			Debug.Log("SaveManager::Save:: Errors were thrown in PreSave event.");
			throw;
		}
		PlayerRegistry.Save();
		try
		{
			PreSave?.Invoke();
		}
		catch (Exception ex2)
		{
			Debug.Log("SaveManager::Save:: Errors were thrown in PreSave event.\n\n" + ex2);
		}
		Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject data = PlayerRegistry.Save();
		persistent.AddField("PlayerRegistry", data);
		(from behaviour in UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsOfType<MonoBehaviour>()
			where behaviour is IPersistentSaveable
			orderby !(behaviour is StrandedWorld)
			select behaviour).Cast<IPersistentSaveable>().ToList().ForEach((IPersistentSaveable saveable) =>
		{
			Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject jObject2 = SavingUtilities.Save(saveable);
			if (jObject2 != null)
			{
				persistent.AddField(saveable.GetType().Name, jObject2);
			}
			else
			{
				Debug.LogError("SaveManager::Save:: Error saving a persistent object.\n\nName: " + saveable.GetType().Name);
			}
		});
		save.AddField("Version", BuildInformation.BuildVersion.ToPaddedString());
		save.AddField("Persistent", persistent);
		LevelLoader.Instance?.PatchServerClientCopy(save);
		Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject jObject = SavingUtilities.Save(Options.CustomSettings);
		if (jObject != null)
		{
			save.AddField("CustomSettings", jObject);
		}
		yield return 0f;
	}

	public static bool SaveToFile(string path, Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject rootData)
	{
		if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))
		{
			Debug.LogError("Path is null or empty!");
			return false;
		}
		if (rootData == null || rootData.IsNull())
		{
			Debug.LogError("Root data is null or empty!");
			return false;
		}
		try
		{
			using FileStream stream = new FileStream(path, FileMode.Create, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.ReadWrite);
			using StreamWriter streamWriter = new StreamWriter(stream);
			streamWriter.Write(rootData.ToString());
			return true;
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			Debug.Log("SaveManager:: Error saving progress:\n\n" + ex);
		}
		return false;
	}

	public static void Save(GameMode mode, Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject save)
	{
		SaveToFile(GetSaveFilePath(mode), save);
	}

	public static bool ChangeCurrentSlot(int slotID)
	{
		Debug.Log("SaveManager:: Selecting slot " + slotID);
		int lastSaveSlotUsed = Options.GeneralSettings.LastSaveSlotUsed;
		Options.GeneralSettings.LastSaveSlotUsed = slotID;
		string slotFolderName = FilePath.GetSlotFolderName(slotID);
		FilePath.WORLD_FOLDER = PathTools.Combine(FilePath.SAVE_FOLDER, slotFolderName, "World");
		FilePath.HEIGHTMAPS_FOLDER = PathTools.Combine(FilePath.SAVE_FOLDER, slotFolderName, "Heightmaps");
		return lastSaveSlotUsed != slotID;
	}

	private static void ReplicateSaveErrorDialogue(IPlayer invokingPlayer, int resultCode)
	{
		if (invokingPlayer.Id == PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.Id)
		{
			UpdateSavingSpinner(active: false);
			int pId = invokingPlayer.Id;
			int prevMap = invokingPlayer.Input.GetCurrentMapId();
			invokingPlayer.Input.GetOtherPlayers().DisableMaps();
			invokingPlayer.Input.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: false, prevMap);
			invokingPlayer.Input.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: true, 16);
			invokingPlayer.Input.SetCursorEnabled(enabled: true);
			string prettyResultMsg = resultCode.GetPrettyResultMsg("SAVE_DB_ERROR_SAVING_DESC");
			DialogueBox.Show(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.Input, "SAVE_DB_ERROR_TITLE", prettyResultMsg, DialogueButton.Ok, DialogueIcon.Warning).Accept += () =>
			{
				IPlayer playerFromId = PlayerUtilities.GetPlayerFromId(pId);
				playerFromId.Input.GetOtherPlayers().RestoreMapsEnabled();
				playerFromId.Input.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: false, 16);
				playerFromId.Input.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: true, prevMap);
				playerFromId.Input.SetCursorEnabled(enabled: false);
			};
		}
		else if (Game.Mode.IsServer())
		{
			ReplicateSaveErrorDialogueMsg replicateSaveErrorDialogueMsg = new ReplicateSaveErrorDialogueMsg();
			replicateSaveErrorDialogueMsg.InvokingPlayer = invokingPlayer;
			replicateSaveErrorDialogueMsg.ResultCode = resultCode;
			replicateSaveErrorDialogueMsg.Post();
		}
	}

	public static CoroutineHandle SaveInternal(IPlayer player, SaveCallback callback)
	{
		return Save(player, callback);
	}
}

	public Vector2 AfsSpecFade = new Vector2(30f, 10f);

	public Texture TerrainFoliageNrmSpecMap;

	private void afsSyncFrequencies()
	{
		temp_WindFrequency = WindFrequency;
		temp_WindJitterFrequency = WindJitterFrequencyForGrassshader;
		domainTime_Wind = 0f;
		domainTime_2ndBending = 0f;
		domainTime_Grass = 0f;
	}

	private void afsCheckColorSpace()
	{
	}

	private void afsLightingSettings()
	{
		if (DirectionalLightReference != null)
		{
			DirectlightDir = DirectionalLightReference.transform.forward;
			if (Sunlight == null)
			{
				Sunlight = DirectionalLightReference.GetComponent<Light>();
			}
			if (!Sunlight.enabled)
			{
				Shader.SetGlobalVector("_AfsDirectSunDir", new Vector4(0f, 0f, 0f, 0f));
			}
			else
			{
				SunLightCol = new Vector3(Sunlight.color.r, Sunlight.color.g, Sunlight.color.b) * Sunlight.intensity;
				SunLuminance = Vector3.Dot(SunLightCol, new Vector3(0.22f, 0.707f, 0.071f));
				Shader.SetGlobalVector("_AfsDirectSunDir", new Vector4(DirectlightDir.x, DirectlightDir.y, DirectlightDir.z, SunLuminance));
				Shader.SetGlobalVector("_AfsDirectSunCol", SunLightCol);
			}
		}
		else
		{
			Shader.SetGlobalVector("_AfsDirectSunDir", new Vector4(0f, 0f, 0f, 0f));
			Shader.SetGlobalVector("_AfsDirectSunCol", new Vector3(0f, 0f, 0f));
		}
		UpdateLightingForClassicBillboards();
		Shader.SetGlobalVector("_AfsSpecFade", new Vector4(AfsSpecFade.x, AfsSpecFade.y, 1f, 1f));
		if (GrassApproxTrans)
		{
			Shader.EnableKeyword("_AFS_GRASS_APPROXTRANS");
		}
		else
		{
			Shader.DisableKeyword("_AFS_GRASS_APPROXTRANS");
		}
	}

	private void afsFogSettings()
	{
		if (disableFoginShader)
		{
			Shader.EnableKeyword("_AFS_DEFERRED");
		}
		else
		{
			Shader.DisableKeyword("_AFS_DEFERRED");
		}
	}

	private void afsSetupGrassShader()
	{
		if (Application.isPlaying || AllGrassObjectsCombined)
		{
			Shader.DisableKeyword("IN_EDITMODE");
			Shader.EnableKeyword("IN_PLAYMODE");
		}
		else
		{
			Shader.DisableKeyword("IN_PLAYMODE");
			Shader.EnableKeyword("IN_EDITMODE");
		}
	}

	private void afsSetupTerrainEngine()
	{
		Shader.SetGlobalFloat("_AfsAlphaCutOff", VertexLitAlphaCutOff);
		Shader.SetGlobalFloat("_AfsTranslucencyViewDependency", VertexLitTranslucencyViewDependency);
		Shader.SetGlobalFloat("_AfsShadowStrength", VertexLitShadowStrength);
		Shader.SetGlobalColor("_AfsTranslucencyColor", VertexLitTranslucencyColor);
		if (isLinear)
		{
			Shader.SetGlobalColor("_AfsSpecularReflectivity", VertexLitSpecularReflectivity.linear);
		}
		else
		{
			Shader.SetGlobalColor("_AfsSpecularReflectivity", VertexLitSpecularReflectivity);
		}
		if (TerrainFoliageNrmSpecMap != null)
		{
			Shader.SetGlobalTexture("_TerrianBumpTransSpecMap", TerrainFoliageNrmSpecMap);
		}
		else
		{
			Shader.SetGlobalTexture("_TerrianBumpTransSpecMap", null);
		}
	}

	private void afsUpdateWind()
	{
		if (SyncWindDir)
		{
			Wind = new Vector4(transform.forward.x, transform.forward.y, transform.forward.z, Wind.w);
		}
		TempWind = Wind;
		TempWind.w *= 2f;
		Shader.SetGlobalVector("_Wind", TempWind);
		Shader.SetGlobalFloat("_WindFrequency", WindFrequency);
		domainTime_Wind += temp_WindFrequency * Time.deltaTime * 2f;
		domainTime_2ndBending += Time.deltaTime;
		Shader.SetGlobalVector("_AfsTimeFrequency", new Vector4(domainTime_Wind, domainTime_2ndBending, 0.375f * (1f + temp_WindFrequency * LeafTurbulenceFoliageShader), 0.193f * (1f + temp_WindFrequency * LeafTurbulenceFoliageShader)));
		temp_WindFrequency = Mathf.MoveTowards(temp_WindFrequency, WindFrequency, freqSpeed);
		SinusWave = Mathf.Sin(domainTime_Wind);
		TriangleWaves = SmoothTriangleWave(new Vector4(SinusWave, SinusWave * 0.8f, 0f, 0f));
		Oscillation = TriangleWaves.x + TriangleWaves.y * TriangleWaves.y;
		Oscillation = (Oscillation + 8f) * 0.125f * TempWind.w;
		TempWind.x *= Oscillation;
		TempWind.z *= Oscillation;
		Shader.SetGlobalFloat("_AfsWaveSize", 0.5f / WaveSizeFoliageShader);
		Shader.SetGlobalFloat("_AfsWindJitterScale", WindJitterScaleForGrassshader * 10f);
		Shader.SetGlobalVector("_AfsGrassWind", TempWind * WindMultiplierForGrassshader);
		domainTime_Grass += temp_WindJitterFrequency * Time.deltaTime;
		temp_WindJitterFrequency = Mathf.MoveTowards(temp_WindJitterFrequency, WindJitterFrequencyForGrassshader, freqSpeed);
		GrassWindSpeed = domainTime_Grass * 0.1f;
		Shader.SetGlobalVector("_AfsWaveAndDistance", new Vector4(GrassWindSpeed, WaveSizeForGrassshader, TempWind.w, DetailDistanceForGrassShader * DetailDistanceForGrassShader));
		Shader.SetGlobalVector("_AFSWindMuliplier", WindMuliplierForTreeShader);
	}

	private void afsUpdateRain()
	{
	}

	private void afsAutoSyncToTerrain()
	{
		if (AutoSyncToTerrain && SyncedTerrain != null)
		{
			DetailDistanceForGrassShader = SyncedTerrain.detailObjectDistance;
			BillboardStart = SyncedTerrain.treeBillboardDistance;
			if (Application.isPlaying && !TreeBillboardShadows)
			{
				BillboardFadeLenght = SyncedTerrain.treeCrossFadeLength;
			}
			GrassWavingTint = SyncedTerrain.terrainData.wavingGrassTint;
		}
	}

	private void afsUpdateGrassTreesBillboards()
	{
		Shader.SetGlobalColor("_AfsWavingTint", GrassWavingTint);
		Shader.SetGlobalColor("_AfsTreeColor", AFSTreeColor);
		Shader.SetGlobalVector("_AfsTerrainTrees", new Vector4(BillboardStart, BillboardFadeLenght, BillboardFadeOutLength, 0f));
		if (BillboardAdjustToCamera)
		{
			if ((bool)Camera.main)
			{
				MainCam = Camera.main;
				CameraForward = MainCam.transform.forward;
				ShadowCameraForward = CameraForward;
				rollingX = MainCam.transform.eulerAngles.x;
				if (rollingX >= 270f)
				{
					rollingX -= 270f;
					rollingX = 90f - rollingX;
					rollingXShadow = rollingX;
				}
				else
				{
					rollingXShadow = 0f - rollingX;
					if (rollingX > BillboardAngleLimit)
					{
						rollingX = Mathf.Lerp(rollingX, 0f, rollingX / BillboardAngleLimit - 1f);
					}
					rollingX *= -1f;
				}
			}
		}
		else
		{
			rollingX = 0f;
			rollingXShadow = 0f;
		}
		CameraForward *= rollingX / 90f;
		ShadowCameraForward *= rollingXShadow / 90f;
		Shader.SetGlobalVector("_AfsBillboardCameraForward", new Vector4(CameraForward.x, CameraForward.y, CameraForward.z, 1f));
		Shader.SetGlobalVector("_AfsBillboardShadowCameraForward", new Vector4(ShadowCameraForward.x, ShadowCameraForward.y, ShadowCameraForward.z, 1f));
	}

	private void afsSetupCameraLayerCulling()
	{
		if (EnableCameraLayerCulling)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Camera.allCameras.Length; i++)
			{
				float[] array = new float[32];
				array = Camera.allCameras[i].layerCullDistances;
				array[8] = SmallDetailsDistance;
				array[9] = MediumDetailsDistance;
				Camera.allCameras[i].layerCullDistances = array;
				array = null;
			}
		}
	}

	private void UpdateLightingForClassicBillboards()
	{
		if (RenderSettings.ambientMode == AmbientMode.Skybox)
		{
			AmbientLightingSH = true;
			UdpateSHLightingforBillboards();
			Shader.EnableKeyword("AFS_SH_AMBIENT");
			Shader.DisableKeyword("AFS_COLOR_AMBIENT");
			Shader.DisableKeyword("AFS_GRADIENT_AMBIENT");
		}
		else if (RenderSettings.ambientMode == AmbientMode.Trilight)
		{
			AmbientLightingSH = false;
			if (isLinear)
			{
				Shader.SetGlobalColor("_AfsSkyColor", RenderSettings.ambientSkyColor.linear);
				Shader.SetGlobalColor("_AfsGroundColor", RenderSettings.ambientGroundColor.linear);
				Shader.SetGlobalColor("_AfsEquatorColor", RenderSettings.ambientEquatorColor.linear);
			}
			else
			{
				Shader.SetGlobalColor("_AfsSkyColor", RenderSettings.ambientSkyColor);
				Shader.SetGlobalColor("_AfsGroundColor", RenderSettings.ambientGroundColor);
				Shader.SetGlobalColor("_AfsEquatorColor", RenderSettings.ambientEquatorColor);
			}
			Shader.DisableKeyword("AFS_SH_AMBIENT");
			Shader.DisableKeyword("AFS_COLOR_AMBIENT");
			Shader.EnableKeyword("AFS_GRADIENT_AMBIENT");
		}
		else if (RenderSettings.ambientMode == AmbientMode.Flat)
		{
			AmbientLightingSH = false;
			Shader.SetGlobalVector("_AfsAmbientColor", RenderSettings.ambientLight);
			Shader.DisableKeyword("AFS_SH_AMBIENT");
			Shader.EnableKeyword("AFS_COLOR_AMBIENT");
			Shader.DisableKeyword("AFS_GRADIENT_AMBIENT");
		}
	}

	private void UdpateSHLightingforBillboards()
	{
		fLight[0].x = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[0, 0];
		fLight[0].y = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[1, 0];
		fLight[0].z = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[2, 0];
		fLight[1].x = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[0, 1];
		fLight[1].y = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[1, 1];
		fLight[1].z = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[2, 1];
		fLight[2].x = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[0, 2];
		fLight[2].y = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[1, 2];
		fLight[2].z = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[2, 2];
		fLight[3].x = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[0, 3];
		fLight[3].y = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[1, 3];
		fLight[3].z = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[2, 3];
		fLight[4].x = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[0, 4];
		fLight[4].y = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[1, 4];
		fLight[4].z = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[2, 4];
		fLight[5].x = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[0, 5];
		fLight[5].y = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[1, 5];
		fLight[5].z = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[2, 5];
		fLight[6].x = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[0, 6];
		fLight[6].y = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[1, 6];
		fLight[6].z = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[2, 6];
		fLight[7].x = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[0, 7];
		fLight[7].y = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[1, 7];
		fLight[7].z = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[2, 7];
		fLight[8].x = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[0, 8];
		fLight[8].y = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[1, 8];
		fLight[8].z = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[2, 8];
		float num = 3.5449078f;
		float num2 = 1f / (2f * num);
		float num3 = Mathf.Sqrt(3f) / (3f * num);
		float num4 = Mathf.Sqrt(15f) / (8f * num);
		float num5 = Mathf.Sqrt(5f) / (16f * num);
		float num6 = 0.5f * num4;
		for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
		{
			vCoeff[i].x = (0f - num3) * fLight[3][i];
			vCoeff[i].y = (0f - num3) * fLight[1][i];
			vCoeff[i].z = num3 * fLight[2][i];
			vCoeff[i].w = num2 * fLight[0][i] - num5 * fLight[6][i];
		}
		Shader.SetGlobalVector("afs_SHAr", vCoeff[0] * RenderSettings.ambientIntensity);
		Shader.SetGlobalVector("afs_SHAg", vCoeff[1] * RenderSettings.ambientIntensity);
		Shader.SetGlobalVector("afs_SHAb", vCoeff[2] * RenderSettings.ambientIntensity);
		for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
		{
			vCoeff[i].x = num4 * fLight[4][i];
			vCoeff[i].y = (0f - num4) * fLight[5][i];
			vCoeff[i].z = 3f * num5 * fLight[6][i];
			vCoeff[i].w = (0f - num4) * fLight[7][i];
		}
		Shader.SetGlobalVector("afs_SHBr", vCoeff[0] * RenderSettings.ambientIntensity);
		Shader.SetGlobalVector("afs_SHBg", vCoeff[1] * RenderSettings.ambientIntensity);
		Shader.SetGlobalVector("afs_SHBb", vCoeff[2] * RenderSettings.ambientIntensity);
		vCoeff[0].x = num6 * fLight[8][0];
		vCoeff[0].y = num6 * fLight[8][1];
		vCoeff[0].z = num6 * fLight[8][2];
		vCoeff[0].w = 1f;
		Shader.SetGlobalVector("afs_SHC", vCoeff[0] * RenderSettings.ambientIntensity);
	}

	private Color Desaturate(float r, float g, float b)
	{
		float num = 0.3f * r + 0.59f * g + 0.11f * b;
		r = num * BillboardAmbientLightDesaturationFactor + r * (1f - BillboardAmbientLightDesaturationFactor);
		g = num * BillboardAmbientLightDesaturationFactor + g * (1f - BillboardAmbientLightDesaturationFactor);
		b = num * BillboardAmbientLightDesaturationFactor + b * (1f - BillboardAmbientLightDesaturationFactor);
		return new Color(r, g, b, 1f);
	}

	private float CubicSmooth(float x)
	{
		return x * x * (3f - 2f * x);
	}

	private float TriangleWave(float x)
	{
		return Mathf.Abs((x + 0.5f) % 1f * 2f - 1f);
	}

	private float SmoothTriangleWave(float x)
	{
		return CubicSmooth(TriangleWave(x));
	}

	private Vector4 CubicSmooth(Vector4 x)
	{
		x = Vector4.Scale(x, x);
		x = Vector4.Scale(x, new Vector4(3f, 3f, 3f, 3f) - 2f * x);
		return x;
	}

	private Vector4 TriangleWave(Vector4 x)
	{
		x = (x + new Vector4(0.5f, 0.5f, 0.5f, 0.5f)) * 2f - new Vector4(1f, 1f, 1f, 1f);
		return AbsVecFour(x);
	}

	private Vector4 SmoothTriangleWave(Vector4 x)
	{
		return CubicSmooth(TriangleWave(x));
	}

	private Vector4 FracVecFour(Vector4 a)
	{
		a.x %= 1f;
		a.y %= 1f;
		a.z %= 1f;
		a.w %= 1f;
		return a;
	}

	private Vector4 AbsVecFour(Vector4 a)
	{
		a.x = Mathf.Abs(a.x);
		a.y = Mathf.Abs(a.y);
		a.z = Mathf.Abs(a.z);
		a.w = Mathf.Abs(a.w);
		return a;
	}
}

using Beam;
using Beam.Utilities;
using Funlabs;
using UnityEngine;

public class ShippingContainerSpawner : MonoBehaviour, IGenerationObject
{
	[SerializeField]
	private ShippingContainer[] _shippingContainers;

	[SerializeField]
	private GameObject _containerDoor;

	[SerializeField]
	private GameObject _containerWall;

	private void Start()
	{
		GenerateShippingContainer();
	}

	private ShippingContainer GetShippingContainer(int index)
	{
		if (index < 0 || index >= _shippingContainers.Length)
		{
			return null;
		}
		return _shippingContainers[index];
	}

	private void GenerateShippingContainer()
	{
		try
		{
			int num = Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.GenerateLocalSeed(transform.position).Next(_shippingContainers.Length);
			ShippingContainer shippingContainer = GetShippingContainer(num);
			if (shippingContainer.IsNullOrDestroyed())
			{
				return;
			}
			GameObject gameObject = Object.Instantiate(shippingContainer.gameObject, transform.position, transform.localRotation);
			gameObject.transform.parent = transform.parent;
			MiniGuid other = MiniGuid.NewFrom(transform.position, MiniGuid.CONTAINER_PREFAB_ID_PLACE_HOLDER, (ushort)num);
			if (gameObject.TryGetComponent<ISaveablePrefab>(out var component))
			{
				MiniGuid miniGuid = (component.ReferenceId = MiniGuid.NewFrom(transform.position, component.PrefabId, (ushort)num));
				other = miniGuid;
			}
			ShippingContainer component2 = gameObject.GetComponent<ShippingContainer>();
			for (int i = 0; i < component2.PanelPositions.Length; i++)
			{
				GameObject gameObject2 = Object.Instantiate((i == 0) ? _containerDoor : _containerWall, component2.PanelPositions[i].position, Quaternion.identity);
				gameObject2.transform.rotation = Quaternion.LookRotation(component2.PanelPositions[i].forward, component2.PanelPositions[i].up);
				if (gameObject2.TryGetComponent<ISaveablePrefab>(out var component3))
				{
					component3.ReferenceId = MiniGuid.NewFrom(other, i + 1);
				}
			}
		}
		finally
		{
			Object.Destroy(base.gameObject);
		}
	}
}

	private Dictionary<string, JObject> _zoneSavedObjectsLookup = new Dictionary<string, JObject>();

	private Vector3 _playerPosition;

	[SerializeField]
	private Zone _zonePrefab;

	[SerializeField]
	private Transform _zoneContainer;

	public static int WORLD_SEED
	{
		get
		{
			if (!Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
			{
				return LOCAL_WORLD_SEED;
			}
			return PlayerRegistry.ServerPeer.WorldSeed;
		}
	}

	public Zone[] Zones => _zones;

	public Zone NmlZone => _nmlZone;

	public ZoneLoader ZoneLoader => _zoneLoader;

	public int ShelterCount { get; private set; }

	public event EmptyEventHandler WorldGenerated;

	public event Action<Zone> ZoneEntered;

	public Transform GetParent()
	{
		GameState state = Game.State;
		if ((uint)(state - 2) <= 1u)
		{
			return _nmlZone.SaveContainer;
		}
		return null;
	}

	public JObject GetZoneData(Zone zone)
	{
		JObject value = null;
		_zoneSavedObjectsLookup.TryGetValue(zone.gameObject.name, out value);
		return value;
	}

	public float GetHeight(Vector3 worldPosition)
	{
		Zone zone = GetZone(worldPosition);
		if (zone?.Terrain == null)
		{
			return -100f;
		}
		return zone.Terrain.SampleHeight(worldPosition) + -100f;
	}

	public Vector3 GetPoint(Vector3 worldPosition)
	{
		Vector3 result = worldPosition;
		Zone zone = GetZone(worldPosition);
		if (zone?.Terrain == null)
		{
			result.y = -100f;
			return result;
		}
		result.y = zone.Terrain.SampleHeight(worldPosition) + -100f;
		return result;
	}

	public Vector3 GetNormal(Vector3 worldPosition)
	{
		Zone zone = GetZone(worldPosition);
		if (zone?.Terrain == null)
		{
			return Vector3.up;
		}
		Vector3 vector = worldPosition - zone.Terrain.transform.position;
		return zone.Terrain.terrainData.GetInterpolatedNormal(Mathf.InverseLerp(0f, zone.Terrain.terrainData.size.x, vector.x), Mathf.InverseLerp(0f, zone.Terrain.terrainData.size.z, vector.z));
	}

	public bool InBounds(Vector3 worldPosition)
	{
		Zone zone = GetZone(worldPosition);
		if (zone == null)
		{
			return false;
		}
		return zone.InSaveBounds(worldPosition);
	}

	public static Zone GetZone(Vector3 worldPosition, bool fallbackToNml = false)
	{
		Zone zone = Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance?.GetZone_(worldPosition);
		if (!fallbackToNml)
		{
			return zone;
		}
		Zone zone2 = zone;
		if ((object)zone2 == null)
		{
			StrandedWorld instance = Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance;
			if ((object)instance == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			zone2 = instance._nmlZone;
		}
		return zone2;
	}

	public int GetZoneId(Zone zone)
	{
		if (null == zone)
		{
			return -1;
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < Zones.Length; i++)
		{
			if (zone == Zones[i])
			{
				return i;
			}
		}
		return -1;
	}

	private Zone GetZone_(Vector3 worldPosition)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < Zones.Length; i++)
		{
			Zone zone = Zones[i];
			if (zone.InBounds(worldPosition))
			{
				return zone;
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	public static Zone.BiomeType GetBiome(Vector3 worldPosition)
	{
		return Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance?.GetBiome_(worldPosition) ?? Zone.BiomeType.RANDOM;
	}

	private Zone.BiomeType GetBiome_(Vector3 worldPosition)
	{
		return GetZone_(worldPosition)?.Biome ?? Zone.BiomeType.RANDOM;
	}

	protected void OnWorldGenerated()
	{
		WorldGenerated?.Invoke();
	}

	protected void OnZoneEntered(Zone zone)
	{
		ZoneEntered?.Invoke(zone);
	}

	private void Awake()
	{
		EventManager.AddListener<ZoneDownloadedEvent>(OnZoneDownloaded);
	}

	private void LoadZonePositions()
	{
		if (World.GenerationZonePositons == null)
		{
			World.CreateWorldZonePoints(WORLD_SEED);
			Debug.Log("StrandedWorld::CreateZones:: No Zone Positions Loaded - Creating New World Zone Positions");
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < 49; i++)
		{
			Vector3 zero = Vector3.zero;
			zero.x = World.GenerationZonePositons[i].x;
			zero.z = World.GenerationZonePositons[i].y;
			_zones[i].transform.position = zero;
			if (i == 0)
			{
				_zones[i].IsStartingIsland = true;
			}
		}
	}

	public float CreateWorld_Async()
	{
		return Timing.WaitUntilDone(CreateWorld());
	}

	public CoroutineHandle CreateWorld()
	{
		return Timing.RunCoroutine(CreateWorld_Sequence());
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> CreateWorld_Sequence()
	{
		if (!Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
		{
			EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent("LOADING_PROGRESS_TEXT_LOADING_WORLD"));
			yield return 0f;
			LoadWorld();
		}
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent("LOADING_PROGRESS_TEXT_LOADING_OBJECTS"));
		yield return 0f;
		LoadObjects();
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent("LOADING_PROGRESS_TEXT_LOADING_STARTING_ZONE"));
		yield return 0f;
		InitializeZones();
		int index = 0;
		Zone zone = FindClosestZone(Vector3.zero, out index);
		if (zone != null && index != -1)
		{
			JObject zoneData = GetZoneData(zone);
			if (zoneData != null)
			{
				zone.Enter();
				ZoneLoader.EObjectProcessingMode mode = _zoneLoader.ObjectProcessingMode;
				_zoneLoader.ObjectProcessingMode = ZoneLoader.EObjectProcessingMode.Faster;
				JObject field = zoneData.GetField("Objects");
				if (field != null && !field.IsNull())
				{
					zone.LoadImpostors(field);
					yield return _zoneLoader.LoadZone_Async(zone, zoneData);
				}
				else
				{
					_zoneLoader.GenerateZone(zone);
					zone.CreateImpostors();
					yield return _zoneLoader.CreateZoneObjects_Async(zone, index);
				}
				_zoneLoader.ObjectProcessingMode = mode;
			}
			else
			{
				Debug.LogError("StrandedWorld::LoadAsync:: Something went wrong. No starting zone data was found.");
			}
		}
		else
		{
			Debug.LogError("StrandedWorld::LoadAsync:: Something went wrong. No starting zone was found.");
		}
		Initialize_shelterTypes();
		SetShelterOnZones();
		SetSheltersOnWorldZones();
		OnWorldGenerated();
		OnZoneEntered(zone);
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new AddStatsEvent(0, new Stats
		{
			IslandsExplored = 1
		}));
		SubscribeToZoneLoaderEvents();
		InvokeRepeating("PollZones", 0f, 0.3f);
	}

	private void SubscribeToZoneLoaderEvents()
	{
		_zoneLoader.CreatedZone += ZoneLoader_LoadedZone;
		_zoneLoader.LoadedZone += ZoneLoader_LoadedZone;
	}

	private void UnsubscribeFromZoneLoaderEvents()
	{
		if (_zoneLoader != null)
		{
			_zoneLoader.CreatedZone -= ZoneLoader_LoadedZone;
			_zoneLoader.LoadedZone -= ZoneLoader_LoadedZone;
		}
	}

	private void ZoneLoader_LoadedZone(Zone zone)
	{
		if (zone.Biome != Zone.BiomeType.MISSION)
		{
			EventManager.RaiseEvent(new AddStatsEvent(0, new Stats
			{
				IslandsHopped = 1
			}));
			if (!zone.HasVisited)
			{
				EventManager.RaiseEvent(new AddStatsEvent(0, new Stats
				{
					IslandsExplored = 1
				}));
			}
		}
	}

	protected override void OnDestroy()
	{
		UnsubscribeFromZoneLoaderEvents();
		WorldGenerated = null;
		ZoneEntered = null;
		EventManager.RemoveListener<ZoneDownloadedEvent>(OnZoneDownloaded);
		base.OnDestroy();
	}

	private void InitializeZones()
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < Zones.Length; i++)
		{
			Zone zone = Zones[i];
			zone.gameObject.SetActive(value: true);
			zone.Terrain.heightmapPixelError = 75f;
			zone.Terrain.basemapDistance = 180f;
			GetZoneData(zone)?.IsNull();
		}
	}

	private void LoadWorld()
	{
		LoadingResult loadingResult = World.LoadWorld();
		if (loadingResult.Succeeded)
		{
			ApplyWorldToZones();
		}
		else
		{
			Debug.LogError("StrandedWorld:: Error loading world: " + loadingResult.Message);
		}
	}

	public void ApplyWorldToZones()
	{
		LoadZonePositions();
		for (int i = 0; i < 49; i++)
		{
			Zone zone = Zones[i];
			Map map = World.MapList[i];
			zone.Terrain.terrainData.SetHeights(0, 0, map.HeightmapData);
			zone.ZoneName = map.EditorData.Name;
			zone.Id = map.EditorData.Id;
			zone.Version = map.EditorData.VersionNumber;
			zone.Biome = map.EditorData.Biome;
			zone.IsMapEditor = map.IsCustomMap();
			zone.IsUserMap = map.IsUserMap();
			zone.Seed = i;
			Texture2D height = WorldTools.CreateHeightMapTexture(zone.Terrain.terrainData);
			Texture2D shore = WorldTools.CreateShoreMaskTexture(zone.Terrain.terrainData);
			if (zone.Biome == Zone.BiomeType.ISLAND || zone.Biome == Zone.BiomeType.ISLAND_SMALL || zone.Biome == Zone.BiomeType.ISLAND_ROCK || zone.Biome == Zone.BiomeType.CARRIER)
			{
				zone.WaveOverlay = AddWaveOverlay(zone.gameObject, height, shore);
			}
			zone.SaveContainer.transform.SetAsLastSibling();
		}
	}

	private void LoadObjects(JObject rootData = null)
	{
		_zoneSavedObjectsLookup.Clear();
		if (Game.State == GameState.LOAD_GAME)
		{
			rootData = rootData ?? SaveManager.LoadSaveFile(Game.Mode);
			JObject persistentData = SaveManager.GetPersistentData(rootData);
			if (persistentData == null || persistentData.IsNull())
			{
				return;
			}
			JObject field = persistentData.GetField("StrandedWorld");
			if (field == null || field.IsNull())
			{
				Debug.LogError("StrandedWorld data is null or empty.");
				return;
			}
			JObject field2 = field.GetField("Zones");
			if (field2 == null || field2.IsNull())
			{
				Debug.LogError("Zones data is null or empty.");
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < 49; i++)
			{
				Zone zone = Zones[i];
				Map map = World.MapList[i];
				JObject jObject = field2.Children[i];
				string value = jObject.GetField("Id").GetValue<string>();
				int value2 = jObject.GetField("Version").GetValue<int>();
				if (map.EditorData.Id != value || map.EditorData.VersionNumber != value2)
				{
					JObject jObject2 = new JObject();
					jObject2.AddField("Name", map.EditorData.Name);
					jObject2.AddField("Id", map.EditorData.Id);
					jObject2.AddField("Version", map.EditorData.VersionNumber);
					if (map.IsCustomMap())
					{
						jObject2.AddField("Objects", map.ObjectData);
					}
					jObject = jObject2;
				}
				JObject field3 = jObject.GetField("Discovered");
				if (field3 != null)
				{
					bool value3 = field3.GetValue<bool>();
					zone.HasVisited = value3;
				}
				JObject field4 = jObject.GetField("Attributes");
				if (field4 != null)
				{
					SavingUtilities.Load(zone.Attributes, field4);
				}
				JObject field5 = jObject.GetField("Objects");
				if (field5 != null && !field5.IsNull())
				{
					zone.HasObjectsForBillboard = true;
				}
				_zoneSavedObjectsLookup.Add(zone.gameObject.name, jObject);
			}
			JObject jObject3 = field2.GetZoneData(_nmlZone.Id);
			if (jObject3 == null || jObject3.IsNull())
			{
				Debug.Log("No NML data. Recreating...");
				JObject jObject4 = new JObject();
				jObject4.AddField("Name", _nmlZone.gameObject.name);
				jObject4.AddField("Id", _nmlZone.Id);
				jObject4.AddField("Version", _nmlZone.Version);
				jObject4.AddField("Discovered", instance: false);
				jObject4.AddField("Objects", (JObject)null);
				jObject3 = jObject4;
			}
			_zoneSavedObjectsLookup.Add(_nmlZone.gameObject.name, jObject3);
			LoadShelterData(field);
		}
		else
		{
			if (Game.State != GameState.NEW_GAME)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < 49; j++)
			{
				Zone zone2 = Zones[j];
				Map map2 = World.MapList[j];
				JObject jObject5 = new JObject();
				jObject5.AddField("Name", map2.EditorData.Name);
				jObject5.AddField("Id", map2.EditorData.Id);
				jObject5.AddField("Version", map2.EditorData.VersionNumber);
				if (map2.IsCustomMap())
				{
					jObject5.AddField("Objects", map2.ObjectData);
					zone2.HasObjectsForBillboard = true;
				}
				_zoneSavedObjectsLookup.Add(zone2.gameObject.name, jObject5);
			}
		}
	}

	private void LoadShelterData(JObject strandedWorldData)
	{
		int[] array = new int[3] { -1, -1, -1 };
		int[] array2 = new int[3] { -1, -1, -1 };
		int num = -1;
		JObject field = strandedWorldData.GetField("Shelters");
		if (field != null)
		{
			JObject jObject = null;
			for (int i = 1; i < 4; i++)
			{
				int num2 = -1;
				int num3 = -1;
				jObject = field.GetField("Shelter" + i);
				if (jObject != null)
				{
					num2 = jObject.GetValue<int>();
				}
				jObject = field.GetField("Shelter" + i + "_zone");
				if (jObject != null)
				{
					num3 = jObject.GetValue<int>();
				}
				if (num2 == -1 || num3 == -1)
				{
					Debug.LogError("Load: Shelter " + i + "Data Not Found. Possible Old Save.");
					continue;
				}
				array[i - 1] = num2;
				array2[i - 1] = num3;
			}
			jObject = field.GetField("Wollie");
			if (jObject != null)
			{
				num = jObject.GetValue<int>();
			}
			if (num == -1)
			{
				Debug.LogError("Load: Wollie Data Not Found. Possible Old Save.");
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < _shelters.Length; j++)
			{
				int num4 = array2[j];
				_shelters[j] = array[j];
				if (_shelters[j] != -1)
				{
					Zones[num4].HasShelter = true;
					Zones[num4].ShelterType = _shelters[j];
				}
			}
			if (num != -1)
			{
				Zones[num].HasWollie = true;
			}
		}
		else
		{
			Debug.LogError("StrandedWorld::Load: Old Save Detected. Shelter Data not found.");
		}
	}

	private void PollZones()
	{
		if (PlayerRegistry.AllPeers.Count == 0 || LevelLoader.IsServerJoinInProgress)
		{
			return;
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < Zones.Length; i++)
		{
			Zone zone = Zones[i];
			bool active = PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers.Any_NonAlloc(InImpostorViewRange, zone);
			zone.Terrain.gameObject.SetActive(active);
			PollImposters(zone);
			if (!PollUnload(zone))
			{
				PollLoad(zone);
			}
		}
	}

	private void PollImposters(Zone zone)
	{
		if (zone.Loading || zone.Loaded)
		{
			return;
		}
		if (!zone.Billboarding)
		{
			if (!PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers.Any_NonAlloc(InImpostorLoadingRange, zone))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (zone.HasObjectsForBillboard)
			{
				JObject field = GetZoneData(zone).GetField("Objects");
				if (field != null && !field.IsNull())
				{
					zone.LoadImpostors(field);
				}
			}
			else if (_zoneLoader.GenerateZone(zone))
			{
				zone.CreateImpostors();
			}
		}
		else if (zone.Billboarding && !PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers.Any_NonAlloc(InImpostorViewRange, zone))
		{
			zone.ReleaseImpostors();
		}
	}

	private void PollZone(Zone zone)
	{
		PollUnload(zone);
	}

	private bool PollUnload(Zone zone)
	{
		if ((zone.Loading || zone.Loaded) && !PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers.Any_NonAlloc(InZoneUnLoadingBounds, zone))
		{
			if (zone.Loading)
			{
				_zoneLoader.AbortLoadingZone(zone);
			}
			else
			{
				SaveZone(zone);
				if (Game.Mode.IsServer())
				{
					MultiplayerZoneSync.Instance?.SendZone((byte)GetZoneId(zone), _zoneSavedObjectsLookup[zone.gameObject.name]);
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	private bool PollLoad(Zone zone)
	{
		if (!zone.Loading && !zone.Loaded && PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers.Any_NonAlloc(InZoneLoadingBounds, zone))
		{
			OnZoneEntered(zone);
			LoadZone(zone);
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	private void SaveZone(Zone zone, bool destroy = true, bool hardSave = false, bool handleOufOfGameBounds4SaveDynamicContainer = true)
	{
		bool flag = zone.Id == _nmlZone.Id;
		float timeScale = Time.timeScale;
		float fixedDeltaTime = Time.fixedDeltaTime;
		Time.fixedDeltaTime = 0f;
		Time.timeScale = 0f;
		JObject jObject = new JObject();
		JObject jObject2 = new JObject();
		SaveablePrefab[] componentsInChildren = zone.SaveContainer.GetComponentsInChildren<SaveablePrefab>(includeInactive: true);
		OrderByFurthestFromPoint(componentsInChildren, zone.transform.position);
		foreach (SaveablePrefab saveablePrefab in componentsInChildren)
		{
			if (!saveablePrefab.gameObject.activeInHierarchy || IsOutOfGameBounds(saveablePrefab.transform.position))
			{
				continue;
			}
			if (zone.InSaveBounds(saveablePrefab.transform.position))
			{
				if (Game.Mode.IsMaster())
				{
					ParentObjectToTransform(saveablePrefab, zone.SaveContainer);
					JObject jObject3 = SavingUtilities.SavePrefabToJObject(saveablePrefab);
					if (jObject3 != null)
					{
						jObject2.Add(jObject3);
					}
				}
				if (destroy)
				{
					MultiplayerMng.Destroy(saveablePrefab, DestroyDelay.NOW);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ParentObjectToTransform(saveablePrefab, _nmlZone.SaveContainer);
			}
		}
		SaveablePrefab[] array = null;
		if (!flag)
		{
			array = _nmlZone.SaveContainer.GetComponentsInChildren<SaveablePrefab>(includeInactive: true);
			foreach (SaveablePrefab saveablePrefab2 in array)
			{
				if (!saveablePrefab2.gameObject.activeInHierarchy || IsOutOfGameBounds(saveablePrefab2.transform.position) || !zone.InSaveBounds(saveablePrefab2.transform.position))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (Game.Mode.IsMaster())
				{
					ParentObjectToTransform(saveablePrefab2, zone.SaveContainer);
					JObject jObject4 = SavingUtilities.SavePrefabToJObject(saveablePrefab2);
					if (jObject4 != null)
					{
						jObject2.Add(jObject4);
					}
				}
				if (destroy)
				{
					MultiplayerMng.Destroy(saveablePrefab2, DestroyDelay.NOW);
				}
			}
		}
		if (Game.Mode.IsMaster())
		{
			try
			{
				Component[] objs = componentsInChildren;
				HandleOutOfGameBounds(objs);
				if (handleOufOfGameBounds4SaveDynamicContainer)
				{
					objs = array;
					HandleOutOfGameBounds(objs);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				Debug.LogError("Error in SaveZone.HandleOutOfGameBounds: " + ex.Message + "\n" + ex.StackTrace);
			}
			jObject.AddField("Name", zone.gameObject.name);
			jObject.AddField("Id", zone.Id);
			jObject.AddField("Version", zone.Version);
			jObject.AddField("Discovered", zone.HasVisited);
			JObject jObject5 = SavingUtilities.Save(zone.Attributes);
			if (jObject5 != null)
			{
				jObject.AddField("Attributes", jObject5);
			}
			jObject.AddField("Objects", jObject2);
			if (!_zoneSavedObjectsLookup.ContainsKey(zone.gameObject.name))
			{
				_zoneSavedObjectsLookup.Add(zone.gameObject.name, null);
			}
			_zoneSavedObjectsLookup[zone.gameObject.name] = jObject;
		}
		if (!hardSave)
		{
			zone.Exit();
			zone.HasObjectsForBillboard = true;
			zone.Loaded = false;
		}
		Time.fixedDeltaTime = fixedDeltaTime;
		Time.timeScale = timeScale;
		_lastSavePosition = zone.transform.position;
	}

	private void OnZoneDownloaded(ZoneDownloadedEvent @event)
	{
		_zoneSavedObjectsLookup[Zones[@event.ZoneId].gameObject.name] = @event.Zone;
	}

	private void LoadZone(Zone zone)
	{
		JObject jObject = _zoneSavedObjectsLookup[zone.gameObject.name];
		JObject field = jObject.GetField("Objects");
		if (field != null && !field.IsNull())
		{
			_zoneLoader.LoadZone(zone, jObject);
		}
		else
		{
			_zoneLoader.CreateZone(zone);
		}
	}

	private void Initialize_shelterTypes()
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < _shelters.Length; i++)
		{
			_shelters[i] = -1;
		}
		System.Random random = new System.Random(WORLD_SEED);
		int num = 0;
		for (int j = 0; j < _shelters.Length; j++)
		{
			int num2;
			do
			{
				num2 = random.Next(0, 8);
				for (int k = 0; k < _shelters.Length; k++)
				{
					if (num2 == _shelters[k])
					{
						num2 = -1;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			while (num2 == -1);
			_shelters[num] = num2;
			num++;
		}
	}

	private void SetShelterOnZones()
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < Zones.Length; i++)
		{
			Zones[i].HasShelter = false;
		}
		int num = CountViableMaps();
		if (num == 0)
		{
			return;
		}
		List<int> list = new List<int>(num);
		for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
		{
			int num2;
			do
			{
				num2 = _zoneLoader.Random.Next(0, Zones.Length);
			}
			while (list.Contains(num2) || !IsMapViable(num2));
			list.Add(num2);
		}
		for (int k = 0; k < list.Count; k++)
		{
			Zones[list[k]].HasShelter = true;
		}
		SetWollieOnShelterZone(list);
	}

	private bool IsMapViable(int randIndex)
	{
		if (!Zones[randIndex].IsMapEditor && !Zones[randIndex].IsStartingIsland && !Zones[randIndex].HasShelter)
		{
			return !Zones[randIndex].Id.Contains("INTERNAL_MISSION");
		}
		return false;
	}

	private int CountViableMaps()
	{
		int num = 0;
		for (int i = 0; i < Zones.Length; i++)
		{
			if (IsMapViable(i))
			{
				num++;
			}
		}
		return Math.Min(_shelters.Length, num);
	}

	private void SetSheltersOnWorldZones()
	{
		int num = 0;
		for (int i = 0; i < Zones.Length; i++)
		{
			if (Zones[i].HasShelter)
			{
				Zones[i].ShelterType = _shelters[num];
				num++;
				if (num >= _shelters.Length)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
		}
		ShelterCount = num;
	}

	private void SetWollieOnShelterZone(List<int> sheltersOnWorld)
	{
		int index = _zoneLoader.Random.Next(0, sheltersOnWorld.Count);
		Zones[sheltersOnWorld[index]].HasWollie = true;
	}

	private static void OrderByFurthestFromPoint(SaveablePrefab[] arr, Vector3 point)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < arr.Length - 1; i++)
		{
			for (int j = i + 1; j < arr.Length; j++)
			{
				SaveablePrefab saveablePrefab = arr[i];
				SaveablePrefab saveablePrefab2 = arr[j];
				if (saveablePrefab.CanReorder && saveablePrefab2.CanReorder)
				{
					float sqrMagnitude = (point - saveablePrefab.transform.position).sqrMagnitude;
					float sqrMagnitude2 = (point - saveablePrefab2.transform.position).sqrMagnitude;
					if (sqrMagnitude < sqrMagnitude2)
					{
						arr[i] = saveablePrefab2;
						arr[j] = saveablePrefab;
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	private Zone FindClosestZone(Vector3 position)
	{
		int index = 0;
		return FindClosestZone(position, out index);
	}

	private Zone FindClosestZone(Vector3 position, out int index)
	{
		index = -1;
		Zone result = null;
		float num = float.PositiveInfinity;
		for (int i = 0; i < Zones.Length; i++)
		{
			float num2 = Vector3.Distance(position, Zones[i].transform.position);
			if (num2 < num)
			{
				num = num2;
				result = Zones[i];
				index = i;
			}
		}
		return result;
	}

	private bool InZoneUnLoadingBounds(IPlayer player, Zone zone)
	{
		return Vector2.Distance(new Vector2(player.transform.position.x, player.transform.position.z), new Vector2(zone.transform.position.x, zone.transform.position.z)) < 250f;
	}

	private bool InZoneLoadingBounds(IPlayer player, Zone zone)
	{
		return Vector2.Distance(new Vector2(player.transform.position.x, player.transform.position.z), new Vector2(zone.transform.position.x, zone.transform.position.z)) < 240f;
	}

	private bool InImpostorLoadingRange(IPlayer player, Zone zone)
	{
		return Vector3Tools.SqrDistanceOnAxis(player.transform.position, zone.transform.position, Vector3Tools.xz) < 1000000f;
	}

	private bool InImpostorViewRange(IPlayer player, Zone zone)
	{
		return Vector3Tools.SqrDistanceOnAxis(player.transform.position, zone.transform.position, Vector3Tools.xz) < 1001600f;
	}

	private void ParentObjectToTransform(SaveablePrefab sp, Transform parent)
	{
		BaseObject baseObject = sp as BaseObject;
		if (baseObject != null)
		{
			if (baseObject.CanParent)
			{
				baseObject.transform.parent = null;
				baseObject.TransformParent = parent;
				baseObject.Parent();
			}
		}
		else
		{
			sp.transform.parent = parent;
		}
	}

	public static int GetRandowWorldSeed()
	{
		string text = (Environment.TickCount & 0x7FFFFFFF).ToString();
		return int.Parse(text.Substring(0, Mathf.Min(text.Length, 8)));
	}

		SetWorldSeed(0);
	}

	public static void SetWorldSeed(int seed)
	{
		if (seed == 0)
		{
			LOCAL_WORLD_SEED = GetRandowWorldSeed();
			Debug.Log("StrandedWorld::SetWorldSeed:: Random [" + LOCAL_WORLD_SEED + "]");
		}
		else
		{
			LOCAL_WORLD_SEED = seed;
			Debug.Log("StrandedWorld::SetWorldSeed:: Custom [" + LOCAL_WORLD_SEED + "]");
		}
	}

	public static void SetWorldSeed(string seedValue)
	{
		if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(seedValue))
		{
			SetWorldSeed(0);
			return;
		}
		string s = seedValue.Substring(0, Mathf.Min(seedValue.Length, 8));
		int result = 0;
		if (!int.TryParse(s, out result))
		{
			Debug.LogWarning("StrandedWorld::SetWorldSeed:: Could not parse seed value. Seed likely contains invalid characters.");
		}
		SetWorldSeed(result);
	}

	public System.Random GenerateLocalSeed(Vector3 objectPosition, int addedValue = 0)
	{
		Vector3 zero = Vector3.zero;
		Vector3 b = new Vector3(objectPosition.x, 0f, objectPosition.z);
		float num = Mathf.Atan2(b.z - zero.z, b.x - zero.x) * 180f / MathF.PI;
		int num2 = (int)Vector3.Distance(zero, b);
		addedValue++;
		return new System.Random(WORLD_SEED + ((int)num + num2) * addedValue);
	}

	public float LoadWorld_Async(JObject rootData, JObject data)
	{
		return Timing.WaitUntilDone(LoadWorld(rootData, data));
	}

	private CoroutineHandle LoadWorld(JObject rootData, JObject data)
	{
		return Timing.RunCoroutine(LoadWorld_Sequence(rootData, data));
	}

	public IEnumerator<float> LoadWorld_Sequence(JObject rootData, JObject data)
	{
		if (!Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
		{
			EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent("LOADING_PROGRESS_TEXT_LOADING_WORLD"));
			yield return 0f;
			LoadWorld();
		}
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent("LOADING_PROGRESS_TEXT_LOADING_OBJECTS"));
		yield return 0f;
		LoadObjects(rootData);
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent("LOADING_PROGRESS_TEXT_LOADING_CURRENT_ZONE"));
		yield return 0f;
		InitializeZones();
		JObject field = data.GetField("ShelterCount");
		if (field != null)
		{
			ShelterCount = field.GetValue<int>();
		}
		JObject playersData = data.GetField("PlayersData");
		Vector3 position2;
		if (playersData != null && !playersData.IsNull())
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < playersData.Children.Count; i++)
			{
				JObject field2 = playersData.Children[i].GetField("Position");
				if (field2 != null)
				{
					Vector3 position = JSerializer.Deserialize<Vector3>(field2);
					yield return LoadStartingZone(position, fallbackToNml: true);
				}
			}
		}
		else if (LegacyUtilities.LoadStrandedWorldPlayerPosition_PreCoop(data, out position2))
		{
			yield return LoadStartingZone(position2);
		}
		if (!_nmlZone.Loaded && GetZoneData(_nmlZone).IsValid())
		{
			yield return LoadStartingZone(_nmlZone);
		}
		OnWorldGenerated();
		SubscribeToZoneLoaderEvents();
		InvokeRepeating("PollZones", 0.3f, 0.3f);
		Debug.Log("StrandedWorld::LoadWorld_Sequence:: Loaded world.");
	}

	private float LoadStartingZone(Vector3 position, bool fallbackToNml = false)
	{
		Zone zone = GetZone(position, fallbackToNml);
		return LoadStartingZone(zone);
	}

	private float LoadStartingZone(Zone zone)
	{
		if (zone != null)
		{
			if (!zone.Loaded)
			{
				return Timing.WaitUntilDone(Timing.RunCoroutine(LoadStartingZone_Sequence(zone)));
			}
		}
		else
		{
			Debug.LogError("StrandedWorld::LoadStartingZone:: Something went wrong. No zone was found.");
		}
		return 0f;
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> LoadStartingZone_Sequence(Zone zone)
	{
		JObject zoneData = GetZoneData(zone);
		if (zoneData != null)
		{
			zone.Enter();
			JObject field = zoneData.GetField("Objects");
			if (field != null && !field.IsNull())
			{
				ZoneLoader.EObjectProcessingMode mode = _zoneLoader.ObjectProcessingMode;
				_zoneLoader.ObjectProcessingMode = ZoneLoader.EObjectProcessingMode.Faster;
				zone.LoadImpostors(field);
				yield return _zoneLoader.LoadZone_Async(zone, zoneData);
				OnZoneEntered(zone);
				_zoneLoader.ObjectProcessingMode = mode;
			}
			else
			{
				Debug.LogError("StrandedWorld::LoadStartingZone_Sequence:: Zone [" + zone.ZoneName + "] [Objects] field is null or empty.");
			}
		}
		else
		{
			Debug.LogError("StrandedWorld::LoadStartingZone_Sequence:: Something went wrong. Zone [" + zone.ZoneName + "] data is null or empty.");
		}
	}

	private bool IsOutOfGameBounds(Vector3 position)
	{
		if (!(position.y > 300f) && !(position.y < -25f) && !(position.x > 2500f) && !(position.x < -2500f) && !(position.z > 2500f))
		{
			return position.z < -2500f;
		}
		return true;
	}

	private bool HandleOutOfGameBounds(Component obj)
	{
		if (IsOutOfGameBounds(obj.transform.position))
		{
			if (obj.gameObject.TryGetComponent<BoltEntity>(out var component))
			{
				if (component.IsOwner)
				{
					MultiplayerMng.DestroyMultiplayerEntity(component.gameObject, DestroyDelay.LATE);
				}
				else
				{
					component.gameObject.SetActive(value: false);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				BeamTeam.Destroy(obj.gameObject);
			}
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	private void HandleOutOfGameBounds(Component[] objs)
	{
		if (objs.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			return;
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < objs.Length; i++)
		{
			Component component = objs[i];
			if (!component.IsNullOrDestroyed() && component.gameObject.activeInHierarchy)
			{
				HandleOutOfGameBounds(objs[i]);
			}
		}
	}

	public void HandleOutOfGameBounds_NoMansLand()
	{
		try
		{
			Rigidbody[] componentsInChildren = _nmlZone.SaveContainer.GetComponentsInChildren<Rigidbody>();
			Component[] objs = componentsInChildren;
			HandleOutOfGameBounds(objs);
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			Debug.LogError("Error in HandleOutOfGameBounds_NoMansLand: " + ex.Message + "\n" + ex.StackTrace);
		}
	}

	public void HandleOutOfGameBounds(Zone zone, bool handleNmlContainer = false)
	{
		if (!zone.IsNullOrDestroyed() && zone.Loaded)
		{
			try
			{
				Rigidbody[] componentsInChildren = zone.SaveContainer.GetComponentsInChildren<Rigidbody>();
				Component[] objs = componentsInChildren;
				HandleOutOfGameBounds(objs);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				Debug.LogError("Error in HandleOutOfGameBounds: " + ex.Message + "\n" + ex.StackTrace);
			}
		}
		if (handleNmlContainer && zone != _nmlZone)
		{
			HandleOutOfGameBounds_NoMansLand();
		}
	}
}

	private enum GeneratorType
	{
		Perlin,
		Normalise,
		Voronoi,
		Smooth
	}

	public class PerlinNoise2D
	{
		private double[,] noiseValues;

		private float amplitude = 1f;

		private int frequency = 1;

		public float Amplitude => amplitude;

		public int Frequency => frequency;

		public PerlinNoise2D(int freq, float _amp, System.Random _wSeed)
		{
			noiseValues = new double[freq, freq];
			amplitude = _amp;
			frequency = freq;
			for (int i = 0; i < freq; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < freq; j++)
				{
					noiseValues[i, j] = _wSeed.NextDouble();
				}
			}
		}

		public double getInterpolatedPoint(int _xa, int _xb, int _ya, int _yb, double Px, double Py)
		{
			double pa = interpolate(noiseValues[_xa % Frequency, _ya % frequency], noiseValues[_xb % Frequency, _ya % frequency], Px);
			double pb = interpolate(noiseValues[_xa % Frequency, _yb % frequency], noiseValues[_xb % Frequency, _yb % frequency], Px);
			return interpolate(pa, pb, Py);
		}

		private double interpolate(double Pa, double Pb, double Px)
		{
			double num = Px * 3.1415927410125732;
			double num2 = (double)(1f - Mathf.Cos((float)num)) * 0.5;
			return Pa * (1.0 - num2) + Pb * num2;
		}
	}

	public static Zone.BiomeType GenerateZoneBiome(Zone.BiomeType biomeType, int seed)
	{
		int num = new System.Random(seed).Next(0, 100);
		Zone.BiomeType biomeType2 = biomeType;

		{

	public static float[,] GenerateZoneHeightmap(Zone.BiomeType biomeType, int randomSeed)
	{
		float[,] array = new float[257, 257];
		switch (biomeType)
		{
		case Zone.BiomeType.ISLAND:
			array = GENERATE_ISLAND_HEIGHTMAP(randomSeed, biomeType);
			break;
		case Zone.BiomeType.ISLAND_SMALL:
			array = GENERATE_ISLAND_HEIGHTMAP(randomSeed, biomeType);
			break;
		case Zone.BiomeType.ISLAND_ROCK:
			array = GENERATE_ISLAND_HEIGHTMAP(randomSeed, biomeType);
			break;
		case Zone.BiomeType.SHALLOW:
			array = PerlinGenerator(array, randomSeed, 6, 0.5f, 6, 1f);
			array = NormalizeHeightmap(array, 0.44f, 0.55f, 1f, biomeType);
			break;
		case Zone.BiomeType.MEDIUM:
			array = PerlinGenerator(array, randomSeed, 12, 0.5f, 6, 1f);
			array = NormalizeHeightmap(array, 0.3f, 0.45f, 1f, biomeType);
			break;
		case Zone.BiomeType.DEEP_SEA:
			array = PerlinGenerator(array, randomSeed, 4, 0.9f, 4, 1f);
			array = NormalizeHeightmap(array, 0.1f, 0.2f, 1f, biomeType);
			break;
		}
		return array;
	}

	public static float[,] GENERATE_ISLAND_HEIGHTMAP(int seed, Zone.BiomeType biome, bool soilMapGeneration = false)
	{
		System.Random random = new System.Random(seed);
		int num = 140;
		int num2 = 200;
		int num3 = num2;
		switch (biome)
		{
		case Zone.BiomeType.ISLAND_SMALL:
			num3 = random.Next(num, num + 20);
			break;
		case Zone.BiomeType.ISLAND:
			num3 = random.Next(num2 - 20, num2);
			break;
		}
		float num4 = 0.685f;
		float num5 = 0.705f;
		float num6 = (float)(num3 - num) / (float)(num2 - num);
		float maxHeight = num4 + (num5 - num4) * num6;
		int numPoints = num3;
		Island island = new Island(num3);
		island.NewIsland(Island.IslandTypes.Radial, Island.PointTypes.Random, numPoints, seed, num3);
		int num7 = 257;
		float num8 = (int)((float)(250 - num3) * 0.5f);
		float[,] array = new float[num7, num7];
		if (!soilMapGeneration)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < num7; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < num7; j++)
				{
					array[i, j] = 0.66f;
				}
			}
		}
		foreach (Center center in island.Centers)
		{
			if (center.Biome == Island.Biome.Ocean)
			{
				continue;
			}
			foreach (Center neighbor in center.Neighbors)
			{
				if (neighbor.Biome == Island.Biome.Lake)
				{
					_ = center.Biome;
					_ = 1;
				}
				List<Vector3> list = new List<Vector3>();
				Edge edge = island.LookUpEdgeFromCenter(center, neighbor);
				if (edge != null && edge.V0 != null && edge.V1 != null)
				{
					Corner v = edge.V0;
					Corner v2 = edge.V1;
					list.Add(new Vector3(v.Point.x, v.Elevation, v.Point.y));
					list.Add(new Vector3(v2.Point.x, v2.Elevation, v2.Point.y));
					list.Add(new Vector3(center.Point.x, center.Elevation, center.Point.y));
					if (soilMapGeneration)
					{
						array.FillCellHeightmap(list.ToArray(), (int)num8);
					}
					else
					{
						array.FillCellHeightmap(list.ToArray(), (int)num8, lake: false, 0.66f, maxHeight);
					}
					list = null;
				}
			}
		}

	public static void FillCellHeightmap(this float[,] heightmap, Vector3[] points, int offset, bool lake = false, float minHeight = 0f, float maxHeight = 1f)
	{

				}
			}

			{

				{

	public static void HeightmapRiver(this float[,] heightmap, int x0, int y0, int x1, int y1)
	{
		int num = y1 - y0;
		int num2 = x1 - x0;
		int num3;
		if (num < 0)
		{
			num = -num;
			num3 = -1;
		}
		else
		{
			num3 = 1;
		}
		int num4;
		if (num2 < 0)
		{
			num2 = -num2;
			num4 = -1;
		}
		else
		{
			num4 = 1;
		}
		num <<= 1;
		num2 <<= 1;
		float num5 = 0f;
		float num6 = 0.0065f;
		float num7 = 0.675f;
		if (heightmap[x0, y0] > num7)
		{
			heightmap[x0, y0] -= num6;
		}
		if (num2 > num)
		{
			num5 = num - (num2 >> 1);
			while (Mathf.Abs(x0 - x1) > 1)
			{
				if (num5 >= 0f)
				{
					y0 += num3;
					num5 -= (float)num2;
				}
				x0 += num4;
				num5 += (float)num;
				if (heightmap[x0, y0] > num7)
				{
					heightmap[x0, y0] -= num6;
				}
			}
			return;
		}
		num5 = num2 - (num >> 1);
		while (Mathf.Abs(y0 - y1) > 1)
		{
			if (num5 >= 0f)
			{
				x0 += num4;
				num5 -= (float)num;
			}
			y0 += num3;
			num5 += (float)num2;
			if (heightmap[x0, y0] > num7)
			{
				heightmap[x0, y0] -= num6;
			}
		}
	}

	public ImpostorBase CreateImpostor(int parentPrefabId, Vector3 position, Quaternion rotation)

		ImpostorBase impostorBase = ImpostorManager.Create(parentPrefabId);
		if (impostorBase == null)
		{
			Debug.LogError("CreateImposter:: " + parentPrefabId);
			return null;
		}
		if (impostorBase == DummyImpostor.Instance)
		{
			return null;
		}
		impostorBase.transform.position = position;
		impostorBase.transform.rotation = rotation;
		impostorBase.ParentInstanceId = impostorBase.transform.position.Hash();
		_activeImposters.Add(impostorBase);
		return impostorBase;
	}

	private ImpostorBase CreateImpostor(int parentPrefabId)
	{
		ImpostorBase impostorBase = ImpostorManager.Create(parentPrefabId);
		if (impostorBase == null)
		{
			Debug.LogError("CreateImposter:: " + parentPrefabId);
			return null;
		}
		if (impostorBase == DummyImpostor.Instance)
		{
			return null;
		}
		_activeImposters.Add(impostorBase);
		return impostorBase;
	}

	private bool TryGetImpostor(int parentInstanceId, out ImpostorBase impostor)
	{
		impostor = null;
		for (int i = 0; i < _activeImposters.Count; i++)
		{
			ImpostorBase impostorBase = _activeImposters[i];
			if (impostorBase.ParentInstanceId == parentInstanceId)
			{
				impostor = impostorBase;
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	public void ReleaseImpostors()
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < _activeImposters.Count; i++)
		{
			ImpostorManager.Release(_activeImposters[i]);
		}
		_activeImposters.Clear();
		_billboarding = false;
	}
}

using UnityEngine;

public class ZoneTerrainPointSampler : IPointSampler
{
	private Zone _zone;

	public void Init(Vector3 worldPosition)
	{
		_zone = StrandedWorld.GetZone(worldPosition);
	}

	public bool TryGetSample(Vector3 worldPosition, out Sample sample)
	{
		sample = Sample.Empty;
		if (_zone == null)
		{
			return false;
		}
		Terrain terrain = _zone.Terrain;
		if (terrain == null)
		{
			return false;
		}
		sample = default;
		sample.Point = worldPosition;
		sample.Point.y = terrain.SampleHeight(worldPosition) + -100f;
		Vector3 vector = worldPosition - terrain.transform.position;
		sample.Normal = terrain.terrainData.GetInterpolatedNormal(Mathf.InverseLerp(0f, terrain.terrainData.size.x, vector.x), Mathf.InverseLerp(0f, terrain.terrainData.size.z, vector.z));
		return true;
	}
}

	public static Texture3D ConvertLookUpTable(Texture2D texture)
	{
		if ((bool)texture)
		{
			if (texture.height != Mathf.FloorToInt(Mathf.Sqrt(texture.width)))
			{
				Debug.LogWarning("Atmosphere::ConvertLookUpTable: The given 2D texture " + texture.name + " cannot be used as a 3D LUT.");
				return null;
			}
			int num = 16;
			int height = texture.height;
			int num2 = 16;
			Color[] pixels = texture.GetPixels();
			Color[] array = new Color[pixels.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < height; j++)
				{
					for (int k = 0; k < num2; k++)
					{
						array[i + j * num + k * num * height] = pixels[i + j * num * num2 + k * num];
					}
				}
			}
			Texture3D texture3D = new Texture3D(num, height, num2, TextureFormat.ARGB32, mipChain: false);
			texture3D.wrapMode = TextureWrapMode.Clamp;
			texture3D.filterMode = FilterMode.Bilinear;
			texture3D.SetPixels(array);
			texture3D.Apply();
			return texture3D;
		}
		Debug.LogError("Atmosphere::ConvertLookUpTable(): Couldn't load 3D LUT texture. Texture3D will be disabled.");
		return null;
	}

	private void CalculateIlluminaryPositions()
	{
		float f = MathF.PI / 180f * _latitude;
		float num = Mathf.Sin(f);
		float num2 = Mathf.Cos(f);
		float num3 = MathF.PI / 180f * _longitude;
		float f2 = 0.4093f * Mathf.Sin(MathF.PI / 184f * (_date - 81f));
		float num4 = Mathf.Sin(f2);
		float num5 = Mathf.Cos(f2);
		float num6 = (int)(_longitude / 15f);
		float num7 = MathF.PI / 12f * num6;
		float num8 = Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.MilitaryTime + 0.17f * Mathf.Sin(0.03369f * (_date - 80f)) - 0.129f * Mathf.Sin(MathF.PI * 2f / 355f * (_date - 8f)) + 12f / MathF.PI * (num7 - num3);
		float f3 = MathF.PI / 12f * num8;
		float num9 = Mathf.Sin(f3);
		float num10 = Mathf.Cos(f3);
		float num11 = Mathf.Asin(num * num4 - num2 * num5 * num10);
		float y = (0f - num5) * num9;
		float x = num2 * num4 - num * num5 * num10;
		float num12 = Mathf.Atan2(y, x);
		_theta = MathF.PI / 2f - num11;
		float phi = num12;
		_sunIlluminary.Transform.position = transform.position + transform.rotation * SphericalToCartesian(_sunOrbitRadius, _theta, phi);
		_sunIlluminary.Transform.LookAt(transform.position);
		_moonIlluminary.Transform.position = transform.position + transform.rotation * SphericalToCartesian(_sunOrbitRadius, _theta + MathF.PI, phi);
		_moonIlluminary.Transform.LookAt(transform.position);
		_altitude = MathF.PI / 2f - _theta;
		float num13 = Mathf.Abs(_altitude);
		float num14 = MathF.PI / 180f;
		float num15 = MathF.PI / 15f;
		if (_altitude > 0f)
		{
			_sunIlluminary.Enable();
			_moonIlluminary.Disable();
			float num16 = Mathf.Lerp(0f, _sunIlluminary.Intensity, num13 / num14);
			_sunIlluminary.CurrentIntensity = ((num13 < num14) ? num16 : _sunIlluminary.Intensity);
			_sunIlluminary.Light.intensity = _sunIlluminary.CurrentIntensity;
			if (!_dayTime)
			{
				_dayTime = true;
				OnSunsetEvent();
			}
		}
		else
		{
			_moonIlluminary.Enable();
			_sunIlluminary.Disable();
			float num17 = Mathf.Lerp(0f, _moonIlluminary.Intensity, num13 / num15);
			_moonIlluminary.CurrentIntensity = ((num13 < num15) ? num17 : _moonIlluminary.Intensity);
			_moonIlluminary.Light.intensity = _moonIlluminary.CurrentIntensity;
			if (_dayTime)
			{
				_dayTime = false;
				OnSunsetEvent();
			}
		}
	}

	private void CalculateIlluminaryColors(Camera camera)
	{
		bool flag = Cameras.IsUnderwater(camera.transform);
		float normalizedTime = Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.NormalizedTime;
		Color color = _sunIlluminary.Gradient.Evaluate(normalizedTime);
		Color color2 = _moonIlluminary.Gradient.Evaluate(normalizedTime);
		WeatherEvent weatherEvent = Singleton<AtmosphereStorm>.Instance?.CurrentWeatherEvent;
		if (weatherEvent != null && weatherEvent.HasStarted)
		{
			color = weatherEvent.GetSunColor(color);
			color2 = weatherEvent.GetMoonColor(color2);
		}
		_sunIlluminary.Light.color = color;
		_moonIlluminary.Light.color = color2;
		if (flag)
		{
			float num = Singleton<CetoSettings>.Instance.BelowVisibility * 1.5f;
			float num2 = Mathf.Clamp01((camera.transform.position.y + num) / num);
			CurrentIlluminary.Light.color = Color.Lerp(CurrentIlluminary.Light.color * new Color(0.5f, 0.9f, 1f), CurrentIlluminary.Light.color, num2);
			CurrentIlluminary.Light.intensity = CurrentIlluminary.CurrentIntensity * num2;
		}
	}

	private void CalculateAmbientColor(Camera camera)
	{
		bool flag = Cameras.IsUnderwater(camera.transform);
		float normalizedTime = Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.NormalizedTime;
		_ambientLightColor = _ambientSkyColorGradient.Evaluate(normalizedTime) * _skyColorPolariser.Evaluate(normalizedTime);
		_ambientGroundColor = (flag ? _ambientUnderwaterGroundColorGradient.Evaluate(normalizedTime) : _ambientGroundColorGradient.Evaluate(normalizedTime));
		WeatherEvent weatherEvent = Singleton<AtmosphereStorm>.Instance?.CurrentWeatherEvent;
		if (weatherEvent != null && weatherEvent.HasStarted)
		{
			_ambientLightColor = weatherEvent.GetAmbientSkyColor(_ambientLightColor);
			_ambientGroundColor = weatherEvent.GetAmbientGroundColor(_ambientGroundColor);
		}
		if (flag)
		{
			float num = Singleton<CetoSettings>.Instance.BelowVisibility * 1.5f;
			float num2 = Mathf.Clamp01((camera.transform.position.y + num) / num);
			_ambientLightColor *= num2;
			_ambientGroundColor *= num2;
		}
		RenderSettings.sun = CurrentIlluminary.Light;
		RenderSettings.ambientLight = _ambientLightColor;
		RenderSettings.ambientEquatorColor = Color.Lerp(_ambientGroundColor, _ambientLightColor, 0.6f);
		RenderSettings.ambientGroundColor = _ambientGroundColor;
	}

	private Vector3 SphericalToCartesian(float radius, float theta, float phi)
	{
		float num = Mathf.Sin(theta);
		float num2 = Mathf.Cos(theta);
		float num3 = Mathf.Sin(phi);
		float num4 = Mathf.Cos(phi);
		Vector3 zero = Vector3.zero;
		zero.x = radius * num * num4;
		zero.y = radius * num2;
		zero.z = radius * num * num3;
		return zero;
	}
}

using System.Collections.Generic;

using Beam.Utilities;
using Funlabs;
using UnityEngine;

public class AtmosphereStorm : Singleton<AtmosphereStorm>, IPersistentSaveable, ISaveable
{
	private class ReplicateCheckWeatherMsg : MultiplayerMessage
	{
		[Replicate]
		public int Seed;

		[Replicate]
		public int Iter;

		public override void OnPeer()
		{
			Singleton<AtmosphereStorm>.Instance.SetState(Seed, Iter);
			Singleton<AtmosphereStorm>.Instance.CheckWeather();
		}
	}

	[Range(0f, 100f)]
	[SerializeField]
	private int _percentage = 70;

	private Atmosphere.Illuminary _sunIlluminary;

	private Atmosphere.Illuminary _moonIlluminary;

	[SerializeField]
	private WeatherEvent _currentWeatherEvent;

	private List<WeatherEvent> _weatherEvents;

	private int _lastRainyDay = -1;

	private int _lastDayChecked = -1;

	private int _rain;

	public int Percentage => _percentage;

	public WeatherEvent CurrentWeatherEvent => _currentWeatherEvent;

	public IList<WeatherEvent> WeatherEvents => _weatherEvents;

	public int Rain => _rain;

	public event WeatherEventHandler WeatherStarted;

	public event EmptyEventHandler WeatherStopped;

	protected virtual void OnWeatherStarted(WeatherEvent weather)
	{
		WeatherStarted?.Invoke(weather);
	}

	protected virtual void OnWeatherStopped()
	{
		WeatherStopped?.Invoke();
	}

	private void Start()
	{
		Shader.SetGlobalFloat("_SheetLightning", 0f);
		Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.NewDayTick += GameTime_NewDayTick;
		Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.HourChanged += GameTime_HourChanged;
		for (int i = 0; i < _weatherEvents.Count; i++)
		{
			_weatherEvents[i].Started += WeatherEvent_Started;
			_weatherEvents[i].Stopped += WeatherEvent_Stopped;
		}
		EventManager.AddListener<EndGameSequenceEvent>(EventManager_EndGameSequenceEvent);
		if (Game.Mode.IsMaster())
		{
			SetState(StrandedWorld.WORLD_SEED, 0);
		}
	}

	protected override void OnDestroy()
	{
		if ((bool)Singleton<GameTime>.Instance)
		{
			Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.NewDayTick -= GameTime_NewDayTick;
			Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.HourChanged -= GameTime_HourChanged;
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < _weatherEvents.Count; i++)
		{
			_weatherEvents[i].Started -= WeatherEvent_Started;
			_weatherEvents[i].Stopped -= WeatherEvent_Stopped;
		}
		EventManager.RemoveListener<EndGameSequenceEvent>(EventManager_EndGameSequenceEvent);
		WeatherStarted = null;
		WeatherStopped = null;
		base.OnDestroy();
	}

	private void SetState(int seed, int iter)
	{
		_random.RestoreState(seed, iter);
	}

	private void EventManager_EndGameSequenceEvent(EndGameSequenceEvent ev)
	{
		ClearWeatherEvent();
		_canDoWeather = false;
	}

	private void GameTime_NewDayTick()
	{
		if (!Game.Mode.IsClient())
		{
			ReplicatedCheckWeather();
		}
	}

	private void GameTime_HourChanged(float hours)
	{
		if (!(_currentWeatherEvent != null))
		{
			return;
		}
		if (_currentWeatherEvent.HasStarted)
		{
			if (GameTime.GetMinutesSince(_currentWeatherEvent.StartedTime) > _currentWeatherEvent.TotalEventMinutes)
			{
				_currentWeatherEvent.ResetEvent();
			}
		}
		else if (Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.MilitaryTime > _currentWeatherEvent.StartTime + _currentWeatherEvent.TotalEventHours)
		{
			ClearWeatherEvent();
		}
		else if (Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.MilitaryTime > _currentWeatherEvent.StartTime)
		{
			float hours2 = Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.MilitaryTime - _currentWeatherEvent.StartTime;
			_currentWeatherEvent.StartedTime = GameTime.Now.RemoveHours(hours2);
			_currentWeatherEvent.ResumeEvent();
			CancelInvoke("PollTimeForWeatherEvent");
		}
	}

	private void CheckWeather()
	{
		if (_lastDayChecked == Singleton<GameCalendar>.Instance.Day)
		{
			return;
		}
		if (_lastRainyDay != Singleton<GameCalendar>.Instance.Day)
		{
			if (_currentWeatherEvent != null)
			{
				_lastRainyDay = Singleton<GameCalendar>.Instance.Day;
			}
			else if ((float)_random.NextDouble() * 100f <= (float)_percentage)
			{
				_lastRainyDay = Singleton<GameCalendar>.Instance.Day;
				CreateWeatherEvent();
			}
		}
		_lastDayChecked = Singleton<GameCalendar>.Instance.Day;
	}

	private void CreateWeatherEvent()
	{
		List<WeatherEvent> list = new List<WeatherEvent>();
		for (int i = 0; i < _weatherEvents.Count; i++)
		{
			WeatherEvent weatherEvent = _weatherEvents[i];
			for (int j = 0; j < weatherEvent.Percentage / 10; j++)
			{
				list.Add(weatherEvent);
			}
		}
		int index = _random.Next(0, list.Count);
		WeatherEvent weatherEvent2 = list[index];
		float startTime = 10f + 6f * (float)_random.NextDouble();
		weatherEvent2.StartTime = startTime;
		NewWeatherEvent(weatherEvent2);
	}

	private void PollTimeForWeatherEvent()
	{
		if (_canDoWeather && Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.MilitaryTime >= _currentWeatherEvent.StartTime)
		{
			CancelInvoke("PollTimeForWeatherEvent");
			StartWeatherEvent();
		}
	}

	public void StartWeatherEvent()
	{
		if (_currentWeatherEvent != null)
		{
			_currentWeatherEvent.StartEvent();
			if (Mathf.Approximately(_currentWeatherEvent.Humidity, 100f))
			{
				_rain++;
			}
		}
	}

	private void WeatherEvent_Started(WeatherEvent weather)
	{
		OnWeatherStarted(weather);
	}

	private void WeatherEvent_Stopped()
	{
		OnWeatherStopped();
	}

	public void NewWeatherEvent(WeatherEvent weather)
	{
		SetWeatherEvent(weather);
		InvokeRepeating("PollTimeForWeatherEvent", 0f, 2f);
	}

	public void SetWeatherEvent(WeatherEvent weather)
	{
		_currentWeatherEvent = weather;
	}

	public void ClearWeatherEvent()
	{
		_currentWeatherEvent = null;
		CancelInvoke("PollTimeForWeatherEvent");
	}

	private void ReplicatedCheckWeather()
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
		{
			ReplicateCheckWeatherMsg replicateCheckWeatherMsg = new ReplicateCheckWeatherMsg();
			replicateCheckWeatherMsg.Seed = _random.GetSeed();
			replicateCheckWeatherMsg.Iter = _random.GetIter();
			replicateCheckWeatherMsg.Post();
		}
		CheckWeather();
	}

	public JObject Save()
	{
		JObject jObject = new JObject();
		jObject.AddField("Rain", _rain);
		JObject data = SavingUtilities.Save(_random);
		jObject.AddField("State", data);
		if (CurrentWeatherEvent != null)
		{
			JObject data2 = CurrentWeatherEvent.Save();
			jObject.AddField(CurrentWeatherEvent.gameObject.name, data2);
		}
		return jObject;
	}

	public void Load(JObject data)
	{
		_rain = data.GetField("Rain").GetValue<int>();
		JObject field = data.GetField("State");
		if ((bool)field)
		{
			SavingUtilities.Load(_random, field);
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < _weatherEvents.Count; i++)
		{
			WeatherEvent weatherEvent = _weatherEvents[i];
			JObject field2 = data.GetField(weatherEvent.name);
			if (field2 != null)
			{
				weatherEvent.Load(field2);
				break;
			}
		}
	}
}

using Beam;

public class BEAMSeaFortGenerator : MonoBehaviour, IGenerationObject
{
	[SerializeField]
	private Transform startingPoint;

	public Module[] Modules;

	public Module[] StartModule;

	private static System.Random _randomSeed;

	[SerializeField]
	private int minIteration = 1;

	[SerializeField]
	private int maxIteration = 4;

	private void Start()
	{
		_randomSeed = Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.GenerateLocalSeed(transform.position);
		int num = _randomSeed.Next(minIteration, maxIteration);
		Module module = UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(StartModule[_randomSeed.Next(StartModule.Length)], startingPoint.position, transform.rotation);
		module.transform.parent = transform.parent;
		module.SetUpSupport(seaLadderAccess: true);
		List<ModuleConnector> list = new List<ModuleConnector>(module.GetExits());
		for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
		{
			List<ModuleConnector> list2 = new List<ModuleConnector>();
			foreach (ModuleConnector item in list)
			{
				string random = GetRandom(item.Tags);
				Module module2 = UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(GetRandomWithTag(Modules, random));
				module2.transform.parent = transform.parent;
				bool upSupport = _randomSeed.NextDouble() < 0.20000000298023224;
				module2.SetUpSupport(upSupport);
				ModuleConnector[] exits = module2.GetExits();
				ModuleConnector exitToMatch = exits.FirstOrDefault((ModuleConnector x) => x.IsDefault) ?? GetRandom(exits);
				MatchExits(item, exitToMatch);
				list2.AddRange(exits.Where((ModuleConnector e) => e != exitToMatch));
			}
			list = list2;
		}
	}

	private void MatchExits(ModuleConnector oldExit, ModuleConnector newExit)
	{
		Transform parent = newExit.transform.parent.parent;
		parent.RotateAround(angle: Azimuth(-oldExit.transform.forward) - Azimuth(newExit.transform.forward), point: newExit.transform.position, axis: Vector3.up);
		Vector3 vector = oldExit.transform.position - newExit.transform.position;
		parent.transform.position += vector;
	}

	private static TItem GetRandom<TItem>(TItem[] array)
	{
		return array[_randomSeed.Next(0, array.Length)];
	}

	private static Module GetRandomWithTag(IEnumerable<Module> modules, string tagToMatch)
	{
		return GetRandom(modules.Where((Module m) => m.Tags.Contains(tagToMatch)).ToArray());
	}

	private static float Azimuth(Vector3 vector)
	{
		return Vector3.Angle(Vector3.forward, vector) * Mathf.Sign(vector.x);
	}
}
