	private void LoadPlayerMaps()
	{
		_reservedZoneIds.Clear();
		if (_validSave)
		{
			LoadPlayerMap(GameMode.SinglePlayer);
			LoadPlayerMap(GameMode.Coop_2);
			LoadPlayerMap(GameMode.Coop_Server);
		}
	}

	private void LoadPlayerMap(GameMode mode)
	{
		if (!SaveManager.TryGetSaveFilePath(mode, out var saveFilePath))
		{
			return;
		}
		JToken jToken = SaveManager.LoadSaveFileFast(saveFilePath)["Persistent"]["StrandedWorld"];
		JToken jToken2 = jToken["PlayersData"];
		if (jToken2 != null && jToken2.HasValues)
		{
			IJEnumerable<JToken> iJEnumerable = jToken2.Children();
			if (jToken2.Type == JTokenType.Object)
			{
				iJEnumerable = jToken2.Children().Children();
			}
			{
				foreach (JToken item2 in iJEnumerable)
				{
					string item = item2["ZoneId"].ToObject<string>();
					_reservedZoneIds.Add(item);
				}
				return;
			}
		}
		if (LegacyUtilities.LoadStrandedWorldPlayerZoneId_PreCoop(jToken, out var zoneId))
		{
			_reservedZoneIds.Add(zoneId);
		}
		else
		{
			Debug.LogError("LoadPlayerMap:: Could not load player data.");
		}
	}

	private void UpdateMapsStatus()
	{
		Map[] mapList = World.MapList;
		foreach (Map map in mapList)
		{
			UpdateMapStatus(map);
		}
	}

	private void UpdateMapStatus(Map map)
	{
		if (map == null || map.EditorData.Id.Contains("INTERNAL_PROCEDURAL"))
		{
			return;
		}
		Map map2 = Maps.AllMapList.FirstOrDefault((Map m) => m.EditorData.Id == map.EditorData.Id && m.EditorData.Source == map.EditorData.Source);
		if (map2 != null)
		{
			if (map.EditorData.VersionNumber < map2.EditorData.VersionNumber)
			{
				map.EditorData.State = MapEditorData.EMapState.Older;
			}
			else
			{
				map.EditorData.State = MapEditorData.EMapState.Current;
			}
		}
		else
		{
			map.EditorData.State = MapEditorData.EMapState.Unavailable;
		}
	}

	private bool ValidateDuplicateMap(Map newMap, bool checkSource = true)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < 49; i++)
		{
			Map map = World.MapList[i];
			if (map.EditorData.Id == newMap.EditorData.Id && (!checkSource || map.EditorData.Source == newMap.EditorData.Source))
			{
				return false;
			}
		}
		return true;
	}

	private void DeleteSave()
	{
		SaveManager.BackupSaveFiles();
		SaveManager.DeleteSaveFiles();
		_validSave = false;
	}

	private void InvokeDelayed(float delay, Action callback)
	{
		if (callback != null)
		{
			StartCoroutine(InvokeDelayed_Sequence(delay, callback));
		}
	}

	private IEnumerator InvokeDelayed_Sequence(float delay, Action callback)
	{
		yield return new WaitForEndOfFrame();
		float timer = 0f;
		while (timer < delay)
		{
			timer += Time.unscaledDeltaTime;
			yield return null;
		}
		callback?.Invoke();
	}
}

	private const float SESSION_TIMEOUT = 30f;

	private bool _isGamePaused;

	[HideInInspector]
	public bool ContinuingMultiplayerGame;

	private DialogueBoxViewAdapter _joinSessionDialog;

	private CoroutineHandle _joinSessionDialogTimeout;

	public static MainMenuPresenter Instance
	{
		get
		{
			if (_Instance == null)
			{
				_Instance = new MainMenuPresenter();
			}
			return _Instance;
		}
		set
		{
			_Instance = value;
		}
	}

	public LoadingScreenPresenter LoadingScreenPresenter => _loadingScreenPresenter;

	public bool IsGamePaused => _isGamePaused;

	public event QuittingToMenuHandler QuittingToMenu;

	private void Awake()
	{
		Debug.Log("Stranded Deep Version: " + BuildInformation.GetPrettyString());
		Game.State = GameState.MAIN_MENU;
		Application.targetFrameRate = 60;
		QualitySettings.SetQualityLevel(QualitySettings.names.Length);
		_view.Hide();
		_newGameMenuPresenter.Initialize(_view);
		_changeSaveSlotPresenter.Initialize(_view);
		_optionsMenuPresenter.Initialize(_view);
		_cartographerMenuPresenter.Initialize(_view);
		_createSessionMenuPresenter.Initialize(_view);
		_newGameMenuPresenter.ShowView += MenuPresenter_ShowView;
		_newGameMenuPresenter.HideView += MenuPresenter_HideView;
		NewGameMenuPresenter newGameMenuPresenter = _newGameMenuPresenter;
		newGameMenuPresenter.StartCallback = (Action<GameSettings>)Delegate.Combine(newGameMenuPresenter.StartCallback, new Action<GameSettings>(StartNewGame));
		NewGameMenuPresenter newGameMenuPresenter2 = _newGameMenuPresenter;
		newGameMenuPresenter2.StartMultiplayerContinueCallback = (Action)Delegate.Combine(newGameMenuPresenter2.StartMultiplayerContinueCallback, new Action(StartContinueGame));
		_changeSaveSlotPresenter.ShowView += MenuPresenter_ShowView;
		_changeSaveSlotPresenter.HideView += MenuPresenter_HideView;
		_changeSaveSlotPresenter.SlotChanged += ChangeSaveSlotMenuPresenter_SlotChanged;
		_optionsMenuPresenter.ShowView += MenuPresenter_ShowView;
		_optionsMenuPresenter.HideView += MenuPresenter_HideView;
		_cartographerMenuPresenter.ShowView += MenuPresenter_ShowView;
		_cartographerMenuPresenter.HideView += MenuPresenter_HideView;
		_cartographerMenuPresenter.CreatedNewWorld += CartographerMenuPresenter_CreatedNewWorld;
		_leaderboardsMenuPresenter.ShowView += MenuPresenter_ShowView;
		_leaderboardsMenuPresenter.HideView += MenuPresenter_HideView;
		_createSessionMenuPresenter.ShowView += MenuPresenter_ShowView;
		_createSessionMenuPresenter.HideView += MenuPresenter_HideView;
		_lobbyMenuPresenter.ShowView += MenuPresenter_ShowView;
		_lobbyMenuPresenter.HideView += MenuPresenter_HideView;
		ReInput.ControllerDisconnectedEvent += Rewired_OnControllerDisconnected;
		SaveManager.DeletedSaveFile += SaveManager_DeletedSaveFile;
		CheckBuildVersion();
		SetControlEvents();
		SubscribeToInputEvents();
		Game.Mode = GameMode.SinglePlayer;
		Timing.RunCoroutine(Initialize_Sequence());
		_currentSubScreen = MainMenuScreen.MAIN;
	}

	private void Start()
	{
		ControllerFocus.Instance?.Subscribe(_view);
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> Initialize_Sequence()
	{
		_view.CanvasGroup.Interactable = false;
		if (Game.PreviousState == GameState.MAIN_MENU)
		{
			Singleton<Fader>.Instance.SetFadeColor(Color.black);
		}
		Singleton<Fader>.Instance.FadeOut(0f);
		_view.Hide();
		_loadingScreenPresenter.Show();
		Rewired.Player input = (_currentPlayerInput = ReInput.players.GetPlayer(0));
		bool checkFilePermissions = FilePath.CheckFilePermissions() && FilePath.CreateDirectories();
		if (!checkFilePermissions)
		{
			_loadingScreenPresenter.Hide();
			string message = Localization.GetLanguageHandler().Localize("MAIN_MENU_DB_FILE_PERMISSIONS_DESC", FilePath.SAVE_FOLDER);
			DialogueBoxViewAdapter dialogueBoxViewAdapter = DialogueBox.Show(_currentPlayerInput, "MAIN_MENU_DB_WARNING_TITLE", message, "MAIN_MENU_DB_BUTTON_VISIT", "MAIN_MENU_BUTTON_QUIT", "", DialogueIcon.Warning);
			dialogueBoxViewAdapter.Accept += () =>
			{
				Application.OpenURL("https://forums.strandeddeepgame.com");
				Singleton<Fader>.Instance.FadeOut(3f, FadeMode.Solid, QuitToDesktop);
			};
			dialogueBoxViewAdapter.Decline += () =>
			{
				Singleton<Fader>.Instance.FadeOut(3f, FadeMode.Solid, QuitToDesktop);
			};
		}
		while (!checkFilePermissions)
		{
			yield return 0f;
		}
		IAccountService accountService = GAccountService.Get();
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent("LOADING_PROGRESS_TEXT_INITIALIZING " + accountService.Name));
		yield return 0f;
		CheckAccountServicesInitialized();
		while (!accountService.Initialized)
		{
			yield return 0f;
		}
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent("LOADING_PROGRESS_TEXT_AUTHENTICATING " + accountService.Name));
		yield return 0f;
		IAuthenticationHandler authentication = accountService.GetAuthenticationHandler();
		authentication.Login(Authentication_OnLoginCallback);
		while (!authentication.LoggedIn)
		{
			yield return 0f;
		}
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent("LOADING_PROGRESS_TEXT_RETRIEVING_USER_INFO"));
		yield return 0f;
		AccountUser localUser = accountService.LocalUser;
		while (localUser.UserInfo == null)
		{
			yield return 0f;
		}
		UpdateUserName(localUser.UserInfo.DisplayName);
		Options.Load();
		GraphicsUtilities.SetFixedFrameRate(Options.GraphicsSettings.FixedFrameRate);
		GraphicsUtilities.SetVSync(Options.GraphicsSettings.VerticalSync);
		yield return Timing.WaitUntilDone(Timing.RunCoroutine(Load_Sequence()));
		input.SetCursorEnabled(enabled: true);
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> Reload_Sequence()
	{
		_view.CanvasGroup.Interactable = false;
		yield return Singleton<Fader>.Instance.FadeOut_Async(0f);
		_view.Hide();
		_loadingScreenPresenter.Show();
		yield return Timing.WaitUntilDone(Timing.RunCoroutine(Load_Sequence()));
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> Load_Sequence()
	{
		SaveManager.ChangeCurrentSlot(Options.GeneralSettings.LastSaveSlotUsed);
		yield return Timing.WaitUntilDone(Timing.RunCoroutine(Migrate_Sequence()));
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent("LOADING_PROGRESS_TEXT_LOADING_WORLD"));
		yield return 0f;
		Prefabs.LoadPrefabMap();
		yield return Timing.WaitUntilDone(Timing.RunCoroutine(LoadWorld()));
		_loadingScreenPresenter.Hide();
		Show(_currentPlayerInput);
		if (Game.PreviousState == GameState.MAP_EDITOR)
		{
			Singleton<Fader>.Instance.ResetFade(FadeMode.Solid, FadeDirection.Out);
			CartographerButton_Click(null);
		}
		else
		{
			LeanTween.value(gameObject, 0f, 1f, 1f).setOnUpdate((float value) =>
			{
				AudioListener.volume = Mathf.Clamp01(value);
			}).setIgnoreTimeScale(useUnScaledTime: true);
			yield return Singleton<Fader>.Instance.FadeIn_Async(1f);
			Singleton<Fader>.Instance.ResetColor();
		}
		_view.CanvasGroup.Interactable = true;
		if (Game.PreviousState != GameState.MAP_EDITOR)
		{
			_view.SelectFirstButton();
		}
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> Migrate_Sequence()
	{
		if (Options.GeneralSettings.LastSaveSlotUsed != 0 || Directory.Exists(PathTools.Combine(SaveManager.GetSaveFolderPath(), "World", "0")))
		{
			yield break;
		}
		string filePath = string.Empty;
		if (!LegacyUtilities.HasSaveFilePre_74_00(GameMode.SinglePlayer, out filePath) && !LegacyUtilities.HasSaveFilePre_74_00(GameMode.Coop_2, out filePath))
		{
			yield break;
		}
		bool import = false;
		DialogueBox.Show(_currentPlayerInput, "IMPORT", "Save data location has changed for game versions 0.75.00 and above.\n\nNo save data was found in the new location, but save data was found in the old location at:\n\n" + filePath + "\n\nDo you want to import?", DialogueButton.YesNo, DialogueIcon.Information).Accept += () =>
		{
			import = true;
		};
		while (DialogueBox.Notifying)
		{
			yield return 0f;
		}
		if (!import)
		{
			yield break;
		}
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent("IMPORTING LEGACY SAVE DATA"));
		yield return 0f;
		string text = string.Empty;
		bool flag;
		try
		{
			LegacyUtilities.MigrateSaveDataPre_74_00();
			flag = true;
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			flag = false;
			text = ex.Message;
			Debug.LogException(ex);
		}
		if (!flag)
		{
			DialogueBox.Show(_currentPlayerInput, "TEXT_ERROR", "There was an error importing:\n" + text + "\n\nPlease visit the Stranded Deep Steam forum below for more information on how to migrate your old save data manually.", "MAIN_MENU_DB_BUTTON_VISIT", "MAIN_MENU_DB_BUTTON_CLOSE", "", DialogueIcon.Warning).Accept += () =>
			{
				Application.OpenURL("https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2265407307");
			};
			while (DialogueBox.Notifying)
			{
				yield return 0f;
			}
		}
		else
		{
			Options.Load();
			UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectOfType<AudioMenuPresenter>()?.LoadMixerValues();
		}
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> LoadWorld()
	{
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent("UPGRADING LEGACY WORLD"));
		yield return 0f;
		LegacyUtilities.UpgradeLegacyGame();
		bool flag = World.CheckWorldSeedFileExists();
		if (!SaveManager.ValidateSaveFile(GameMode.SinglePlayer) && !SaveManager.ValidateSaveFile(GameMode.Coop_2) && !SaveManager.ValidateSaveFile(GameMode.Coop_Server) && !flag)
		{
			EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent("LOADING_PROGRESS_TEXT_CREATING_WORLD"));
			yield return 0f;
			_cartographerMenuPresenter.CreateRandomWorld();
			yield break;
		}
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent("LOADING_PROGRESS_TEXT_LOADING_WORLD"));
		yield return 0f;
		if (!World.LoadWorld().Succeeded)
		{
			DialogueBox.Show(_currentPlayerInput, "MAIN_MENU_DB_ERROR_TITLE", "MAIN_MENU_DB_ERROR_LOAD_WORLD_DESC", DialogueButton.Ok, DialogueIcon.Warning).Accept += () =>
			{
				_view.NewGameButton.Enabled = false;
				_cartographerMenuPresenter.Show();
			};
		}
	}

	private bool CheckAccountServicesInitialized()
	{
		IAccountService accountService = GAccountService.Get();
		bool initialized = accountService.Initialized;
		if (!initialized)
		{
			_loadingScreenPresenter.Hide();
			string message = Localization.GetLanguageHandler().Localize("MAIN_MENU_DB_ERROR_INITIALIZE_DRM_DESC", accountService.Name);
			DialogueBox.Show(_currentPlayerInput, "TEXT_ERROR", message, DialogueButton.Ok, DialogueIcon.Warning).Accept += () =>
			{
				Singleton<Fader>.Instance.FadeOut(3f, FadeMode.Solid, QuitToDesktop);
			};
		}
		return initialized;
	}

	private void Authentication_OnLoginCallback(AuthCallbackInfo callbackInfo)
	{
		if (callbackInfo.Result != 0)
		{
			_loadingScreenPresenter.Hide();
			string message = Localization.GetLanguageHandler().Localize("MAIN_MENU_DB_ERROR_AUTHENTICATE_DESC", GAccountService.Get().Name, callbackInfo.Result.ToString("X8"));
			DialogueBox.Show(_currentPlayerInput, "MAIN_MENU_DB_ERROR_TITLE", message, DialogueButton.Ok, DialogueIcon.Warning).Accept += () =>
			{
				Singleton<Fader>.Instance.FadeOut(3f, FadeMode.Solid, QuitToDesktop);
			};
		}
	}

	private void CheckSystemSpecs()
	{
	}

	private void CheckBuildVersion()
	{
		_view.VersionNumberLabel.Text = BuildInformation.GetPrettyString();
	}

	private void OnDestroy()
	{
		QuittingToMenu = null;
		if ((bool)ControllerFocus.Instance)
		{
			ControllerFocus.Instance.Unsubscribe(_view);
		}
		_view.HideView -= _newGameMenuPresenter.Hide;
		_view.HideView -= _changeSaveSlotPresenter.Hide;
		_view.HideView -= _optionsMenuPresenter.Hide;
		_view.HideView -= _cartographerMenuPresenter.Hide;
		_view.HideView -= _createSessionMenuPresenter.Hide;
		_newGameMenuPresenter.ShowView -= MenuPresenter_ShowView;
		_newGameMenuPresenter.HideView -= MenuPresenter_HideView;
		_changeSaveSlotPresenter.ShowView -= MenuPresenter_ShowView;
		_changeSaveSlotPresenter.HideView -= MenuPresenter_HideView;
		_changeSaveSlotPresenter.SlotChanged -= ChangeSaveSlotMenuPresenter_SlotChanged;
		_optionsMenuPresenter.ShowView -= MenuPresenter_ShowView;
		_optionsMenuPresenter.HideView -= MenuPresenter_HideView;
		_cartographerMenuPresenter.ShowView -= MenuPresenter_ShowView;
		_cartographerMenuPresenter.HideView -= MenuPresenter_HideView;
		_leaderboardsMenuPresenter.ShowView -= MenuPresenter_ShowView;
		_leaderboardsMenuPresenter.HideView -= MenuPresenter_HideView;
		_createSessionMenuPresenter.ShowView -= MenuPresenter_ShowView;
		_createSessionMenuPresenter.HideView -= MenuPresenter_HideView;
		_lobbyMenuPresenter.ShowView -= MenuPresenter_ShowView;
		_lobbyMenuPresenter.HideView -= MenuPresenter_HideView;
		_cartographerMenuPresenter.CreatedNewWorld -= CartographerMenuPresenter_CreatedNewWorld;
		ReInput.ControllerDisconnectedEvent -= Rewired_OnControllerDisconnected;
		SaveManager.DeletedSaveFile -= SaveManager_DeletedSaveFile;
		UnsubscribeFromInputEvents();
		EventManager.RemoveListener<PlayerConnectedEvent>(OnPlayerConnected);
	}

	private void CopyLobbyCodeButton_Click(object sender)
	{
		_view.LobbyCodeLabel.Text.CopyToClipboard();
	}

	private void SubscribeToInputEvents()
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < RewiredUtilities.Players.Count; i++)
		{
			RewiredUtilities.Players[i].AddInputEventDelegate(RewiredPlayer_EscapeButtonDown, UpdateLoopType.Update, InputActionEventType.ButtonJustPressed, 39);
		}
	}

	private void UnsubscribeFromInputEvents()
	{
		if (ReInput.isReady)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < RewiredUtilities.Players.Count; i++)
			{
				RewiredUtilities.Players[i].RemoveInputEventDelegate(RewiredPlayer_EscapeButtonDown, UpdateLoopType.Update, InputActionEventType.ButtonJustPressed, 39);
			}
		}
	}

	private void Update()
	{
		Shader.SetGlobalVector("_UnscaledTime", new Vector4(Time.realtimeSinceStartup / 20f, Time.realtimeSinceStartup, Time.realtimeSinceStartup * 2f, Time.realtimeSinceStartup * 3f));
		Rewired.Player player = ReInput.players.GetPlayer(0);
		if ((player.GetButtonDown(39) || player.GetButtonDown(31)) && _view.Visible)
		{
			AttemptToGoToPreviousScreen();
		}
	}

	public void Show(Rewired.Player input)
	{
		Instance = this;
		if (!_view.Visible)
		{
			if ((bool)Singleton<SoundtrackManager>.Instance)
			{
				Singleton<SoundtrackManager>.Instance.PauseTracks();
			}
			AudioSource audioSource = ((Game.State == GameState.MAIN_MENU) ? _mainMenuTrack : _pauseMenuTrack);
			if (!audioSource.isPlaying)
			{
				audioSource.Play();
			}
			IAudioPlayer audioPlayer = AudioManager.GetAudioPlayer();
			audioPlayer.GetAudioMixer().GetChannel(AudioMixerChannels.Environment).Mute = true;
			audioPlayer.GetAudioMixer().GetChannel(AudioMixerChannels.FX).Mute = true;
			audioPlayer.GetAudioMixer().GetChannel(AudioMixerChannels.Voice).Mute = true;
			Time.timeScale = 0f;
			_currentPlayerInput = input;
			if (Game.State != GameState.MAIN_MENU)
			{
				_isGamePaused = true;
				_mapBeforePaused = _currentPlayerInput.GetCurrentMapId();
				_currentPlayerInput.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: false, _mapBeforePaused);
				_currentPlayerInput.AddInputEventDelegate(RewiredPlayer_EscapeButtonDown, UpdateLoopType.Update, InputActionEventType.ButtonJustPressed, 31);
			}
			else
			{
				_currentPlayerInput.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: false, 0);
			}
			_currentPlayerInput.GetOtherPlayers().DisableMaps();
			_currentPlayerInput.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: true, 8);
			_currentPlayerInput.SetCursorEnabled(enabled: true);
			EventManager.RaiseEvent(new MainMenuOpenedEvent(RewiredUtilities.GetPlayerFromInput(input)?.Id ?? input.id, opened: true));
			IPlayer playerFromInput = RewiredUtilities.GetPlayerFromInput(_currentPlayerInput);
			if (!playerFromInput.IsNullOrDestroyed())
			{
				playerFromInput.IsBusy = true;
				++playerFromInput.Movement.IsBusy;
				playerFromInput.Interacter.IsInPauseMenu = true;
				playerFromInput.PlayerCamera.MouseLook.enabled = false;
			}
			Refresh();
			_view.LobbyCodeGroup.transform.gameObject.SetActive(_isGamePaused && Game.Mode.IsServer());
			if (Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
			{
				_view.LobbyCodeLabel.Text = Game.MultiplayerSessionName.ToCode(MultiplayerMng.GetCloudRegionIndex());
			}
			_view.SetInput(_currentPlayerInput);
			_view.Show();
			_view.SelectFirstButton();
			if (Game.Mode.IsServer())
			{
				EventManager.AddListener<PlayerConnectedEvent>(OnPlayerConnected);
			}
		}
	}

	private void OnPlayerConnected(PlayerConnectedEvent @event)
	{
		Hide();
	}

	private void Refresh()
	{
		InitializeControls();
		InitializeStats();
	}

	private void Hide()
	{
		EventManager.RemoveListener<PlayerConnectedEvent>(OnPlayerConnected);
		if (_view.Visible)
		{
			_mainMenuTrack.Stop();
			_pauseMenuTrack.Stop();
			if ((bool)Singleton<SoundtrackManager>.Instance)
			{
				Singleton<SoundtrackManager>.Instance.ResumeTracks();
			}
			IAudioPlayer audioPlayer = AudioManager.GetAudioPlayer();
			audioPlayer.GetAudioMixer().GetChannel(AudioMixerChannels.Environment).Mute = false;
			audioPlayer.GetAudioMixer().GetChannel(AudioMixerChannels.FX).Mute = false;
			audioPlayer.GetAudioMixer().GetChannel(AudioMixerChannels.Voice).Mute = false;
			Time.timeScale = 1f;
			EventManager.RaiseEvent(new MainMenuOpenedEvent(RewiredUtilities.GetPlayerFromInput(_currentPlayerInput)?.Id ?? _currentPlayerInput.id, opened: false));
			IPlayer playerFromInput = RewiredUtilities.GetPlayerFromInput(_currentPlayerInput);
			if (!playerFromInput.IsNullOrDestroyed())
			{
				playerFromInput.IsBusy = false;
				--playerFromInput.Movement.IsBusy;
				playerFromInput.Interacter.IsInPauseMenu = false;
				playerFromInput.PlayerCamera.MouseLook.enabled = true;
			}
			if (Game.State != GameState.MAIN_MENU)
			{
				_isGamePaused = false;
				_currentPlayerInput.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: true, _mapBeforePaused);
				_currentPlayerInput.RemoveInputEventDelegate(RewiredPlayer_EscapeButtonDown, UpdateLoopType.Update, InputActionEventType.ButtonJustPressed, 31);
			}
			else
			{
				_currentPlayerInput.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: true, 0);
			}
			_currentPlayerInput.GetOtherPlayers().RestoreMapsEnabled();
			_currentPlayerInput.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: false, 8);
			_currentPlayerInput.SetCursorEnabled(enabled: false);
			_currentPlayerInput = null;
			_view.Hide();
		}
	}

	private void InitializeControls()
	{
		_view.PlaySubMenu.SetActive(value: false);
		_view.PlayOnlineSubMenu.SetActive(value: false);
		_view.UserDetailsGroup.SetActive(value: true);
		if (Game.State == GameState.MAIN_MENU)
		{
			_view.MainMenuControlGroup.SetActive(value: true);
			_view.PauseMenuControlGroup.SetActive(value: false);
			ValidateContinueButtons();
		}
		else
		{
			_view.MainMenuControlGroup.SetActive(value: false);
			_view.PauseMenuControlGroup.SetActive(value: true);
		}
		_view.SetNavigation();
	}

	private void InitializeStats()
	{
		if (Game.State == GameState.MAIN_MENU)
		{
			if (IsContinueButtonAvailable())
			{
				LoadStats(GameMode.SinglePlayer);
				UpdateUserStats(GAccountService.Get().LocalUser.UserStats.SessionStats);
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateUserStats("---", "---");
			}
		}
		else if (Game.State == GameState.NEW_GAME || Game.State == GameState.LOAD_GAME)
		{
			UpdateUserStats(Singleton<GameCalendar>.Instance.DaysAlive, Mathf.FloorToInt(Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.SessionDuration));
		}
	}

	private void LoadStats(GameMode mode)
	{
		GAccountService.Get().LocalUser.UserStats.Load(mode);
	}

	private void ResetStats()
	{
		GAccountService.Get().LocalUser.UserStats.Reset();
	}

	private void ValidateContinueButtons()
	{
		if (SaveManager.ValidateSaveFile(GameMode.SinglePlayer))
		{
			_view.ContinueButton.Show();
		}
		else
		{
			_view.ContinueButton.Hide();
		}
		if (SaveManager.ValidateSaveFile(GameMode.Coop_2))
		{
			_view.ContinueCoopButton.Show();
			_view.ContinueCoopButton.Enabled = ReInput.players.playerCount == 2;
		}
		else
		{
			_view.ContinueCoopButton.Hide();
		}
	}

	private void UpdateUserName(string name)
	{
		_view.UserNameLabel.Text = name;
	}

	private void UpdateUserStats(Stats stats)
	{
		UpdateUserStats(stats.DaysSurvived + 1, stats.TimePlayed);
	}

	private void UpdateUserStats(int days, int seconds)
	{
		TimeSpan timeSpan = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(seconds);
		UpdateUserStats(days.ToString(), $"{timeSpan.Days:0}d {timeSpan.Hours:00}h {timeSpan.Minutes:00}m");
	}

	private void UpdateUserStats(string days, string seconds)
	{
		_view.UserDetailsDaysLabel.Text = days;
		_view.UserDetailsHoursLabel.Text = seconds;
	}

	private void RewiredPlayer_EscapeButtonDown(InputActionEventData eventData)
	{
		if (!_suspend && !_childPanelOpen && Game.State != GameState.MAIN_MENU && Game.State != GameState.INTRO && !Singleton<Fader>.Instance.IsFading && !LevelLoader.IsLoading() && !LevelLoader.IsServerJoinInProgress && !SaveManager.IsSaving && !DialogueBox.Notifying && !RewiredUtilities.GetPlayerFromInput(eventData.player).IsNullOrDestroyed() && !RewiredUtilities.GetPlayerFromInput(eventData.player).Lighter.IsLightingFire && !RewiredUtilities.GetPlayerFromInput(eventData.player).Movement.IsInEndGameScene)
		{
			if (_view.Visible && _currentPlayerInput == eventData.player)
			{
				Hide();
			}
			else if (!_view.Visible && _currentPlayerInput == null)
			{
				Show(eventData.player);
			}
		}
	}

	private void Rewired_OnControllerDisconnected(ControllerStatusChangedEventArgs args)
	{
		if (Game.Mode != GameMode.Coop_2 || _currentPlayerInput == null || _currentPlayerInput.id != 1 || !_view.Visible)
		{
			return;
		}
		_currentPlayerInput.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: true, 0);
		_currentPlayerInput.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: false, 8);
		_currentPlayerInput.DisableMaps();
		_currentPlayerInput = ReInput.players.GetPlayer(0);
		_currentPlayerInput.RestoreMapsEnabled();
		foreach (IPlayer allPlayer in PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers)
		{
			if (allPlayer.Input.IsNullOrDestroyed())
			{
				return;
			}
			allPlayer.PlayerUI.UserInterface.EventSystem.Suspend(allPlayer.Input.id != _currentPlayerInput.id);
			allPlayer.PlayerUI.UserInterface.EventSystem.SetSelectedGameObject(null);
		}
		_currentPlayerInput.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: false, 0);
		_currentPlayerInput.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: true, 8);
		_currentPlayerInput.SetCursorEnabled(enabled: true);
		_view.SetInput(_currentPlayerInput);
		if (_optionsMenuPresenter.CurrentPanel == null)
		{
			_view.SelectFirstButton();
		}
		else
		{
			_optionsMenuPresenter.ResetControls(_currentPlayerInput);
		}
	}

	private void AttemptToGoToPreviousScreen()
	{
		if (_view.Visible && !DialogueBox.Notifying && Game.State == GameState.MAIN_MENU)
		{
			switch (_currentSubScreen)
			{
			case MainMenuScreen.PLAY:
				PlayBackButton_Click(null);
				break;
			case MainMenuScreen.PLAY_ONLINE:
				PlayOnlineBackButton_Click(null);
				break;
			case MainMenuScreen.HOST:
				PlayOnlineHostBackButton_Click(null);
				break;
			case MainMenuScreen.HOST_CONTINUE_GAME:
				_currentSubScreen = MainMenuScreen.HOST;
				break;
			case MainMenuScreen.HOST_NEW_GAME:
				_currentSubScreen = MainMenuScreen.HOST;
				break;
			case MainMenuScreen.JOIN:
				_currentSubScreen = MainMenuScreen.PLAY_ONLINE;
				break;
			}
		}
	}

	private void StartNewGame(GameSettings settings)
	{
		AccountUserStats userStats = GAccountService.Get().LocalUser.UserStats;
		userStats.SessionStats.Reset();
		userStats.Rebase();
		GameMode mode = Game.Mode;
		if (settings.Mode == EGameMode.Cooperative)
		{
			mode = GameMode.Coop_2;
		}
		GameState state = GameState.INTRO;
		int scene = 2;
		Options.CustomSettings = settings;
		if (settings.World == EGameWorldMode.Existing || (settings.World == EGameWorldMode.Random && NEW_RANDOM_WORLD_CREATED))
		{
			ReplicatedStartGame(mode, state, scene);
		}
		else if (settings.World == EGameWorldMode.Random)
		{
			Timing.RunCoroutine(CreateRandomWorld_Sequence(mode, state, scene));
		}
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> CreateRandomWorld_Sequence(GameMode mode, GameState state, int scene)
	{
		if (mode.IsServer())
		{
			yield return PlayerRegistry.LocalPeer.SetTimeout_Async(Peer.GetSessionTimeout());
		}
		_cartographerMenuPresenter.ShowRandomizeWorldDialogue_NoInput(() =>
		{
			if (mode.IsServer())
			{
				PlayerRegistry.LocalPeer.WorldSeed = StrandedWorld.LOCAL_WORLD_SEED;
			}
			ReplicatedStartGame(mode, state, scene);
			_newGameMenuPresenter.Suspend = false;
		}, () =>
		{
			_newGameMenuPresenter.Suspend = false;
		});
	}

	private void StartContinueGame()
	{
		ReplicatedStartGame(Game.Mode, GameState.LOAD_GAME, 3);
	}

	public void StartGame(GameMode mode, GameState state, int scene)
	{
		Time.timeScale = 1f;
		if ((bool)_view)
		{
			_view.CanvasGroup.Interactable = false;
		}
		else
		{
			Debug.LogError("No _view");
		}
		Game.Mode = mode;
		Game.State = state;
		ResetStats();
		if (Game.Mode.IsMaster() && Game.State == GameState.LOAD_GAME)
		{
			LoadStats(Game.Mode);
		}
		if (!Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
		{
			MultiplayerMng.ConnectToLocal(() =>
			{
				_newGameMenuPresenter.Hide();
				StartScene(scene);
			});
		}
		else
		{
			_newGameMenuPresenter.Hide();
			StartScene(scene);
		}
		_view.PlayOnlineHostSubMenu.SetActive(value: false);
	}

	private void StartScene(int scene)
	{
		FadeMode mode = FadeMode.Custom;
		if (Game.State != GameState.LOAD_GAME || !_customBgd)
		{
			mode = FadeMode.Solid;
		}
		Singleton<Fader>.Instance.FadeOut(3f, mode, () =>
		{
			LoadLevel(scene);
		});
	}

	private void CloseSession(DisconnectDetail detail)
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsClient())
		{
			World.PopWorld();
		}
		SetSceneRootsActive(3, value: false);
		PlayerUtilities.SetPlayerBundlesActive(active: false);
		PlayerRegistry.LocalPeer.ReplicatedDisconnect(detail, null, forceLocalShutdown: true);
		if (!MultiplayerMng.Instance.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(MultiplayerMng.Instance.gameObject);
		}
	}

	public static void SetSceneRootsActive(int sceneBuildIndex, bool value)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < SceneManager.sceneCount; i++)
		{
			Scene sceneAt = SceneManager.GetSceneAt(i);
			if (sceneAt.IsNullOrDestroyed() || sceneAt.buildIndex != sceneBuildIndex)
			{
				continue;
			}
			GameObject[] rootGameObjects = sceneAt.GetRootGameObjects();
			foreach (GameObject gameObject in rootGameObjects)
			{
				if (gameObject != null)
				{
					gameObject.SetActive(value);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public void QuitToMenu(float fadeOutTime = 3f)
	{
		NEW_RANDOM_WORLD_CREATED = false;
		_view.CanvasGroup.Interactable = false;
		_suspend = true;
		QuittingToMenu?.Invoke();
		CloseSession(DisconnectDetail.Intended);
		RewiredUtilities.Players.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: false, 15);
		Singleton<Fader>.Instance.FadeOut(fadeOutTime, FadeMode.Solid, Game.QuitToMenu);
	}

	{
		Game.QuitToDesktop();
	}

	public void LoadLevel(int level, LoadSceneMode mode = LoadSceneMode.Additive)
	{
		CursorUtils.LockState = CursorLockMode.Locked;
		CursorUtils.Visible = false;
		LevelLoader.LoadLevel(level, mode, SceneLoad_Started, SceneLoad_Finished);
	}

	{
		Hide();
		_loadingScreenPresenter.Show();
	}

	private void SceneLoad_Finished()
	{
		_loadingScreenPresenter.Hide();
		_view.BackgroundTexture.Enabled = false;
		_view.BackgroundTexture.transform.gameObject.SetActive(value: false);
	}

	public void ShowJoinSessionDialog(Action onTimeout = null, EmptyEventHandler onSkip = null)
	{
		_currentPlayerInput.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: false, 8);
		_joinSessionDialog = DialogueBox.Show(_currentPlayerInput, "NEW_GAME_MENU_LABEL_TITLE", "PLAY_ONLINE_MENU_CREATE_SESSION_CREATING", DialogueButton.None);
		if (onSkip != null)
		{
			_joinSessionDialog.Decline += onSkip;
		}
		_joinSessionDialogTimeout = Timing.RunCoroutine(TimeOut_Sequence(onTimeout));
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> TimeOut_Sequence(Action onTimeout)
	{
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(30f);
		onTimeout?.Invoke();
	}

	public void HideJoinSessionDialog()
	{
		_currentPlayerInput.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: true, 8);
		if ((bool)_joinSessionDialog)
		{
			_joinSessionDialog.Destroy();
		}
		if (_joinSessionDialogTimeout.IsValid && _joinSessionDialogTimeout.IsRunning)
		{
			_joinSessionDialogTimeout.IsRunning = false;
		}
	}

	public void ShowNewGameMenuPresenter()
	{
		_newGameMenuPresenter.Show();
	}

	private void MPFriendlyQuit()
	{
		MultiplayerMng.UpdateSessionToken_IsBusy(isBusy: false);
		if (Game.Mode.IsServer())
		{
			new ReplicateQuitToMenu().Post();
			BeamTiming.WaitAnd(0.33f, () =>
			{
				QuitToMenu();
			});
		}
		else
		{
			QuitToMenu();
		}
	}

	public void ReplicatedStartGame(GameMode mode, GameState state, int scene)
	{
		if (mode.IsServer())
		{
			ReplicateStartGame replicateStartGame = new ReplicateStartGame();
			replicateStartGame.Mode = ((mode == GameMode.Coop_Server) ? 5 : 4);
			replicateStartGame.State = (int)state;
			replicateStartGame.Scene = scene;
			replicateStartGame.Post();
		}
		StartGame(mode, state, scene);
	}

	private void SetBackgroundTexture(Texture2D texture)
	{
		if (!_view.BackgroundTexture.transform.gameObject.activeSelf)
		{
			_view.BackgroundTexture.Enabled = true;
			_view.BackgroundTexture.transform.gameObject.SetActive(value: true);
		}
		_view.BackgroundTexture.Texture = texture;
		Singleton<Fader>.Instance.SetCustomTexture(texture);
	}

	private Texture2D LoadTextureBytes(string path)
	{
		if (!File.Exists(path))
		{
			return null;
		}
		byte[] array;
		using (FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(path, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read))
		{
			array = new byte[fileStream.Length];
			fileStream.Read(array, 0, (int)fileStream.Length);
		}
		return LoadTextureBytes(array);
	}

	private Texture2D LoadTextureBytes(byte[] bytes)
	{
		if (bytes == null)
		{
			return null;
		}
		Texture2D texture2D = new Texture2D(1, 1);
		if (texture2D.LoadImage(bytes))
		{
			return texture2D;
		}
		return null;
	}

	protected bool IsContinueButtonAvailable()
	{
		if (!_view.ContinueButton.Visible)
		{
			return _view.ContinueCoopButton.Visible;
		}
		return true;
	}

	public async void CheckOnlineAvailable(Action onAvailable, Action onNotAvailableDialogueDismissed, Action onNotAvailable = null)
	{
		_view.CanvasGroup.Interactable = false;
		if (await NetworkConnectivity.CheckHttpConnectivityAsync() != 0)
		{
			_view.CanvasGroup.Interactable = true;
			onNotAvailable?.Invoke();
			DialogueBox.Show(_currentPlayerInput, "TEXT_ERROR", "PLAY_ONLINE_MENU_CREATE_SESSION_CREATING_ERROR_CONNECTING", DialogueButton.Ok, DialogueIcon.Warning).Accept += () =>
			{
				onNotAvailableDialogueDismissed?.Invoke();
			};
		}
		else
		{
			_view.CanvasGroup.Interactable = true;
			onAvailable?.Invoke();
		}
	}
}

	public override void SetWatchMode(int mode)
	{
		if (_currentMode == mode && _currentMode != 3 && _currentMode != 2)
		{
			return;
		}
		_currentMode = mode;
		for (int i = 0; i < _watchModes.Length; i++)
		{
			bool active = i == _currentMode;
			_watchModes[i].Active = active;
		}
		if (_currentMode == 3)
		{
			int num = 0;
			Zone[] zones = Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.Zones;
			foreach (Zone zone in zones)
			{
				if ((Game.Mode.IsMaster() && zone.HasVisited) || (Game.Mode.IsClient() && zone.HasVisited))
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			CreateStatusLabels(statisticsNames, _statisticsNamesLabelsContainer, _statisticsNamesLabelPrefab, tryUpdate: true);
		}
		else if (_currentMode == 2)
		{
			IList<string> statusEffectsWatch = _controller.Player.Statistics.GetStatusEffectsWatch();
			if (statusEffectsWatch != null)
			{
				CreateStatusLabels(statusEffectsWatch, _statusLabelsContainer, _statusLabelPrefab, tryUpdate: true);
			}
		}
	}

	public override void CycleWatchModeForward()
	{
		int num = _currentMode + 1;
		if ((Game.Mode.IsClient() || (Game.Mode.IsLocalCoop() && _controller.Player.Id > 0)) && num == 3)
		{
			num++;
		}
		if (num > _watchModes.Length - 1)
		{
			num = 0;
		}
		SetWatchMode(num);
	}

	public override void CycleWatchModeBackward()
	{
		int num = _currentMode - 1;
		if (num < 0)
		{
			num = _watchModes.Length - 1;
		}
		if ((Game.Mode.IsClient() || (Game.Mode.IsLocalCoop() && _controller.Player.Id > 0)) && num == 3)
		{
			num--;
		}
		SetWatchMode(num);
	}

	public void CreateStatusLabels<T>(IList<T> labels, TransformViewAdapter container, TMPLabelViewAdapter prefab, bool tryUpdate = false)
	{
		if (tryUpdate && labels.Count == container.Transform.childCount)
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (num = 0; num < container.Transform.childCount; num++)
			{
				TMPLabelViewAdapter component = container.Transform.GetChild(num).gameObject.GetComponent<TMPLabelViewAdapter>();
				if (component == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				component.Text = labels[num].ToString().ToUpper();
			}
			if (num == container.Transform.childCount)
			{
				return;
			}
		}
		BeamTeam.DestroyAllChildren(container);
		foreach (T label in labels)
		{
			TMPLabelViewAdapter tMPLabelViewAdapter = Object.Instantiate(prefab);
			tMPLabelViewAdapter.transform.SetParent(container.Transform, worldPositionStays: false);
			tMPLabelViewAdapter.Text = label.ToString().ToUpper();
			FormatLabelAutoSizing(tMPLabelViewAdapter, 17f, 8f);
		}
	}

	private void FormatLabelAutoSizing(TMPLabelViewAdapter label, float maxSize, float minSize)
	{
		label.EnableAutoSizing = true;
		label.FontSizeMax = maxSize;
		label.FontSizeMin = minSize;
		label.EnableWordWrapping = false;
	}
}

		}

	{

		{
			_cachedDisplayName = string.Join(" ", DisplayNamePrefixes, _displayName);
		}
		else
		{

	}

	public virtual void Damage(float damage, IBase damager)
	{
		OnDamaged(damage, damager);
		IPickupable pickupable = damager as IPickupable;
		if (!pickupable.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			LastPlayerIdToDamageThis = pickupable.PreviousOwnerId;
		}
		HealthPoints -= damage;
		if (HealthPoints <= 0f)
		{
			if (_materialRefunder != null)
			{
				_materialRefunder.RefundMaterials(LastPlayerIdToDamageThis);
			}
			Destroy();
		}
	}

		{
			jObject.AddField("dName", JSerializer.Serialize(_displayName));
		}
		if (!Mathf.Approximately(_healthPoints, OriginalHealthPoints))
		{
			jObject.AddField("healthPoints", JSerializer.Serialize(_healthPoints));
		}
		return jObject;
	}

	public override void Load(JObject data)

		CompleteTransformSerialization();
		JObject field = data.GetField("dName");
		if (field != null)
		{
			string value = field.GetValue<string>();
			DisplayName = value;
		}
		JObject field2 = data.GetField("healthPoints");
		if (field2 != null)
		{
			_healthPoints = field2.GetValue<float>();
		}
	}
}

	public static bool IsUnderwater(Transform t)

		{

		}
		return t.position.y < Ceto.Ocean.Instance.QueryWaves(t.position.x, t.position.z);

	public static bool IsVisible(Bounds bounds)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < _AllCameras.Count; i++)
		{
			IGameCamera gameCamera = _AllCameras[i];
			BeamGeometryUtility.CalculateFrustumPlanes(_planes, gameCamera.Camera.projectionMatrix * gameCamera.Camera.worldToCameraMatrix);
			if (GeometryUtility.TestPlanesAABB(_planes, bounds))
			{
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	public static bool IsCulled(Vector3 position, float cullingDistance)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < _AllCameras.Count; i++)
		{
			if ((_AllCameras[i].Camera.transform.position - position).sqrMagnitude < BeamMath.Sqr(cullingDistance))
			{
				return false;
			}
		}
		return true;
	}

	private void Camera_OnPreCull(Camera camera)
	{
		if (!(camera == null) && (camera.CompareTag("MainCamera") || camera.CompareTag("PlayerCamera")))
		{
			_Current = camera;
			OnPreCull?.Invoke(_Current);
			CalculateFrustumCorners(_Current);
		}
	}

	private void CalculateFrustumCorners(Camera camera)
	{
		float nearClipPlane = camera.nearClipPlane;
		float farClipPlane = camera.farClipPlane;
		float fieldOfView = camera.fieldOfView;
		float aspect = camera.aspect;
		Matrix4x4 identity = Matrix4x4.identity;
		float num = fieldOfView * 0.5f;
		Vector3 vector = camera.transform.right * nearClipPlane * Mathf.Tan(num * (MathF.PI / 180f)) * aspect;
		Vector3 vector2 = camera.transform.up * nearClipPlane * Mathf.Tan(num * (MathF.PI / 180f));
		Vector3 vector3 = camera.transform.forward * nearClipPlane - vector + vector2;
		float num2 = vector3.magnitude * farClipPlane / nearClipPlane;
		vector3.Normalize();
		vector3 *= num2;
		Vector3 vector4 = camera.transform.forward * nearClipPlane + vector + vector2;
		vector4.Normalize();
		vector4 *= num2;
		Vector3 vector5 = camera.transform.forward * nearClipPlane + vector - vector2;
		vector5.Normalize();
		vector5 *= num2;
		Vector3 vector6 = camera.transform.forward * nearClipPlane - vector - vector2;
		vector6.Normalize();
		vector6 *= num2;
		identity.SetRow(0, vector3);
		identity.SetRow(1, vector4);
		identity.SetRow(2, vector5);
		identity.SetRow(3, vector6);
		Shader.SetGlobalMatrix("_ShaderFrustumCorners", identity);
	}

		Vector3 vector = zone.transform.position + Vector3.up * 128f;
		string text = ((Game.Mode == GameMode.SinglePlayer) ? "dynamic" : "dynamic_COOP");
		CaptureScreen(vector, down, Screen.width, Screen.height, text);
		JObject jObject = new JObject();
		jObject.AddField("Pos", JSerializer.Serialize(vector));
		jObject.AddField("Dir", JSerializer.Serialize(down));
		rootData.AddField("ScreenCap", jObject);
	}

	private void CaptureScreen(Vector3 position, Vector3 direction, int width, int height, string name)
	{
		Debug.Log("Cameras::CaptureScreen:: Capturing Screen...");
		Camera camera = CreateCamera(_postCamera);
		camera.depth = GetPostCamera().depth + 2f;
		Camera camera2 = CreateCamera(PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers[0].PlayerCamera.Camera);
		camera2.depth = camera.depth - 1f;
		if (!CameraData.ContainsKey(camera2))
		{
			CameraData.Add(camera2, new AlwaysCameraData(camera2));
		}
		Quaternion rotation = Quaternion.LookRotation(direction, Vector3.up);
		RenderTexture temporary = RenderTexture.GetTemporary(width, height, 24, RenderTextureFormat.ARGB32);
		RenderInto(camera2, temporary, position, rotation);
		RenderInto(camera, temporary, position, rotation);
		RenderTexture active = RenderTexture.active;
		RenderTexture.active = temporary;
		Texture2D texture2D = new Texture2D(temporary.width, temporary.height, TextureFormat.RGB24, mipChain: false);
		texture2D.ReadPixels(new Rect(0f, 0f, texture2D.width, texture2D.height), 0, 0);
		texture2D.Apply(updateMipmaps: false);
		RenderTexture.active = active;
		temporary.Release();
		DestroyCamera(camera2);
		DestroyCamera(camera);
		Debug.Log("Cameras::CaptureScreen:: Writing screenshot to file...");
		string path = PathTools.Combine(SaveManager.GetSaveFolderPath(), name + ".bytes");
		try
		{
			using (FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(path, FileMode.Create, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.ReadWrite))
			{
				byte[] array = texture2D.EncodeToPNG();
				fileStream.Write(array, 0, array.Length);
			}
			Debug.Log("Cameras::CaptureScreen:: Complete.");
		}
		catch (Exception)
		{
			Debug.LogError("Cameras::CaptureScreen:: Error writing screenshot to file: ");
			LocalizedNotification localizedNotification = new LocalizedNotification(new Notification());
			localizedNotification.Priority = NotificationPriority.Immediate;
			localizedNotification.Duration = 8f;
			localizedNotification.PlayerId = 0;
			localizedNotification.MessageText.SetTerm("Error writing screenshot to file. Please contact Beam Team on the Steam Forum.");
			localizedNotification.Raise();
		}
	}

	private void RenderInto(Camera camera, RenderTexture target, Vector3 position, Quaternion rotation)
	{
		camera.transform.position = position;
		camera.transform.rotation = rotation;
		camera.targetTexture = target;
		camera.Render();
	}
}

using System.Collections;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Beam;

public class Decal : MonoBehaviour
{
	private ITerrainProvider _terrain;

	[SerializeField]
	private float _size = 1f;

	[SerializeField]
	private float _offset = 0.03f;

	private IEnumerator Start()
	{
		Decal decal = this;
		ITerrainProvider instance = Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance;
		decal._terrain = instance ?? NullObject<NullTerrainProvider>.Instance;
		while (LevelLoader.IsLoading())
		{
			yield return null;
		}
		GenerateDecalMesh();
	}

	private void GenerateDecalMesh()
	{
		Mesh mesh = new Mesh();
		float size = _size;
		int num = 8;
		int num2 = num + 1;
		int num3 = num + 1;
		int num4 = num2 * num3;
		Vector3[] array = new Vector3[num4];
		Vector2[] array2 = new Vector2[num4];
		Vector2 b = new Vector2(1f / ((float)num3 - 1f), 1f / ((float)num2 - 1f));
		Vector3 a = new Vector3(size / ((float)num3 - 1f), 1f, size / ((float)num2 - 1f));
		for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
		{
			for (int j = 0; j < num3; j++)
			{
				Vector3 b2 = new Vector3(j, 0f, i);
				Vector3 position = Vector3.Scale(a, b2) - new Vector3(size / 2f, 0f, size / 2f);
				Vector3 worldPosition = transform.TransformPoint(position);
				float height = _terrain.GetHeight(worldPosition);
				array[j * num3 + i] = transform.InverseTransformPoint(new Vector3(worldPosition.x, height + _offset, worldPosition.z));
				array2[j * num3 + i] = Vector2.Scale(new Vector2(j, i), b);
			}
		}
		mesh.vertices = array;
		mesh.uv = array2;
		int num5 = num + 1;
		int[] array3 = new int[num * num * 6];
		int k = 0;
		int num6 = 0;
		for (; k < num; k++)
		{
			for (int l = 0; l < num; l++)
			{
				array3[num6++] = k * num5 + l;
				array3[num6++] = k * num5 + (l + 1);
				array3[num6++] = (k + 1) * num5 + (l + 1);
				array3[num6++] = k * num5 + l;
				array3[num6++] = (k + 1) * num5 + l + 1;
				array3[num6++] = (k + 1) * num5 + l;
			}
		}
		mesh.triangles = array3;
		mesh.RecalculateNormals();
		mesh.RecalculateTangents();
		GetComponent<MeshFilter>().mesh = mesh;
	}

using System.Collections.Generic;
using Beam.Developer.UI;
using Beam.Serialization;
using Funlabs;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Beam;

public class DeveloperMode : MonoBehaviour, INeedPlayerComponent
{
	private class ReplicateToggleGod : MultiplayerMessage
	{
		[Replicate]
		public IPlayer Player;

		public override void OnPeer()
		{
			Player.DeveloperMode.ToggleGodMode();
		}
	}

	private class ReplicateCreate : MultiplayerMessage
	{
		[Replicate]
		public short PrefabId;

		[Replicate]
		public Vector3 Pos;

		public override void OnPeer()
		{
			MultiplayerMng.Instantiate<SaveablePrefab>((uint)PrefabId, Pos, Quaternion.identity, MiniGuid.New());
		}
	}

	public bool startInFlyMode;

	public KeyCode toggleMode = KeyCode.G;

	public KeyCode flyUp = KeyCode.E;

	public KeyCode flyDown = KeyCode.Q;

	[SerializeField]
	private List<GameObject> _items;

	[SerializeField]
	private List<GameObject> _tools;

	[SerializeField]
	private List<GameObject> _consumables;

	private float curSpeed;

	private float minFlySpeed = 20f;

	private float nrmFlySpeed = 35f;

	private float maxFlySpeed = 75f;

	private bool _inFlyMode;

	private IPlayer _player;

	private CharacterController _characterController;

	public bool InFlyMode => _inFlyMode;

	public IPlayer Player => _player;

	private void Awake()
	{
		_characterController = GetComponent<CharacterController>();
		_inFlyMode = startInFlyMode;
	}

	public void SetPlayer(IPlayer player)
	{
		_player = player;
	}

	public void Create(GameObject prefab, float offset = 0f)
	{
		uint valueOrDefault = (prefab?.GetComponent<ISaveablePrefab>()?.PrefabId).GetValueOrDefault();
		if (valueOrDefault != 0)
		{
			Create(valueOrDefault, offset);
		}
	}

	public void Create(uint prefabId, float offset = 0f)
	{
		Vector3 forward = Camera.main.transform.forward;
		forward.y = 0f;
		forward.Normalize();
		bool flag = Prefabs.TryGetMultiplayerPrefabName(prefabId, out var _);
		Vector3 vector = transform.position + forward + Vector3.up * offset;
		if (flag)
		{
			if (Game.Mode.IsClient())
			{
				ReplicateCreate replicateCreate = new ReplicateCreate();
				replicateCreate.PrefabId = (short)prefabId;
				replicateCreate.Pos = vector;
				replicateCreate.Post();
			}
			else
			{
				MultiplayerMng.Instantiate<SaveablePrefab>(prefabId, vector, Quaternion.identity, MiniGuid.New());
			}
		}
		else
		{
			MultiplayerMng.Instantiate<SaveablePrefab>(prefabId, vector, Quaternion.identity, MiniGuid.New());
			ReplicateCreate replicateCreate2 = new ReplicateCreate();
			replicateCreate2.PrefabId = (short)prefabId;
			replicateCreate2.Pos = vector;
			replicateCreate2.Post();
		}
	}

	private void FixedUpdate()
	{
		if (_inFlyMode && _player.IsOwner && (!DeveloperConsolePresenter.Instance || !DeveloperConsolePresenter.Instance.IsOpen))
		{
			float axis = _player.Input.GetAxis(0);
			float axis2 = _player.Input.GetAxis(1);
			curSpeed = nrmFlySpeed;
			if (_player.Input.GetButton(6))
			{
				curSpeed = maxFlySpeed;
			}
			if (_player.Input.GetButton(5))
			{
				curSpeed = minFlySpeed;
			}
			Vector3 direction = new Vector3(axis, 0f, axis2);
			direction = _player.PlayerCamera.transform.TransformDirection(direction);
			direction *= curSpeed;
			_characterController.Move(direction * Time.deltaTime);
		}
	}

	private void ToggleGodMode()
	{
		if (!_inFlyMode)
		{
			_player.Movement.GodMode = true;
			_player.Movement.falling = false;
			_player.Movement.grounded = false;
			_player.Movement.InWater = false;
			_player.Movement.ActivePlatform = null;
			_player.Movement.activeLadder = null;
			_player.Movement.activeLedge = null;
			_inFlyMode = true;
		}
		else if (_inFlyMode)
		{
			_player.Movement.activeLadder = null;
			_player.Movement.ActivePlatform = null;
			_player.Movement.GodMode = false;
			_inFlyMode = false;
		}
	}

	public bool Teleport(int zoneId)
	{
		if (zoneId < 0 || zoneId > 48)
		{
			return false;
		}
		Zone zone = Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.Zones[zoneId];
		Teleport(zone.transform.position);
		return true;
	}

	public bool Teleport(Vector3 position)
	{
		if (!_inFlyMode)
		{
			ReplicatedToggleGodMode();
		}
		_player.transform.position = position + Vector3.up * 22.5f;
		return true;
	}

	public void ReplicatedToggleGodMode()
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
		{
			ReplicateToggleGod replicateToggleGod = new ReplicateToggleGod();
			replicateToggleGod.Player = _player;
			replicateToggleGod.Post();
		}
		ToggleGodMode();
	}
}



/* SOURCE_FILE: /storage/emulated/0/Map Check/reports/V24_SOURCE_RECOVERY/CS_SOURCE/Assembly-CSharp__Beam__FlockController.cs
SOURCE_BYTES: 11133
SOURCE_SHA256: ff69f38490da62dd7c06b9c3b4687e3d24b8543e9aa68b42fd4a7bd738a13634
MATCHES: StrandedWorld
*/
using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Beam.Events;
using Beam.Utilities;
using Funlabs;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Beam;

public class FlockController : MonoBehaviour
{
	private class ReplicatedRepositionOriginMsg : MultiplayerMessage
	{
		[Replicate]
		public Vector3 Position;

		public override void OnPeer()
		{
			UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectOfType<FlockController>().RepositionOrigin(Position);
		}
	}

	private static FlockController _Instance;

	private LandingSpotController _landingSpotController;

	[SerializeField]
	private Transform _activeContainer;

	[SerializeField]
	private Transform _deactivatedContainer;

	[SerializeField]
	private LayerMask _avoidanceMask;

	private Vector3 _origin;

	[Header("Flock Bounds")]
	[SerializeField]
	private Vector3 _center;

	[SerializeField]
	private Vector2 _size;

	[SerializeField]
	private Vector2 _spawnBuffer;

	[Header("Waypoints")]
	[SerializeField]
	private float _waypointDistance = 10f;

	[Tooltip("Bias for new waypoint direction between flock's forward direction and random direction.")]
	[Range(0f, 1f)]
	[SerializeField]
	private float _waypointForwardBias = 0.3f;

	[Tooltip("Bias for new waypoint height between flock's height and random height.")]
	[Range(0f, 1f)]
	[SerializeField]
	private float _waypointHeightBias = 0.5f;

	[Header("Flocks")]
	[SerializeField]
	private FlockProvider _flockProvider;

	public FlockAudio _flockAudioPrefab;

	private IList<FlockData> _flockData;

	private Dictionary<FlockSpecies, FlockData> _availableFlocks = new Dictionary<FlockSpecies, FlockData>();

	private string _currentZoneName;

	private string _nmlZoneName = "";

	private string _endGameZoneName = "";

	public static FlockController Instance => _Instance;

	public Transform ActiveContainer => _activeContainer;

	public Transform DeactivatedContainer => _deactivatedContainer;

	public LayerMask AvoidanceMask => _avoidanceMask;

	public IDictionary<FlockSpecies, FlockData> AvailableFlocks => _availableFlocks;

	public Vector3 ControllerPosition => _origin + _center;

	public float MaxLandingSpotDistance => 30f;

	private void Awake()
	{
		if (_Instance != null)
		{
			BeamTeam.Destroy(gameObject);
		}
		else
		{
			_Instance = this;
		}
	}

	private IEnumerator Start()
	{
		_landingSpotController = Singleton<LandingSpotController>.Instance;
		if (!Game.Mode.IsMaster())
		{
			yield break;
		}
		while (LevelLoader.IsLoadingScene())
		{
			yield return null;
		}
		_flockData = _flockProvider.GetFlocks();
		CreateFlocks();
		EventManager.AddListener<EndGameSequenceEvent>(EventManager_EndGameSequenceEvent);
		if ((bool)Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance)
		{
			_nmlZoneName = Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.NmlZone.name;
			Zone zone = Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.FindEndGameZone();
			if ((bool)zone)
			{
				_endGameZoneName = zone.name;
			}
		}
		InvokeRepeating("PollZone", 1f, 1f);
		InvokeRepeating("PollFlockEvents", 1f, 1f);
	}

	private void OnDestroy()
	{
		if (!(_Instance != this))
		{
			_Instance = null;
			if (Game.Mode.IsMaster())
			{
				EventManager.RemoveListener<EndGameSequenceEvent>(EventManager_EndGameSequenceEvent);
			}
		}
	}

	private void EventManager_EndGameSequenceEvent(EndGameSequenceEvent e)
	{
		StopAllFlockAudio();
	}

	private void PollZone()
	{
		IPlayer player = PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers.FirstOrDefault_NonAlloc();
		if (player.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			return;
		}
		Zone zone = StrandedWorld.GetZone(player.transform.position);
		if ((bool)zone && !(zone.name == _currentZoneName))
		{
			_currentZoneName = zone.name;
			DeactivateFlocks();
			if (!(_currentZoneName == _nmlZoneName) && !(_currentZoneName == _endGameZoneName))
			{
				ReplicatedRepositionOrigin(zone.transform.position);
				RefreshAvailableFlocks();
			}
		}
	}

	private void RepositionOrigin(Vector3 position)
	{
		Vector3 origin = position;
		origin.y = 0f;
		_origin = origin;
	}

	private void CreateFlocks()
	{
		foreach (FlockData flockDatum in _flockData)
		{
			_availableFlocks.Add(flockDatum.Species, flockDatum);
			FlockAudio audio = CreateFlockAudio(flockDatum);
			_availableFlocks[flockDatum.Species].Audio = audio;
			for (int i = 0; i < flockDatum.Population; i++)
			{
				CreateFlockChild(flockDatum);
			}
		}
	}

	public void StopAllFlockAudio()
	{
		foreach (FlockData flockDatum in _flockData)
		{
			_availableFlocks[flockDatum.Species].Audio.Stop();
		}
	}

	private FlockChild CreateFlockChild(FlockData flockData)
	{
		FlockChild component = MultiplayerMng.Instantiate<SaveablePrefab>(flockData.Prefab.GetComponent<SaveablePrefab>().PrefabId, MiniGuid.New()).GetComponent<FlockChild>();
		component.transform.SetParent(_deactivatedContainer, worldPositionStays: false);
		component.Initialize(this, _landingSpotController);
		flockData.Children.Add(component);
		return component;
	}

	private FlockAudio CreateFlockAudio(FlockData flockData)
	{
		FlockAudio flockAudio = UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(_flockAudioPrefab);
		flockAudio.transform.SetParent(_deactivatedContainer, worldPositionStays: false);
		flockAudio.AmbientClip = flockData.FlockAudioClip;
		return flockAudio;
	}

	private void InitializeFlockChild(FlockChild flockChild, Vector3 startingPosition)
	{
		flockChild.transform.position = startingPosition + UnityEngine.Random.onUnitSphere * flockChild.LocalWaypointSpreadRadius;
		flockChild.Reset();
		flockChild.SetLocalWaypoint();
		flockChild.ReplicatedChangeState(FlockChildState.Flying, Vector3.zero);
	}

	private void PollFlockEvents()
	{
		if (_currentZoneName == _nmlZoneName || _currentZoneName == _endGameZoneName)
		{
			return;
		}
		foreach (KeyValuePair<FlockSpecies, FlockData> availableFlock in _availableFlocks)
		{
			FlockData value = availableFlock.Value;
			if ((!value.Active || value.Migrating) && CheckTime(value.StartTime, value.EndTime))
			{
				if (UnityEngine.Random.value * 100f <= (float)value.Percentage)
				{
					StartFlockEvent(value);
				}
			}
			else if (value.Active && !CheckTime(value.StartTime, value.EndTime))
			{
				StopFlockEvent(value);
			}
			if (value.Migrating && value.Children.All_NonAlloc((FlockChild x) => (FlockChildState)x.CurrentState == FlockChildState.Migrated))
			{
				DeactivateFlock(value);
			}
		}
	}

	private void StartFlockEvent(FlockData flockData)
	{
		Vector3 startingPosition = GetStartingPosition();
		flockData.Migrating = false;
		flockData.Waypoint = GetRandomPositionInBounds();
		SetNewWaypointForSpecies(flockData.Species, UnityEngine.Random.onUnitSphere);
		flockData.Audio.transform.position = startingPosition;
		ActivateFlock(flockData);
		foreach (FlockChild child in flockData.Children)
		{
			InitializeFlockChild(child, startingPosition);
		}
	}

	private void StopFlockEvent(FlockData flockData)
	{
		if (flockData.Migrating)
		{
			return;
		}
		Vector3 startingPosition = GetStartingPosition();
		flockData.Migrating = true;
		flockData.Waypoint = startingPosition;
		flockData.Audio.TargetPosition = startingPosition;
		foreach (FlockChild child in flockData.Children)
		{
			child.SpeciesWaypoint = flockData.Waypoint;
			child.SetLocalWaypoint();
			child.Migrate();
		}
	}

	private void ActivateFlock(FlockData flockData)
	{
		foreach (FlockChild child in flockData.Children)
		{
			child.transform.SetParent(_activeContainer);
		}
		flockData.Audio.transform.SetParent(_activeContainer);
		flockData.Active = true;
	}

	private void DeactivateFlock(FlockData flockData)
	{
		if (!flockData.Active)
		{
			return;
		}
		foreach (FlockChild child in flockData.Children)
		{
			DeactivateFlockChild(child);
		}
		flockData.Audio.transform.SetParent(_deactivatedContainer);
		flockData.Active = false;
	}

	private void DeactivateFlocks()
	{
		foreach (KeyValuePair<FlockSpecies, FlockData> availableFlock in _availableFlocks)
		{
			FlockData value = availableFlock.Value;
			DeactivateFlock(value);
		}
	}

	public void DeactivateFlockChild(FlockChild flockChild)
	{
		flockChild.transform.SetParent(_deactivatedContainer);
	}

	private void RefreshAvailableFlocks()
	{
		_flockData = _flockProvider.GetFlocks();
	}

	public void SetNewWaypointForSpecies(FlockSpecies species, Vector3 forward)
	{
		Vector3 newWaypoint = GetNewWaypoint(_availableFlocks[species].Waypoint, forward);
		foreach (FlockChild child in _availableFlocks[species].Children)
		{
			child.SpeciesWaypoint = newWaypoint;
		}
		_availableFlocks[species].Waypoint = newWaypoint;
		_availableFlocks[species].Audio.TargetPosition = newWaypoint;
	}

	private Vector3 GetNewWaypoint(Vector3 previousWaypoint, Vector3 forward)
	{
		Vector3 vector = Vector3.Lerp(forward, UnityEngine.Random.onUnitSphere, _waypointForwardBias) * _waypointDistance;
		if (Vector3Tools.DistanceOnAxis(ControllerPosition, previousWaypoint + vector, Vector3Tools.xz) > _size.x)
		{
			vector.x *= -1f;
			vector.z *= -1f;
		}
		Vector3 result = previousWaypoint + vector;
		result.y = Mathf.Lerp(previousWaypoint.y, result.y, _waypointHeightBias);
		result.y = Mathf.Clamp(result.y, ControllerPosition.y, ControllerPosition.y + _size.y);
		return result;
	}

	private Vector3 GetStartingPosition()
	{
		Vector3 vector = ControllerPosition - PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers[0].transform.position;
		vector.y = 0f;
		vector.Normalize();
		return ControllerPosition + vector * (_size.x + _spawnBuffer.x);
	}

	public void RemoveChildFromFlock(FlockChild flockChild)
	{
		if (_availableFlocks.TryGetValue(flockChild.Species, out var value))
		{
			value.Children.Remove(flockChild);
			FlockChild flockChild2 = CreateFlockChild(value);
			if (value.Active)
			{
				flockChild2.transform.SetParent(_activeContainer);
			}
			flockChild2.SpeciesWaypoint = value.Waypoint;
			InitializeFlockChild(flockChild2, GetStartingPosition());
			if (value.Migrating)
			{
				flockChild2.Migrate();
			}
		}
	}

	private Vector3 GetRandomPositionInBounds()
	{
		Vector3 result = ControllerPosition + UnityEngine.Random.insideUnitSphere * _size.x;
		result.y = ControllerPosition.y + UnityEngine.Random.Range(0f, _size.y);
		return result;
	}

	private Vector3 GetRandomPositionOnBounds()
	{
		Vector3 result = ControllerPosition + UnityEngine.Random.onUnitSphere * _size.x;
		result.y = ControllerPosition.y + UnityEngine.Random.Range(0f, _size.y);
		return result;
	}

	private void ReplicatedRepositionOrigin(Vector3 position)
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsServer())
		{
			ReplicatedRepositionOriginMsg replicatedRepositionOriginMsg = new ReplicatedRepositionOriginMsg();
			replicatedRepositionOriginMsg.Position = position;
			replicatedRepositionOriginMsg.Post();
		}
		RepositionOrigin(position);
	}

	private bool CheckTime(float startTime, float endTime)
	{
		return IsTimeBetween(GameTime.Now.TimeOfDay, TimeSpan.FromHours(startTime), TimeSpan.FromHours(endTime));
	}

	private bool IsTimeBetween(TimeSpan time, TimeSpan startTime, TimeSpan endTime)
	{
		if (endTime == startTime)
		{
			return true;
		}
		if (endTime < startTime)
		{
			if (!(time <= endTime))
			{
				return time >= startTime;
			}
			return true;
		}
		if (time >= startTime)
		{
			return time <= endTime;
		}
		return false;
	}
}

		get
		{
			return _day;
		}
		set
		{
			_day = value;
			if (_day > DateTime.DaysInMonth(_year, Month + 1) - 1)
			{
				_day = 0;
				Month++;
			}
		}
	}

	public int DaysElapsed => _daysElapsed;

	public int DaysAlive => DaysElapsed + 1;

	public DayTickEvent NewDayTick => _newDayTick;

	private void Awake()
	{
		_year = 2022;
		FastRandom fastRandom = new FastRandom(StrandedWorld.WORLD_SEED);
		Month = fastRandom.Next(0, 12);
		Day = fastRandom.Next(0, DateTime.DaysInMonth(_year, Month + 1));
		Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.DayTick += GameTime_DayTick;
		Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.NewDayTick += GameTime_NewDayTick;
	}

	protected override void OnDestroy()
	{
		if (Singleton<GameTime>.Instance != null)

			Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.NewDayTick -= GameTime_NewDayTick;
		}
		base.OnDestroy();
	}

	private void GameTime_DayTick()
	{
		Day++;
		_daysElapsed++;

	private void GameTime_NewDayTick()
	{
		NewDayTick?.Invoke(_daysElapsed);
		GAccountService.Get().LocalUser.UserStats.SessionStats.DaysSurvived = DaysElapsed;

		private IEnumerator<float> ConnectSegments()
		{

			float startTime = Time.unscaledTime;
			bool found = false;
			while (!found && !(Time.unscaledTime > startTime + Peer.DEFAULT_TIMEOUT))
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < SegmentsReferenceIds.Length; i++)
				{
					MiniGuid referenceId = SegmentsReferenceIds[i];
					if (!referenceId.IsDefault())
					{
						InteractiveObject_PALM_LOG interactiveObject_PALM_LOG = MultiplayerMng.FindObject<InteractiveObject_PALM_LOG>(referenceId);
						if (!interactiveObject_PALM_LOG.IsNullOrDestroyed())
						{
							segments.Add(interactiveObject_PALM_LOG);
							SegmentsReferenceIds[i] = default;
						}
					}
				}
				found = SegmentsReferenceIds.Length == segments.Count;
				if (!found)
				{
					yield return 0f;
				}
			}
			if (found)
			{
				ConnectTreeSegments(segments);

				PlayerRegistry.LocalPeer.ReplicatedDisconnect(DisconnectDetail.Timeout_PalmSegments);

	private void GenerateFruit()
	{
		if (_fruits.Count != 0)
		{
			return;
		}
		Vector3 localPosition = new Vector3(0f, 1f + 2.03f * (float)_treeNumber, 0f);
		GameObject gameObject = Object.Instantiate(_fruitSpawnerPrefab);
		gameObject.transform.parent = transform;
		gameObject.transform.localPosition = localPosition;
		int num = Mathf.Min(Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.GenerateLocalSeed(transform.position).Range(1, gameObject.transform.childCount), 63);
		for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
		{
			MiniGuid referenceId = MiniGuid.NewFrom(ReferenceId, i + 1);
			Transform fruitPosition = gameObject.transform.GetChild(i);
			if (Game.Mode.IsMaster())
			{
				AddFruit(MultiplayerMng.Instantiate<InteractiveObject_FOOD>(_fruit.PrefabId, fruitPosition.position, fruitPosition.rotation, referenceId), fruitPosition);
				continue;
			}
			MultiplayerZoneSync.Instance.LinkData(MultiplayerZoneSync.Usage.Palm, referenceId, (MultiplayerZoneSync.Command command) =>
			{
				AddFruit((InteractiveObject_FOOD)command.Instance, fruitPosition);
			});
		}
		BeamTeam.Destroy(gameObject);
	}

	private void AddFruit(InteractiveObject_FOOD fruit, Transform fruitPosition)
	{
		fruit.transform.parent = null;
		fruit.TransformParent = Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.NmlZone.SaveContainer;
		fruit.Parent();
		AttachFruit(fruit, fruitPosition);
	}

	public override void Damage(float damage, IBase damager)
	{
		IPickupable pickupable = damager as IPickupable;
		if (!pickupable.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			IPlayer playerFromId = PlayerUtilities.GetPlayerFromId(pickupable.OwnerId);
			if (!playerFromId.IsNullOrDestroyed() && !playerFromId.Movement.ClimbingLadder)
			{
				BaseUtilities.DoPlayerDamageMultipliers_Harvesting(ref damage, pickupable);
				_fallDir = playerFromId.transform.forward;
				base.Damage(damage, damager);
				Vector3 vector = new Vector3(0f, 0.15f / (OriginalHealthPoints / damage), 0f);
				_treeTrunk.localPosition += vector;
			}
		}
	}

	public override void Destroy()
	{
		BaseUtilities.DoPlayerDamageExperience_Harvesting(OriginalHealthPoints, LastPlayerIdToDamageThis);
		Lop();
	}

	private void Lop()
	{
		GetComponent<BoxCollider>().enabled = false;
		DetachFruit();
		if (Game.Mode.IsMaster())
		{
			List<InteractiveObject_PALM_LOG> list = GenerateTreeSegments();
			ReplicatedConnectTreeSegments(list);
			float num = Mathf.Max(10f, 20f / (float)list.Count);
			list[list.Count - 1].rigidbody.AddForce(_fallDir * num, ForceMode.Impulse);
		}
		Ladders componentInChildren = GetComponentInChildren<Ladders>();
		if (componentInChildren != null)
		{
			foreach (IPlayer allPlayer in PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers)
			{
				if (allPlayer.Movement.activeLadder == componentInChildren)
				{
					allPlayer.Movement.ExitLadder();
				}
			}
		}
		_stump.transform.parent = transform.parent;
		transform.CheckForProjectilesInChildren();
		ActionEventData.Populate(this, null);
		Lopped?.Invoke(this, ActionEventData);
		BeamTeam.Destroy(gameObject);
	}

	private static void ConnectTreeSegments(List<InteractiveObject_PALM_LOG> segments)
	{
		int num = 0;
		for (int i = 0; i < segments.Count - 1; i++)
		{
			InteractiveObject_PALM_LOG interactiveObject_PALM_LOG = segments[i];
			InteractiveObject_PALM_LOG interactiveObject_PALM_LOG2 = segments[i + 1];
			if (i > 0)
			{
				InteractiveObject_PALM_LOG connectedBelowLog = segments[i - 1];
				interactiveObject_PALM_LOG.ConnectedBelowLog = connectedBelowLog;
			}
			interactiveObject_PALM_LOG.ConnectedAboveLog = interactiveObject_PALM_LOG2;
			FixedJoint fixedJoint = segments[i].gameObject.AddComponent<FixedJoint>();
			fixedJoint.connectedBody = interactiveObject_PALM_LOG2.rigidbody;
			fixedJoint.breakForce = float.PositiveInfinity;
			fixedJoint.breakTorque = float.PositiveInfinity;
			interactiveObject_PALM_LOG.FixedJoint = fixedJoint;
			num++;
		}
		if (num > 0)
		{
			InteractiveObject_PALM_LOG connectedBelowLog2 = segments[num - 1];
			segments[num].ConnectedBelowLog = connectedBelowLog2;
		}
		foreach (InteractiveObject_PALM_LOG segment in segments)
		{
			segment.CheckSeperated();
		}
	}

	public void AttachFruit(InteractiveObject_FOOD fruit, Transform position)
	{
		if (position.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			fruit.Attach(null);
		}
		else
		{
			fruit.Attach(new StaticAttachingAnchor(position));
		}
		fruit.DetachedEvent += Fruit_Detached;
		_fruits.Add(fruit);
	}

	private void DetachFruit()
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < _fruits.Count; i++)
		{
			InteractiveObject_FOOD interactiveObject_FOOD = _fruits[i];
			interactiveObject_FOOD.DetachedEvent -= Fruit_Detached;
			interactiveObject_FOOD.DetachFromImpact();
			interactiveObject_FOOD.rigidbody.AddForce(_fallDir * 4f, ForceMode.VelocityChange);
		}
		_fruits.Clear();
	}

	private void Fruit_Detached(IAttachable sender)
	{
		InteractiveObject_FOOD interactiveObject_FOOD = sender as InteractiveObject_FOOD;
		interactiveObject_FOOD.DetachedEvent -= Fruit_Detached;
		_fruits.Remove(interactiveObject_FOOD);
	}

	private void ReplicatedConnectTreeSegments(List<InteractiveObject_PALM_LOG> segments)
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
		{
			new ReplicateConnectTreeSegments(segments).Post();
		}
		ConnectTreeSegments(segments);
	}

	public override JObject Save()
	{
		JObject jObject = base.Save();
		if (_fruits.Count > 0)
		{
			JObject jObject2 = new JObject();
			for (int i = 0; i < _fruits.Count; i++)
			{
				jObject2.Add(_fruits[i].ReferenceId.ToString());
			}
			jObject.AddField("Fruits", jObject2);
		}
		return jObject;
	}

	public override void Load(JObject data)
	{
		base.Load(data);
		JObject fruitsData = data.GetField("Fruits");
		if (fruitsData == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		LevelLoader.CurrentLoader.DeferredLoading.Add(() =>
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < fruitsData.Children.Count; i++)
			{
				InteractiveObject_FOOD interactiveObject_FOOD = MultiplayerMng.FindObject<InteractiveObject_FOOD>(fruitsData.Children[i].GetValue<string>().ToMiniGuid());
				if (interactiveObject_FOOD != null)
				{
					AttachFruit(interactiveObject_FOOD, interactiveObject_FOOD.transform);
				}
			}
		});
	}
}

			_animation.Play(dieAnimation);
			_animation.Sample();
			_animation.Stop();
			IsDamageable = false;
			IsKinematic = false;
			IsDraggable = true;
			CanPickUp = true;
			_interactiveCollider.enabled = true;
		}
		JObject field2 = data.GetField("Skinnable");

		{
			this.LoadSkinnable(field2);
		}
	}

		_deployedAnchorTransform.gameObject.SetActive(value: true);
		_deployedAnchorTransform.position = transform.parent.position + Vector3.down * 1.1f + -Wind.Direction * 10f;
		_deployedAnchorTransform.rotation = Quaternion.LookRotation(Wind.Direction, Vector3.up);
		_deployedAnchorRope.gameObject.SetActive(value: true);
		_packedAnchorTransform.gameObject.SetActive(value: false);
		_raft.Buoyancy.EnableWind(enable: false);
		_raft.Buoyancy.SetDampening(0.7f);
		_deployedSequence = Timing.RunCoroutine(Deployed_Sequence());
		Deployed = true;
		OnDeploy?.Invoke();
	}

	public void Retrieve()
	{
		Singleton<BuoyancyManager>.Instance?.Remove(this);
		_deployedAnchorTransform.gameObject.SetActive(value: false);
		_deployedAnchorTransform.localPosition = Vector3.zero;
		_deployedAnchorRope.gameObject.SetActive(value: false);
		_packedAnchorTransform.gameObject.SetActive(value: true);
		_raft.Buoyancy.EnableWind(enable: true);
		_raft.Buoyancy.ResetDampening();
		Timing.KillCoroutines(_deployedSequence);
		Deployed = false;
		OnRetrieve?.Invoke();
	}

	public bool InteractWithObject(IPlayer player, IBase obj)
	{
		return Interact(player);
	}

	private bool CanDeploy()
	{
		if (Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance == null)
		{
			return true;
		}
		Vector3 vector = transform.parent.position + -Wind.Direction * 10f;
		if (Physics.CheckSphere(vector, _deployedAnchorCollider.radius, _deployedAnchorCollisionMask, QueryTriggerInteraction.Ignore))
		{
			return false;
		}
		if (Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.GetHeight(vector) > -5f)
		{
			return false;
		}
		return true;
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> Deployed_Sequence()
	{
		while (true)
		{
			_anchorWaveQuery.posX = _deployedAnchorTransform.position.x;
			_anchorWaveQuery.posZ = _deployedAnchorTransform.position.z;
			Vector3 position = _deployedAnchorTransform.position;
			position.y = _anchorWaveQuery.result.height - 1.1f;
			_deployedAnchorTransform.position = position;
			yield return 0f;
		}
	}

	public void Parent()
	{
	}

	public void Damage(float damage, IBase damager1)
	{
	}

	public void Destroy()
	{
	}

	public new JObject Save()
	{
		JObject jObject = new JObject();
		jObject.AddField("Deployed", Deployed);
		return jObject;
	}

	public new void Load(JObject data)
	{
		if (data.GetField("Deployed").GetValue<bool>())
		{
			Deploy();
		}
	}
}

	private static void RecursiveFixRigidbodyWorldPositions(Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject rootData, Vector3 newOrigin)
	{
		foreach (Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject child in rootData.Children)
		{
			if (child.IsNull())
			{
				continue;
			}

			{
				FixRigidbodyWorldPosition(field, newOrigin);
			}

			if (field2 != null && !field2.IsNull())
			{
				foreach (Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject child2 in field2.Children)
				{
					FixRigidbodyWorldPosition(child2, newOrigin);
				}
			}
			RecursiveFixRigidbodyWorldPositions(child, newOrigin);
		}
	}

	public static Vector3 ConvertLegacyWorldPositionToLocal(Vector3 worldPosition, Vector2 localOrigin)
	{
		Vector3 vector = worldPosition;
		vector.x -= 315f;
		vector.z -= 315f;
		float num = BeamMath.Frac(vector.x / 630f);
		float num2 = BeamMath.Frac(vector.z / 630f);
		float num3 = num * 630f;
		float num4 = num2 * 630f;
		float num5 = (float)Math.Sign(vector.x) * 315f;
		float num6 = (float)Math.Sign(vector.z) * 315f;
		num3 -= num5;
		num4 -= num6;
		Vector3 zero = Vector3.zero;
		zero.x = localOrigin.x + num3;
		zero.z = localOrigin.y + num4;
		zero.y = vector.y;
		return zero;
	}

		public SaveablePrefab MissionSaveablePrefab;

		[Replicate]

		[Replicate]
		public bool OnePlayerLeavesMission;

		public override void OnPeer()

			((MissionControllerBase)MissionSaveablePrefab).ComputeMissionFailed(Player, OnePlayerLeavesMission);
