	public List<IPlayer> ActivePlayers = new List<IPlayer>();

	private const float START_DISTANCE = 40f;

	private const float FAIL_DISTANCE = 80f;

	private const float PROXIMITY_DISTANCE = 15f;

	[SerializeField]
	private MissionAssetLoader _missionAssetLoader;

	[SerializeField]
	private MissionData _missionData;

	[SerializeField]
	private bool _missionActivated;

	[SerializeField]
	private bool _missionLeave;

	private bool _missionCompleted;

	private bool _inProximity;

	public IMissionData MissionData => _missionData;

	public IMissionGoal MissionGoal { get; set; }

	public event Action<IMissionDetailsProvider, bool> MissionStarted;

	public event Action<IMissionDetailsProvider> MissionCompleted;

	public event Action MissionFailed;

	public event Action MissionEnded;

	public event Action<bool> EnteredMissionProximity;

	public event Action LeftMissionProximity;

	protected virtual void OnMissionStarted(IMissionDetailsProvider missionDetailsProvider, bool alreadyStarted)
	{
		MissionStarted?.Invoke(missionDetailsProvider, alreadyStarted);
		MultiplayerMng.UpdateSessionToken_IsBusy(isBusy: true);
	}

	protected virtual void OnMissionCompleted(IMissionDetailsProvider missionDetailsProvider)
	{
		MissionCompleted?.Invoke(missionDetailsProvider);
		MultiplayerMng.UpdateSessionToken_IsBusy(isBusy: false);
	}

	protected virtual void OnMissionFailed()
	{
		MissionFailed?.Invoke();
		MultiplayerMng.UpdateSessionToken_IsBusy(isBusy: false);
	}

	protected virtual void OnMissionEnded()
	{
		MissionEnded?.Invoke();
		MultiplayerMng.UpdateSessionToken_IsBusy(isBusy: false);
	}

	protected virtual void OnEnteredMissionProximity(bool showHUD)
	{
		EnteredMissionProximity?.Invoke(showHUD);
	}

	protected virtual void OnLeftMissionProximity()
	{
		LeftMissionProximity?.Invoke();
	}

	private void Start()
	{
		StartCoroutine(Initialize_Sequence());
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> Initialize_Sequence()
	{
		_missionAssetLoader.LoadedGoal += MissionAssetLoader_LoadedGoal;
		_missionAssetLoader.LoadFailed += MissionAssetLoader_LoadFailed;
		_missionAssetLoader.Load();
		while (LevelLoader.IsLoading())
		{
			yield return 0f;
		}
		InvokeRepeating("PollActivation_InvokeRepeating", 0f, 1f);
	}

	private void OnDestroy()
	{
		MissionStarted = null;
		MissionCompleted = null;
		MissionFailed = null;
		MissionEnded = null;
		EnteredMissionProximity = null;
		LeftMissionProximity = null;
	}

	private void PollActivation_InvokeRepeating()
	{
		if (_missionCompleted)
		{
			CancelInvoke("PollActivation_InvokeRepeating");
		}
		else
		{
			if (MissionGoal == null || LevelLoader.IsServerJoinInProgress)
			{
				return;
			}
			IPlayer player = PlayerUtilities.FindClosestPlayer(transform.position, out var distance);
			float playerDistanceFromMission = PlayerUtilities.GetPlayerDistanceFromMission(transform.position, PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer);
			if (distance < 40f && (!_missionActivated || (!ActivePlayers.Contains(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer) && playerDistanceFromMission < 40f)))
			{
				if (!ActivePlayers.Contains(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer) && playerDistanceFromMission < 40f)
				{
					ReplicatedComputeMissionStarted(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer, _missionActivated);
				}
				else if (!_missionActivated)
				{
					ReplicatedComputeMissionStarted(player, _missionActivated);
				}
			}
			else if ((distance > 80f || (ActivePlayers.Contains(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer) && playerDistanceFromMission > 80f && !_missionLeave)) && _missionActivated)
			{
				if (ActivePlayers.Count == 2 && ActivePlayers.Contains(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer) && playerDistanceFromMission > 80f)
				{
					ReplicatedComputeMissionFailed(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer, onePlayerLeavesMission: true);
				}
				else
				{
					ReplicatedComputeMissionFailed(player, onePlayerLeavesMission: false);
				}
				return;
			}
			float playerDistanceFromMission2 = PlayerUtilities.GetPlayerDistanceFromMission(MissionGoal.Location, PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer);
			if (playerDistanceFromMission2 < 15f && !_inProximity)
			{
				ReplicatedComputeEnteredMission(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer);
			}
			else if (playerDistanceFromMission2 > 15f && _inProximity)
			{
				ReplicatedComputeLeftMission(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer);
			}
		}
	}

	private void ComputeMissionStarted(IPlayer player, bool alreadyStarted)
	{
		Debug.Log($"<color=#FF0000>Player {player.Id} starts Mission</color>");
		Zone zone = StrandedWorld.GetZone(player.transform.position);
		Zone zone2 = StrandedWorld.GetZone(transform.position);
		Zone zone3 = StrandedWorld.GetZone(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.transform.position);
		if (!ActivePlayers.Contains(player))
		{
			ActivePlayers.Add(player);
		}
		if (alreadyStarted)
		{
			_missionLeave = false;
		}
		if (zone == zone2 && (PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.CurrentMissionGoal == null || zone3 == zone2))
		{
			PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.CurrentMissionGoal = MissionGoal;
			OnMissionStarted(this, alreadyStarted);
		}
		_missionActivated = true;
	}

	private void ComputeMissionFailed(IPlayer player, bool onePlayerLeavesMission)
	{
		Debug.Log($"<color=#FF0000>Player {player.Id} failed Mission</color>");
		Zone zone = StrandedWorld.GetZone(player.transform.position);
		Zone zone2 = StrandedWorld.GetZone(transform.position);
		Zone zone3 = StrandedWorld.GetZone(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.transform.position);
		if (!onePlayerLeavesMission)
		{
			ActivePlayers.Clear();
		}
		if (zone == zone2 && PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.CurrentMissionGoal == MissionGoal && zone3 == zone2)
		{
			PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.CurrentMissionGoal = null;
			if (!onePlayerLeavesMission)
			{
				MissionGoal.Reset();
				_missionActivated = false;
			}
			OnMissionFailed();
			OnMissionEnded();
		}
	}

	private void ComputeEnteredMission(IPlayer player)
	{
		Zone zone = StrandedWorld.GetZone(player.transform.position);
		Zone zone2 = StrandedWorld.GetZone(transform.position);
		Zone zone3 = StrandedWorld.GetZone(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.transform.position);
		if (zone == zone2 && (PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.CurrentMissionGoal == MissionGoal || zone3 == zone2))
		{
			OnEnteredMissionProximity(zone3 == zone2);
			_inProximity = true;
		}
	}

	private void ComputeLeftMission(IPlayer player)
	{
		Zone zone = StrandedWorld.GetZone(player.transform.position);
		Zone zone2 = StrandedWorld.GetZone(transform.position);
		Zone zone3 = StrandedWorld.GetZone(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.transform.position);
		if (zone == zone2 && (PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.CurrentMissionGoal == MissionGoal || zone3 == zone2))
		{
			OnLeftMissionProximity();
			_inProximity = false;
		}
	}

	private void ComputeOnePlayerLeftMission(IPlayer player)
	{
		ActivePlayers.Remove(player);
		if (player == PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer)
		{
			_missionLeave = true;
		}
	}

	private void MissionAssetLoader_LoadedGoal(IMissionGoal goal)
	{
		MissionGoal = goal;
		if (Game.Mode.IsMaster())
		{
			MissionGoal.Completed += MissionGoal_Completed;
		}
	}

	private void MissionAssetLoader_LoadFailed()
	{
		LocalizedNotification localizedNotification = new LocalizedNotification(new Notification());
		localizedNotification.Priority = NotificationPriority.Immediate;
		localizedNotification.Duration = 4f;
		localizedNotification.MessageText.SetTerm("MISSIONS_MISSION_ASSET_LOADER_FAILED");
		localizedNotification.Raise();
	}

	private void MissionGoal_Completed()
	{
		ReplicatedMissionGoal_CompletedCore(PlayerUtilities.FindClosestPlayer(transform.position));
	}

	private void MissionGoal_CompletedCore(IPlayer player)
	{
		_missionCompleted = true;
		_missionActivated = false;
		MissionData.RewardProvider.DoRewards(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer);
		OnMissionCompleted(this);
		Zone zone = StrandedWorld.GetZone(player.transform.position);
		Zone zone2 = StrandedWorld.GetZone(transform.position);
		Zone zone3 = StrandedWorld.GetZone(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.transform.position);
		if (zone == zone2 && (PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.CurrentMissionGoal == null || PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.CurrentMissionGoal == MissionGoal || zone3 == zone2))
		{
			PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.CurrentMissionGoal = null;
			OnMissionEnded();
		}
	}

	private void ReplicatedMissionGoal_CompletedCore(IPlayer player)
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsServer())
		{
			ReplicateMissionGoal_Completed replicateMissionGoal_Completed = new ReplicateMissionGoal_Completed();
			replicateMissionGoal_Completed.MissionSaveablePrefab = this;
			replicateMissionGoal_Completed.Player = player;
			replicateMissionGoal_Completed.Post();
		}
		MissionGoal_CompletedCore(player);
	}

	private void ReplicatedComputeMissionStarted(IPlayer player, bool alreadyStarted)
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsServer() | alreadyStarted)
		{
			ReplicateMissionStarted replicateMissionStarted = new ReplicateMissionStarted();
			replicateMissionStarted.MissionSaveablePrefab = this;
			replicateMissionStarted.Player = player;
			replicateMissionStarted.AlreadyStarted = alreadyStarted;
			replicateMissionStarted.Post();
		}
		ComputeMissionStarted(player, alreadyStarted);
	}

	private void ReplicatedComputeMissionFailed(IPlayer player, bool onePlayerLeavesMission)
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsServer() && !onePlayerLeavesMission)
		{
			ReplicateMissionFailed replicateMissionFailed = new ReplicateMissionFailed();
			replicateMissionFailed.MissionSaveablePrefab = this;
			replicateMissionFailed.Player = player;
			replicateMissionFailed.OnePlayerLeavesMission = onePlayerLeavesMission;
			replicateMissionFailed.Post();
		}
		else if (onePlayerLeavesMission)
		{
			ReplicatedOnePlayerLeftMission(player);
		}
		ComputeMissionFailed(player, onePlayerLeavesMission);
	}

	private void ReplicatedComputeEnteredMission(IPlayer player)
	{
		ComputeEnteredMission(player);
	}

	private void ReplicatedComputeLeftMission(IPlayer player)
	{
		ComputeLeftMission(player);
	}

	private void ReplicatedOnePlayerLeftMission(IPlayer player)
	{
		ReplicateOnePlayerLeftMission replicateOnePlayerLeftMission = new ReplicateOnePlayerLeftMission();
		replicateOnePlayerLeftMission.MissionSaveablePrefab = this;
		replicateOnePlayerLeftMission.Player = player;
		replicateOnePlayerLeftMission.Post();
		ComputeOnePlayerLeftMission(player);
	}

	public override JObject Save()
	{
		JObject jObject = base.Save();
		JObject data = JSerializer.Serialize(transform);
		jObject.AddField("Transform", data);
		return jObject;
	}

	public override void Load(JObject data)
	{
		base.Load(data);
		JSerializer.DeserializeInto(data.GetField("Transform"), transform);
		CompleteTransformSerialization();
	}
}

			Projectile.transform.localRotation = ProjectileRotation;
		}

	private class ReplicateLocalFaunaStick : MultiplayerMessage

		[Replicate]

		public override void OnPeer()
		{
			ProjectileMovement component = Projectile.GetComponent<ProjectileMovement>();
			component.SetupMultiplayerLaunch(fire: false);
			ProjectileEventDataVal projectileEventDataVal = new ProjectileEventDataVal(Point, (PhysicMaterial)Material);
			Projectile.transform.position = ProjectilePosition;
			Projectile.transform.forward = ProjectileForward;
			Projectile.LocalFaunaPierce();
			component._isStuck = true;
			component.Rigidbody.isKinematic = true;
			component.Rigidbody.velocity = Vector3.zero;
			component._trailRenderer.transform.SetParent(ParticleManager.TRAIL_CONTAINER, worldPositionStays: true);
			component._collider.enabled = true;
			component.Stuck?.Invoke(component, projectileEventDataVal);
		}

	public static bool DEBUG_COLLISION;

	[SerializeField]
	private ProjectileCollisionDetectionBase _collisionDetection;

	[SerializeField]
	private LayerMask _collisionLayermask;

	[SerializeField]
	private LayerMask _autoAimLayermask;

	[SerializeField]
	private GameObject _impactParticle;

	[SerializeField]
	private GameObject _gib;

	[SerializeField]
	private float _projectileHead;

	[SerializeField]
	private float _projectileAutoAimRadius;

	[SerializeField]
	private int _projectileAutoAimSamples = 8;

	[SerializeField]
	private float _projectileDamage;

	[SerializeField]
	private TrailRenderer _trailRenderer;

	[PREFAB_PROCESSOR_GetComponent]
	[SerializeField]
	private Rigidbody _rigidbody;

	[PREFAB_PROCESSOR_GetComponent]
	[SerializeField]
	private Collider _collider;

	protected IPlayer _thrower;

	private IProjectile _projectile;

	private bool _isStuck;

	private RaycastHit _hit;

	private static string _raycastLabel;

	private Queue<ReplicateHandleCollision> _replicatedCollissions = new Queue<ReplicateHandleCollision>();

	public Rigidbody Rigidbody
	{
		get
		{
			if (_rigidbody == null)
			{
				_rigidbody = GetComponent<Rigidbody>();
			}
			return _rigidbody;
		}
	}

	public IBase AttachedBase { get; set; }

	public IPlayer Thrower => _thrower;

	public event Action<ProjectileMovement, IProjectileEventData> Stuck;

	public event Action<ProjectileMovement, IProjectileEventData> Broken;

	private void Awake()
	{
		_trailRenderer.transform.SetParent(ParticleManager.TRAIL_CONTAINER, worldPositionStays: false);
		_trailRenderer.transform.localPosition = Vector3.zero;
	}

	public void Initialize(IProjectile projectile)
	{
		_projectile = projectile;
	}

	private void OnDestroy()
	{
		Stuck = null;
		Broken = null;
		if (_trailRenderer != null)
		{
			BeamTeam.Destroy(_trailRenderer.gameObject);
		}
	}

	public void Fire(IPlayer player)
	{
		_collider.enabled = false;
		_thrower = player;
		_trailRenderer.transform.SetParent(transform, worldPositionStays: false);
		_trailRenderer.transform.localPosition = Vector3.zero;
		_trailRenderer.Clear();
		SetupMultiplayerLaunch(fire: true);
	}

	private void SetupMultiplayerLaunch(bool fire)
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
		{
			Rigidbody.isKinematic = !fire;
			Rigidbody.useGravity = fire;
			((SaveablePrefab)_projectile).ParentId = (fire ? TransformId.Unknown : gameObject.transform.parent.GetTransfromId());
		}
	}

	public void Reset()
	{
		_collider.enabled = true;
		_thrower = null;
		_isStuck = false;
		AttachedBase = null;
	}

	private void FixedUpdate()
	{
		if (_isStuck || Rigidbody == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		if (Rigidbody.velocity.magnitude > 0.001f)
		{
			Rigidbody.MoveRotation(Quaternion.LookRotation(Rigidbody.velocity));
		}
		if (_thrower.IsOwner)
		{
			CheckCollision((Vector3 position, RaycastHit hit) =>
			{
				Vector3 point = hit.point;
				Collider collider = hit.collider;
				Rigidbody rigidbody = hit.rigidbody;
				PhysicMaterialPenetration penetration = GetPenetration(collider);
				if (penetration == PhysicMaterialPenetration.STICK)
				{
					Rigidbody.position = position;
				}
				if (Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
				{
					if (PhysicMaterialPenetration.STICK == penetration && GetAttachedBase(collider, rigidbody) is Interactive_FISHES)
					{
						if (Game.Mode.IsClient())
						{
							GetPositionAndForward(point, out var position2, out var forward);
							ReplicateLocalFaunaStick replicateLocalFaunaStick = new ReplicateLocalFaunaStick();
							replicateLocalFaunaStick.Projectile = (ProjectileObject)_projectile;
							replicateLocalFaunaStick.Point = point;
							replicateLocalFaunaStick.Material = (byte)PhysicMaterialUtility.GetPhysicMaterialType(collider);
							replicateLocalFaunaStick.ProjectilePosition = position2;
							replicateLocalFaunaStick.ProjectileForward = forward;
							replicateLocalFaunaStick.Post();
						}
						HandleCollision(rigidbody, collider, point);
					}
					else
					{
						collider = (collider.IsReplicable() ? collider : null);
						rigidbody = (rigidbody.IsReplicable() ? rigidbody : null);
						ReplicatedHandleCollision(rigidbody, collider, point);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					HandleCollision(rigidbody, collider, point);
				}
			});
		}
		if (_replicatedCollissions.Count != 0)
		{
			_replicatedCollissions.Dequeue().Execute(this);
		}
	}

	private void CheckCollision(Action<Vector3, RaycastHit> onCollision)
	{
		if (_collisionDetection.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			return;
		}
		Vector3 vector = ((Rigidbody.velocity.magnitude < 0.001f) ? transform.forward : Rigidbody.velocity.normalized);
		Quaternion quaternion = Quaternion.LookRotation(vector);
		float num = _projectileHead + Time.fixedDeltaTime * 120f;
		if (_collisionDetection.CheckCollisions(new Ray(Rigidbody.position, vector), out _hit, num, _collisionLayermask.value))
		{
			onCollision(Rigidbody.position, _hit);
			return;
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < _projectileAutoAimSamples; i++)
		{
			Vector3 zero = Vector3.zero;
			zero.x = UnityEngine.Random.Range(0f - _projectileAutoAimRadius, _projectileAutoAimRadius);
			zero.y = UnityEngine.Random.Range(0f - _projectileAutoAimRadius, _projectileAutoAimRadius);
			Vector3 vector2 = Rigidbody.position + quaternion * zero;
			if (Physics.Raycast(new Ray(vector2, vector), out _hit, num, _autoAimLayermask.value))
			{
				onCollision(vector2, _hit);
				break;
			}
		}
	}

	private void ReplicatedHandleCollision(Rigidbody rigidbody, Collider collider, Vector3 point)
	{
		if (HandleCollision(rigidbody, collider, point) && Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
		{
			ReplicateHandleCollision replicateHandleCollision = new ReplicateHandleCollision();
			replicateHandleCollision.Projectile = GetComponent<SaveablePrefab>();
			replicateHandleCollision.ProjectilePosition = transform.localPosition;
			replicateHandleCollision.ProjectileRotation = transform.localRotation;
			replicateHandleCollision.Rigidbody = rigidbody;
			replicateHandleCollision.Collider = collider;
			replicateHandleCollision.Point = point;
			replicateHandleCollision.Post();
		}
	}

	private bool HandleCollision(Rigidbody rigidbody, Collider collider, Vector3 hitPoint)
	{
		PhysicMaterial physicMaterialType = PhysicMaterialUtility.GetPhysicMaterialType(collider);
		ProjectileEventDataVal projectileEventDataVal = new ProjectileEventDataVal(hitPoint, physicMaterialType);
		PhysicMaterialPenetration penetration = GetPenetration(collider);
		if (DEBUG_COLLISION)
		{
			StrandedWorld.AddDebugAxis(hitPoint, transform.rotation, $"R {rigidbody?.name}\nC {collider?.name}\nP {penetration}");
		}
		switch (penetration)
		{
		case PhysicMaterialPenetration.STICK:
		{
			SetupMultiplayerLaunch(fire: false);
			_isStuck = true;
			Vector3 force2 = Rigidbody.mass * Rigidbody.velocity;
			Rigidbody.velocity = Vector3.zero;
			GetPositionAndForward(hitPoint, out var position, out var forward);
			transform.position = position;
			transform.forward = forward;
			AttachedBase = GetAttachedBase(collider, rigidbody);
			ProjectileHit args = new ProjectileHit(collider.transform, AttachedBase);
			_projectile.Pierce(args);
			if (!AttachedBase.IsNullOrDestroyed())
			{
				IAttachable attachable = AttachedBase as IAttachable;
				if (attachable.IsNullOrDestroyed() || !attachable.IsAttached)
				{
					rigidbody?.AddForce(force2, ForceMode.Impulse);
				}
				Shootable component2 = AttachedBase.transform.GetComponent<Shootable>();
				if ((bool)component2)
				{
					component2.Shot?.Invoke(new DamageUnityEventArgs(_projectileDamage, _projectile as IBase));
				}
			}
			_trailRenderer.transform.SetParent(ParticleManager.TRAIL_CONTAINER, worldPositionStays: true);
			_collider.enabled = true;
			Stuck?.Invoke(this, projectileEventDataVal);
			return true;
		}
		case PhysicMaterialPenetration.BREAK:
			SetupMultiplayerLaunch(fire: false);
			Broken?.Invoke(this, projectileEventDataVal);
			UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(_gib, transform.position, transform.rotation);
			MultiplayerMng.Destroy(gameObject.GetComponent<SaveablePrefab>());
			return true;
		case PhysicMaterialPenetration.BREAK_DAMAGE:
		{
			SetupMultiplayerLaunch(fire: false);
			Broken?.Invoke(this, projectileEventDataVal);
			Vector3 force = Rigidbody.mass * Rigidbody.velocity;
			rigidbody.AddForce(force, ForceMode.Impulse);
			Shootable component = rigidbody.GetComponent<Shootable>();
			if ((bool)component)
			{
				component.Shot?.Invoke(new DamageUnityEventArgs(_projectileDamage, _projectile as IBase));
			}
			if (_gib != null)
			{
				UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(_gib, transform.position, transform.rotation);
			}
			MultiplayerMng.Destroy(gameObject.GetComponent<SaveablePrefab>());
			return true;
		}
		default:
			return false;
		}
	}

	private void GetPositionAndForward(Vector3 hitPoint, out Vector3 position, out Vector3 forward)
	{
		Vector3 normalized = (hitPoint - Rigidbody.position).normalized;
		position = hitPoint - normalized * _projectileHead;
		forward = normalized;
	}

	private IBase GetAttachedBase(Collider collider, Rigidbody rigidbody)
	{
		IBase obj = collider.GetInterface<IBase>();
		if (obj.IsNullOrDestroyed() && rigidbody != null)
		{
			obj = rigidbody.GetInterface<IBase>();
			if (obj.IsNullOrDestroyed())
			{
				RagdollChild component = rigidbody.GetComponent<RagdollChild>();
				if (component != null)
				{
					obj = component.InteractiveObject;
				}
			}
		}
		return obj;
	}

	private PhysicMaterialPenetration GetPenetration(Collider collider)
	{
		if (collider == null)
		{
			return PhysicMaterialPenetration.BREAK;
		}
		return PhysicMaterialUtility.GetPenetration(collider.sharedMaterial?.name);
	}
}

using Ceto.Common.Containers.Interpolation;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Ceto;

[AddComponentMenu("Ceto/Overlays/AddAutoShoreMask")]
[DisallowMultipleComponent]
public class AddAutoShoreMask : AddWaveOverlayBase
{
	public bool ignoreQuerys;

	public bool textureFoam = true;

	[Range(0.1f, 100f)]
	public float heightSpread = 10f;

	[Range(0.1f, 10f)]
	public float foamSpread = 2f;

	[Range(0.1f, 10f)]
	public float clipOffset = 4f;

	public int resolution = 1024;

	public bool useHeightMask = true;

	[Range(0f, 1f)]
	public float heightAlpha = 0.9f;

	public bool useNormalMask = true;

	[Range(0f, 1f)]
	public float normalAlpha = 0.8f;

	public bool useEdgeFoam = true;

	[Range(0f, 10f)]
	public float edgeFoamAlpha = 1f;

	public bool useFoamMask = true;

	[Range(0f, 1f)]
	public float foamMaskAlpha = 1f;

	public bool useClipMask = true;

	private bool m_registered;

	private float m_width;

	private float m_height;

	private Texture2D m_heightMask;

	private Texture2D m_edgeFoam;

	private Texture2D m_clipMask;

	private float m_heightSpread;

	private float m_foamSpread;

	private float m_clipOffset;

	private float m_resolution;

	protected override void Start()
	{
		m_overlays.Add(new WaveOverlay());
		UpdateOverlay();
	}

	protected override void Update()
	{
		if (m_overlays != null && m_overlays.Count == 1)
		{
			UpdateOverlay();
		}
	}

	protected override void OnDestroy()
	{
		base.OnDestroy();
		Release();
	}

	private void UpdateOverlay()
	{
		if (Ocean.Instance != null && (!m_registered || SettingsChanged()))
		{
			CreateShoreMasks();
		}
		Vector2 halfSize = new Vector2(m_width * 0.5f, m_height * 0.5f);
		Vector3 position = transform.position;
		position.x += halfSize.x;
		position.z += halfSize.y;
		m_overlays[0].Position = position;
		m_overlays[0].HalfSize = halfSize;
		m_overlays[0].HeightTex.maskAlpha = (useHeightMask ? heightAlpha : 0f);
		m_overlays[0].HeightTex.ignoreQuerys = ignoreQuerys;
		m_overlays[0].NormalTex.maskAlpha = (useNormalMask ? normalAlpha : 0f);
		m_overlays[0].NormalTex.maskMode = OVERLAY_MASK_MODE.WAVES_AND_OVERLAY_BLEND;
		m_overlays[0].FoamTex.alpha = (useEdgeFoam ? edgeFoamAlpha : 0f);
		m_overlays[0].FoamTex.textureFoam = textureFoam;
		m_overlays[0].FoamTex.maskAlpha = (useFoamMask ? foamMaskAlpha : 0f);
		m_overlays[0].ClipTex.alpha = (useClipMask ? 1f : 0f);
		m_overlays[0].ClipTex.ignoreQuerys = ignoreQuerys;
		m_overlays[0].UpdateOverlay();
	}

	private void CreateShoreMasks()
	{
		Release();
		Terrain component = GetComponent<Terrain>();
		if (component == null)
		{
			Ocean.LogWarning("The AddAutoShoreMask script must be attached to a component with a Terrain. The shore mask will not be created.");
			enabled = false;
			return;
		}
		if (component.terrainData == null)
		{
			Ocean.LogWarning("The terrain data is null. The shore mask will not be created.");
			enabled = false;
			return;
		}
		Vector3 size = component.terrainData.size;
		resolution = Mathf.Clamp(resolution, 32, 4096);
		m_width = size.x;
		m_height = size.z;
		float level = Ocean.Instance.level;
		float[] data = ShoreMaskGenerator.CreateHeightMap(component);
		int heightmapResolution = component.terrainData.heightmapResolution;
		InterpolatedArray2f heightMap = new InterpolatedArray2f(data, heightmapResolution, heightmapResolution, 1, wrap: false);
		if (useHeightMask || useNormalMask || useFoamMask)
		{
			m_heightMask = ShoreMaskGenerator.CreateMask(heightMap, resolution, resolution, level, heightSpread, TextureFormat.ARGB32);
		}
		if (useEdgeFoam)
		{
			m_edgeFoam = ShoreMaskGenerator.CreateMask(heightMap, resolution, resolution, level, foamSpread, TextureFormat.ARGB32);
		}
		if (useClipMask)
		{
			m_clipMask = ShoreMaskGenerator.CreateClipMask(heightMap, resolution, resolution, level + clipOffset, TextureFormat.ARGB32);
		}
		if (useHeightMask)
		{
			m_overlays[0].HeightTex.mask = m_heightMask;
		}
		if (useNormalMask)
		{
			m_overlays[0].NormalTex.mask = m_heightMask;
		}
		if (useFoamMask)
		{
			m_overlays[0].FoamTex.mask = m_heightMask;
		}
		if (useEdgeFoam)
		{
			m_overlays[0].FoamTex.tex = m_edgeFoam;
		}
		if (useClipMask)
		{
			m_overlays[0].ClipTex.tex = m_clipMask;
		}
		if (!m_registered)
		{
			Ocean.Instance.OverlayManager.Add(m_overlays[0]);
			m_registered = true;
		}
		m_heightSpread = heightSpread;
		m_foamSpread = foamSpread;
		m_clipOffset = clipOffset;
		m_resolution = resolution;
	}

	private bool SettingsChanged()
	{
		if (m_heightSpread != heightSpread)
		{
			return true;
		}
		if (m_foamSpread != foamSpread)
		{
			return true;
		}
		if (m_clipOffset != clipOffset)
		{
			return true;
		}
		if (m_resolution != (float)resolution)
		{
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	private void Release()
	{
		if (m_heightMask != null)
		{
			Object.Destroy(m_heightMask);
			m_heightMask = null;
		}
		if (m_edgeFoam != null)
		{
			Object.Destroy(m_edgeFoam);
			m_edgeFoam = null;
		}
		if (m_clipMask != null)
		{
			Object.Destroy(m_clipMask);
			m_clipMask = null;
		}
		if (m_overlays != null && m_overlays.Count == 1)
		{
			m_overlays[0].HeightTex.mask = null;
			m_overlays[0].NormalTex.mask = null;
			m_overlays[0].FoamTex.mask = null;
			m_overlays[0].FoamTex.tex = null;
			m_overlays[0].ClipTex.tex = null;
		}
	}
}



/* SOURCE_FILE: /storage/emulated/0/Map Check/reports/V24_SOURCE_RECOVERY/CS_SOURCE/Assembly-CSharp__Ceto__ShoreMaskGenerator.cs

using Ceto.Common.Containers.Interpolation;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Ceto;

public static class ShoreMaskGenerator
{
	public static float[] CreateHeightMap(Terrain terrain)
	{
		TerrainData terrainData = terrain.terrainData;
		int heightmapResolution = terrainData.heightmapResolution;
		Vector3 heightmapScale = terrainData.heightmapScale;
		float[,] heights = terrainData.GetHeights(0, 0, heightmapResolution, heightmapResolution);
		float[] array = new float[heightmapResolution * heightmapResolution];
		for (int i = 0; i < heightmapResolution; i++)
		{
			for (int j = 0; j < heightmapResolution; j++)
			{
				array[j + i * heightmapResolution] = heights[i, j] * heightmapScale.y + terrain.transform.position.y;
			}
		}
		return array;
	}

	public static Texture2D CreateMask(float[] heightMap, int size, float shoreLevel, float spread, TextureFormat format)
	{
		Texture2D texture2D = new Texture2D(size, size, format, mipChain: false, linear: true);
		texture2D.filterMode = FilterMode.Bilinear;
		int num = size * size;
		Color[] array = new Color[num];
		for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
		{
			float num2 = Mathf.Clamp(shoreLevel - heightMap[i], 0f, spread);
			num2 = 1f - num2 / spread;
			array[i].r = num2;
			array[i].g = num2;
			array[i].b = num2;
			array[i].a = num2;
		}
		texture2D.SetPixels(array);
		texture2D.Apply();
		return texture2D;
	}

	public static Texture2D CreateMask(InterpolatedArray2f heightMap, int width, int height, float shoreLevel, float spread, TextureFormat format)
	{
		Texture2D texture2D = new Texture2D(width, height, format, mipChain: false, linear: true);
		texture2D.filterMode = FilterMode.Bilinear;
		Color[] array = new Color[width * height];
		bool flag = width == heightMap.SX && height == heightMap.SY;
		for (int i = 0; i < height; i++)
		{
			for (int j = 0; j < width; j++)
			{
				int num = j + i * height;
				float num2 = 0f;
				if (flag)
				{
					num2 = Mathf.Clamp(shoreLevel - heightMap.Data[num], 0f, spread);
				}
				else
				{
					float x = (float)j / ((float)width - 1f);
					float y = (float)i / ((float)height - 1f);
					num2 = Mathf.Clamp(shoreLevel - heightMap.Get(x, y, 0), 0f, spread);
				}
				num2 = 1f - num2 / spread;
				array[num].r = num2;
				array[num].g = num2;
				array[num].b = num2;
				array[num].a = num2;
			}
		}
		texture2D.SetPixels(array);
		texture2D.Apply();
		return texture2D;
	}

	public static Texture2D CreateClipMask(float[] heightMap, int size, float shoreLevel, TextureFormat format)
	{
		Texture2D texture2D = new Texture2D(size, size, format, mipChain: false, linear: true);
		texture2D.filterMode = FilterMode.Bilinear;
		int num = size * size;
		Color[] array = new Color[num];
		for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
		{
			float num2 = Mathf.Clamp(heightMap[i] - shoreLevel, 0f, 1f);
			if (num2 > 0f)
			{
				num2 = 1f;
			}
			array[i].r = num2;
			array[i].g = num2;
			array[i].b = num2;
			array[i].a = num2;
		}
		texture2D.SetPixels(array);
		texture2D.Apply();
		return texture2D;
	}

	public static Texture2D CreateClipMask(InterpolatedArray2f heightMap, int width, int height, float shoreLevel, TextureFormat format)
	{
		Texture2D texture2D = new Texture2D(width, height, format, mipChain: false, linear: true);
		texture2D.filterMode = FilterMode.Bilinear;
		Color[] array = new Color[width * height];
		bool flag = width == heightMap.SX && height == heightMap.SY;
		for (int i = 0; i < height; i++)
		{
			for (int j = 0; j < width; j++)
			{
				int num = j + i * height;
				float num2 = 0f;
				if (flag)
				{
					num2 = Mathf.Clamp(heightMap.Data[num] - shoreLevel, 0f, 1f);
				}
				else
				{
					float x = (float)j / ((float)width - 1f);
					float y = (float)i / ((float)height - 1f);
					num2 = Mathf.Clamp(heightMap.Get(x, y, 0) - shoreLevel, 0f, 1f);
				}
				if (num2 > 0f)
				{
					num2 = 1f;
				}
				array[num].r = num2;
				array[num].g = num2;
				array[num].b = num2;
				array[num].a = num2;
			}
		}
		texture2D.SetPixels(array);
		texture2D.Apply();
		return texture2D;
	}
}

		{
			return;

	{

	private IEnumerator<float> UpdateGridObjects_Sequence(bool distributed)
	{
		_samplesCounter = 0;
		for (int x = 0; x < 3; x++)
		{
			for (int y = 0; y < 3; y++)
			{
				SpawnGrid spawnGrid = _spawnGrids[x, y];
				if (spawnGrid.CanGenerate && !HashCollectionCache.HasHash(this, spawnGrid.Transform.position.Hash()))
				{
					_gridUpdateCoroutine = Timing.RunCoroutine(CreateGridObjects_Sequence(spawnGrid, 400));
					yield return Timing.WaitUntilDone(_gridUpdateCoroutine);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> CreateGridObjects_Sequence(SpawnGrid grid, int samplesPerStep)
	{
		if (Following == null)
		{
			yield break;
		}
		grid.CanGenerate = false;
		_random.Reinitialise((int)(grid.Transform.position.x + grid.Transform.position.z));
		Zone.BiomeType currentBiome = StrandedWorld.GetBiome(Following.position);
		if (currentBiome == Zone.BiomeType.DEEP_SEA)
		{
			yield break;
		}
		_sampler.Init(grid.Transform.position);
		BiomeGrid[] gridObjects = GridObjects2;
		foreach (BiomeGrid biomeGrid in gridObjects)
		{
			GridObject[] biomeParameters = biomeGrid.biomeParameters;
			foreach (GridObject gridObject in biomeParameters)

	public void ClearPatch(Vector3 position, float radius)
	{
		SpawnGrid[,] spawnGrids = _spawnGrids;
		int upperBound = spawnGrids.GetUpperBound(0);
		int upperBound2 = spawnGrids.GetUpperBound(1);
		for (int i = spawnGrids.GetLowerBound(0); i <= upperBound; i++)
		{
			for (int j = spawnGrids.GetLowerBound(1); j <= upperBound2; j++)
			{
				foreach (Transform item in spawnGrids[i, j].Transform)
				{
					if (Vector3.Distance(item.position, position) <= radius)
					{
						ObjectPoolManager.DestroyPooled(item.gameObject);
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	bool IHashCollection.HasHash(int hash)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
		{
			for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++)
			{
				if (_spawnGrids[i, j].Transform.position.Hash() == hash)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	public static JObject CopyFrom(this JObject dst, JObject src, string[] srcPaths, string[] dstPaths)
	{
		if (src == null || dst == null)
		{
			return dst;
		}
		int num = Mathf.Min(srcPaths.Length, dstPaths.Length);
		for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
		{
			dst.Set(dstPaths[i], src.Get(srcPaths[i]));
		}
		return dst;
	}

	public static JObject ApplyPatch(this JObject data, JObject patch)
	{
		if (data.IsNullOrDestroyed() || patch.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			return data;
		}
		if (data.Type != patch.Type && data.Type != JObject.EToken.NULL)
		{
			return data;
		}
		switch (patch.Type)
		{
		case JObject.EToken.OBJECT:
		{
			if (patch.Keys.IsNullOrDestroyed() || patch.Children.IsNullOrDestroyed())
			{
				return data;
			}
			int count2 = patch.Children.Count;
			for (int k = 0; k < count2; k++)
			{
				JObject jObject = data[patch.Keys[k]];
				if (jObject.IsNullOrDestroyed())
				{
					data.AddField(patch.Keys[k], patch.Children[k]);
				}
				else
				{
					jObject.ApplyPatch(patch.Children[k]);
				}
			}
			break;
		}
		case JObject.EToken.ARRAY:
		{
			if (patch.Children.IsNullOrDestroyed())
			{
				return data;
			}
			int count = patch.Children.Count;
			int num = data.Children?.Count ?? 0;
			int num2 = count - num;
			for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
			{
				data.Add(new JObject());
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
			{
				if (patch.Children[j].Type != JObject.EToken.NULL)
				{
					if (data.Children[j].Type == JObject.EToken.NULL)
					{
						data.Children[j] = patch.Children[j];
					}
					else
					{
						data.Children[j].ApplyPatch(patch.Children[j]);
					}
				}
			}
			break;
		}
		case JObject.EToken.NULL:
			return data;
		default:
			data.Data = patch.Data;
			break;
		}
		return data;
	}

	public static JObject MakeNewRefenceIds(this JObject data)

		return data;
	}

	public static ushort Compress(this float value)
	{
		if ((double)value > 1.0)
		{
			value = 1f;
		}
		if ((double)value < 0.0)
		{
			value = 0f;
		}
		return (ushort)(value * 65535f);
	}

	public static float Decompress(this ushort value)
	{
		return (float)(int)value / 65535f;
	}

	public static bool IsCompressStable(this ushort value)
	{
		return value == value.Decompress().Compress();
	}

	private static ushort GetCompressStable(this ushort value)
	{
		if (value.IsCompressStable())
		{
			return value;
		}
		int num = 1;
		while (true)
		{
			if (value - num >= 0 && ((ushort)(value - num)).IsCompressStable())
			{
				return (ushort)(value - num);
			}
			if (value + num <= 65535 && ((ushort)(value + num)).IsCompressStable())
			{
				break;
			}
			num++;
		}
		return (ushort)(value + num);
	}

	public static ushort ToCompressStable(this ushort value)
	{
		return _toCompressStable[value];
	}

	public static void InitializeCompressStableValues()
	{
		for (int i = 0; i <= 65535; i++)
		{
			_toCompressStable[i] = ((ushort)i).GetCompressStable();
		}
	}

	public static bool IsCompressStableValuesInitialized()
	{
		return _toCompressStable[32768] != 0;
	}

	public static T GetInParent<T>(this Transform transform) where T : ISaveablePrefab
	{
		if (transform.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			return default;
		}
		T component = transform.GetComponent<T>();
		if (!component.IsNullOrDestroyed() && component.IsValidPrefab)
		{
			return component;
		}
		return transform.parent.GetInParent<T>();
	}

	public static void WriteVector3(this UdpPacket packet, Vector3 value)
	{
		packet.WriteFloat(value.x);
		packet.WriteFloat(value.y);
		packet.WriteFloat(value.z);
	}

	public static void WriteQuaternion(this UdpPacket packet, Quaternion value)
	{
		packet.WriteFloat(value.x);
		packet.WriteFloat(value.y);
		packet.WriteFloat(value.z);
		packet.WriteFloat(value.w);
	}

	public static void WriteMiniGuid(this UdpPacket packet, MiniGuid value)
	{
		packet.WriteByte(value._d0);
		packet.WriteByte(value._d1);
		packet.WriteByte(value._d2);
		packet.WriteByte(value._d3);
		packet.WriteByte(value._d4);
		packet.WriteByte(value._d5);
		packet.WriteByte(value._d6);
		packet.WriteByte(value._d7);
	}

	public static void WriteSaveablePrefab(this UdpPacket packet, ISaveablePrefab value)
	{
		if (value == null)
		{
			packet.WriteBool(value: false);
			packet.WriteMiniGuid(default);
		}
		else if (value.IsMultiplayerEntity)
		{
			packet.WriteBool(value: true);
			packet.WriteULong(value.Entity.NetworkId.PackedValue);
		}
		else
		{
			packet.WriteBool(value: false);
			packet.WriteMiniGuid(value.ReferenceId);
		}
	}

	public static void WriteRigidbody(this UdpPacket packet, Rigidbody rigidbody)
	{
		ISaveablePrefab saveablePrefab = (((object)rigidbody != null) ? rigidbody.transform.GetInParent<ISaveablePrefab>() : null);
		if (null == rigidbody || saveablePrefab == null)
		{
			packet.WriteSaveablePrefab(null);
			packet.WriteByte(0);
		}
		else
		{
			packet.WriteSaveablePrefab(saveablePrefab);
			packet.WriteByte((byte)(saveablePrefab.GetRigidbodyId(rigidbody) + 1));
		}
	}

	public static void WriteCollider(this UdpPacket packet, Collider collider)
	{
		if (null == collider)
		{
			packet.WriteBool(value: true);
			packet.WriteByte(0);
			return;
		}
		if (collider is TerrainCollider)
		{
			packet.WriteBool(value: true);
			packet.WriteByte((byte)(Beam.Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.GetZoneId(collider.transform.GetComponentInParent<Zone>()) + 1));
			return;
		}
		ISaveablePrefab inParent = collider.transform.GetInParent<ISaveablePrefab>();
		if (inParent == null)
		{
			packet.WriteBool(value: true);
			packet.WriteByte(0);
		}
		else
		{
			packet.WriteBool(value: false);
			packet.WriteSaveablePrefab(inParent);
			packet.WriteByte((byte)(inParent.GetColliderId(collider) + 1));
		}
	}

	public static float XZSqr(this Vector3 v)
	{
		return v.x * v.x + v.z * v.z;
	}
}

	public static void ConnectToCloud(int cloudRegionIndex = 0, Action onSuccess = null, Action<string> onError = null)
	{
		string text = Game.Mode.ToString();
		CloudRegion cloudRegion = (CloudRegion)cloudRegionIndex;
		Log("Connect " + text + " Region " + cloudRegion);
		if (BoltNetwork.IsRunning)
		{
			LogError("Bolt still running - shutting down");
			BoltNetwork.ShutdownImmediate();
			BeamTiming.WaitAnd(3f, () =>
			{
				ConnectTo(cloudRegionIndex, onSuccess, onError);
			});
		}
		else
		{
			ConnectTo(cloudRegionIndex, onSuccess, onError);
		}
	}

	private static void ConnectTo(int cloudRegionIndex = 0, Action onSuccess = null, Action<string> onError = null)
	{
		if (BoltNetwork.IsRunning)
		{
			throw new Exception($"Bolt: Unable to start game mode {Game.Mode.ToString()} IsRunning {BoltNetwork.IsRunning} IsServer {BoltNetwork.IsServer} IsClient {BoltNetwork.IsClient} IsSinglePlayer {BoltNetwork.IsSinglePlayer}");
		}
		string text = Game.Mode.ToString();
		CloudRegion cloudRegion = (CloudRegion)cloudRegionIndex;
		Log("Connect " + text + " Region " + cloudRegion);
		DisconnectPayload = new DisconnectPayLoad();
		_instance._shutdownDisconnectInProgress = false;
		_instance._onSuccess = onSuccess;
		_instance._onError = onError;
		PhotonPlatformConfig photonPlatformConfig = DefaultPhotonPlatformConfig.Copy();
		photonPlatformConfig.Region = PhotonRegion.GetRegion((PhotonRegion.Regions)cloudRegionIndex);
		BoltLauncher.SetUdpPlatform(new PhotonPlatform(photonPlatformConfig));
		BoltConfig configCopy = BoltRuntimeSettings.instance.GetConfigCopy();
		configCopy.disableAutoSceneLoading = true;
		configCopy.serverConnectionAcceptMode = BoltConnectionAcceptMode.Manual;
		switch (Game.Mode)
		{
		case GameMode.SinglePlayer:
		case GameMode.Coop_2:
		case GameMode.Coop_3:
		case GameMode.Coop_4:
			BoltLauncher.StartSinglePlayer(configCopy);
			break;
		case GameMode.Coop_Server:
			BoltLauncher.StartServer(configCopy);
			break;
		case GameMode.Coop_Client:
			BoltLauncher.StartClient(configCopy);
			break;
		}
	}

	public static void ConnectToSession(string sessionId = null, MultiplayerTokens.Session token = null, Action onSuccess = null, Action<string> onError = null)

		sessionId = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(sessionId) ? DEFAULT_SESSION_ID : sessionId);
		token = token ?? new MultiplayerTokens.Session

			IsPrivate = true,

		_instance._onError = onError;

		}

		}
	}

	public static void ClearBlockedClientList()
	{
		_blockedClientList.Clear();
	}

	public static void ListenForSuccesfulClientConnection()
	{
		if (BoltNetwork.IsServer)
		{
			BeamTiming.RunCoroutine(CheckForAvailableEndpoint());
		}
	}

	private static IEnumerator<float> CheckForAvailableEndpoint()
	{
		bool listening = true;
		bool success = false;
		float time = Time.time;
		while (listening && !(Time.time - time > 5f))
		{
			foreach (BoltConnection connection in BoltNetwork.Connections)
			{
				connection.ReceiveData(out var data);
				if (data != null && data[0] == 1)
				{
					listening = false;
					success = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			yield return float.NegativeInfinity;
		}
		if (success)
		{
			yield break;
		}
		LogError("client invalid for connection, disconnecting clients");
		foreach (BoltConnection client in BoltNetwork.Clients)
		{
			client.Disconnect();
		}
	}

	public override void ConnectRequest(UdpEndPoint endpoint, IProtocolToken joinToken)
	{
		Log("ConnectRequest " + joinToken.ToStringSafe());
		if (!Game.Mode.IsServer())
		{
			return;
		}
		MultiplayerTokens.Session token = BoltMatchmaking.CurrentSession.GetToken();
		string id = ((MultiplayerTokens.Join)joinToken).Id;
		string nameClient = ((MultiplayerTokens.Join)joinToken).Name;
		if (Game.State.IsGame())
		{
			if (token == null || !token.IsJoinable() || _blockedClientList.Contains(id) || IsClientOnWaitTime(id))
			{
				if (_permisionPrompt.gameObject.activeSelf)
				{
					_permisionPrompt.Hide();
				}
				BoltNetwork.Refuse(endpoint);
			}
			else
			{
				_permisionPrompt.endpoint = endpoint;
				_permisionPrompt.joinToken = joinToken;
				_permisionPrompt.Show(nameClient, id);
			}
		}
		else if (token == null || !token.IsJoinable() || _blockedClientList.Contains(id))
		{
			BoltNetwork.Refuse(endpoint);
		}
		else
		{
			_connectedClientId = id;
			BoltNetwork.Accept(endpoint, new MultiplayerTokens.Accept
			{
				ServerGameState = Game.State
			});
		}
	}

	public static void UpdateClientOnHold(string requestClientId)
	{
		if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(requestClientId))
		{
			return;
		}
		if (_clientsOnHold.TryGetValue(requestClientId, out var value))
		{
			value.Requests++;
			value.LastRequestTime = Time.unscaledTime;
			_clientsOnHold[requestClientId] = value;
			if (value.Requests > 3)
			{
				BlockCurrentClientId(requestClientId);
				RemoveClientOnHold(requestClientId);
			}
		}
		else
		{
			ClientOnHold value2 = new ClientOnHold(requestClientId);
			_clientsOnHold.Add(requestClientId, value2);
		}
	}

	public static void RemoveClientOnHold(string requestClientId)
	{
		if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(requestClientId) && _clientsOnHold.ContainsKey(requestClientId))
		{
			_clientsOnHold.Remove(requestClientId);
		}
	}

	public static bool IsClientOnWaitTime(string requestClientId)
	{
		if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(requestClientId))
		{
			return false;
		}
		if (_clientsOnHold.TryGetValue(requestClientId, out var value) && Time.unscaledTime - value.LastRequestTime < 30f)
		{
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	public override void Connected(BoltConnection connection)
	{
		Log(string.Format("{0}:: Connection type: {1}, Accept Token: {2}, Connect Token: {3}", "Connected", connection.ConnectionType, connection.AcceptToken, connection.ConnectToken));
		_messageInId = 0;
		_messageOutId = 0;
		_messages.Clear();
		_connectTime = Time.unscaledTime;
		MultiplayerTokens.Accept accept = connection.AcceptToken as MultiplayerTokens.Accept;
		if (BoltNetwork.IsClient && accept == null)
		{
			LogError("Disconnected due to bad token");
			connection.Disconnect();
			return;
		}
		ServerGameState = (BoltNetwork.IsServer ? Game.State : accept.ServerGameState);
		Log($"ServerGameState {ServerGameState}");
		if (!BoltNetwork.IsServer)
		{
			BoltNetwork.Server.SendData(new byte[1] { 1 });
		}
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new PlayerConnectedEvent(BoltNetwork.IsServer ? 1 : 0));
		if (BoltNetwork.IsServer)
		{
			UpdateSessionToken_IsOccupied(isOccupied: true);
		}
	}

	public override void Disconnected(BoltConnection connection)
	{
		if (_shutdownDisconnectInProgress)
		{
			return;
		}
		Log("Disconnected");
		_messageInId = 0;
		_messageOutId = 0;
		_messages.Clear();
		_connectTime = 0f;
		_connectedClientId = null;
		int num = ((BoltNetwork.IsServer && connection != null) ? 1 : 0);
		_shutdownDisconnectInProgress = num == 0 || (BoltNetwork.IsClient && num == 1);
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new PlayerDisconnectedEvent(num, DisconnectPayload));
		if (BoltNetwork.IsServer && num == 1)
		{
			if (Game.State == GameState.LOAD_GAME || Game.State == GameState.NEW_GAME)
			{
				UpdateToken();
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateSessionToken_IsOccupied(isOccupied: false);
			}
		}
	}

	private void UpdateToken()
	{
		try
		{
			MultiplayerTokens.Session token = BoltMatchmaking.CurrentSession.GetToken();
			token.IsOccupied = false;
			Zone zone = StrandedWorld.GetZone(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.transform.position);
			if (zone.Biome == Zone.BiomeType.MISSION && !zone.Equals(Beam.Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.FindEndGameZone()))
			{
				token.IsBusy = true;
			}
			else if (GetSessionToken().IsBusy)
			{
				token.IsBusy = false;
			}
			BoltMatchmaking.UpdateSession(token);
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			LogError("Error updating session token " + ex.Message);
		}
	}

	public override void BoltShutdownBegin(AddCallback registerDoneCallback, UdpConnectionDisconnectReason disconnectReason)
	{
		Log($"BoltShutdownBegin {disconnectReason} isRunning {BoltNetwork.IsRunning}");
		if (BoltNetwork.IsRunning)
		{
			Disconnected(null);
		}
	}

	public static void Shutdown()
	{
		if (BoltNetwork.IsRunning && !_shuttingDown)
		{
			_shuttingDown = true;
			PlayerRegistry.Clear();
			try
			{
				BoltNetwork.ShutdownImmediate();
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			_shuttingDown = false;
		}
	}

	private void PostSuccess()
	{
		Action onSuccess = _onSuccess;
		_onSuccess = null;
		_onError = null;
		onSuccess?.Invoke();
	}

	private void PostError(string reason)
	{
		Action<string> onError = _onError;
		_onSuccess = null;
		_onError = null;
		onError?.Invoke(reason);
	}

	public static IEnumerator<float> FindObject_Sequence<T>(DisconnectDetail disconnectDetail, MiniGuid referenceId, Action<T> onSuccess, Action onTimeout = null, float retryPeriod = 0.5f) where T : ISaveableReference
	{
		T obj = default;
		float startTime = Time.unscaledTime;
		while (obj.IsNullOrDestroyed() && !(Time.unscaledTime > startTime + Peer.DEFAULT_TIMEOUT))
		{
			obj = FindObject<T>(referenceId);
			if (obj.IsNullOrDestroyed())
			{
				yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(retryPeriod);
			}
		}
		if (obj.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			onTimeout?.Invoke();
			PlayerRegistry.LocalPeer.ReplicatedDisconnect(disconnectDetail);
		}
		else
		{
			onSuccess?.Invoke(obj);
		}
	}

	public static int GetLocalPeerId()
	{
		if (!Game.Mode.IsServer())
		{
			return 1;
		}
		return 0;
	}

	public static int GetEntityId(BoltEntity entity)
	{
		if (BoltNetwork.IsServer != entity.IsOwner)
		{
			return 1;
		}
		return 0;
	}

	public static string GetCloudRegion()
	{
		string value = "NONE";
		if (!BoltNetwork.IsRunning)
		{
			return value;
		}
		try
		{
			Dictionary<string, object> currentMetadata = BoltMatchmaking.CurrentMetadata;
			if (currentMetadata != null)
			{
				currentMetadata.TryGetValue<string>("Region", out value);
			}
		}
		catch (Exception)
		{
		}
		if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
		{
			return value.ToUpper();
		}
		return "NONE";
	}

	public static int GetCloudRegionIndex()
	{
		int result = 0;
		string cloudRegion = GetCloudRegion();
		for (int i = 0; i < BoltRuntimeSettings.photonCloudRegions.Length; i++)
		{
			if (BoltRuntimeSettings.photonCloudRegionsId[i].Equals(cloudRegion.ToLower()))
			{
				result = i;
				break;
			}
		}
		return result;
	}

	private static IEnumerator<SearchContainer> AllSearchContainers()
	{
		if (_instance.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			yield break;
		}
		yield return new SearchContainer(_instance._receivedEntities, includeInactive: true);
		if ((bool)LevelLoader.Instance)
		{
			foreach (Zone loadingZone in LevelLoader.Instance.LoadingZones)
			{
				if (loadingZone.Id != Beam.Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.NmlZone.Id)
				{
					yield return new SearchContainer(loadingZone.SaveContainer);
				}
			}
		}
		Zone[] zones = Beam.Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.Zones;
		foreach (Zone zone in zones)
		{
			if (!LevelLoader.Instance || !LevelLoader.Instance.LoadingZones.Contains(zone))
			{
				yield return new SearchContainer(zone.SaveContainer);
			}
		}
		yield return new SearchContainer(Beam.Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.NmlZone.SaveContainer);
	}

	public static T FindObject<T>(MiniGuid referenceId, bool includeInactive = false) where T : ISaveableReference
	{
		try
		{
			if (referenceId.IsDefault() || _instance.IsNullOrDestroyed())
			{
				return default;
			}
			IEnumerator<SearchContainer> enumerator = AllSearchContainers();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				T val = enumerator.Current.Container.FindObject<T>(referenceId, includeInactive & enumerator.Current.IncludeInactive);
				if (val != null)
				{
					return val;
				}
			}
			foreach (BoltEntity entity in BoltNetwork.Entities)
			{
				if (entity.gameObject.TryGetComponent<T>(out var component) && component.ReferenceId.Equals(referenceId))
				{
					return component;
				}
			}
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			LogError($"Error while finding entity {referenceId}: {ex.Message}\n{ex.StackTrace}");
		}
		return default;
	}

	public static T FindObject<T>(ulong networkId) where T : ISaveableReference
	{
		try
		{
			BoltEntity boltEntity = BoltNetwork.FindEntity(new NetworkId(networkId));
			if (null == boltEntity)
			{
				return default;
			}
			return boltEntity.GetComponent<T>();
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			LogError($"Error while finding entity {networkId}: {ex.Message}\n{ex.StackTrace}");
			return default;
		}
	}

	public void RegisterPrefabs()
	{
		FieldInfo[] fields = typeof(BoltPrefabs).GetFields(BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public);
		FieldInfo[] array = fields;
		foreach (FieldInfo fieldInfo in array)
		{
			_prefabs[fieldInfo.Name] = (PrefabId)fieldInfo.GetValue(null);
		}
		Log($"Multiplayer prefabs {fields.Length}");
		Prefabs.LinkMPPrefabs();
	}

	public static string GetBoltPrefabName(string prefabPath)
	{
		return Path.GetFileName(prefabPath).Split(' ', '-').RemoveEmpty()
			.Join("_");
	}

	public static bool TryGetPrefabName(string prefabPath, out string multiplayerPrefabName)
	{
		multiplayerPrefabName = GetBoltPrefabName(prefabPath);
		PrefabId value;
		return _instance?._prefabs.TryGetValue(multiplayerPrefabName, out value) ?? false;
	}

	public static T Instantiate<T>(PrefabId multiplayerPrefab, IProtocolToken token = null) where T : MonoBehaviour
	{
		return BoltNetwork.Instantiate(multiplayerPrefab, token).GetComponent<T>();
	}

	public static T Instantiate<T>(string prefabPath, MiniGuid referenceId) where T : SaveablePrefab
	{
		if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(prefabPath))
		{
			return null;
		}
		T val = (_instance._prefabs.TryGetValue(GetBoltPrefabName(prefabPath), out var value) ? Instantiate<T>(value, new MultiplayerTokens.SaveablePrefab(referenceId)) : UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(Resources.Load<T>(prefabPath)));
		val.ReferenceId = referenceId;
		return val;
	}

	public static T Instantiate<T>(uint prefabId, MiniGuid referenceId, Transform parent = null) where T : SaveablePrefab
	{
		T val = null;
		if (!_instance.IsNullOrDestroyed() && Prefabs.TryGetMultiplayerPrefabName(prefabId, out var multiplayerPrefabName))
		{
			Log($"Instantiate Bolt Pref for {prefabId} -> {_instance._prefabs[multiplayerPrefabName].Value}", "create/destroy");
			val = Instantiate<T>(_instance._prefabs[multiplayerPrefabName], new MultiplayerTokens.SaveablePrefab(referenceId));
			val.gameObject.transform.parent = parent;
		}
		else
		{
			val = (T)Prefabs.CreatePrefabFromId(prefabId, parent);
		}
		val.ReferenceId = referenceId;
		return val;
	}

	public static T Instantiate<T>(uint prefabId, Vector3 position, Quaternion rotation, MiniGuid referenceId, Transform parent = null) where T : SaveablePrefab
	{
		T val = Instantiate<T>(prefabId, referenceId);
		val.transform.position = position;
		val.transform.rotation = rotation;
		val.gameObject.transform.parent = parent;
		return val;
	}

	public static void DestroyMultiplayerEntity(GameObject gameObject, DestroyDelay destroyDelay = DestroyDelay.SAFE)
	{
		if (gameObject.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			Log($"Destroying {gameObject} - redundant destroy", "create/destroy", "magenta");
			return;
		}
		if (Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer() && destroyDelay != DestroyDelay.NOW)
		{
			_destroyCommands.Add(new BoltDestroyCommand(gameObject, Time.unscaledTime + (float)destroyDelay / 30f));
			gameObject.SetActive(value: false);
			return;
		}
		Log($"Destroying {gameObject} -  no delay", "create/destroy", "magenta");
		try
		{
			BoltNetwork.Destroy(gameObject);
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			LogError("Error while destroying multiplayer game object: " + ex.Message + "\n" + ex.StackTrace);
		}
	}

	public static void Destroy(SaveablePrefab saveablePrefab, DestroyDelay destroyDelay = DestroyDelay.SAFE)
	{
		if (saveablePrefab.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			return;
		}
		if (saveablePrefab.IsMultiplayerEntity)
		{
			if (saveablePrefab.IsOwner)
			{
				DestroyMultiplayerEntity(saveablePrefab.gameObject, destroyDelay);
			}
			else
			{
				saveablePrefab.gameObject.SetActive(value: false);
			}
		}
		else
		{
			BeamTeam.Destroy(saveablePrefab.gameObject);
		}
	}

	private void UpdateDestroyCommands()
	{
		int count = _destroyCommands.Count;
		float unscaledTime = Time.unscaledTime;
		int i = count - 1;
		while (i >= 0)
		{
			_destroyCommands[i].Destroy(unscaledTime, () =>
			{
				_destroyCommands.RemoveAt(i);
			});
			int num = i - 1;
			i = num;
		}
	}

	private void FixedUpdate()
	{
		UpdateDestroyCommands();
		UpdateMessages();
		if (BoltNetwork.IsServer && !BoltNetwork.IsSinglePlayer)
		{
			UpdateSessionOccupied();
		}
	}

	private void UpdateSessionOccupied()
	{
		if (PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers.Count != 0 && Math.Abs(Time.unscaledTime - _sessionOccupiedLastUpdateTime) > 3f)
		{
			bool flag = PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers.Count == 2;
			if (flag != GetSessionToken().IsOccupied)
			{
				UpdateSessionToken_IsOccupied(flag);
			}
			_sessionOccupiedLastUpdateTime = Time.unscaledTime;
		}
	}

	public static void AddListener<T>(Listener<T> listener) where T : Photon.Bolt.Event
	{
		if (_instance._internalListeners.TryGetValue(listener, out var _))
		{
			LogError("Listener for " + typeof(T).Name + " already added");
			return;
		}
		Listener listener2 = (Photon.Bolt.Event e) =>
		{
			listener((T)e);
		};
		_instance._internalListeners[listener] = listener2;
		Type typeFromHandle = typeof(T);
		_instance._listeners.TryGetValue(typeFromHandle, out var value2);
		value2 = (Listener)Delegate.Combine(value2, listener2);
		_instance._listeners[typeFromHandle] = value2;
	}

	public static void RemoveListener<T>(Listener<T> listener) where T : Photon.Bolt.Event
	{
		if (!_instance.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(T);
			if (_instance._internalListeners.TryGetValue(listener, out var value) && _instance._listeners.TryGetValue(typeFromHandle, out var value2))
			{
				value2 = (Listener)Delegate.Remove(value2, value);
				_instance._listeners[typeFromHandle] = value2;
				_instance._internalListeners.Remove(listener);
			}
		}
	}

	public override bool PersistBetweenStartupAndShutdown()
	{
		return true;
	}

	public static void SendGameStateChangeGlobalEvent(GameState fromState, GameState toState)
	{
		GameStateChangeGlobalEvent gameStateChangeGlobalEvent = GameStateChangeGlobalEvent.Create();
		gameStateChangeGlobalEvent.FromState = (int)fromState;
		gameStateChangeGlobalEvent.ToState = (int)toState;
		SendGlobalEvent_Core(gameStateChangeGlobalEvent);
	}

	public override void OnEvent(GameStateChangeGlobalEvent evnt)

		OnGlobalEventReceived_Core(evnt);
	}

	public static ushort GetMessageOutId()
	{
		return _instance._messageOutId++;
	}

		_instance._messageOutId++;
	}

		Log($"Consume {_instance._messageInId} - Sync Fence", "messages");
		_instance._messageInId++;
	}

	public override void OnEvent(MessageGlobalEvent evnt)
	{
		if (!evnt.FromSelf)
		{
			MultiplayerMessage multiplayerMessage = ((MultiplayerTokens.MessageEnvelope)evnt.Envelope).Get<MultiplayerMessage>();
			multiplayerMessage.ReceivedTime = Time.unscaledTime;
			multiplayerMessage.Ping = ((evnt.RaisedBy == null) ? 0f : evnt.RaisedBy.PingAliased);
			if (BoltNetwork.IsClient && Math.Abs(Time.unscaledTime - _connectTime) < 0.5f && multiplayerMessage.Id > 50)
			{
				Log($"Reject message {multiplayerMessage.GetType().Name} with ID {multiplayerMessage.Id} as it looks as a message posted before the connection was made");
				return;
			}
			Log($"Received message {multiplayerMessage.GetType().Name} with index {multiplayerMessage.Id}");
			_messages.Add(multiplayerMessage);
		}
	}

	public override void OnEvent(I_MessageGlobalEvent evnt)
	{
		if (!evnt.FromSelf)
		{
			I_MultiplayerMessage i_MultiplayerMessage = ((MultiplayerTokens.MessageEnvelope)evnt.Envelope).Get<I_MultiplayerMessage>();
			i_MultiplayerMessage.SetTransportEntity(evnt.Instantiated);
			i_MultiplayerMessage.ReceivedTime = Time.unscaledTime;
			i_MultiplayerMessage.Ping = ((evnt.RaisedBy == null) ? 0f : evnt.RaisedBy.PingAliased);
			if (BoltNetwork.IsClient && Math.Abs(Time.unscaledTime - _connectTime) < 0.5f && i_MultiplayerMessage.Id > 50)
			{
				Log($"Reject message {i_MultiplayerMessage.GetType().Name} with ID {i_MultiplayerMessage.Id} as it looks as a message posted before the connection was made");
				return;
			}
			Log($"Received message  {i_MultiplayerMessage.GetType().Name} with index {i_MultiplayerMessage.Id}");
			_messages.Add(i_MultiplayerMessage);
		}
	}

	private void UpdateMessages()
	{
		bool flag = _messages.Count != 0;
		while (flag)
		{
			int messageIndex = GetMessageIndex(_messageInId, out var oldestMessageTime);
			if (messageIndex != -1)
			{
				MultiplayerMessage multiplayerMessage = _messages[messageIndex];
				_messages.RemoveAt(messageIndex);
				_messageInId++;
				multiplayerMessage.Log("Executing " + multiplayerMessage.ToString());
				try
				{
					multiplayerMessage.OnPeer();
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					LogError("Error executing " + multiplayerMessage.ToString() + " " + ex.Message + "\n" + ex.StackTrace);
				}
				flag = _messages.Count != 0;
			}
			else
			{
				flag = false;
				if (Time.unscaledTime - oldestMessageTime > Peer.DEFAULT_TIMEOUT)
				{
					PlayerRegistry.LocalPeer.ReplicatedDisconnect(DisconnectDetail.Timeout_Messages, null, forceLocalShutdown: true);
				}
			}
		}
		if (_messages.Count != 0)
		{
			Log($"Queued {_messages.Count} with cursor {_messageInId}", "messages");
		}
	}

	private int GetMessageIndex(ushort id, out float oldestMessageTime)
	{
		oldestMessageTime = float.MaxValue;
		int count = _messages.Count;
		for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
		{
			MultiplayerMessage multiplayerMessage = _messages[i];
			if (multiplayerMessage.Id == id)
			{
				oldestMessageTime = multiplayerMessage.ReceivedTime;
				return i;
			}
			if (multiplayerMessage.ReceivedTime < oldestMessageTime)
			{
				oldestMessageTime = multiplayerMessage.ReceivedTime;
			}
		}
		return -1;
	}

	private static void SendGlobalEvent_Core(Photon.Bolt.Event evnt)
	{
		Log($"Send global event {evnt}", "messages");
		evnt.Send();
	}

	private void OnGlobalEventReceived_Core<T>(T evnt) where T : Photon.Bolt.Event
	{
		Log($"Received global event {evnt}", "messages");
		Type typeFromHandle = typeof(T);
		if (_listeners.TryGetValue(typeFromHandle, out var value))
		{
			value?.Invoke(evnt);
		}
	}

	private void Awake()
	{
		if (_instance != null)
		{
			UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(gameObject);
			return;
		}
		_instance = this;
		UnityEngine.Object.DontDestroyOnLoad(gameObject);
		RegisterPrefabs();
		MultiplayerFence.Register();
		MultiplayerMessageManager.Register();
		SaveManager.BeforeWrite += UpdateSessionToken_BeforeWriteSave;
	}

	private void OnDestroy()
	{
		Log("Shuting down connection");
		_joinToken = null;
		foreach (BoltDestroyCommand destroyCommand in _destroyCommands)
		{
			destroyCommand.Destroy(Time.frameCount, null, force: true);
		}
		_destroyCommands.Clear();
		if (_instance == this)
		{
			_instance = null;
		}
		SaveManager.BeforeWrite -= UpdateSessionToken_BeforeWriteSave;
	}

	private static void UpdateSessionToken_BeforeWriteSave(JObject rootData)
	{
		UpdateSessionToken_Player(rootData);
	}

	public static void UpdateSessionToken_Player(JObject data)
	{
		if (!BoltNetwork.IsServer || data.IsNullOrDestroyed() || data.IsNull() || BoltMatchmaking.CurrentSession.IsNullOrDestroyed() || BoltMatchmaking.CurrentSession.GetToken().IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			return;
		}
		try
		{

	private static string GetTimeStampCosmeticText(string value, string color = "yellow")
	{
		float unscaledTime = Time.unscaledTime;
		float num = Mathf.Floor(unscaledTime);
		double num2 = Math.Floor((unscaledTime - num) * 1000f);
		return $"[{num}:{num2:0.###}] {value}";
	}

	private static string GetCosmeticText(string value, string color = "yellow")
	{
		string[] array = GetTimeStampCosmeticText(value).Split(new char[1] { '\n' });
		string text = "";
		for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
		{
			string text2 = array[i];
			text = ((i != 0) ? (text + "\n<color=" + color + ">" + text2 + "</color>") : (text + "<color=" + color + ">" + text2 + "</color>"));
		}
		return text;
	}

	private void UpdateStayAlive()
	{

			if (entity.IsOwner && Time.unscaledTime - _lastSentTime > ALIVE_INTERVAL)
			{

				stayAliveMessage.PeerId = (byte)Id;

				stayAliveMessage.Post();

	private void StayAlive(int aliveId)
	{
		_aliveTime = Time.unscaledTime;
		if (aliveId > _aliveId)
		{
			_aliveId = aliveId;
			StayAliveMessage stayAliveMessage = new StayAliveMessage();
			stayAliveMessage.PeerId = (byte)Id;

	public float SetTimeout_Async(float timeout)
	{
		return Timing.WaitUntilDone(Timing.RunCoroutine(SetTimout_Sequence(timeout)));
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> SetTimout_Sequence(float timeout)
	{
		_ = _timeout;
		_ = timeout;
		ReplicatedSetTimeout(timeout);
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(1f);
	}

	public void SetTimeout(float timeout)
	{
		if (_timeout != timeout)
		{
			ReplicatedSetTimeout(timeout);
		}
	}

	{
		_timeout = timeout;
		StayAlive(_aliveId);
	}

	private void ReplicatedSetTimeout(float timeout)
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
		{
			ReplicateSetTimeout replicateSetTimeout = new ReplicateSetTimeout();
			replicateSetTimeout.PeerId = (byte)Id;
			replicateSetTimeout.TimeOut = timeout;
			replicateSetTimeout.Post();
		}
		SetTimeout_Core(timeout);
	}

				float num24 = num18 / (float)num19;
				float num25 = heights[j, i];
				float v = ((float)(j + o_minX) / num - o_relBrushMinX2) / p_relativeBrushSize;
				float u = ((float)(i + o_minY) / num2 - o_relBrushMinY2) / p_relativeBrushSize;
				float num26 = p_amount * p_alphaBrushTexture.GetPixelBilinear(u, v).a;
				heights[j, i] = num25 * (1f - num26) + num24 * num26;
				heights[j, i] = ClampHeightBounds(heights[j, i], o_minX + j, o_minY + i);
			}
		}
		m_terrainData.SetHeights(o_minY, o_minX, heights);
		LE_EventInterface.LevelDataChanged(this);
	}

	public void ChangeHeight(float p_delta, float p_targetHeight, Texture2D p_alphaBrushTexture, float p_relativeBrushSize, Vector2 p_relativeLocalLocation)
	{
		ChangeHeightInternal(p_alphaBrushTexture, p_relativeBrushSize, p_relativeLocalLocation, out var o_minX, out var o_maxX, out var o_minY, out var o_maxY, out var o_heights, out var o_relBrushMinX, out var o_relBrushMinY, out var o_heightmapMaxX, out var o_heightmapMaxY);
		int num = Mathf.Min(o_maxX - o_minX, o_heights.GetLength(0) - 1);
		int num2 = Mathf.Min(o_maxY - o_minY, o_heights.GetLength(1) - 1);
		for (int i = 0; i <= num; i++)
		{
			for (int j = 0; j <= num2; j++)
			{
				float num3 = o_heights[i, j];
				if (Mathf.Abs(num3 - p_targetHeight) > 0.0001f)
				{
					float v = ((float)(i + o_minX) / o_heightmapMaxX - o_relBrushMinX) / p_relativeBrushSize;
					float u = ((float)(j + o_minY) / o_heightmapMaxY - o_relBrushMinY) / p_relativeBrushSize;
					float num4 = p_delta * p_alphaBrushTexture.GetPixelBilinear(u, v).a;
					float num5 = ((p_targetHeight - num3 > 0f) ? 1f : (-1f));
					if (Mathf.Sign(p_targetHeight - num3) != Mathf.Sign(p_targetHeight - (num3 + num5 * num4)))
					{
						o_heights[i, j] = p_targetHeight;
					}
					else
					{
						o_heights[i, j] += num5 * num4;
					}
				}
				o_heights[i, j] = ClampHeightBounds(o_heights[i, j], o_minX + i, o_minY + j);
			}
		}
		m_terrainData.SetHeights(o_minY, o_minX, o_heights);
		LE_EventInterface.LevelDataChanged(this);
	}

	private float ClampHeightBounds(float heightToClamp, int x, int y)
	{
		float num = 20f;
		float num2 = 257f;
		if ((!((float)x > num) || !((float)x < num2 - num) || !((float)y > num) || !((float)y < num2 - num)) && heightToClamp > 0.65f)
		{
			heightToClamp = 0.65f;
		}
		return heightToClamp;
	}

	public void ChangeHeight(float p_delta, Texture2D p_alphaBrushTexture, float p_relativeBrushSize, Vector2 p_relativeLocalLocation)
	{
		ChangeHeightInternal(p_alphaBrushTexture, p_relativeBrushSize, p_relativeLocalLocation, out var o_minX, out var o_maxX, out var o_minY, out var o_maxY, out var o_heights, out var o_relBrushMinX, out var o_relBrushMinY, out var o_heightmapMaxX, out var o_heightmapMaxY);
		int num = Mathf.Min(o_maxX - o_minX, o_heights.GetLength(0) - 1);
		int num2 = Mathf.Min(o_maxY - o_minY, o_heights.GetLength(1) - 1);
		for (int i = 0; i <= num; i++)
		{
			for (int j = 0; j <= num2; j++)
			{
				float v = ((float)(i + o_minX) / o_heightmapMaxX - o_relBrushMinX) / p_relativeBrushSize;
				float u = ((float)(j + o_minY) / o_heightmapMaxY - o_relBrushMinY) / p_relativeBrushSize;
				float a = p_alphaBrushTexture.GetPixelBilinear(u, v).a;
				o_heights[i, j] += p_delta * a;
				o_heights[i, j] = ClampHeightBounds(o_heights[i, j], o_minX + i, o_minY + j);
			}
		}
		m_terrainData.SetHeights(o_minY, o_minX, o_heights);
		LE_EventInterface.LevelDataChanged(this);
	}

	private void ChangeHeightInternal(Texture2D p_alphaBrushTexture, float p_relativeBrushSize, Vector2 p_relativeLocalLocation, out int o_minX, out int o_maxX, out int o_minY, out int o_maxY, out float[,] o_heights, out float o_relBrushMinX, out float o_relBrushMinY, out float o_heightmapMaxX, out float o_heightmapMaxY)
	{
		o_heightmapMaxX = m_terrainData.heightmapResolution - 1;
		o_heightmapMaxY = m_terrainData.heightmapResolution - 1;
		GetAffectedAreaInternal(p_alphaBrushTexture, p_relativeBrushSize, p_relativeLocalLocation, o_heightmapMaxX, o_heightmapMaxY, out o_minX, out o_maxX, out o_minY, out o_maxY, out o_relBrushMinX, out o_relBrushMinY);
		o_heights = m_terrainData.GetHeights(o_minY, o_minX, o_maxY - o_minY + 1, o_maxX - o_minX + 1);
	}

	private void GetAffectedAreaInternal(Texture2D p_alphaBrushTexture, float p_relativeBrushSize, Vector2 p_relativeLocalLocation, float p_maxX, float p_maxY, out int o_minX, out int o_maxX, out int o_minY, out int o_maxY, out float o_relBrushMinX, out float o_relBrushMinY)
	{
		o_minX = 0;
		o_maxX = 0;
		o_minY = 0;
		o_maxY = 0;
		o_relBrushMinX = p_relativeLocalLocation.x - p_relativeBrushSize * 0.5f;
		float num = p_relativeLocalLocation.x + p_relativeBrushSize * 0.5f;
		o_relBrushMinY = p_relativeLocalLocation.y - p_relativeBrushSize * 0.5f;
		float num2 = p_relativeLocalLocation.y + p_relativeBrushSize * 0.5f;
		if (p_alphaBrushTexture == null)
		{
			Debug.LogError("LE_TerrainManager: Parameter 'p_alphaBrushTexture' is null!");
			return;
		}
		if (p_relativeBrushSize != Mathf.Clamp01(p_relativeBrushSize))
		{
			Debug.LogError("LE_TerrainManager: Parameter 'p_relativeBrushSize' is out of bounds expected range [0,1], but was '" + p_relativeBrushSize + "'!");
			return;
		}
		if (p_relativeLocalLocation.x != Mathf.Clamp01(p_relativeLocalLocation.x) || p_relativeLocalLocation.y != Mathf.Clamp01(p_relativeLocalLocation.y))
		{
			Vector2 vector = p_relativeLocalLocation;
			Debug.LogError("LE_TerrainManager: Parameter 'p_relativeLocalLocation' is out of bounds expected range ([0,1],[0,1]), but was '" + vector.ToString() + "'!");
			return;
		}
		o_minX = Mathf.Clamp(Mathf.FloorToInt(p_maxX * o_relBrushMinX), 0, (int)p_maxX);
		o_maxX = Mathf.Clamp(Mathf.CeilToInt(p_maxX * num), 0, (int)p_maxX);
		o_minY = Mathf.Clamp(Mathf.FloorToInt(p_maxY * o_relBrushMinY), 0, (int)p_maxY);
		o_maxY = Mathf.Clamp(Mathf.CeilToInt(p_maxY * num2), 0, (int)p_maxY);
	}
}

	public override void SetIsCursorAction(bool p_isCursorAction)

		if (m_isTerrainSetHeightReadInFrame != -1 && !p_isCursorAction && m_isTerrainSetHeightReadInFrame + 1 < Time.frameCount)
		{
			m_isReadingTerrainSetHeight = false;
			m_isTerrainSetHeightReadInFrame = -1;
		}
		if (((IsCursorOverSomething && IsInteractable) & p_isCursorAction) && m_lastCursorActiveScreenCoords != m_cursorScreenCoords)
		{
			m_lastCursorActiveScreenCoords = m_cursorScreenCoords;
			if (!(m_cursorHitInfo.transform.gameObject.GetComponent<Terrain>() != null))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (m_isReadingTerrainSetHeight)
			{
				Terrain component = m_cursorHitInfo.transform.gameObject.GetComponent<Terrain>();
				float num = component.SampleHeight(m_cursorHitInfo.point);
				m_targetRelativeValue = Mathf.Clamp01(num / component.terrainData.size.y);
				m_isTerrainSetHeightReadInFrame = Time.frameCount;
				return;
			}
			switch (m_editMode)
			{
			case LE_ETerrainEditMode.CHANGE_HEIGHT:
				m_terrainMgr.ChangeHeight(Mathf.Sign(Amount) * Mathf.Max(0.002f, Amount * Amount) * Time.deltaTime * 2f, BrushAlphaTexture, Size, GetRelativeLocalLocation(m_cursorHitInfo));
				break;
			case LE_ETerrainEditMode.CHANGE_HEIGHT_TO_TARGET_VALUE:
				m_terrainMgr.ChangeHeight(Mathf.Max(0.002f, Amount * Amount) * Time.deltaTime * 2f, TargetRelativeValue, BrushAlphaTexture, Size, GetRelativeLocalLocation(m_cursorHitInfo));

				m_terrainMgr.SmoothHeight(Time.deltaTime * 2f, p_neighbourCount, BrushAlphaTexture, Size, GetRelativeLocalLocation(m_cursorHitInfo), m_isDirectedSmooth, m_directedSmoothAngle);
				break;

			default:
				Debug.LogError("LE_GUI3dTerrain: unknown EditMode!");
				break;
			case LE_ETerrainEditMode.PROCEDURAL:
				break;
			}
		}
		else

			m_lastCursorActiveScreenCoords = -1f * Vector3.one;
		}

	public void Focus()
	{
		if (IsCursorOverSomething)
		{
			Vector3 point = m_cursorHitInfo.point;
			Vector3 vector = new Vector3(m_brushProjector.orthographicSize, m_brushProjector.orthographicSize * 0.7f, m_brushProjector.orthographicSize);
			Vector3 vector2 = Camera.main.transform.position - point;
			float num = Mathf.Max(vector.x, vector.y, vector.z) * 3f;
			Camera.main.transform.position = point + vector2.normalized * num;
			if (Camera.main.transform.position.y < point.y)
			{
				Vector3 position = Camera.main.transform.position;
				position.y = point.y;
				Camera.main.transform.position = position;
			}
			Camera.main.transform.LookAt(point, Vector3.up);
		}
	}

	private void UpdateBrushProjector(bool p_isHit, RaycastHit p_hitInfo)
	{
		if (p_isHit)
		{
			Vector3 size = m_terrainMgr.TerrainData.size;
			Vector2 relativeLocalLocation = GetRelativeLocalLocation(p_hitInfo);
			BrushProjector.transform.position = new Vector3(p_hitInfo.transform.position.x + relativeLocalLocation.y * size.x, p_hitInfo.point.y, p_hitInfo.transform.position.z + relativeLocalLocation.x * size.z);
			BrushProjector.orthographicSize = m_terrainMgr.TerrainData.size.z * m_size * 0.5f;
			BrushProjector.aspectRatio = m_terrainMgr.TerrainData.size.x / m_terrainMgr.TerrainData.size.z;
			if (BrushProjector.transform.childCount > 0)
			{
				BrushProjector.transform.GetChild(0).gameObject.SetActive(m_editMode == LE_ETerrainEditMode.SMOOTH_HEIGHT && IsDirectedSmooth);
			}
		}
		else
		{
			BrushProjector.orthographicSize = 0f;
			if (BrushProjector.transform.childCount > 0)
			{
				BrushProjector.transform.GetChild(0).gameObject.SetActive(value: false);
			}
		}
	}

	private Vector2 GetRelativeLocalLocation(RaycastHit hit)
	{
		Terrain component = hit.transform.gameObject.GetComponent<Terrain>();
		Vector3 size = component.terrainData.size;
		Vector3 vector = hit.transform.InverseTransformPoint(hit.point);
		Vector2 zero = Vector2.zero;
		zero.x = vector.z / size.z;
		zero.y = vector.x / size.x;
		float num = 1f / (float)(component.terrainData.heightmapResolution - 1);
		float num2 = 1f / (float)(component.terrainData.heightmapResolution - 1);
		zero.x = Mathf.Round(zero.x / num) * num;
		zero.y = Mathf.Round(zero.y / num2) * num2;
		return zero;
	}

	private void OnTerrainGenerateCustomHeightmap(object p_obj, EventArgs p_args)
	{
		if (Singleton<LE_LevelEditorMain>.Instance.GUI3dTerrain.Heightmap == null)
		{
			DialogueBox.Show(GetPlayerInput(), "MAP_EDITOR_DB_GENERATE_HEIGHTMAP_TITLE", "MAP_EDITOR_DB_NO_SELECTION_DESC", DialogueButton.Ok, DialogueIcon.Warning);
			return;
		}
		DialogueBox.Show(GetPlayerInput(), "MAP_EDITOR_DB_GENERATE_HEIGHTMAP_TITLE", "MAP_EDITOR_DB_GENERATE_HEIGHTMAP_DESC", DialogueButton.YesNo, DialogueIcon.Warning).Accept += () =>
		{
			if ((bool)Singleton<LE_ZoneTileGenerator>.Instance)
			{
				Singleton<LE_ZoneTileGenerator>.Instance.terrain.terrainData.SetHeights(0, 0, Singleton<LE_LevelEditorMain>.Instance.GUI3dTerrain.Heightmap.Heights);
			}
		};
	}

	private void OnTerrainGeneratePerlin(object p_obj, EventArgs p_args)
	{
		DialogueBox.Show(GetPlayerInput(), "MAP_EDITOR_DB_GENERATE_HEIGHTMAP_TITLE", "MAP_EDITOR_DB_GENERATE_HEIGHTMAP_DESC", DialogueButton.YesNo, DialogueIcon.Warning).Accept += () =>
		{
			DialogueBoxViewAdapter dialogue = DialogueBox.Show(GetPlayerInput(), "MAP_EDITOR_DB_GENERATING_HEIGHTMAP_TITLE", "MAP_EDITOR_DB_GENERATING_HEIGHTMAP_DESC", DialogueButton.None, DialogueIcon.Information);
			BeamTeam.InvokeDelayed(0.5f, () =>
			{
				TerrainGeneratePerlin();
				dialogue.Destroy();
			});
		};
	}

	private void TerrainGeneratePerlin()
	{
		if (Singleton<LE_ZoneTileGenerator>.Instance != null)

			Singleton<LE_ZoneTileGenerator>.Instance.GenerateAdvancedPerlin((int)TERRAIN_GENERATE_PERLIN_FREQ.value, TERRAIN_GENERATE_PERLIN_AMPLITUDE.value, (int)TERRAIN_GENERATE_PERLIN_OCTAVES.value, TERRAIN_GENERATE_PERLIN_BLEND.value);
		}
	}

	private void SetupTexturePickerEvents(string p_errorPickerName, uMyGUI_TexturePicker p_texPicker, ref Action<Texture2D[], int> r_setTexturesDelegate, Action<int> p_buttonCallback, ref EventHandler<LE_GUIInterface.EventHandlers.IntEventArgs> r_onChangedEvent)
	{
		if (p_texPicker != null)
		{
			r_setTexturesDelegate = (Action<Texture2D[], int>)Delegate.Combine(r_setTexturesDelegate, (Action<Texture2D[], int>)((Texture2D[] p_textures, int p_selectedIndex) =>
			{
				p_texPicker.SetTextures(p_textures, p_selectedIndex);
				AddButtonClickSoundsToGeneratedUI(p_texPicker.transform as RectTransform);
			}));
			p_texPicker.ButtonCallback = p_buttonCallback;
			r_onChangedEvent = (EventHandler<LE_GUIInterface.EventHandlers.IntEventArgs>)Delegate.Combine(r_onChangedEvent, (EventHandler<LE_GUIInterface.EventHandlers.IntEventArgs>)((object p_obj, LE_GUIInterface.EventHandlers.IntEventArgs p_args) =>
			{
				if (p_texPicker != null)
				{
					p_texPicker.SetSelection(p_args.Value);
				}
			}));
		}
		else
		{
			Debug.LogError("LE_GUIInterface_uGUIimpl: " + p_errorPickerName + " is not set in inspector!");
		}
	}

	private float GetCameraPerspectiveGizmoRightPixelOffset()
	{
		return CAM_GIZMO_RIGHT_PIXEL_OFFSET * ((float)Screen.height / m_transform.rect.height);
	}

	private float GetObliqueCameraPerspectiveRightPixelOffset()

	}

	private void SetTerrainUIMode(LE_GUIInterface.Delegates.ETerrainUIMode p_mode)
	{
		if (TERRAIN_UI_MODE_EDIT != null)
		{
			bool flag = p_mode == LE_GUIInterface.Delegates.ETerrainUIMode.EDIT;
			TERRAIN_UI_MODE_EDIT.gameObject.SetActive(flag);
			if (flag)
			{
				TERRAIN_UI_MODE_EDIT.gameObject.SendMessage("uMyGUI_OnActivateTab", SendMessageOptions.DontRequireReceiver);
			}
		}
		else
		{
			Debug.LogError("LE_GUIInterface_uGUIimpl: SetTerrainUIMode: TERRAIN_UI_MODE_EDIT is not set in inspector!");
		}
		if (TERRAIN_MENU != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(TERRAIN_MENU_FADE_IN_ANIM) && TERRAIN_MENU.gameObject.activeInHierarchy)
		{
			Animation component = TERRAIN_MENU.GetComponent<Animation>();
			if (component != null)
			{
				component.Play(TERRAIN_MENU_FADE_IN_ANIM);
			}
		}
		else if (TERRAIN_MENU == null)
		{
			Debug.LogError("LE_GUIInterface_uGUIimpl: SetTerrainUIMode: TERRAIN_MENU is not set in inspector!");
		}
	}

			TextMeshProUGUI component = TERRAIN_READ_SET_HEIGHT_BTN.transform.GetChild(0).GetComponent<TextMeshProUGUI>();
			string term = (p_isReadingSetHeight ? "MAP_EDITOR_TERRAIN_BUTTON_CLICK_TO_READ_TERRAIN_HEIGHT" : "MAP_EDITOR_TERRAIN_BUTTON_READ_TERRAIN_PAINT_HEIGHT");
			component.text = Localization.GetLanguageHandler().Localize(term);
