	private void SetObjects(LE_ObjectMap p_objectMap)
	{
		if (OBJECT_BROWSER != null)
		{
			OBJECT_BROWSER.BuildTree(SetObjectsRecursive(p_objectMap, 0));
			AddButtonClickSoundsToGeneratedUI(OBJECT_BROWSER.transform as RectTransform);
			uMyGUI_TreeBrowser oBJECT_BROWSER = OBJECT_BROWSER;
			oBJECT_BROWSER.OnInnerNodeClick = (EventHandler<uMyGUI_TreeBrowser.NodeClickEventArgs>)Delegate.Combine(oBJECT_BROWSER.OnInnerNodeClick, (EventHandler<uMyGUI_TreeBrowser.NodeClickEventArgs>)((object p_object, uMyGUI_TreeBrowser.NodeClickEventArgs p_args) =>
			{
				AddButtonClickSoundsToGeneratedUI(OBJECT_BROWSER.transform as RectTransform);
			}));
			uMyGUI_TreeBrowser oBJECT_BROWSER2 = OBJECT_BROWSER;
			oBJECT_BROWSER2.OnLeafNodeClick = (EventHandler<uMyGUI_TreeBrowser.NodeClickEventArgs>)Delegate.Combine(oBJECT_BROWSER2.OnLeafNodeClick, (EventHandler<uMyGUI_TreeBrowser.NodeClickEventArgs>)((object p_object, uMyGUI_TreeBrowser.NodeClickEventArgs p_args) =>
			{
				if (!m_nodeToObject.TryGetValue(p_args.ClickedNode, out var value))
				{
					Debug.LogError("LE_GUIInterface_uGUIimpl: could not find selected node's object!");
				}
				if (value != null)
				{
					LE_GUIInterface.Instance.OnObjectSelectDraggable(value);
				}
			}));
		}
		else
		{
			Debug.LogError("LE_GUIInterface_uGUIimpl: SetObjects: OBJECT_BROWSER is not set in inspector!");
		}
	}

	private uMyGUI_TreeBrowser.Node[] SetObjectsRecursive(LE_ObjectMap p_objectMap, int p_indentLevel)
	{
		List<uMyGUI_TreeBrowser.Node> list = new List<uMyGUI_TreeBrowser.Node>();
		foreach (LE_ObjectMap subObjectMap in p_objectMap.SubObjectMaps)
		{
			if (subObjectMap != null)
			{
				LE_ObjectCategoryNode.SendMessageInitData p_sendMessageData = new LE_ObjectCategoryNode.SendMessageInitData(subObjectMap.CategoryName, p_indentLevel);
				list.Add(new uMyGUI_TreeBrowser.Node(p_sendMessageData, SetObjectsRecursive(subObjectMap, p_indentLevel + 1)));
			}
		}
		foreach (LE_Object objectPrefab in p_objectMap.ObjectPrefabs)
		{
			if (objectPrefab != null)
			{
				uMyGUI_TreeBrowser.Node node = new uMyGUI_TreeBrowser.Node(new LE_ObjectPrefabNode.SendMessageInitData(objectPrefab, p_indentLevel), null);
				list.Add(node);
				m_nodeToObject.Add(node, objectPrefab);
			}
			else
			{
				Debug.LogError("LE_GUIInterface_uGUIimpl: SetObjectsRecursive: object from map '" + p_objectMap.CategoryName + "' at index '' is null!");
			}
		}
		return list.ToArray();
	}

	private bool IsObjectDragged()
	{
		if (OBJECT_PREVIEW_DRAGGABLE != null)
		{
			return OBJECT_PREVIEW_DRAGGABLE.IsDragged;
		}
		return false;
	}

	private void SetDraggableObjectState(LE_GUIInterface.Delegates.EDraggedObjectState p_state)
	{
		if (OBJECT_PREVIEW_IMAGE != null)
		{
			switch (p_state)
			{
			case LE_GUIInterface.Delegates.EDraggedObjectState.NOT_PLACEABLE:
				OBJECT_PREVIEW_IMAGE.color = Color.red;
				break;
			case LE_GUIInterface.Delegates.EDraggedObjectState.IN_3D_PREVIEW:
				OBJECT_PREVIEW_IMAGE.color = Color.clear;
				break;
			default:
				OBJECT_PREVIEW_IMAGE.color = Color.white;
				break;
			}
		}
	}

	{
		if (OBJECT_PREVIEW_MESSAGE != null)
		{
			OBJECT_PREVIEW_MESSAGE.Text = p_message;
		}
	}

	private void ShowPopupConfirmDeleteObject(Action<bool> p_confirmCallback)
	{
		DialogueBoxViewAdapter dialogueBoxViewAdapter = DialogueBox.Show(GetPlayerInput(), "MAP_EDITOR_DB_DELETE_OBJECT_TITLE", "MAP_EDITOR_DB_DELETE_OBJECT_DESC", DialogueButton.YesNo);
		dialogueBoxViewAdapter.Accept += () =>
		{
			p_confirmCallback(obj: true);
		};
		dialogueBoxViewAdapter.Cancel += () =>
		{
			p_confirmCallback(obj: false);
		};
	}

	private void AddButtonClickSoundsToGeneratedUI(RectTransform p_root)
	{
		if (p_root != null && BUTTON_CLICK_AUDIO_SOURCE != null)
		{
			Button[] componentsInChildren = p_root.GetComponentsInChildren<Button>(includeInactive: true);
			for (int i = 0; i < componentsInChildren.Length; i++)
			{
				componentsInChildren[i].onClick.RemoveListener(OnButtonClickSound);
				componentsInChildren[i].onClick.AddListener(OnButtonClickSound);
			}
			Toggle[] componentsInChildren2 = p_root.GetComponentsInChildren<Toggle>(includeInactive: true);
			for (int j = 0; j < componentsInChildren2.Length; j++)
			{
				componentsInChildren2[j].onValueChanged.RemoveListener(OnToggleClickSound);
				componentsInChildren2[j].onValueChanged.AddListener(OnToggleClickSound);
			}
		}
	}

	private void OnButtonClickSound()
	{
		if (BUTTON_CLICK_AUDIO_SOURCE != null)
		{
			BUTTON_CLICK_AUDIO_SOURCE.Play();
		}
	}

	private void OnToggleClickSound(bool p_isOn)
	{
		if (BUTTON_CLICK_AUDIO_SOURCE != null)
		{
			BUTTON_CLICK_AUDIO_SOURCE.Play();
		}
	}
}

	public LE_GUI3dTerrain GUI3dTerrain => m_GUI3dTerrain;

	public Vector3 CamPivot
	{
		get
		{
			return m_camPivot;
		}
		set
		{
			m_camPivot = value;
		}
	}

	private Camera Cam
	{
		get
		{
			if (m_cam == null)
			{
				m_cam = Camera.main;
			}
			return m_cam;
		}
	}

	public bool IsReady => m_isFirstUpdateInitialized;

	public int LastChangeFrame => m_lastChangeFrame;

	public void ExecuteWhenReady(Action p_action)
	{
		m_executeWhenReady = (Action)Delegate.Combine(m_executeWhenReady, p_action);
	}

	public static bool SetObliqueFocusProjectionMatrix(bool p_isObliqueProjectionEnabled)
	{
		if (LE_GUIInterface.Instance.delegates.GetObliqueCameraPerspectiveRightPixelOffset != null)
		{
			if (p_isObliqueProjectionEnabled)
			{
				Camera.main.ResetProjectionMatrix();
				Matrix4x4 projectionMatrix = Camera.main.projectionMatrix;
				projectionMatrix[0, 2] = LE_GUIInterface.Instance.delegates.GetObliqueCameraPerspectiveRightPixelOffset() / (float)Screen.width;
				Camera.main.projectionMatrix = projectionMatrix;
			}
			else
			{
				Camera.main.ResetProjectionMatrix();
			}
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	void LE_IInputHandler.SetCursorPosition(Vector3 p_cursorScreenCoords)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < m_GUI3d.Count; i++)
		{
			if (m_GUI3d[i].ActiveEditMode == m_editMode && m_GUI3d[i].IsInteractable)
			{
				m_GUI3d[i].SetCursorPosition(p_cursorScreenCoords);
			}
		}
	}

	void LE_IInputHandler.SetIsCursorAction(bool p_isCursorAction)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < m_GUI3d.Count; i++)
		{
			if (m_GUI3d[i].ActiveEditMode == m_editMode)
			{
				m_GUI3d[i].SetIsCursorAction(p_isCursorAction);
			}
		}
	}

	void LE_IInputHandler.MoveCamera(Vector3 p_fromScreenCoords, Vector3 p_toScreenCoords, bool scrolling = false)
	{
		if (!IS_CAMERA_MOVEMENT)
		{
			return;
		}
		Camera cam = Cam;
		if ((!scrolling || !IsMouseOverGUI()) && cam != null)
		{
			float num = EstimateDistanceToLevel(EEstimateDistanceMode.AVERAGE);
			Vector3 direction = p_toScreenCoords - p_fromScreenCoords;
			direction = cam.transform.TransformDirection(direction);
			Vector3 vector;
			if (cam.orthographic)
			{
				float num2 = Vector3.Dot(direction, cam.transform.forward);
				direction -= cam.transform.forward * num2;
				cam.orthographicSize = Mathf.Clamp(cam.orthographicSize - num2 * (cam.orthographicSize / (float)Screen.width), 5f, 1000f);
				vector = direction * (cam.orthographicSize / (float)Screen.width);
			}
			else
			{
				vector = direction * (num / (float)Screen.width);
			}
			cam.transform.position += vector;
			cam.transform.position = new Vector3(Mathf.Clamp(cam.transform.position.x, -300f, 300f), Mathf.Clamp(cam.transform.position.y, -100f, 150f), Mathf.Clamp(cam.transform.position.z, -300f, 300f));
		}
	}

	void LE_IInputHandler.RotateCamera(Vector3 p_fromScreenCoords, Vector3 p_toScreenCoords)
	{
		if (!IS_CAMERA_MOVEMENT)
		{
			return;
		}
		Camera cam = Cam;
		if (cam != null)
		{
			Ray ray = cam.ScreenPointToRay(p_fromScreenCoords);
			Ray ray2 = cam.ScreenPointToRay(p_toScreenCoords);
			if (cam.orthographic)
			{
				ray.direction = (ray.origin + ray.direction * 100f - cam.transform.position).normalized;
				ray2.direction = (ray2.origin + ray2.direction * 100f - cam.transform.position).normalized;
			}
			float num = Vector3.Angle(ray.direction, ray2.direction);
			Vector3 normalized = Vector3.Cross(ray.direction, ray2.direction).normalized;
			float num2 = Mathf.Abs(cam.transform.forward.y);
			if (num2 > 0.9f)
			{
				num2 = (1f - num2) / 0.100000024f;
				num2 *= num2;
				float num3 = Vector3.Dot(normalized, cam.transform.right);
				normalized -= (1f - num2) * (normalized - num3 * cam.transform.right);
			}
			cam.transform.Rotate(normalized, 0f - num, Space.World);
			if (cam.transform.up.y > 0f)
			{
				cam.transform.LookAt(cam.transform.position + cam.transform.forward, Vector3.up);
			}
			else
			{
				cam.transform.LookAt(cam.transform.position + cam.transform.forward, Vector3.down);
			}
		}
	}

	void LE_IInputHandler.RotateCameraAroundPivot(Vector3 p_fromScreenCoords, Vector3 p_toScreenCoords)
	{
		if (!IS_CAMERA_MOVEMENT)
		{
			return;
		}
		Camera cam = Cam;
		if (cam != null)
		{
			Vector2 vector = new Vector2(p_toScreenCoords.x, p_toScreenCoords.y) - new Vector2(p_fromScreenCoords.x, p_fromScreenCoords.y);
			vector.x /= Screen.width;
			vector.y /= Screen.height;
			cam.transform.RotateAround(m_camPivot, cam.transform.right, vector.y * 300f);
			cam.transform.RotateAround(m_camPivot, cam.transform.up, (0f - vector.x) * 300f);
			if (cam.transform.up.y > 0f)
			{
				cam.transform.LookAt(m_camPivot, Vector3.up);
			}
			else
			{
				cam.transform.LookAt(m_camPivot, Vector3.down);
			}
		}
	}

	private void Start()
	{
		if (LE_GUIInterface.Instance == null)
		{
			Debug.LogError("LE_LevelEditorMain: a LE_GUIInterface object must be added to the scene!");
		}
		LE_ConfigTerrain lE_ConfigTerrain = GetComponentInChildren<LE_ConfigTerrain>();
		if (lE_ConfigTerrain == null)
		{
			Debug.LogError("LE_LevelEditorMain: a LE_ConfigTerrain component must be added to the game object with the LE_LevelEditorMain script!");
			lE_ConfigTerrain = gameObject.AddComponent<LE_ConfigTerrain>();
		}
		if (!IS_TERRAIN_EDITOR)
		{
			if (lE_ConfigTerrain.Brushes.Length != 0)
			{
				Debug.LogWarning("LE_LevelEditorMain: IS_TERRAIN_EDITOR is set to 'false', but you have provided a non empty array for LE_ConfigTerrain.Brushes! This is performance waist and will increase loading time! Remove brushes or reenable terrain editing.");
			}
			if (lE_ConfigTerrain.BrushProjector != null)
			{
				Debug.LogWarning("LE_LevelEditorMain: IS_TERRAIN_EDITOR is set to 'false', but you have provided a value for LE_ConfigTerrain.BrushProjector! This is performance waist and will increase loading time! Remove brush projector from scene or reenable terrain editing.");
			}
		}
		Camera cam = Cam;
		if (cam == null)
		{
			Debug.LogError("LE_LevelEditorMain: Start: could not find main camera!");
		}
		if (IS_OBJECT_EDITOR)
		{
			m_GUI3dObject = gameObject.AddComponent<LE_GUI3dObject>();
			m_GUI3dObject.TERRAIN_LAYER = 14;
			LE_GUI3dObject gUI3dObject = m_GUI3dObject;
			gUI3dObject.OnFocused = (Action<Vector3, float>)Delegate.Combine(gUI3dObject.OnFocused, new Action<Vector3, float>(OnGUI3dObjectFocused));
			m_GUI3dObject.IsKeyComboFocus = (ACTIVE_KEY_COMBOS & LE_EKeyCombo.FOCUS) != 0;
			m_GUI3dObject.IsKeyComboDuplicate = (ACTIVE_KEY_COMBOS & LE_EKeyCombo.DUPLICATE) != 0;
			m_GUI3d.Add(m_GUI3dObject);
		}
		m_input = new LE_Input(this);
		m_camPivot = cam.transform.position + cam.transform.forward * 100f;
		LE_EventInterface.OnChangeLevelData = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(LE_EventInterface.OnChangeLevelData, new EventHandler(OnChangeLevelData));
		LE_GUIInterface.EventHandlers events = LE_GUIInterface.Instance.events;
		events.OnEditModeBtn = (EventHandler<LE_GUIInterface.EventHandlers.EditModeEventArgs>)Delegate.Combine(events.OnEditModeBtn, new EventHandler<LE_GUIInterface.EventHandlers.EditModeEventArgs>(OnEditModeBtn));
		MAP_EDITOR_SEED = StrandedWorld.GetRandowWorldSeed();
	}

	private void Initialize_InFirstUpdate()
	{
		Camera cam = Cam;
		LE_ConfigTerrain componentInChildren = GetComponentInChildren<LE_ConfigTerrain>();
		if (LE_GUIInterface.Instance.delegates.IsCursorOverUI == null)
		{
			Debug.LogError("LE_LevelEditorMain: you have not setup LE_GUIInterface.delegates.IsCursorOverUI. Terrain might be edited behind UI while the user interacts with the UI, same is true for object placement!");
		}
		if (IS_TERRAIN_EDITOR)
		{
			m_GUI3dTerrain = gameObject.AddComponent<LE_GUI3dTerrain>();
			m_GUI3d.Add(m_GUI3dTerrain);
			InitializeDefaultTerrain(componentInChildren);
			m_logicTerrain = new LE_LogicTerrain(componentInChildren, m_GUI3dTerrain);
			m_logic.Add(m_logicTerrain);
		}
		else if (componentInChildren.CustomDefaultTerrain != null)
		{
			Debug.LogWarning("LE_LevelEditorMain: IS_TERRAIN_EDITOR is set to 'false', but you have provided a value for LE_ConfigTerrain.CustomDefaultTerrain! The value will be ignored!");
		}
		m_logicLevel = new LE_LogicLevel(m_GUI3dTerrain, m_GUI3dObject, IS_OBLIQUE_FOCUS_CENTERING);
		m_logic.Add(m_logicLevel);
		if (IS_OBJECT_EDITOR)
		{
			if (ROOT_OBJECT_MAP == null)
			{
				InitializeObjects();
			}
			m_LogicObjects = new LE_LogicObjects(m_GUI3dObject, ROOT_OBJECT_MAP);
			m_logic.Add(m_LogicObjects);
		}
		if (cam != null && IS_WITH_CAMERA_PERSPECTIVE_GIZMO)
		{
			if (LE_GUIInterface.Instance.delegates.GetCameraPerspectiveGizmoRightPixelOffset != null)
			{
				float num = 0.2f * (float)Screen.width / cam.aspect;
				float height = 0.2f * (float)Screen.height;
				m_perspectiveGizmoRect = new Rect((float)Screen.width - LE_GUIInterface.Instance.delegates.GetCameraPerspectiveGizmoRightPixelOffset() - num, 0f, num, height);
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(LayerMask.LayerToName(CAMERA_PERSPECTIVE_GIZMO_LAYER)))
				{
					Debug.LogWarning("LE_LevelEditorMain: Inspector property 'CAMERA_PERSPECTIVE_GIZMO_LAYER' is set to '" + CAMERA_PERSPECTIVE_GIZMO_LAYER + "', but this layer has no name in 'Tags & Layers' set. Please set the name of this layer to 'CameraPerspectiveGizmo' or change the value of the 'CAMERA_PERSPECTIVE_GIZMO_LAYER' property! To open the 'Tags & Layers' manager select any game object, in the inspector click on the layer drop down at top right then click on 'Add Layer...'.");
				}
				else if (LayerMask.LayerToName(CAMERA_PERSPECTIVE_GIZMO_LAYER) != "CameraPerspectiveGizmo")
				{
					Debug.LogWarning("LE_LevelEditorMain: Inspector property 'CAMERA_PERSPECTIVE_GIZMO_LAYER' is set to '" + CAMERA_PERSPECTIVE_GIZMO_LAYER + "', but the name of this layer is '" + LayerMask.LayerToName(CAMERA_PERSPECTIVE_GIZMO_LAYER) + "'. Is this intended? If not please set the name of this layer to 'CameraPerspectiveGizmo' or change the value of the 'CAMERA_PERSPECTIVE_GIZMO_LAYER' property! To open the 'Tags & Layers' manager select any game object, in the inspector click on the layer drop down at top right then click on 'Add Layer...'.");
				}
				m_cameraPerspectiveGizmo = CPG_CameraPerspectiveGizmo.Create(cam, CAMERA_PERSPECTIVE_GIZMO_LAYER);
				if (m_cameraPerspectiveGizmo != null)
				{
					m_cameraPerspectiveGizmo.transform.position = Vector3.down * -10000f;
					m_cameraPerspectiveGizmo.OrthoOffset = cam.farClipPlane * 0.2f;
					cam.cullingMask &= ~(1 << CAMERA_PERSPECTIVE_GIZMO_LAYER);
					m_cameraPerspectiveGizmo.RelativeScreenSize = 0.2f;
					float num2 = LE_GUIInterface.Instance.delegates.GetCameraPerspectiveGizmoRightPixelOffset() / (float)Screen.width;
					m_cameraPerspectiveGizmo.RelativeScreenPos = new Vector2(1f - 0.1f / cam.aspect - num2, 0.9f);
					CPG_CameraPerspectiveGizmo cameraPerspectiveGizmo = m_cameraPerspectiveGizmo;
					cameraPerspectiveGizmo.m_onBeforeSwitchToOrthographic = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(cameraPerspectiveGizmo.m_onBeforeSwitchToOrthographic, new EventHandler(OnCameraPerspectiveSwitchToOrthographic));
					CPG_CameraPerspectiveGizmo cameraPerspectiveGizmo2 = m_cameraPerspectiveGizmo;
					cameraPerspectiveGizmo2.m_onAfterSwitchToPerspective = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(cameraPerspectiveGizmo2.m_onAfterSwitchToPerspective, new EventHandler(OnCameraPerspectiveSwitchToPerspective));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				Debug.LogError("LE_LevelEditorMain: LE_GUIInterface.delegates.GetCameraPerspectiveGizmoRightPixelOffset was not set from the UI scripts! The camera perspective gizmo cannot be placed to the right screen position! To set this delegate use 'LE_GUIInterface.Instance.delegates.GetCameraPerspectiveGizmoRightPixelOffset = ...' in one of the Start functions of your scripts!");
			}
		}
		if (IS_OBLIQUE_FOCUS_CENTERING && !SetObliqueFocusProjectionMatrix(p_isObliqueProjectionEnabled: true))
		{
			Debug.LogError("LE_LevelEditorMain: IS_OBLIQUE_FOCUS_CENTERING is true, but you have not provided the LE_GUIInterface.delegates.GetObliqueCameraPerspectiveRightPixelOffset delegate! Provide it to bring focused objects in the center of the visible (not covered by UI) screen area!");
		}
	}

	public void OnObjectEditModeKey(LE_EObjectEditMode editMode)
	{
		m_GUI3dObject.ObjectEditMode = editMode;
	}

	public void OnSelectedObjectDeleteKey()
	{
		if (m_GUI3dObject.SelectedObject != null)
		{
			if (LE_GUIInterface.Instance.delegates.ShowPopupConfirmDeleteObject != null)
			{
				m_LogicObjects.ConfirmDelete();
			}
			else
			{
				Debug.LogError("LE_LogicObject: OnSelectedObjectDeleteBtn: you have triggered the delete button behaviour, but the LE_GUIInterface.delegates.ShowPopupConfirmDeleteObject delegate is not set! Set this delegate to make the delete button work!");
			}
		}
	}

	public void OnSelectedObjectDuplicateKey()
	{
		m_GUI3dObject.CloneObject();
	}

	public void InitializeObjects()
	{
		Debug.Log("LevelEditorMain:: Initializing Editor Objects");
		List<LE_ObjectMap> list = new List<LE_ObjectMap>();
		foreach (LE_Object.Categories value in Enum.GetValues(typeof(LE_Object.Categories)))
		{
			if (value != LE_Object.Categories.NONE)
			{
				LE_ObjectMap lE_ObjectMap = new LE_ObjectMap();
				lE_ObjectMap.CategoryName = value.GetAttribute<DescriptionAttribute>().Text;
				lE_ObjectMap.ObjectPrefabs = new List<LE_Object>();
				list.Add(lE_ObjectMap);
			}
		}
		ROOT_OBJECT_MAP = new LE_ObjectMap();
		ROOT_OBJECT_MAP.ObjectPrefabs = new List<LE_Object>();
		Shader.SetGlobalColor("_HighlightRimColor", Color.black);
		Shader.SetGlobalFloat("_HighlightRimPower", 1f);
		LE_Object[] componentsInChildren = ObjectInstanceContainer.GetComponentsInChildren<LE_Object>();
		foreach (LE_Object item in componentsInChildren)
		{
			MapObjectReferences.Add(item);
		}
		ObjectInstanceContainer.gameObject.SetActive(value: false);
		foreach (LE_Object mapObjectReference in MapObjectReferences)
		{
			if (mapObjectReference.Category == LE_Object.Categories.NONE)
			{
				ROOT_OBJECT_MAP.ObjectPrefabs.Add(mapObjectReference);
			}
			else
			{
				list[(int)(mapObjectReference.Category - 1)].ObjectPrefabs.Add(mapObjectReference);
			}
		}
		foreach (LE_ObjectMap item2 in list)
		{
			item2.ObjectPrefabs = item2.ObjectPrefabs.OrderBy((LE_Object go) => go.gameObject.name).ToList();
			ROOT_OBJECT_MAP.SubObjectMaps.Add(item2);
		}
	}

	private void Validate_References()
	{
	}

	private void Initialize_InSecondUpdate()
	{
		if (IS_OBLIQUE_FOCUS_CENTERING)
		{
			Camera cam = Cam;
			if (cam != null)
			{
				SetObliqueFocusProjectionMatrix(!cam.orthographic);
			}
		}
	}

	private void InitializeDefaultTerrain(LE_ConfigTerrain p_LEConfTerrain)
	{
		if (p_LEConfTerrain.CustomDefaultTerrain != null && p_LEConfTerrain.CustomDefaultTerrain.terrainData != null)
		{
			m_GUI3dTerrain.SetTerrain(p_LEConfTerrain.CustomDefaultTerrain);
			LE_EventInterface.LevelDataChanged(p_LEConfTerrain.CustomDefaultTerrain.gameObject);
			if (LE_GUIInterface.Instance.delegates.SetTerrainUIMode != null)
			{
				LE_GUIInterface.Instance.delegates.SetTerrainUIMode(LE_GUIInterface.Delegates.ETerrainUIMode.EDIT);
			}
			else
			{
				Debug.LogWarning("LE_LevelEditorMain: you have not set the LE_GUIInterface.delegates.SetTerrainUIMode delegate. You need to set it for example if you want to disable the create UI if the default Unity terrain is set!");
			}
		}
		else if (LE_GUIInterface.Instance.delegates.SetTerrainUIMode != null)
		{
			LE_GUIInterface.Instance.delegates.SetTerrainUIMode(LE_GUIInterface.Delegates.ETerrainUIMode.CREATE);
		}
		else
		{
			Debug.LogWarning("LE_LevelEditorMain: you have not set the LE_GUIInterface.delegates.SetTerrainUIMode delegate. You need to set it for example if you want to show the create UI if there is no default Unity terrain set!");
		}
	}

	private void Update()
	{
		if (m_isFirstUpdateInitialized && !m_isSecondUpdateInitialized)
		{
			m_isSecondUpdateInitialized = true;
			Initialize_InSecondUpdate();
		}
		if (!m_isFirstUpdateInitialized)
		{
			m_isFirstUpdateInitialized = true;
			Initialize_InFirstUpdate();
		}
		bool flag = IsMouseOverGUI();
		for (int i = 0; i < m_GUI3d.Count; i++)
		{
			m_GUI3d[i].IsInteractable = !flag && m_GUI3d[i].ActiveEditMode == m_editMode;
		}
		for (int j = 0; j < m_logic.Count; j++)
		{
			m_logic[j].Update();
		}
		m_input.Update();
		UpdateCameraPivotPoint();
		if (m_cameraPerspectiveGizmo != null)
		{
			m_cameraPerspectiveGizmo.Pivot = m_camPivot;
		}
		if (m_executeWhenReady != null && IsReady)
		{
			m_executeWhenReady();
			m_executeWhenReady = null;
		}
	}

	public bool IsMouseOverGUI()
	{
		bool flag = LE_GUIInterface.Instance.delegates.IsCursorOverUI != null && LE_GUIInterface.Instance.delegates.IsCursorOverUI();
		bool flag2 = false;
		if (IS_WITH_CAMERA_PERSPECTIVE_GIZMO && !flag)
		{
			Vector3 mousePosition = Input.mousePosition;
			mousePosition.y = Mathf.Clamp((float)Screen.height - mousePosition.y, 0f, Screen.height);
			mousePosition.x = Mathf.Clamp(mousePosition.x, 0f, Screen.width);
			flag2 = m_perspectiveGizmoRect.Contains(mousePosition);
		}
		return flag | flag2;
	}

	private void OnGUI3dObjectFocused(Vector3 p_focusOn, float p_distance)
	{
		m_camPivot = p_focusOn;
		Camera cam = Cam;
		if (cam != null && cam.orthographic && m_cameraPerspectiveGizmo != null)
		{
			cam.transform.position = m_camPivot - cam.transform.forward * Mathf.Abs(m_cameraPerspectiveGizmo.OrthoOffset + p_distance);
			cam.orthographicSize = p_distance;
		}
	}

	protected override void OnDestroy()
	{
		LE_EventInterface.OnChangeLevelData = (EventHandler)Delegate.Remove(LE_EventInterface.OnChangeLevelData, new EventHandler(OnChangeLevelData));
		if (LE_GUIInterface.Instance != null)
		{
			LE_GUIInterface.EventHandlers events = LE_GUIInterface.Instance.events;
			events.OnEditModeBtn = (EventHandler<LE_GUIInterface.EventHandlers.EditModeEventArgs>)Delegate.Remove(events.OnEditModeBtn, new EventHandler<LE_GUIInterface.EventHandlers.EditModeEventArgs>(OnEditModeBtn));
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < m_GUI3d.Count; i++)
		{
			if (m_GUI3d[i] is LE_GUI3dObject)
			{
				((LE_GUI3dObject)m_GUI3d[i]).OnFocused = null;
			}
		}
		m_executeWhenReady = null;
		if (m_input != null)
		{
			m_input.Destroy();
		}
		for (int j = 0; j < m_logic.Count; j++)
		{
			m_logic[j].Destroy();
		}
		base.OnDestroy();
	}

	private void OnChangeLevelData(object p_sender, EventArgs p_args)
	{
		m_lastChangeFrame = Time.frameCount;
	}

	private void OnEditModeBtn(object p_sender, LE_GUIInterface.EventHandlers.EditModeEventArgs p_args)
	{
		m_editMode = p_args.EditMode;
		if (m_editMode != LE_EEditMode.TERRAIN && m_GUI3dTerrain != null)
		{
			m_GUI3dTerrain.HideCursor();
		}
		if (m_editMode != LE_EEditMode.OBJECT && m_GUI3dObject != null)
		{
			m_GUI3dObject.RemoveSelection();
		}
		if (m_editMode != LE_EEditMode.NONE)
		{
			_screenShotCamera.SetActive(value: false);
		}
		else
		{
			_screenShotCamera.SetActive(value: true);
		}
	}

	private void OnCameraPerspectiveSwitchToOrthographic(object p_sender, EventArgs p_args)
	{
		if (IS_OBLIQUE_FOCUS_CENTERING)
		{
			SetObliqueFocusProjectionMatrix(p_isObliqueProjectionEnabled: false);
		}
		if (m_cameraPerspectiveGizmo != null)
		{
			float value = EstimateDistanceToLevel(EEstimateDistanceMode.NEAREST);
			Camera cam = Cam;
			if (cam != null)
			{
				cam.orthographicSize = Mathf.Clamp(value, 5f, 60f);
			}
		}
	}

	private void OnCameraPerspectiveSwitchToPerspective(object p_sender, EventArgs p_args)
	{
		if (IS_OBLIQUE_FOCUS_CENTERING)
		{
			SetObliqueFocusProjectionMatrix(p_isObliqueProjectionEnabled: true);
		}
	}

	private void UpdateCameraPivotPoint()
	{
		Camera cam = Cam;
		if (cam != null)
		{
			Vector3 rhs = m_camPivot - cam.transform.position;
			float num = Vector3.Dot(cam.transform.forward, rhs);
			if (num < 1f)
			{
				float num2 = num - 1.5f;
				m_camPivot = cam.transform.position - cam.transform.forward * num2;
				rhs = m_camPivot - cam.transform.position;
				num = Vector3.Dot(cam.transform.forward, rhs);
			}
			if (Vector3.Cross(cam.transform.forward, rhs).magnitude > 1f)
			{
				m_camPivot = cam.transform.position + cam.transform.forward * num;
			}
		}
	}

	private float EstimateDistanceToLevel(EEstimateDistanceMode p_mode)
	{
		float result = 300f;
		Camera cam = Cam;
		if (cam != null)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			Vector3 vector = Vector3.zero;
			float num2 = float.MaxValue;
			for (float num3 = 0f; num3 < 2f; num3++)
			{
				for (float num4 = 0f; num4 < 2f; num4++)
				{
					if (!Physics.Raycast(cam.ScreenPointToRay(new Vector3(cam.rect.width * (float)Screen.width * (0.25f + 0.5f * num3), cam.rect.height * (float)Screen.height * (0.25f + 0.5f * num4), 0f)), out var hitInfo))
					{
						continue;
					}
					num++;
					if (p_mode == EEstimateDistanceMode.AVERAGE)
					{
						vector += hitInfo.point;
						continue;
					}
					float magnitude = (hitInfo.point - cam.transform.position).magnitude;
					if (num2 > magnitude)
					{
						num2 = magnitude;
						vector = hitInfo.point;
					}
				}
			}
			if (num > 0f)
			{
				if (p_mode == EEstimateDistanceMode.AVERAGE)
				{
					vector /= num;
				}
				result = (vector - cam.transform.position).magnitude;
			}
		}
		return result;
	}

	public void ClearLevel()
	{
		foreach (Transform item in ObjectDumpContainer)
		{
			UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(item.gameObject);
		}
	}
}

public class LE_ZoneTileGenerator : Singleton<LE_ZoneTileGenerator>

	public void GenerateHeightmapFromTexture(Texture2D heightmap)
	{

	{

			Texture2D height = WorldTools.CreateHeightMapTexture(terrain.terrainData);
			Texture2D shore = WorldTools.CreateShoreMaskTexture(terrain.terrainData);

	}

	}

	private Texture2D CreateHeightMapTexture(TerrainData terrain)
	{
		int heightmapResolution = terrain.heightmapResolution;
		int heightmapResolution2 = terrain.heightmapResolution;
		Texture2D texture2D = new Texture2D(heightmapResolution, heightmapResolution2, TextureFormat.RGB24, mipChain: false, linear: false);
		for (int i = 0; i < heightmapResolution; i++)
		{
			for (int j = 0; j < heightmapResolution2; j++)
			{
				float num = terrain.GetHeight(i, j) + -100f;
				Color color = Color.Lerp(Color.black, Color.white, Mathf.Clamp01((num + 10f) / 10f));
				Color color2 = ((num > 0f) ? Color.white : color);
				texture2D.SetPixel(i, j, color2);
			}
		}
		texture2D.Apply();
		return texture2D;
	}

	private Texture2D CreateShoreMaskTexture(TerrainData terrain)
	{
		int heightmapResolution = terrain.heightmapResolution;
		int heightmapResolution2 = terrain.heightmapResolution;
		Texture2D texture2D = new Texture2D(heightmapResolution, heightmapResolution2, TextureFormat.RGB24, mipChain: false, linear: false);
		int num = -100;
		for (int i = 0; i < heightmapResolution; i++)
		{
			for (int j = 0; j < heightmapResolution2; j++)
			{
				Color color = ((terrain.GetHeight(i, j) + (float)num >= 0f) ? Color.white : Color.black);
				texture2D.SetPixel(i, j, color);
			}
		}
		texture2D.Apply();
		return texture2D;
	}

	private void AddWaveOverlay(GameObject zone, Texture2D height, Texture2D shore)
	{
		if ((bool)_waveOverlay)
		{
			Object.Destroy(_waveOverlay.heightTexture.tex);
			Object.Destroy(_waveOverlay.heightTexture.mask);
			Object.Destroy(_waveOverlay.normalTexture.tex);
			Object.Destroy(_waveOverlay.normalTexture.mask);
			Object.Destroy(_waveOverlay.foamTexture.tex);
			Object.Destroy(_waveOverlay.foamTexture.mask);
			Object.Destroy(_waveOverlay.gameObject);
		}
		GameObject gameObject = new GameObject("WaveOverlay");
		gameObject.transform.parent = zone.transform;
		gameObject.transform.position = new Vector3(0f, 0f, 0f);
		_waveOverlay = gameObject.AddComponent<AddWaveOverlay>();
		_waveOverlay.width = 250f;
		_waveOverlay.height = 250f;
		_waveOverlay.heightTexture = new OverlayHeightTexture();
		_waveOverlay.heightTexture.tex = shore;
		_waveOverlay.heightTexture.mask = height;
		_waveOverlay.heightTexture.alpha = 0f;
		_waveOverlay.heightTexture.maskMode = OVERLAY_MASK_MODE.WAVES;
		_waveOverlay.normalTexture = new OverlayNormalTexture();
		_waveOverlay.normalTexture.tex = shore;
		_waveOverlay.normalTexture.mask = height;
		_waveOverlay.normalTexture.alpha = 0f;
		_waveOverlay.normalTexture.maskAlpha = 0.4f;
		_waveOverlay.normalTexture.maskMode = OVERLAY_MASK_MODE.WAVES;
		_waveOverlay.foamTexture = new OverlayFoamTexture();
		_waveOverlay.foamTexture.tex = shore;
		_waveOverlay.foamTexture.mask = height;
		_waveOverlay.foamTexture.alpha = 0.4f;
		_waveOverlay.foamTexture.maskMode = OVERLAY_MASK_MODE.WAVES;
	}

	public void LoadMap(Map map)
	{
		Singleton<LE_LevelEditorMain>.Instance.ClearLevel();
		terrain.terrainData.SetHeights(0, 0, map.HeightmapData);
	}
}

	private void OnConnect(PlayerConnectedEvent @event)
	{
		if (!Game.State.IsMenu() && Game.Mode.IsServer() && @event.PlayerId == 1 && !_loadingSequence.IsRunning)

	private void OnDisconnect(PlayerDisconnectedEvent @event)

			Debug.LogError($"OnDisconnect {@event.PlayerId} {Game.State} Loading: {_loadingSequence.IsRunning} Join {_serverJoinInProgress.IsRunning}");
			if (Game.Mode.IsServer() && IsInNormalGameplay())
			{
				UpdateServerClientCopy(PlayerUtilities.GetPlayerFromId(1));
			}
			Timing.RunCoroutine(OnDisconnect_Sequence(@event));
		}
	}

	private bool IsInNormalGameplay()

		if (!_serverJoinInProgress.IsRunning)

			return !_loadingSequence.IsRunning;
		}
		return false;

	private IEnumerator<float> OnDisconnect_Sequence(PlayerDisconnectedEvent @event)
	{
		yield return 0f;
		if (Game.Mode.IsServer() && @event.PlayerId == 1)
		{
			if (_serverJoinInProgress.IsRunning)
			{
				_serverJoinInProgress.IsRunning = false;
				StopSync();
			}
			else if (_loadingSequence.IsRunning)
			{
				StopSync();
			}
		}
		bool hostDisconnected = @event.PlayerId == 0;
		if (hostDisconnected)
		{
			Timing.KillCoroutines();
		}
		Rewired.Player player = ReInput.players.GetPlayer(0);
		if (player.IsValid() && @event.TryGetDisconnectDialog(out var title, out var content))
		{
			player.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: false, 0);
			player.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: true, 16);
			player.SetCursorEnabled(enabled: true);
			DialogueBox.Show(player, title, content, DialogueButton.Ok, DialogueIcon.Warning).Accept += () =>
			{
				if (hostDisconnected)
				{
					StartCoroutine(QuitToMenu_Sequence());
				}
			};
		}
		else if (hostDisconnected)
		{
			StartCoroutine(QuitToMenu_Sequence());
		}
	}

	private void StopSync()
	{
		_syncSaveCoroutine.IsRunning = false;
		_syncSaveCoroutineSend.IsRunning = false;
		_syncSaveCoroutineRecv.IsRunning = false;
		_syncWorldCoroutine.IsRunning = false;
		_syncWorldCoroutineSend.IsRunning = false;

	private IEnumerator<float> ServerJoinInProgress()
	{
		yield return BeamTiming.WaitForPeer(1, 10f);
		if (PlayerUtilities.GetPeerFromId(1).IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			yield break;
		}
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new ServerJoinInProgressStarted());
		EventManager.EventDelegate<PlayerDisconnectedEvent> onDisconnect = null;
		onDisconnect = (PlayerDisconnectedEvent @event) =>
		{
			if (@event.PlayerId == 1)
			{
				EventManager.RemoveListener(onDisconnect);
				Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.Paused = false;
				Physics.autoSimulation = true;
				--PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.Movement.IsBusy;
				PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.Input.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: true, PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.Input.GetCurrentMapId());
				PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.PlayerUI.Refresh(RefreshUIMode.Clear);
				MainMenuPresenter.Instance.LoadingScreenPresenter.Hide();
				Singleton<Fader>.Instance.FadeIn(0.1f);
				AudioListener.volume = 1f;
				PlayerRegistry.LocalPeer.SetTimeout(Peer.GetDefaultTimeout());
				MultiplayerWorldSync.Instance?.Reset();
				EventManager.RaiseEvent(new ServerJoinInProgressEnded(PlayerRegistry.IsClientPeerValid));
			}
		};
		while (IsLoading())
		{
			yield return 0f;
		}
		EventManager.AddListener(onDisconnect);
		Singleton<GameTime>.Instance.Paused = true;
		Physics.autoSimulation = false;
		Singleton<Fader>.Instance.FadeOut(0.1f);
		AudioListener.volume = 0f;
		MainMenuPresenter.Instance.LoadingScreenPresenter.Show();
		++PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.Movement.IsBusy;
		yield return PlayerRegistry.LocalPeer.SetTimeout_Async(Peer.GetSessionTimeout());
		JObject save = new JObject();
		JObject persistent = new JObject();
		bool succeeded = true;
		yield return Timing.WaitUntilDone(Timing.Instance.RunCoroutine(SaveManager.GenerateSave_Sequence(save, persistent), (Exception ex) =>
		{
			if (ex != null)
			{
				succeeded = false;
				Debug.LogException(ex);
			}
		}));
		if (succeeded)
		{
			yield return Timing.WaitUntilDone(SyncSave_Async((JObject saveData) =>
			{
				persistent = SaveManager.GetPersistentData(saveData);
			}, save));
			yield return Timing.WaitUntilDone(SyncWorld_Async(serverLoadWorld: false));
			yield return BeamTiming.WaitForAllPlayers();
			PlayerRegistry.InitializeReplicants();
			yield return Timing.WaitUntilDone(Timing.RunCoroutine(ServerJoinInProgress_LoadPlayerReplicant(persistent)));
			yield return Timing.WaitUntilDone(MultiplayerFence.Sync(Fence.FinishLoading));
			onDisconnect(new PlayerDisconnectedEvent(1, null));
		}
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> ServerJoinInProgress_LoadPlayerReplicant(JObject persistent)
	{
		IPlayer playerFromId = PlayerUtilities.GetPlayerFromId(1);
		if (playerFromId.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			yield break;
		}
		StorageLoader storageLoader = new StorageLoader
		{
			IsLoading = true
		};
		CurrentLoader = storageLoader;
		if (persistent.IsValid())
		{
			JObject jObject = persistent.Get("PlayerRegistry");
			if (jObject.IsValid() && jObject.Children.IsValid() && jObject.Children.Count > 1)
			{
				JObject jObject2 = jObject.Children[1];
				if (jObject2.IsValid() && !jObject2.IsNull())
				{
					SavingUtilities.Load(playerFromId, jObject2);
				}
			}
		}
		Zone zone = StrandedWorld.GetZone(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.transform.position);
		int numLoadedZones = (zone ? 1 : 0);
		if (!persistent.Get("StrandedWorld/Zones").GetZoneData(Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.NmlZone.Id).GetField("Objects")
			.IsNull())
		{
			numLoadedZones++;
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < numLoadedZones; i++)
		{
			yield return Timing.WaitUntilDone(MultiplayerFence.Sync(Fence.ProcessLoading));
		}
		for (int j = 0; j < storageLoader.DeferredLoading.Count; j++)
		{
			LoadingActionUtilities.ExecuteDeferredAction(storageLoader.DeferredLoading[j]);
		}
		for (int k = 0; k < storageLoader.PostLoading.Count; k++)
		{
			LoadingActionUtilities.ExecuteDeferredAction(storageLoader.PostLoading[k]);
		}
		for (int l = 0; l < storageLoader.PhysicalLoading.Count; l++)
		{
			LoadingActionUtilities.ExecuteDeferredAction(storageLoader.PhysicalLoading[l]);
		}
		storageLoader.IsLoading = false;
		CurrentLoader = null;
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> ClientActivateEntities()
	{
		yield return BeamTiming.WaitForPeer(0);
		MultiplayerMng.ReceivedEntitiesActive = true;
		yield return Timing.WaitForSeconds(1f);
	}

	private CoroutineHandle SyncWorld_Async(bool serverLoadWorld = true)
	{
		return _syncWorldCoroutine = Timing.RunCoroutine(SyncWorld_Sequence(serverLoadWorld));
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> SyncWorld_Sequence(bool serverLoadWorld = true)
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsServer() & serverLoadWorld)
		{
			LoadingResult loadingResult = World.LoadWorld();
			if (loadingResult.Succeeded)
			{
				Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.ApplyWorldToZones();
			}
			else
			{
				Debug.LogError("StrandedWorld:: Error loading world: " + loadingResult.Message);
			}
			PlayerRegistry.ServerPeer.WorldSeed = StrandedWorld.LOCAL_WORLD_SEED;
		}
		if (Game.Mode.IsServer() && PlayerRegistry.IsClientPeerValid)
		{
			yield return MultiplayerWorldSync.Instance.SendWorld_Async(World.CurrentWorld, (CoroutineHandle coroutine) =>
			{
				_syncWorldCoroutineSend = coroutine;
			}, (float ratio) =>
			{
				EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent(string.Format("{0} [{1}%]", "LOADING_PROGRESS_SYNC_WORLD", (int)((double)ratio * 100.0))));
			}, () =>
			{
			}, ShutdownToMainMenu);
		}
		if (Game.Mode.IsClient())
		{
			yield return MultiplayerWorldSync.Instance.ReceiveWorld_Async((CoroutineHandle coroutine) =>
			{
				_syncWorldCoroutineRecv = coroutine;
			}, (float ratio) =>
			{
				EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent(string.Format("{0} [{1}%]", "LOADING_PROGRESS_SYNC_WORLD", (int)((double)ratio * 100.0))));
			}, (World.Bundle world) =>
			{
				World.PushWorld(world);
				Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.ApplyWorldToZones();
			}, ShutdownToMainMenu);
		}
	}

	private CoroutineHandle SyncSave_Async(Action<JObject> onSaveFile, JObject saveFile = null)
	{
		return _syncSaveCoroutine = Timing.RunCoroutine(SyncSave_Sequence(onSaveFile, saveFile));
	}

	private IEnumerator<float> SyncSave_Sequence(Action<JObject> onSaveFile, JObject saveFile)
	{
		if (Game.Mode.IsServer())
		{
			saveFile = saveFile ?? (SaveManager.ValidateSaveFile(Game.Mode) ? SaveManager.LoadSaveFile(Game.Mode) : null);
			if (PlayerRegistry.IsClientPeerValid)
			{
				yield return MultiplayerWorldSync.Instance.SendSave_Async(saveFile, (CoroutineHandle coroutine) =>
				{
					_syncSaveCoroutineSend = coroutine;

	}

	private IEnumerator<float> CreateGame_Sequence()
	{

	}

	private IEnumerator<float> LoadGame_Sequence(JObject rootData)
	{
		JObject persistentData = SaveManager.GetPersistentData(rootData);
		Vector3 originalP1position = Vector3.zero;
		if (persistentData != null && !persistentData.IsNull())
		{
			JObject field = persistentData.GetField("GameTime");
			SavingUtilities.Load(Singleton<GameTime>.Instance, field);
			JObject field2 = persistentData.GetField("GameCalendar");
			SavingUtilities.Load(Singleton<GameCalendar>.Instance, field2);
			Physics.autoSimulation = false;
			float fixedDeltaTime = Time.fixedDeltaTime;
			if (!Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
			{
				Time.fixedDeltaTime = 10f;
			}
			LegacyUtilities.LoadPlayer(persistentData);
			IPlayer player = PlayerRegistry.AllPlayers[0];
			player.Character.RefreshPosition();
			player.Character.RefreshRotation();
			player.Character.SetCameraMode(player.PlayerCamera.CameraMode);
			player.PlayerCamera.CameraMovement.SetPosition(player.Character.CameraRigTransform);
			player.PlayerCamera.CameraMovement.SetRotation(player.Character.CameraRigTransform);
			player.PlayerCamera.UpdateCameraPosition(force: true);
			originalP1position = player.transform.position;
			JObject field3 = persistentData.GetField("StrandedWorld");
			yield return Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.LoadWorld_Async(rootData, field3);
			(from behaviour in UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsOfType<MonoBehaviour>()
				where behaviour is IPersistentSaveable && !(behaviour is GameTime) && !(behaviour is GameCalendar) && !(behaviour is StrandedWorld)
				select behaviour).Cast<IPersistentSaveable>().ToList().ForEach((IPersistentSaveable saveableObject) =>
			{
				string text = saveableObject.GetType().Name;
				JObject field4 = persistentData.GetField(text);
				if (field4 != null)
				{
					SavingUtilities.Load(saveableObject, field4);
				}
				else
				{
					Debug.LogWarning("LevelLoader:: No data was saved for persistent object [" + text + "].");
				}
			});
			for (int num = 0; num < DeferredLoading.Count; num++)
			{
				LoadingActionUtilities.ExecuteDeferredAction(DeferredLoading[num]);
			}
			for (int num2 = 0; num2 < PostLoading.Count; num2++)
			{
				LoadingActionUtilities.ExecuteDeferredAction(PostLoading[num2]);
			}
			if (!Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
			{
				Time.fixedDeltaTime = fixedDeltaTime;
			}
			Physics.autoSimulation = true;
		}
		else
		{
			Debug.LogError("LevelLoader:: [Persistent] node is null or empty.");
		}
		if (!Game.State.IsGame() || !Game.Mode.IsClient() || !(originalP1position != Vector3.zero))
		{
			yield break;
		}
		IPlayer playerFromId = PlayerUtilities.GetPlayerFromId(1);
		LayerMask physicsLayerMask = GetPhysicsLayerMask(Layers.PLAYER);
		physicsLayerMask = (int)physicsLayerMask ^ (1 << Layers.PLAYER);
		if (!Physics.CheckSphere(playerFromId.transform.position, 0.7f, physicsLayerMask))
		{
			yield break;
		}
		Vector3 vector = Vector3.zero;
		bool flag = false;
		float num3 = 0f;
		int num4 = 180;
		for (int num5 = 0; num5 < num4; num5++)
		{
			float x = Mathf.Sin(num3);
			float z = Mathf.Cos(num3);
			num3 += MathF.PI * 2f / (float)num4;
			vector = new Vector3(x, 0f, z);
			float radius = 0.25f;
			if (!Physics.CheckSphere(originalP1position + vector, radius, physicsLayerMask) && !Physics.Raycast(originalP1position + vector, originalP1position - (originalP1position + vector), vector.magnitude, physicsLayerMask))
			{
				flag = true;
				break;
			}
		}
		if (flag)
		{
			playerFromId.transform.position = originalP1position + vector;
		}
	}

	private LayerMask GetPhysicsLayerMask(int currentLayer)
	{
		int num = 0;
		for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++)
		{
			if (!Physics.GetIgnoreLayerCollision(currentLayer, i))
			{
				num |= 1 << i;
			}
		}
		return num;
	}
}

		base.OnCustomMapLoaded();
		_customMap = true;
		Initialize();

		if (_shipwreckMarker != null)
		{
			_shipwreckMarker.transform.position = new Vector3(transform.position.x, 0.2f, transform.position.z);

	private void SpawnContainers()
	{
		if (_containersGenerated)
		{
			return;
		}
		WollieSpawner component = gameObject.GetComponent<WollieSpawner>();
		if (component != null)
		{

						containers = new Container[1]
						{
							new Container

								prefab = Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.ProceduralObjectsManager.WolliePrefab,
								rarity = 100f
							}
						}

	private void Setup(SaveablePrefab saveablePrefab)
	{

		{

			if (interactive_STORAGE != null)

				interactive_STORAGE.PickedUp += Storage_PickedUp;
				interactive_STORAGE.BeginDragged += Storage_BeginDragged;

	private void Storage_Opened(Interactive_STORAGE sender)
	{
		CheckScavenged(sender.ReferenceId);
	}

	private void Storage_PickedUp(IPickupable sender)
	{
		CheckScavenged(sender.ReferenceId);
	}

	private void Storage_BeginDragged(IDraggable sender)
	{
		ISaveablePrefab saveablePrefab = sender as ISaveablePrefab;
		if (!saveablePrefab.IsNullOrDestroyed())
		{
			CheckScavenged(saveablePrefab.ReferenceId);
		}
	}

	private void CheckScavenged(MiniGuid refId)
	{
		if (!_containersGenerated || _scavenged)
		{
			return;
		}
		int num = _containerIds.FindIndex((MiniGuid id) => id.Equals(refId));
		if (num == -1)
		{
			return;
		}
		_containerIds.RemoveAt(num);
		if (_containerIds.Count == 0)
		{
			if (IsOnShipwreck)
			{
				EventManager.RaiseEvent(new AddStatsEvent(0, new Stats
				{
					ShipsScavenged = 1
				}));
			}
			else
			{
				EventManager.RaiseEvent(new ScavengedShelterEvent());
			}
			_scavenged = true;
		}
	}

	{

		jObject.AddField("Scavenged", JSerializer.Serialize(_scavenged));
		JObject jObject2 = new JObject();
		for (int i = 0; i < _containerIds.Count; i++)
		{
			jObject2.Add(JSerializer.Serialize(_containerIds[i].ToString()));
		}
		jObject.AddField("ContainerIDs", jObject2);
		return jObject;
	}

	public override void Load(JObject data)
	{
		base.Load(data);
		if (data != null && !data.IsNull())
		{
			JSerializer.DeserializeInto(data.GetField("Transform"), transform);
			CompleteTransformSerialization();
			bool value = data.GetField("containersGenerated").GetValue<bool>();
			_containersGenerated = value;
			JObject field = data.GetField("Scavenged");
			if (field != null)
			{
				_scavenged = field.GetValue<bool>();
			}
			JObject field2 = data.GetField("ContainerIDs");
			if (field2 != null && field2.Children != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < field2.Children.Count; i++)
				{

						if (interactive_STORAGE != null)
						{
							interactive_STORAGE.PickedUp += Storage_PickedUp;
							interactive_STORAGE.BeginDragged += Storage_BeginDragged;
							interactive_STORAGE.Opened += Storage_Opened;
							_containerIds.Add(miniGuid);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		Initialize();
	}

using System;

public static class MapNameGenerator
{
	private static readonly string[] Prefixes = new string[8] { "MAP_NAME_PREFIX_1", "MAP_NAME_PREFIX_2", "MAP_NAME_PREFIX_3", "MAP_NAME_PREFIX_4", "MAP_NAME_PREFIX_5", "MAP_NAME_PREFIX_6", "MAP_NAME_PREFIX_7", "MAP_NAME_PREFIX_8" };

	private static readonly string[] Stems = new string[10] { "MAP_NAME_STEM_1", "MAP_NAME_STEM_2", "MAP_NAME_STEM_3", "MAP_NAME_STEM_4", "MAP_NAME_STEM_5", "MAP_NAME_STEM_6", "MAP_NAME_STEM_7", "MAP_NAME_STEM_8", "MAP_NAME_STEM_9", "MAP_NAME_STEM_10" };

	private static readonly string[] Suffixes = new string[6] { "MAP_NAME_SUFFIX_1", "MAP_NAME_SUFFIX_2", "MAP_NAME_SUFFIX_3", "MAP_NAME_SUFFIX_4", "MAP_NAME_SUFFIX_5", "MAP_NAME_SUFFIX_6" };

	public static string GenerateRandomMapName(int seedEffect)
	{
		Random random = new Random(StrandedWorld.WORLD_SEED + seedEffect);
		return string.Join(" ", Prefixes[random.Next(0, Prefixes.Length)], Stems[random.Next(0, Stems.Length)], Suffixes[random.Next(0, Suffixes.Length)]);
	}
}

	{
		if (!LevelLoader.IsLoading())
		{
			Initialize();
		}
	}

	private void Initialize()
	{
		if (_objectSpawn.Count > 0)
		{
			SpawnObjects();
		}
	}

	public override void OnCustomMapLoaded()
	{
		base.OnCustomMapLoaded();
		_customMap = true;
		Initialize();
	}

	private void SetupSpawnedObject(SaveablePrefab saveable)
	{
		if (!saveable.IsValid())
		{
			return;
		}
		InteractiveObject component = saveable.GetComponent<InteractiveObject>();
		if ((bool)component)
		{
			component.transform.parent = transform.parent;
			component.TransformParent = transform.parent;
			if (_customMap)
			{
				component.OnCustomMapLoaded();
			}
		}
	}

	private void SpawnObject(GameObject objToSpawn, Vector3 pos, Quaternion rot)
	{
		if (objToSpawn.TryGetComponent<ISaveablePrefab>(out var component))
		{
			uint prefabId = component.PrefabId;
			MiniGuid referenceId = MiniGuid.NewFrom(pos, prefabId, 48879);
			if (Game.Mode.IsMaster() || !component.IsMultiplayerEntity)
			{
				SaveablePrefab saveable = MultiplayerMng.Instantiate<SaveablePrefab>(prefabId, pos, rot, referenceId);
				SetupSpawnedObject(saveable);
			}
			else
			{
				MultiplayerZoneSync.Instance.LinkData(MultiplayerZoneSync.Usage.Module, referenceId, (MultiplayerZoneSync.Command cmd) =>
				{
					SetupSpawnedObject(cmd.Instance);
				});
			}
		}
		else
		{
			UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(objToSpawn, pos, rot);
		}
	}

	private void SpawnObjects()
	{
		System.Random random = Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.GenerateLocalSeed(transform.position);
		foreach (Spawn item in _objectSpawn)
		{
			if ((float)(random.Next(1000) / 10) <= item.SpawnChance)
			{
				SpawnObject(item.Obj, item.Position.position, item.Position.rotation);
			}
		}
	}

	public void SetUpSupport(bool seaLadderAccess = false)
	{
		if (!(FortLadder == null))
		{
			_seaLadderAccess = seaLadderAccess;
			FortLadder.SetActive(seaLadderAccess);
		}
	}

	public override JObject Save()
	{
		JObject jObject = base.Save();
		JObject data = JSerializer.Serialize(transform);
		jObject.AddField("Transform", data);
		jObject.AddField("hasLadder", JSerializer.Serialize(_seaLadderAccess));
		return jObject;
	}

	public override void Load(JObject data)
	{
		base.Load(data);
		if (data != null && !data.IsNull())
		{
			JSerializer.DeserializeInto(data.GetField("Transform"), transform);
			CompleteTransformSerialization();
			bool value = data.GetField("hasLadder").GetValue<bool>();
			_seaLadderAccess = value;
		}
		SetUpSupport(_seaLadderAccess);
	}
}

	private void CreateGridObjects(SpawnGrid grid)
	{
		Zone[] zones = Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.Zones;
		foreach (Zone zone in zones)
		{
			if ((grid.Grid.position - zone.transform.position).magnitude < 150f || grid.Grid.position.x > 2500f || grid.Grid.position.x < -2500f || grid.Grid.position.z > 2500f || grid.Grid.position.z < -2500f)
			{
				return;
			}
		}
		for (int j = 0; j < _playerGridGroup.Length; j++)
		{
			PlayerGridGroup playerGridGroup = _playerGridGroup[j];
			if (playerGridGroup.Player == null)
			{
				continue;
			}
			for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
			{
				for (int l = 0; l < 3; l++)
				{
					if ((grid.Grid.position - playerGridGroup.SpawnGrids[k, l].Grid.transform.position).magnitude < 10f && playerGridGroup.SpawnGrids[k, l].Generated)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		grid.CanGenerate = false;
		grid.Generated = true;
		GameObject gameObject = ChooseCreature();
		if (!(gameObject == null))
		{
			GameObject gameObject2 = UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(gameObject, grid.Grid.position, Quaternion.identity);
			grid.piscusManager = gameObject2.GetComponent<PiscusManager>();
			grid.piscusManager.SpawnDistance = 150f;
			gameObject2.transform.parent = grid.Grid.transform;
			grid.piscusManager.transform.position = grid.Grid.position;
		}
	}

	private GameObject ChooseCreature()
	{
		float num = 0f;
		CreatureToSpawn[] creatures = Creatures;
		foreach (CreatureToSpawn creatureToSpawn in creatures)
		{
			num += creatureToSpawn.Rarity;
		}
		float num2 = UnityEngine.Random.value * num;
		for (int j = 0; j < Creatures.Length; j++)
		{
			if (num2 < Creatures[j].Rarity)
			{
				return Creatures[j].CreatureObj;
			}
			num2 -= Creatures[j].Rarity;
		}
		return null;
	}

	public JObject Save()

		}
		return jObject;
	}

	public void Load(JObject data)
	{
		int playersCount = Game.Mode.GetPlayersCount();
		_loadedCenterGridPos = new Vector3[playersCount];
		if (data != null && !data.IsNull())
		{
			JObject field = data.GetField("CenterGridPos");
			if (field != null)
			{
				Vector3 vector = JSerializer.Deserialize<Vector3>(field);
				for (int i = 0; i < playersCount; i++)
				{
					_loadedCenterGridPos[i] = vector;
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < playersCount; j++)
			{
				JObject field2 = data.GetField("CenterGridPos_" + j);
				if (field2 != null)
				{
					_loadedCenterGridPos[j] = JSerializer.Deserialize<Vector3>(field2);
				}
			}
		}
		if ((bool)Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance)
		{
			Singleton<StrandedWorld>.Instance.WorldGenerated += CreateGrid;
		}
		CreateGrid();
	}

	public static Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject GetPersistentData(Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject root)
	{
		if (root == null || root.IsNull())
		{
			Debug.LogError("SaveManager::LoadSaveFile:: Root was null or empty.");
			return null;
		}
		Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject field = root.GetField("Persistent");
		if (field != null && !field.IsNull())
		{
			return field;
		}
		Debug.LogError("SaveManager::LoadSaveFile:: [Persistent] node is null, empty or missing.");
		return null;

	public static string GetSaveFolderPath()
	{
		return PathTools.Combine(FilePath.SAVE_FOLDER, FilePath.GetSlotFolderName(Options.GeneralSettings.LastSaveSlotUsed));
	}

	public static string GetSaveFilePath(GameMode mode)
	{
		return PathTools.Combine(GetSaveFolderPath(), "data" + FilePath.GetSaveFileExtension(mode));
	}

	public static bool TryGetSaveFilePath(GameMode mode, out string saveFilePath)
	{
		saveFilePath = string.Empty;
		if (!GAccountService.Get().Initialized)
		{
			Debug.LogError("SaveManager::CheckSaveFileExists:: DRM not initialized.");
			return false;
		}
		string saveFolderPath = GetSaveFolderPath();
		if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(saveFolderPath) || !Directory.Exists(saveFolderPath))
		{
			return false;
		}
		string saveFilePath2 = GetSaveFilePath(mode);
		if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(saveFilePath2))
		{
			return false;
		}
		saveFilePath = saveFilePath2;
		return File.Exists(saveFilePath);
	}

	public static bool CheckSaveFileVersion(GameMode mode)
	{
		try
		{
			Version saveFileVersion = GetSaveFileVersion(mode);
			if (saveFileVersion == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!ValidateVersionNumber(saveFileVersion))
			{
				Debug.LogError($"SaveManager::CheckSaveFileVersion:: {mode} save file is an older version.");
				return false;
			}
			Debug.Log($"SaveManager::CheckSaveFileVersion:: Valid {mode} save file version [" + saveFileVersion?.ToString() + "]");
			return true;
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			Debug.LogError("SaveManager::CheckSaveFileVersion:: There was an error parsing save file version:\n" + ex.Message);
			return false;
		}
	}

	public static VersionStatus CompareSaveFileVersion(GameMode mode, Version otherVersion)
	{
		if (otherVersion == null)
		{
			return VersionStatus.Newer;
		}
		Version saveFileVersion = GetSaveFileVersion(mode);
		if (saveFileVersion == null)
		{
			return VersionStatus.Older;
		}
		return (VersionStatus)saveFileVersion.CompareTo(otherVersion);
	}

	public static Version GetSaveFileVersion(GameMode mode)
	{
		if (!GAccountService.Get().Initialized)
		{
			Debug.LogError("SaveManager::GetSaveFileVersion:: Steam not initialized.");
			return null;
		}
		if (!TryGetSaveFilePath(mode, out var saveFilePath))
		{
			Debug.Log($"SaveManager::GetSaveFileVersion:: {mode} save file does not exist.");
			return null;
		}
		try
		{
			using FileStream stream = new FileStream(saveFilePath, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read);
			using StreamReader streamReader = new StreamReader(stream);
			streamReader.Read();
			bool flag = streamReader.Peek() == 13;
			if (flag)
			{
				streamReader.Read();
			}
			bool flag2 = streamReader.Peek() == 10;
			if (flag2)
			{
				streamReader.Read();
			}
			string version;
			if (flag | flag2)
			{
				version = streamReader.ReadLine().Trim().Substring(12, 7);
			}
			else
			{
				char[] array = new char[20];
				streamReader.Read(array, 0, array.Length);
				version = new string(array).Substring(11, 7);
			}
			return new Version(version);
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			Debug.LogError("SaveManager::GetSaveFileVersion:: Error loading version data from save file:\n\n" + ex.Message);
			return null;
		}
	}

	public static bool ValidateVersionNumber(Version version)
	{
		VersionStatus versionStatus = (VersionStatus)version.CompareTo(BuildInformation.MinimumVersion);
		if (versionStatus != VersionStatus.Equal)
		{
			return versionStatus == VersionStatus.Newer;
		}
		return true;
	}

	public static bool ValidateSaveFile(GameMode mode)
	{
		if (CheckSaveFileVersion(mode))
		{
			return ValidateSaveFileFast(mode);
		}
		return false;
	}

	private static bool ValidateSaveFileFast(GameMode mode)
	{
		if (!TryGetSaveFilePath(mode, out var saveFilePath))
		{
			Debug.LogError("SaveManager:: Error loading save file. File does not exist.");
			return false;
		}
		try
		{
			using FileStream stream = new FileStream(saveFilePath, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read);
			using StreamReader reader = new StreamReader(stream);
			using JsonTextReader reader2 = new JsonTextReader(reader);
			JToken jToken = JToken.ReadFrom(reader2);
			if (jToken == null || !jToken.HasValues)
			{
				Debug.LogError("SaveManager:: Error loading save file. Data was null or empty.");
				return false;
			}
			JToken jToken2 = jToken.SelectToken("Persistent.StrandedWorld");
			if (jToken2.IsNullOrDestroyed() || !jToken2.HasValues)
			{
				Debug.LogError("SaveManager:: Error loading save file. Stranded world data was null or empty.");
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			Debug.LogError("SaveManager:: Error loading save file:\n\n" + ex);
			return false;
		}
	}

	public static Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject LoadSaveFile(GameMode mode)
	{
		if (!TryGetSaveFilePath(mode, out var saveFilePath))
		{
			Debug.LogError($"SaveManager::LoadSaveFile:: Error loading {mode} save file. File does not exist.");
			return null;
		}
		Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject jObject = null;
		using (FileStream stream = new FileStream(saveFilePath, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read))
		{
			using StreamReader streamReader = new StreamReader(stream);
			jObject = new Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject(streamReader.ReadToEnd());
		}
		if (jObject.IsNull())
		{
			Debug.LogError("SaveManager::LoadSaveFile:: Error loading save file. Data was null or empty.");
			return null;
		}
		Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject jObject2 = jObject.Get("Persistent/StrandedWorld");
		if (jObject2.IsNullOrDestroyed() || jObject2.IsNull())
		{
			Debug.LogError("SaveManager::LoadSaveFile:: Error loading save file. Stranded world data was null or empty.");
			return null;
		}
		Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject field = jObject.GetField("CustomSettings");
		if (field != null)
		{
			GameSettings gameSettings = new GameSettings();
			if (!SavingUtilities.Load(gameSettings, field))
			{
				Debug.LogError("SaveManager::Load:: Could not load [CustomSettings] data.");
			}
			Options.CustomSettings = gameSettings;
		}
		else
		{
			Debug.LogError("SaveManager::Load:: Old Save Detected. No [CustomSettings] data was found.");
		}
		return jObject;
	}

	public static JToken LoadSaveFileFast(string path)
	{
		try
		{
			using FileStream stream = new FileStream(path, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.ReadWrite);
			using StreamReader reader = new StreamReader(stream);
			using JsonTextReader reader2 = new JsonTextReader(reader);
			JToken jToken = JToken.ReadFrom(reader2);
			if (jToken == null)
			{
				throw new Exception("Root data null.");
			}
			if (!jToken.HasValues)
			{
				throw new Exception("Root data empty.");
			}
			return jToken;
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			Debug.LogError("SaveManager:: Error loading save file:\n\n" + ex);
			return null;
		}
	}

	public static void BackupSaveFiles(string suffix = "")
	{
		if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(suffix))
		{
			suffix = "_BACKUP";
		}
		if (TryGetSaveFilePath(GameMode.SinglePlayer, out var saveFilePath))
		{
			string destFileName = saveFilePath + suffix;
			File.Copy(saveFilePath, destFileName, overwrite: true);
		}
		if (TryGetSaveFilePath(GameMode.Coop_2, out saveFilePath))
		{
			string destFileName2 = saveFilePath + suffix;
			File.Copy(saveFilePath, destFileName2, overwrite: true);
		}
		if (TryGetSaveFilePath(GameMode.Coop_Server, out saveFilePath))
		{
			string destFileName3 = saveFilePath + suffix;
			File.Copy(saveFilePath, destFileName3, overwrite: true);
		}
	}

	public static void DeleteSaveFile(GameMode mode)
	{
		if (TryGetSaveFilePath(mode, out var saveFilePath) && File.Exists(saveFilePath))
		{
			File.Delete(saveFilePath);
			DeletedSaveFile?.Invoke(mode);
		}
	}

	public static void DeleteSaveFiles()
	{
		DeleteSaveFile(GameMode.SinglePlayer);
		DeleteSaveFile(GameMode.Coop_2);
		DeleteSaveFile(GameMode.Coop_Server);
	}

	public static void SaveGame(IPlayer invokingPlayer)
	{
		if (_isSaving)
		{
			return;
		}
		_isSaving = true;
		MultiplayerMng.UpdateSessionToken_IsBusy(isBusy: true);
		ReplicateSavingState(saving: true);
		Save(invokingPlayer, (int result) =>
		{
			MultiplayerMng.UpdateSessionToken_IsBusy(isBusy: false);
			ReplicateSavingState(saving: false);
			if (result == 0)
			{
				LocalizedNotification.Post(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer, NotificationPriority.Immediate, 4f, "BED_NTF_SAVED_DESC");
				new ReplicateSavedNotificationMsg().Post();
			}
			else
			{
				ReplicateSaveErrorDialogue(invokingPlayer, result);
			}
			_isSaving = false;
		});
	}

	private static void ReplicateSavingState(bool saving)
	{
		Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer();
		UpdateSavingSpinner(saving);
		ReplicateSavingStateMsg replicateSavingStateMsg = new ReplicateSavingStateMsg();
		replicateSavingStateMsg.Saving = saving;
		replicateSavingStateMsg.Post();
	}

		}
	}

	private static CoroutineHandle Save(IPlayer player, SaveCallback callback)
	{
		return Timing.RunCoroutine(Save_Sequence(player, callback));
	}

	private static IEnumerator<float> Save_Sequence(IPlayer player, SaveCallback callback)
	{
		bool succeeded = true;
		Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject save = new Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject();
		Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject persistent = new Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject();
		yield return Timing.WaitUntilDone(Timing.Instance.RunCoroutine(GenerateSave_Sequence(save, persistent), (Exception ex) =>
		{
			if (ex != null)
			{
				succeeded = false;
				Debug.LogException(ex);
				callback(57005);
			}
		}));
		if (!succeeded)
		{
			yield break;
		}
		yield return Timing.WaitUntilDone(Timing.Instance.RunCoroutine(AfterSave_Sequence(player, save, callback), (Exception ex) =>
		{
			if (ex != null)
			{
				succeeded = false;
				Debug.LogException(ex);
				callback(48879);
			}
		}));
	}

	private static IEnumerator<float> AfterSave_Sequence(IPlayer player, Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject save, SaveCallback callback)
	{
		try
		{
			BeforeWrite?.Invoke(save);
		}
		catch (Exception)
		{
			Debug.Log("SaveManager::Save:: Errors were thrown in BeforeWrite event.");
			throw;
		}
		using (FileStream stream = new FileStream(GetSaveFilePath(Game.Mode), FileMode.Create, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.ReadWrite))
		{
			using StreamWriter streamWriter = new StreamWriter(stream);
			string value = save.ToString();
			streamWriter.Write(value);
		}
		Debug.LogError("Yield 4");
		yield return 0f;
		int result = 0;
		callback(result);
		Debug.LogError("Yield 5");
		yield return 0f;
		GC.Collect();
		Debug.LogError("Garbage collect finished");
	}

	public static IEnumerator<float> GenerateSave_Sequence(Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject save, Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject persistent)
	{
		try
		{
			PreSave?.Invoke();
		}
		catch (Exception)
		{
			Debug.Log("SaveManager::Save:: Errors were thrown in PreSave event.");
			throw;
		}
		PlayerRegistry.Save();
		try
		{
			PreSave?.Invoke();
		}
		catch (Exception ex2)
		{
			Debug.Log("SaveManager::Save:: Errors were thrown in PreSave event.\n\n" + ex2);
		}
		Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject data = PlayerRegistry.Save();
		persistent.AddField("PlayerRegistry", data);
		(from behaviour in UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsOfType<MonoBehaviour>()
			where behaviour is IPersistentSaveable
			orderby !(behaviour is StrandedWorld)
			select behaviour).Cast<IPersistentSaveable>().ToList().ForEach((IPersistentSaveable saveable) =>
		{
			Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject jObject2 = SavingUtilities.Save(saveable);
			if (jObject2 != null)
			{
				persistent.AddField(saveable.GetType().Name, jObject2);
			}
			else
			{
				Debug.LogError("SaveManager::Save:: Error saving a persistent object.\n\nName: " + saveable.GetType().Name);
			}
		});
		save.AddField("Version", BuildInformation.BuildVersion.ToPaddedString());
		save.AddField("Persistent", persistent);
		LevelLoader.Instance?.PatchServerClientCopy(save);
		Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject jObject = SavingUtilities.Save(Options.CustomSettings);
		if (jObject != null)
		{
			save.AddField("CustomSettings", jObject);
		}
		yield return 0f;
	}

	public static bool SaveToFile(string path, Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject rootData)
	{
		if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))
		{
			Debug.LogError("Path is null or empty!");
			return false;
		}
		if (rootData == null || rootData.IsNull())
		{
			Debug.LogError("Root data is null or empty!");
			return false;
		}
		try
		{
			using FileStream stream = new FileStream(path, FileMode.Create, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.ReadWrite);
			using StreamWriter streamWriter = new StreamWriter(stream);
			streamWriter.Write(rootData.ToString());
			return true;
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			Debug.Log("SaveManager:: Error saving progress:\n\n" + ex);
		}
		return false;
	}

	public static void Save(GameMode mode, Beam.Serialization.Json.JObject save)
	{
		SaveToFile(GetSaveFilePath(mode), save);
	}

	public static bool ChangeCurrentSlot(int slotID)
	{
		Debug.Log("SaveManager:: Selecting slot " + slotID);
		int lastSaveSlotUsed = Options.GeneralSettings.LastSaveSlotUsed;
		Options.GeneralSettings.LastSaveSlotUsed = slotID;
		string slotFolderName = FilePath.GetSlotFolderName(slotID);
		FilePath.WORLD_FOLDER = PathTools.Combine(FilePath.SAVE_FOLDER, slotFolderName, "World");
		FilePath.HEIGHTMAPS_FOLDER = PathTools.Combine(FilePath.SAVE_FOLDER, slotFolderName, "Heightmaps");
		return lastSaveSlotUsed != slotID;
	}

	private static void ReplicateSaveErrorDialogue(IPlayer invokingPlayer, int resultCode)
	{
		if (invokingPlayer.Id == PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.Id)
		{
			UpdateSavingSpinner(active: false);
			int pId = invokingPlayer.Id;
			int prevMap = invokingPlayer.Input.GetCurrentMapId();
			invokingPlayer.Input.GetOtherPlayers().DisableMaps();
			invokingPlayer.Input.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: false, prevMap);
			invokingPlayer.Input.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: true, 16);
			invokingPlayer.Input.SetCursorEnabled(enabled: true);
			string prettyResultMsg = resultCode.GetPrettyResultMsg("SAVE_DB_ERROR_SAVING_DESC");
			DialogueBox.Show(PlayerRegistry.LocalPlayer.Input, "SAVE_DB_ERROR_TITLE", prettyResultMsg, DialogueButton.Ok, DialogueIcon.Warning).Accept += () =>
			{
				IPlayer playerFromId = PlayerUtilities.GetPlayerFromId(pId);
				playerFromId.Input.GetOtherPlayers().RestoreMapsEnabled();
				playerFromId.Input.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: false, 16);
				playerFromId.Input.SetAndCacheMapsEnabled(state: true, prevMap);
				playerFromId.Input.SetCursorEnabled(enabled: false);
			};
		}
		else if (Game.Mode.IsServer())
		{
			ReplicateSaveErrorDialogueMsg replicateSaveErrorDialogueMsg = new ReplicateSaveErrorDialogueMsg();
			replicateSaveErrorDialogueMsg.InvokingPlayer = invokingPlayer;
			replicateSaveErrorDialogueMsg.ResultCode = resultCode;
			replicateSaveErrorDialogueMsg.Post();
		}
	}

	public static CoroutineHandle SaveInternal(IPlayer player, SaveCallback callback)
	{
		return Save(player, callback);
	}
}

	private void afsLightingSettings()
	{
		if (DirectionalLightReference != null)
		{
			DirectlightDir = DirectionalLightReference.transform.forward;
			if (Sunlight == null)
			{
				Sunlight = DirectionalLightReference.GetComponent<Light>();
			}
			if (!Sunlight.enabled)
			{
				Shader.SetGlobalVector("_AfsDirectSunDir", new Vector4(0f, 0f, 0f, 0f));
			}
			else
			{
				SunLightCol = new Vector3(Sunlight.color.r, Sunlight.color.g, Sunlight.color.b) * Sunlight.intensity;
				SunLuminance = Vector3.Dot(SunLightCol, new Vector3(0.22f, 0.707f, 0.071f));
				Shader.SetGlobalVector("_AfsDirectSunDir", new Vector4(DirectlightDir.x, DirectlightDir.y, DirectlightDir.z, SunLuminance));
				Shader.SetGlobalVector("_AfsDirectSunCol", SunLightCol);
			}
		}
		else
		{
			Shader.SetGlobalVector("_AfsDirectSunDir", new Vector4(0f, 0f, 0f, 0f));
			Shader.SetGlobalVector("_AfsDirectSunCol", new Vector3(0f, 0f, 0f));
		}
		UpdateLightingForClassicBillboards();
		Shader.SetGlobalVector("_AfsSpecFade", new Vector4(AfsSpecFade.x, AfsSpecFade.y, 1f, 1f));
		if (GrassApproxTrans)
		{
			Shader.EnableKeyword("_AFS_GRASS_APPROXTRANS");
		}
		else
		{
			Shader.DisableKeyword("_AFS_GRASS_APPROXTRANS");
		}
	}

	private void afsUpdateWind()
	{
		if (SyncWindDir)
		{
			Wind = new Vector4(transform.forward.x, transform.forward.y, transform.forward.z, Wind.w);
		}
		TempWind = Wind;
		TempWind.w *= 2f;
		Shader.SetGlobalVector("_Wind", TempWind);
		Shader.SetGlobalFloat("_WindFrequency", WindFrequency);
		domainTime_Wind += temp_WindFrequency * Time.deltaTime * 2f;
		domainTime_2ndBending += Time.deltaTime;
		Shader.SetGlobalVector("_AfsTimeFrequency", new Vector4(domainTime_Wind, domainTime_2ndBending, 0.375f * (1f + temp_WindFrequency * LeafTurbulenceFoliageShader), 0.193f * (1f + temp_WindFrequency * LeafTurbulenceFoliageShader)));
		temp_WindFrequency = Mathf.MoveTowards(temp_WindFrequency, WindFrequency, freqSpeed);
		SinusWave = Mathf.Sin(domainTime_Wind);
		TriangleWaves = SmoothTriangleWave(new Vector4(SinusWave, SinusWave * 0.8f, 0f, 0f));
		Oscillation = TriangleWaves.x + TriangleWaves.y * TriangleWaves.y;
		Oscillation = (Oscillation + 8f) * 0.125f * TempWind.w;
		TempWind.x *= Oscillation;
		TempWind.z *= Oscillation;
		Shader.SetGlobalFloat("_AfsWaveSize", 0.5f / WaveSizeFoliageShader);
		Shader.SetGlobalFloat("_AfsWindJitterScale", WindJitterScaleForGrassshader * 10f);
		Shader.SetGlobalVector("_AfsGrassWind", TempWind * WindMultiplierForGrassshader);
		domainTime_Grass += temp_WindJitterFrequency * Time.deltaTime;
		temp_WindJitterFrequency = Mathf.MoveTowards(temp_WindJitterFrequency, WindJitterFrequencyForGrassshader, freqSpeed);
		GrassWindSpeed = domainTime_Grass * 0.1f;
		Shader.SetGlobalVector("_AfsWaveAndDistance", new Vector4(GrassWindSpeed, WaveSizeForGrassshader, TempWind.w, DetailDistanceForGrassShader * DetailDistanceForGrassShader));
		Shader.SetGlobalVector("_AFSWindMuliplier", WindMuliplierForTreeShader);
	}

	private void afsUpdateGrassTreesBillboards()
	{
		Shader.SetGlobalColor("_AfsWavingTint", GrassWavingTint);
		Shader.SetGlobalColor("_AfsTreeColor", AFSTreeColor);
		Shader.SetGlobalVector("_AfsTerrainTrees", new Vector4(BillboardStart, BillboardFadeLenght, BillboardFadeOutLength, 0f));
		if (BillboardAdjustToCamera)
		{
			if ((bool)Camera.main)
			{
				MainCam = Camera.main;
				CameraForward = MainCam.transform.forward;
				ShadowCameraForward = CameraForward;
				rollingX = MainCam.transform.eulerAngles.x;
				if (rollingX >= 270f)
				{
					rollingX -= 270f;
					rollingX = 90f - rollingX;
					rollingXShadow = rollingX;
				}
				else
				{
					rollingXShadow = 0f - rollingX;
					if (rollingX > BillboardAngleLimit)
					{
						rollingX = Mathf.Lerp(rollingX, 0f, rollingX / BillboardAngleLimit - 1f);
					}
					rollingX *= -1f;
				}
			}
		}
		else
		{
			rollingX = 0f;
			rollingXShadow = 0f;
		}
		CameraForward *= rollingX / 90f;
		ShadowCameraForward *= rollingXShadow / 90f;
		Shader.SetGlobalVector("_AfsBillboardCameraForward", new Vector4(CameraForward.x, CameraForward.y, CameraForward.z, 1f));
		Shader.SetGlobalVector("_AfsBillboardShadowCameraForward", new Vector4(ShadowCameraForward.x, ShadowCameraForward.y, ShadowCameraForward.z, 1f));
	}

	private void afsSetupCameraLayerCulling()

			{
				float[] array = new float[32];
				array = Camera.allCameras[i].layerCullDistances;
				array[8] = SmallDetailsDistance;
				array[9] = MediumDetailsDistance;
				Camera.allCameras[i].layerCullDistances = array;
				array = null;
			}
		}
	}

	private void UpdateLightingForClassicBillboards()
	{
		if (RenderSettings.ambientMode == AmbientMode.Skybox)
		{
			AmbientLightingSH = true;
			UdpateSHLightingforBillboards();
			Shader.EnableKeyword("AFS_SH_AMBIENT");
			Shader.DisableKeyword("AFS_COLOR_AMBIENT");
			Shader.DisableKeyword("AFS_GRADIENT_AMBIENT");
		}
		else if (RenderSettings.ambientMode == AmbientMode.Trilight)
		{
			AmbientLightingSH = false;
			if (isLinear)
			{
				Shader.SetGlobalColor("_AfsSkyColor", RenderSettings.ambientSkyColor.linear);
				Shader.SetGlobalColor("_AfsGroundColor", RenderSettings.ambientGroundColor.linear);
				Shader.SetGlobalColor("_AfsEquatorColor", RenderSettings.ambientEquatorColor.linear);
			}
			else
			{
				Shader.SetGlobalColor("_AfsSkyColor", RenderSettings.ambientSkyColor);
				Shader.SetGlobalColor("_AfsGroundColor", RenderSettings.ambientGroundColor);
				Shader.SetGlobalColor("_AfsEquatorColor", RenderSettings.ambientEquatorColor);
			}
			Shader.DisableKeyword("AFS_SH_AMBIENT");
			Shader.DisableKeyword("AFS_COLOR_AMBIENT");
			Shader.EnableKeyword("AFS_GRADIENT_AMBIENT");
		}
		else if (RenderSettings.ambientMode == AmbientMode.Flat)
		{
			AmbientLightingSH = false;
			Shader.SetGlobalVector("_AfsAmbientColor", RenderSettings.ambientLight);
			Shader.DisableKeyword("AFS_SH_AMBIENT");
			Shader.EnableKeyword("AFS_COLOR_AMBIENT");
			Shader.DisableKeyword("AFS_GRADIENT_AMBIENT");
		}
	}

	private void UdpateSHLightingforBillboards()
	{
		fLight[0].x = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[0, 0];
		fLight[0].y = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[1, 0];
		fLight[0].z = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[2, 0];
		fLight[1].x = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[0, 1];
		fLight[1].y = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[1, 1];
		fLight[1].z = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[2, 1];
		fLight[2].x = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[0, 2];
		fLight[2].y = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[1, 2];
		fLight[2].z = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[2, 2];
		fLight[3].x = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[0, 3];
		fLight[3].y = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[1, 3];
		fLight[3].z = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[2, 3];
		fLight[4].x = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[0, 4];
		fLight[4].y = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[1, 4];
		fLight[4].z = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[2, 4];
		fLight[5].x = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[0, 5];
		fLight[5].y = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[1, 5];
		fLight[5].z = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[2, 5];
		fLight[6].x = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[0, 6];
		fLight[6].y = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[1, 6];
		fLight[6].z = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[2, 6];
		fLight[7].x = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[0, 7];
		fLight[7].y = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[1, 7];
		fLight[7].z = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[2, 7];
		fLight[8].x = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[0, 8];
		fLight[8].y = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[1, 8];
		fLight[8].z = RenderSettings.ambientProbe[2, 8];
		float num = 3.5449078f;
		float num2 = 1f / (2f * num);
		float num3 = Mathf.Sqrt(3f) / (3f * num);
		float num4 = Mathf.Sqrt(15f) / (8f * num);
		float num5 = Mathf.Sqrt(5f) / (16f * num);
		float num6 = 0.5f * num4;
		for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
		{
			vCoeff[i].x = (0f - num3) * fLight[3][i];
			vCoeff[i].y = (0f - num3) * fLight[1][i];
			vCoeff[i].z = num3 * fLight[2][i];
			vCoeff[i].w = num2 * fLight[0][i] - num5 * fLight[6][i];
		}
		Shader.SetGlobalVector("afs_SHAr", vCoeff[0] * RenderSettings.ambientIntensity);
		Shader.SetGlobalVector("afs_SHAg", vCoeff[1] * RenderSettings.ambientIntensity);
		Shader.SetGlobalVector("afs_SHAb", vCoeff[2] * RenderSettings.ambientIntensity);
		for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
		{
			vCoeff[i].x = num4 * fLight[4][i];
			vCoeff[i].y = (0f - num4) * fLight[5][i];
			vCoeff[i].z = 3f * num5 * fLight[6][i];
			vCoeff[i].w = (0f - num4) * fLight[7][i];
		}
		Shader.SetGlobalVector("afs_SHBr", vCoeff[0] * RenderSettings.ambientIntensity);
		Shader.SetGlobalVector("afs_SHBg", vCoeff[1] * RenderSettings.ambientIntensity);
		Shader.SetGlobalVector("afs_SHBb", vCoeff[2] * RenderSettings.ambientIntensity);
		vCoeff[0].x = num6 * fLight[8][0];
		vCoeff[0].y = num6 * fLight[8][1];
		vCoeff[0].z = num6 * fLight[8][2];
		vCoeff[0].w = 1f;
		Shader.SetGlobalVector("afs_SHC", vCoeff[0] * RenderSettings.ambientIntensity);
	}

	private Color Desaturate(float r, float g, float b)
	{
		float num = 0.3f * r + 0.59f * g + 0.11f * b;
		r = num * BillboardAmbientLightDesaturationFactor + r * (1f - BillboardAmbientLightDesaturationFactor);
		g = num * BillboardAmbientLightDesaturationFactor + g * (1f - BillboardAmbientLightDesaturationFactor);
		b = num * BillboardAmbientLightDesaturationFactor + b * (1f - BillboardAmbientLightDesaturationFactor);
		return new Color(r, g, b, 1f);
	}

	private float CubicSmooth(float x)
	{
		return x * x * (3f - 2f * x);
	}

	private float TriangleWave(float x)
	{
		return Mathf.Abs((x + 0.5f) % 1f * 2f - 1f);
	}

	private float SmoothTriangleWave(float x)
	{
		return CubicSmooth(TriangleWave(x));
	}

	private Vector4 CubicSmooth(Vector4 x)
	{
		x = Vector4.Scale(x, x);
		x = Vector4.Scale(x, new Vector4(3f, 3f, 3f, 3f) - 2f * x);
		return x;
	}

	private Vector4 TriangleWave(Vector4 x)
	{
		x = (x + new Vector4(0.5f, 0.5f, 0.5f, 0.5f)) * 2f - new Vector4(1f, 1f, 1f, 1f);
		return AbsVecFour(x);
	}

	private Vector4 SmoothTriangleWave(Vector4 x)
	{
		return CubicSmooth(TriangleWave(x));
	}

	private Vector4 FracVecFour(Vector4 a)
	{
		a.x %= 1f;
		a.y %= 1f;
		a.z %= 1f;
		a.w %= 1f;
		return a;
	}

	private Vector4 AbsVecFour(Vector4 a)
	{
		a.x = Mathf.Abs(a.x);
		a.y = Mathf.Abs(a.y);
		a.z = Mathf.Abs(a.z);
		a.w = Mathf.Abs(a.w);
		return a;
	}
}

	private IEnumerator<float> CreateWorld_Sequence()
	{
		if (!Game.Mode.IsMultiplayer())
		{
			EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent("LOADING_PROGRESS_TEXT_LOADING_WORLD"));
			yield return 0f;
			LoadWorld();
		}
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent("LOADING_PROGRESS_TEXT_LOADING_OBJECTS"));
		yield return 0f;
		LoadObjects();
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new LoadingProgressChangedEvent("LOADING_PROGRESS_TEXT_LOADING_STARTING_ZONE"));
		yield return 0f;
		InitializeZones();
		int index = 0;
		Zone zone = FindClosestZone(Vector3.zero, out index);
		if (zone != null && index != -1)
		{
			JObject zoneData = GetZoneData(zone);
			if (zoneData != null)
			{
				zone.Enter();
				ZoneLoader.EObjectProcessingMode mode = _zoneLoader.ObjectProcessingMode;
				_zoneLoader.ObjectProcessingMode = ZoneLoader.EObjectProcessingMode.Faster;
				JObject field = zoneData.GetField("Objects");
				if (field != null && !field.IsNull())
				{
					zone.LoadImpostors(field);
					yield return _zoneLoader.LoadZone_Async(zone, zoneData);
				}
				else
				{
					_zoneLoader.GenerateZone(zone);
					zone.CreateImpostors();
					yield return _zoneLoader.CreateZoneObjects_Async(zone, index);
				}
				_zoneLoader.ObjectProcessingMode = mode;
			}
			else
			{
				Debug.LogError("StrandedWorld::LoadAsync:: Something went wrong. No starting zone data was found.");
			}
		}
		else
		{
			Debug.LogError("StrandedWorld::LoadAsync:: Something went wrong. No starting zone was found.");
		}
		Initialize_shelterTypes();
		SetShelterOnZones();
		SetSheltersOnWorldZones();
		OnWorldGenerated();
		OnZoneEntered(zone);
		EventManager.RaiseEvent(new AddStatsEvent(0, new Stats
		{
			IslandsExplored = 1
		}));
		SubscribeToZoneLoaderEvents();
		InvokeRepeating("PollZones", 0f, 0.3f);
	}

	private void SubscribeToZoneLoaderEvents()
	{
		_zoneLoader.CreatedZone += ZoneLoader_LoadedZone;
		_zoneLoader.LoadedZone += ZoneLoader_LoadedZone;
	}

	private void UnsubscribeFromZoneLoaderEvents()
	{

		{
			_zoneLoader.CreatedZone -= ZoneLoader_LoadedZone;
			_zoneLoader.LoadedZone -= ZoneLoader_LoadedZone;
		}
	}

	}

			Texture2D shore = WorldTools.CreateShoreMaskTexture(zone.Terrain.terrainData);

				int value2 = jObject.GetField("Version").GetValue<int>();
				if (map.EditorData.Id != value || map.EditorData.VersionNumber != value2)
				{
					JObject jObject2 = new JObject();
					jObject2.AddField("Name", map.EditorData.Name);
					jObject2.AddField("Id", map.EditorData.Id);
					jObject2.AddField("Version", map.EditorData.VersionNumber);
					if (map.IsCustomMap())
					{
						jObject2.AddField("Objects", map.ObjectData);
					}
					jObject = jObject2;
				}
				JObject field3 = jObject.GetField("Discovered");
				if (field3 != null)
				{
					bool value3 = field3.GetValue<bool>();
					zone.HasVisited = value3;
				}
				JObject field4 = jObject.GetField("Attributes");
				if (field4 != null)
				{
					SavingUtilities.Load(zone.Attributes, field4);
				}
				JObject field5 = jObject.GetField("Objects");
				if (field5 != null && !field5.IsNull())
				{
					zone.HasObjectsForBillboard = true;
				}
				_zoneSavedObjectsLookup.Add(zone.gameObject.name, jObject);
